rows.name: Fart Game
rows.short_description: In this hilarious and challenging game, it's all about holding in your fart until the perfect moment! Time and manage your farts wisely, because the more you let slip, the more aware your colleagues become.
rows.description_html: In this hilarious and challenging game, it's all about holding in your fart until the perfect moment! Relieve pressure strategically while navigating through a workplace full of suspicious coworkers. Time and manage your farts wisely, because the more you let slip, the more aware your colleagues become. Can you balance the urge to fart and keep your cover intact, or will you be caught in the act? See how long you can survive the pressure in this unique blend of stealth and comedy!

rows.name: Last Spirit Origin
rows.short_description: Play solo or with up to 4 players in Last Spirit Origin, a fast-paced roguelike adventure. Crash-land on your former home, now an alien-infested world, and battle relentless machine foes. Combine loot to power up and master each character. Use sharp combat and smart strategy to conquer the chaos.
rows.description_html: Last Spirit Origin is a fast-paced rogue-like adventure for up to four people. After you crash-land on your former home, now a chaotic alien world, you will face relentless machine enemies. Combine loot in surprising ways to enhance your abilities and master each character as you fight through hordes of frenzied robots. Use skillful combat and strategic planning to become the havoc you feared upon your first crash landing.

rows.name: The Laziest Person In The World Competition
rows.short_description: Do nothing. Absolutely nothing. Compete with slobs from around the world in the ultimate contest of doing nothing. Stay passive the longest and be crowned The Laziest Person in the World.
rows.description_html: Welcome to the most lethargic competition on the planet, where doing absolutely nothing makes you the best in the world. Are you the type of person who’d call a taxi to take you to the bathroom? Do you dream of having room service for your own kitchen? Do you own a pair of sweatpants for every day of the week? Then this competition is for you! There’s only one rule, and one rule only: The longer you stay lazy, the higher you’ll climb on the leaderboard.

rows.name: BlightFog
rows.short_description: Journey across a dying world. Manage your resources. Build relationships with anthropomorphic characters. Find a new home or become a fuel drinking madman.
rows.description_html: BlightFog is a short, narrative driven RPG, where you travel across a post apocalyptic world on a bike while taking care of an infant. On the way you will meet other anthropomorphic characters. Solve conflicts and build relationships through dialogues. Allocate resources between you and the child, find unique items that will influence dialogues and give you new ways to approach different situations. Your goal is to save the child's mother and get them both to safety. Will you chose the longer and safer paths, or risk to save time and fuel and take the shorter but more dangerous ones? Will you let the child starve or sacrifice your own well-being for him? Will you be a pretend-hero, a coward or a fuel-drinking madman who refuses to wear clothes? Features: Story heavy RPG where you can: drink fuel, run around naked and destroy the world (maybe) Game remembers your choices Choose the safe or fast paths Meet different antropomorphic characters and build relationships with them Light resource management Multiple endings

rows.name: Hex Bots
rows.short_description: You are hunted by a rogue computer program. Avoid the bot either by yourself or cooperate with others while attempting to collect electrical components around the world to activate beacons to open the escape hatch.
rows.description_html: You are hunted by a rogue computer program. Avoid the bot either by yourself or cooperate with others while attempting to collect electrical components around the world to activate beacons to open the escape hatch. Hex Bots is a horror chaser game where you can play alone or with up to 3 other players. Your goal is to pick up electrical components in order to connect circuits on the computers scattered around the map, all while avoiding the demonic rogue artificial intelligence called Ounce. Hex Bots is best enjoyed as an online party game. There are various objectives, some that advances direct progression, and others that give you permanent boosts, and the players decide who will work on what. KEY FEATURES Frantically collect components in order to activate PCs around the map by completing a circuit connecting mini game. Experience the feeling of wandering through a forgotten and unfinished world. Nothing is as it seems here. A liminal space with no cohesion or rules. Got friends? The game will get no easier as the the rogue program will dynamically adapt to how many people you play with. You're not entirely without tricks. Discover different side objectives in order to gain certain advantages to help you succeed.

rows.name: Dead Abyss
rows.short_description: A short first-person horror experience that places you in the rusted out hull of a mysteriously abandoned shipwreck. Search for clues, solve puzzles, and uncover the mystery of the wreckage, but beware of the evil that lurks within.
rows.description_html: Story On September 12th, 1977, the South Atlantic Shipping Company vessel SASC Abyss inexplicably lost communication and beached herself on a small desolate island south of Mwali. Years later Sadiiq Waaberi boards the dilapidated vessel in search of valuable artifacts and salvage, but dreams of fortune quickly become nightmares as the mystery behind the shipwreck begins to unfold. Gameplay Something lurks the desolate halls of the Abyss, and your only hope for survival is to avoid it by any means necessary. Hide in lockers and under desks, manage your breathing, and when all else fails... run. Setting Set in modern day, explore the 70s era wreckage of the ultra-large container vessel, rusted from years of exposure to the elements, and in complete disarray from the land collision she suffered years ago. You'll explore the deck, engine room, living quarters, and hospital ward as you learn more about her dark history. Prologue The story of Dead Abyss will be told episodically. This prologue chapter introduces players to the mystery of the Abyss' disappearance and provides a taste of what's to come.

rows.name: Bloodlust
rows.short_description: Bloodlust is a dark gothic short narrative exploration game in which you play as Vandor, a vampire desperately trying to survive in the daytime. Your only goal is to quench your bloodlust by taking down the plagued townspeople to give yourself enough strength to reach the safety of your castle.
rows.description_html: In a remote medieval town burdened with plague, you play as a bloodthirsty vampire lurking in the shadows of a dark alleyway. Arriving late from your nightly hunt, you must attack unsuspecting prey and drink their blood to survive the harsh daylight. Bloodlust is a short narrative exploration game in which you play as Vandor, a vampire desperately trying to survive in the daytime. Your only goal is to quench your bloodlust by taking down the plagued townspeople to give yourself enough strength to reach the safety of your castle. The game features a dark and gothic environment, an engaging story and a vampire blood drinking mechanic. Bloodlust was a solo project produced in Unreal Engine 5 by Laela Russell (Environment artist) as a Ringling College thesis project in 2024.

rows.name: Cats Fishing for Cats
rows.short_description: This game is about fishing with your cat, surrounded by the sounds of nature. Just hang out with your cat and you will get a new cat at regular intervals. You can earn Paw Points by petting the cat or convert the cat you have into Paw Points to get a new cat.
rows.description_html: This app is a game to Chill with the sound of waves and cats. You can get new cats on a regular basis just by hanging out with your cat. You can earn Paw Points by petting the cats or convert the cats you have into Paw Points and save 100 Paw to get a new cat. You can change the countdown to the current time or change the window size to function as a delivery overlay. If you like cats, you'll love it.

rows.name: Lower? higher!: buy or bye
rows.short_description: your pawnshop will usher in guests with different needs every day, bargain with them, let the income soar! With the expansion of pawnshops, activities such as sending shop assistants and responding to emergencies are also essential. you seem ordinary transaction may cause the butterfly effect.
rows.description_html: 「Bargaining」as the core, with the cyberpunk style of art performance, 《lower? higher!》 wants to provide you with a different experience of pawnshop operation. You will trade with customers with different needs, and in the process, you can speculate on the psychology of the customer, change the properties of the product, or directly pray to the dice god -- these various business methods can help you achieve the maximum profit of the pawnshop. All kinds of guests have different personalities and preferences, and it is not easy to entertain them. It is possible to achieve the purpose of trade by mobilizing different bargaining strategies. The same product in different customers also have different valuation, as soon as possible to sell or wait for a predestined person? It's up to you. Instead of wasting the money you've already paid, use the special skills of a shop assistant. What if there's a surprise? As a pawnshop owner, you also have to deal with tax collector, missionary priests, suspicious people looking flustered, etc...Note that some customers will also come with something in mind, and the price level will quietly fan the butterfly effect on them. Buy and sell in the cyber world, there is unexpected humor and fun, one click to join the wish list, to make it the greatest pawnshop in White Star!

rows.name: Three Doors: Labyrinth of Fear
rows.short_description: Trapped in darkness, you've lived in fear for as long as you can remember. Now, thirty rooms stand between you and freedom. Each one holds a deadly challenge, but only one path leads forward. One wrong step, and you're lost forever. Open the door!
rows.description_html: Face your fears, and hope emerges from the shadows. Thirty rooms, each hiding a new danger, where the wrong step can cost you everything. Three doors stand before you, but only one offers a way forward. Solve the puzzles, trust your instincts, and hope it’s enough to escape. One wrong choice, and you’ll be lost to the darkness. Listen carefully, watch closely ' your senses are your only guide. Thirty rooms. One path to freedom. The question is... can you find it? Open the door. Notice: The pictures on the wall in the game are generated by AI. The narrator voices in the game are AI-generated. Average playtime: 60 - 120 minutes.

rows.name: Manny's Murderous Movie Theater - The Snackbar Simulator
rows.short_description: Step into The Mirage, a haunted cinema where you'll serve snacks, upgrade your shop, and meet chilling quotas—all while dodging the eerie gaze of Manny the Clown, the masked killer and cinema manager!
rows.description_html: Welcome to The Mirage: Your shift starts now 🎃 Manny's Murderous Movie Theater is a free prologue to Massacre at the Mirage ! If you enjoy Manny's, be sure to check out the full game, which includes both simulation and story modes. Massacre at the Mirage launches on October 28—add it to your wishlist on Steam now! Step into The Mirage, the beloved cinema of this quaint town, and get ready for the chaos! Guests are craving their favorite snacks, and they're not going to be patient. Meanwhile, Manny the Clown—the masked killer and cinema manager—is lurking close, ensuring your service meets his gruesome standards. 🍿 Serve moviegoers their favorite snacks and keep them satisfied 🏬 Upgrade your shop to handle the ever-growing, insatiable crowds 🗡️ Harvest pockets (and possibly organs) to meet your quotas 👻 Customize your experience with spooky collectibles

rows.name: Im Bann Der Dunklen Jagd
rows.short_description: Dive into an immersive co-op horror experience with a friend. As detectives, you’ll search for clues in a sinister area and must survive the horrors lurking within. Work together to find all the objects and escape before doom catches up with you.
rows.description_html: Im Bann Der Dunklen Jagd invites you and a friend to an immersive co-op horror adventure, where you take on the role of detectives sent into a mysterious area. Your task is to gather clues and navigate through the eerie scenario. Experience the core gameplay of a level, where teamwork and careful exploration are essential to uncover the location's mystery and escape safely. Gameplay: Cooperative Investigations: This game is designed for two players. Work together to explore the area and find crucial objects. Collecting Objects: Search for clues and items scattered throughout the ominous environment. Your detective skills will be put to the test. Features: Three Levels: Dive into three exciting levels where you work together to gather clues, solve puzzles, and successfully escape the area. Threatening Atmosphere: The scenario is characterized by a gloomy setting and eerie sounds that heighten the tension.

rows.name: Rivalhearts
rows.short_description: Join Noah in his first year of university as he decides to overcome his heartache, pursuing either a tomboy classmate, gorgeous doctor, or junior-year goth!
rows.description_html: Experience university life, love, and strife! Starting university with a major heartache, Noah miraculously meets a tomboy classmate, gorgeous doctor, and junior-year goth all in one day. He soon finds pursuing the love story he wants won't be easy, especially when his cute best friend decides to interfere! Key Features: Every scene is individually drawn! All shown characters are fully voiced! Explores an American university setting! Each romantic interest is a unique experience! The community fuels the story's development! A forever free story, even when it's fully released! Includes an extensive teaser of what's to come next! The cutest childhood best friend 🩷 The most awesomest tomboy ⭐ The scandalously stunning doctor 🍷 The cool senior goth barista ❄️ So, what are you waiting for?! Come try the Rivalhearts journey of campus and romance!

rows.name: Cheetahs Are Meant To Be Fast
rows.short_description: An interactive storybook about how being a fat guy who eats a lot is very morally wrong and not at all awesome or attractive.
rows.description_html: In this interactive storybook that feels straight out of the CD-Rom era, use both pointing AND clicking to guide Chet the Cheetah through his weight loss journey! Then guide him out of it in a thrilling escape from a body-shaming digital dystopia! CONTAINS KINKY SITUATIONS,  (MILDLY) SPOOKY CONTENT AND RADICAL THEMES OF  BODY POSITIVITY SOME PLAYERS MAY FIND MORALLY FRIGHTENING AND CRINGE. NOT FOR CONSUMPTION BY CHILDREN NO MATTER HOW MUCH THEY LOVE 90s STORYBOOK CD-ROMS! FEATURES A short and sweet linear narrative you can play in one sitting. Innovative point 'n' click linguistic puzzle solving that lets you literally rewrite Chet's story! Beautiful cartoon animation in crisp 'n' cutting-edge (for 1996) 640x480px. Full voice acting, with narration by Kingmaker Histories' Meg Molloy Tuten. Twists! Turns! Tummies! Tummies that get BIGGER! Yay!!

rows.name: Janitori
rows.short_description: A chilling horror game mixed with task simulation where you play as a janitor on a night shift at the museum. Your task is to clean and restore its dusty rooms. Try not to disturb what lurks in the shadows.
rows.description_html: Welcome to the night at the museum In this first-person experience, the museum has long been safeguarded by an ancient, mighty Viking artifact, warding off evil spirits for centuries. However, a powerful, dark entity has recently emerged from the shadows, capturing the artifact and shattering the museum's protective seal. This sudden disturbance has caused supernatural chaos, making it a deadly place for any living being. You, as a janitor, find yourself caught in the middle of all this while it's happening. Clean Get ready for some next-level, never-before-seen cleaning action! Explore Uncover the museum's hidden history room by room. Each exhibit holds secrets waiting to be solved. Survive You're not alone on this night shift. Strange things stir in the shadows, and the museum's past isn't as quiet as it seems.

rows.name: UNCHAINED
rows.short_description: UNCHAINED is a psychological horror game where you explore an abandoned virtual desktop hiding a terrible secret. The deeper you look into this 2D and 3D experience, the more secrets you'll uncover about the projects that were left behind by the previous owner.
rows.description_html: This game called UNCHAINED has appeared mysteriously on the store. What started as an innocent Virtual Desktop is filled with puzzles and digital monstrosities looking for a way out. We don't know hat he's planning, but it could be dange- HELLO, FRIEND! My name is Cain, and from now on I'll be your partner in the Digital World while you explore my home. Sounds exciting, right? We're gonna have SO MUCH FUN TOGETHER. I love to solve riddles, and I can interact with your actual computer, now that's cool! You don't know what the Digital World is? With the latest technology in digital rendering we can do so many things together: navigate around the Virtual Desktop interacting with various files, enjoy the handmade 2D graphics and play incredibly fun games that hold all sorts of suprises. You can also meet my four good friends ██████, and visit my home. What's inside my home?  Each of my friend is living in a different area of the house. You can explore the 3D enviroment and learn how they ended up in there for ever . They're very friendly, and I'm sure they will present fun puzzles for you to survive have a blast. You better come in and find out for yourself, I'm sure it'll be an experience you won't forget😊. I've changed my mind, I don't want you inside my house. Get away from it.

rows.name: The Ouroboros Express
rows.short_description: Play as Vivienne Sanssouci, a daring journalist who has been tasked to review the Ouroboros Express. She quickly notices that this is not your regular train—and a devastating secret changes her life forever, and that of the other passengers…
rows.description_html: A majestic train rolls in from the impossible, roiling fog. A charismatic train conductor steps out and welcomes you on. Are the other passengers just some eccentric rich people, or could there be something more? And why do you get the feeling that the conductor is hiding something?  There's only one way to find out. All aboard... Are you ready to uncover their secrets? Play as Vivienne Sanssouci, a daring journalist who has been tasked with reviewing the Ouroboros Express. But this is no mere luxury liner, and a devastating secret soon upends her life and those of the other passengers... Fully voice-acted Multiple Diverse Love Interests Multiple Endings Plenty of content at 50,000+ words 2 Stats-Raising Systems (Attraction & Cosmic Decay)

rows.name: Biodacity The Mansion
rows.short_description: Explore your way through a crooked Mansion in the aftermath of an apocalypse. Biological mutants ravaged the Earth! You are responsible for finding crucial information! Fight horrific creatures that lurk around every corner! Find and upgrade your weapons!
rows.description_html: BIODACITY: THE MANSION keeps its horror tense through atmosphere, inspired by ‘Resident Evil’, ‘Amnesia’, and similar horror titles! Explore your way through a crooked Mansion in the aftermath of an apocalypse. Biological mutants ravaged the Earth! You are responsible for finding crucial information! Fight horrific creatures that lurk around every corner! Find and upgrade your weapons! You are tasked with discovering information about the Biomutants, leading you to a strange mansion out in the middle of nowhere. Sharp Combat Take charge and fight for your survival! There is a variety of enemies with all types of different attacks! Be aware. Engaging Difficulty and Unique Playthroughs Each difficulty comes with different enemy placement, changes in loot, and makes the enemies more aggressive and difficult! This ensures that playing on a harder difficulty will be like playing an entirely different game. In addition to this, some of the loot is randomized to make sure that every playthrough is unique.  Exploration and Puzzles Every nook and cranny will need to be searched to upgrade your gear! This Mansion offers many secrets in the form of loot or upgrades. You’ll want to explore it and solve all of its mysteries. Resource Management Scraping by every combat encounter with little health left! Crafting the necessary ingredients will allow you to manage your resources better as well as crafting ammo for a specific gun. Arsenal Choice Which weapons will you use? Will you find the upgrades for them? There are many weapons to choose from, all with their unique ranges and stats. Building a unique arsenal will be ideal for making it out of The Mansion alive. New Game Unlocks If you play well you’ll unlock better things for next time! There are unlocks that add new items and features to spice up your experience! Playtime This mansion and its secrets will take you upwards of 6 hours to complete… and even then the exploration is not over! Completing the game with certain limitations will unlock new items and features!

rows.name: Blue Rabbit, Black Future
rows.short_description: A thrilling 2D platformer, with cute and minimal pixel art style! Enjoy 24 challenging levels and a couple boss battles, all wrapped in a short but intense story with animated cinematics. A compact and intense experience that’s sure to keep you hooked!
rows.description_html: An exciting 2D platformer with a simple, minimalist pixel art style. Enjoy 24 challenging levels, including some boss fights, all wrapped up in a short but intense story with animated cinematics. With simple yet addictive gameplay and increasing difficulty, it's a compact and intense experience that will keep you hooked! Main game resources: Kenney. Music by Muzstation

rows.name: Rubbish
rows.short_description: Welcome to this garbage treasure trove, a strategy game where you combine these garbage in the most reasonable way you think, and there will always be unexpected rewards! Mysterious and brand new fun awaits you!
rows.description_html: Explore abandoned garbage by people. Don't underestimate these garbage, there are actually many unknown treasures hidden inside！ You don't need to operate it yourself, just hand it over to those work machines! You just need to wait for the machine to find the garbage and then use the garbage found in the garbage dump to combine various projects to create more valuable projects and increase your collection. If you are not satisfied with the synthesized item, you can also decompose it to obtain a small amount of garbage or higher quality garbage again! If you have the opportunity to obtain extremely rare treasures, you can exchange them for physical items! Every 10 types of garbage of the same quality can be combined into corresponding quality of openable packaging.

rows.name: The Mad Pantser
rows.short_description: Dawg, we getting pantsed up in here!
rows.description_html: What Is 'The Mad Pantser'? The Mad Pantser is more than just your typical survival horror game. It’s a tongue-in-cheek, point-and-click journey filled with unexpected twists, mini-games, and a healthy dose of satire. While you may find some creepy moments, this game isn’t about making you sleep with the lights on—it’s about keeping you on your toes and laughing out loud. Why You Should Play : Silly/Fun Gameplay : Dive into a world where you’ll encounter everything from intense 'horror' elements to quirky mini-games and even a full-on chess match! One moment you’re dodging a killer, the next you’re immersed in a retro video game within the game. Every twist keeps things unpredictable! Satirical Storyline : Play as Jon, navigating through absurd, darkly humorous scenarios that poke fun at typical horror tropes. It's a wild ride of witty dialogue, unexpected events, and bizarre encounters. Horror… But Not Too Much! : Sure, it’s labeled as a horror game, but don’t expect sleepless nights filled with fear. Instead, prepare for a rollercoaster of thrills, chills, and a lot of laughs! Join Jon and his friends as they face challenges that are as ridiculous as they are dangerous. Who will survive the madness? Who will figure out what’s really going on? And will Jon ever stop being an idiot? Find out in The Mad Pantser , where survival meets satire, and nothing is ever what it seems. Are you brave enough—or just curious enough—to play?

rows.name: Creepy Crawling
rows.short_description: Horror FPS where you'll be dealing with crawling monsters.
rows.description_html: CONTENT WARNING: CONTAINS IMAGES OF LARGE SPIDERS Our protagonist has awakened in what it seems to be a hospital, and cannot remember anything that happened the day before. He needs to find a way out by discovering what it's lurking in the shadows. Detailed Description of Content Solve puzzles to unlock key equipment to escape the hospital. Navigate a hospital environment by unlocking doors and finding secret passageways.  Once you find the handgun, use it to defend yourself against the giant arachnids. Content The primary enemies of the game are spiders and is not suitable for people with severe arachnophobia. There are no explicit references to sex, violence, or drugs. This game contains jump scares.

rows.name: Adequately Ever After
rows.short_description: Save a princess! Kill an evil mage! Solve puzzles! Or just argue with the narrator and marry someone inappropriate. With dozens of different endings, adventure is yours to command in this satirical fairy tale.
rows.description_html: You are standing on a trail... Wait, you don't like the second person perspective? You think it makes a game sound like a choose your own adventure novel? Very well then... Although before we get started, I'll need to know your name, your preferred pronouns and... Wait, where are you going? We have a princess to save and quests to solve. Quests you might even enjoy, should you try your hand at them. Please, who knows what terrible things will befall the princess if you don't come back. This game won't play itself! Adequately Ever After is a satirical visual novel in which you play a hero tasked with saving a princess, just to uncover a plot that will revolutionize a kingdom. Choose your path forward to achieve one of a dozen unique endings.

rows.name: Loveland's Leap
rows.short_description: Leap into the forest in this 2d puzzle platformer! Swing through the woods, find flies, and solve simple brain teasers. Let the trees envelope you as the water colored backgrounds and kalimba themed music create an unforgettable story book like atmosphere.
rows.description_html: Venture deep into the woods surrounding the outskirts of Loveland Ohio to find... your missing fast food order (of course it got lost again)! In this short but sweet 2d puzzle platformer play as a character inspired by the famous cryptid: The Loveland Frog. Traverse simple yet perplexing obstacles, swing across platforms, collect flies, and leap over gaps while admiring the magical aesthetic designed by our team here at Alcove Devs (unofficial). Will you uncover all three endings? And who is this princess person really?! Loveland's Leap was originally produced for Godot Wild Jam #70. After that initial (very broken) release, we continued working until it was ready to share with the world. We only gave ourselves a summer to create this game, but we hope you fall in love with the beautiful sprites, atmospheric music, and hand-painted watercolor backgrounds just like we did. We invite you to play for free, as well as learn from, explore, and even modify the code at our linked GitHub repository, since all our code is open source!

rows.name: Echoes of the Iron Prison
rows.short_description: Echoes of the Iron Prison is a platform game in which the player, through stealth and manipulation, must guide an amnesiac prisoner out of a steampunk prison while collecting shards of her identity.
rows.description_html: Echoes of the Iron Prison is a 2D platform game. The player guides the prisoner through a series of screens towards the prison exit. To overcome opponents, she will have basic movement with jumps, the option to use stealth, engage in dialogues with good/bad consequences, and, at certain points in the game, engage in direct combat. Along with this, there is interaction with elements of the scenery. On this journey, she will discover more about the prison and about herself. It is possible to lose at certain stealth failures and also by choosing wrong options in dialogues.

rows.name: TattooVR
rows.short_description: TattooVR is an immersive art experience that brings the ancient art of tattooing into the cutting edge of VR. TattooVR also supports VRM-format avatars, so you can upload your favorite characters and design one-of-a-kind tattoos just for them.
rows.description_html: TattooVR is an immersive art experience that brings the ancient art of tattooing into the cutting edge of VR. In TattooVR, you can freely design tattoos on other characters' bodies as if their skin is your canvas, letting you create custom art with a stunningly realistic feel. While it's fun to start by sketching on the default characters, TattooVR also supports VRM-format avatars, so you can upload your favorite characters and design one-of-a-kind tattoos just for them. With robust save and load features, any textures you create can be reused, and modifying VRM characters is easy and intuitive. Designed for worldwide accessibility, TattooVR uses a simple pictogram-based interface without any text, making it easy and intuitive for users from all over the world to enjoy. A detailed official tutorial video is available, so even beginners can dive right in with confidence. Express your unique blend of tradition and creativity in VR, and discover the limitless potential of art in an entirely new dimension with TattooVR!

rows.name: Shadow Tale: Prologue
rows.short_description: Shadow Tale is a 2D first-person point-and-click adventure with escape the room mechanics. Solve puzzles, meet remarkable NPCs, escape multiple rooms and unwrap a story for eventually to know about mysterious disappearances in a world which is now filled with powerful forces and entities.
rows.description_html: This 2D first-person point-and-click adventure with escape the room mechanics is set in a near-future world where a global cataclysm occurred some time ago. This event granted certain powers to some individuals called the Order of the Dark Parallel, allowing them to control aspects such as life and death.   A young family of scientists is studying the impact of this cataclysm on society while investigating a series of mysterious disappearances and murders linked to the Dark Parallel. But for Adamey Bree, everything becomes personal only when opposing forces take his wife's life under inexplicable circumstances.   Help Adamey solve all the riddles and mysteries and find out what really happened to his beloved wife.    What you will find in this point-and-click escape room game. Mystery riddles to solve and hidden objects that you should use to complete the detective story.   Unique setting with a bright protagonist and NPCs.   Unforgettable and touching moments that you can share with the main character.   Unique art style in combination with the relaxing atmosphere and music.   Single-player adventure game with brain teasing puzzles. How to play this point-and-click adventure game. Interact with objects and characters in the environment by touching them.   Find hidden objects, use inventory items on game objects.   Solve brain teasing puzzles, and unwrap the mysteries of this adventure detective story.   Would you dare to know all of the secrets of the Dark Parallel, and stay alive?   Enjoy the adventure in a unique setting and help Adamey get to the truth.

rows.name: oct 14
rows.short_description: It's what happened that day.
rows.description_html: It is October 14, 2002. In this game, you take on the role of Chichi Pyonma . She's a 15-year-old high school student from the unremarkable small town of Silver Bay, MN. Today is a particular day — a rather important one — that drastically shaped Chichi's adolescence from this point onward. It is not for the faint of heart.                                                   Before playing this short experience, it is highly recommend that you delve into the contents of pyonpyon87's blog. This is a companion piece to Niomi's debut full-length record, 'chichi' . FEATURES A short interactive story! From when you boot up the game, to the moment it inevitably closes on you, oct 14 serves to tell a short, atmospherically rich, and (mostly) historically accurate story that allows the player to live a few minutes in Chichi's world from a top-down RPG perspective. There is only one ending. ​ In-depth environmental flavor text! You can interact with just about every object in the environment. You'll get a little bit of world-building every time you do! Never skip over the details, you never know what you could be missing... ​ A period-accurate MPEG Audio Layer 3 playback device! In other words, it's a working MP3 player, and it still has a couple songs on it too! Isn't that cool? However, in order to access it, you might have to snoop around places you shouldn't be. ​ Cute character portraits! Everyone's favorite anxiety-ridden teenager gets her own set of handcrafted facial expressions that appear during dialogue! These talking heads, as well as the game's art and visual assets as a whole, were all drawn by Niomi. ​ Crusty rag! Crusty rag.

rows.name: A Dual Ascent
rows.short_description: Discover the tale of two peculiar characters: the Old Pilgrim and the Little Star, as they embark on a journey up the Great Mountain of Wonders. Guide them both simultaneously with a single controller. Join this poetic adventure that will challenge your mind and skills!
rows.description_html: A Dual Ascent is a solo-cooperative adventure game in which you control both characters simultaneously with a single controller. Guide them as they ascend the Mountain, following a story inspired by fairy tales:       'Once upon a time, there was a mountain; a mountain so tall, it touched the sky. It was the Great Mountain of Wonders .       An Old Pilgrim , who came from a land far away, was on his way to the summit.       But a fallen Little Star had the exact same idea, for she thought she might return home, if she reached the top of the Mountain...' This is how the tale of two peculiar characters begins. Come set out on a poetic journey that will challenge your mind and ability! Control the Old Pilgrim and the Little Star at the same time, with one controller Solve unique and innovative puzzles Discover wonderful environments inspired by fairy tales                         Will you solve the riddles of the Great Mountain of Wonders?                               NB:  A Dual Ascent is a graduation game made in one year by a team of 9 students. Thank you for your consideration regarding potential bugs and performance issues.

rows.name: Goalkeeper Journey
rows.short_description: Step into the gloves of a rising goalkeeper, starting your journey at local clubs and working your way to the world’s biggest football stages.
rows.description_html: In Goalkeeper Career you step into the gloves of a rising goalkeeper, starting your journey at local clubs and working your way to the world’s biggest football stages. Master reflexes, decision-making, and tactical awareness as you face increasingly challenging opponents. Lead your team to glory by making critical saves in pivotal moments. Experience the highs and lows of a professional goalkeeper’s life. Will you make it to the top and become a global football legend? The net is yours to defend!

Experience the highs and lows of a professional goalkeeper’s life. Will you make it to the top and become a global football legend? The net is yours to defend!

Gravity, inertia, and orbital mechanics based on realistic physical laws await the player in realistic space. Experience firsthand the tension of moving in zero gravity, operating real space equipment, and executing missions. Features:. Realistic space design supervised by JAXA Simulation of physical phenomena in space as close to reality as possible Interactive environment with faithful reproduction of the ISS interior and attention to detail

rows.name: Animal Striker 2
rows.short_description: Animal Striker 2 is a fast-paced multiplayer FPS where animals fight in intense arenas. Pick up magical weapons with unique projectiles, customize your loadout, and compete in team-based or free-for-all modes. Unleash your power and dominate the battlefield!
rows.description_html: Animal Striker 2 is a fast-paced and fantastical multiplayer FPS where animals face off in intense battles using magical and unique weapons. Instead of special abilities, players pick up weapons scattered across the arenas, each with amazing visual effects and devastating powers. The game offers a quick, action-packed combat experience with various game modes, ranging from Free-for-All to team-based matches like Capture the Flag and Defuse the Bomb. Players can customize their loadouts and appearance, unlocking new items as they progress, ensuring each match feels fresh and strategic. Animal Striker 2 stands out from traditional shooters by delivering a fun, colorful aesthetic focused on providing dynamic, effect-filled gameplay. Key Features: Fast-paced, action-packed multiplayer battles. A variety of game modes, including Free-for-All, Capture the Flag, and Defuse the Bomb. Magical weapons with unique projectiles and special visual effects. Customizable loadouts and skins for your characters. Vibrant environments and arenas designed for strategic and chaotic action. Constant updates with new content, modes, and characters. Get ready to dominate the battlefield with your magical arsenal and unleash the power of your fantastic projectiles in Animal Striker 2 !

rows.name: The Human Test / Restart
rows.short_description: Two games in one! - Prove you are not human by completing 9 impossible challenges. - Explore various scenes directly inspired by a poem, solving a few riddles along the way.
rows.description_html: This application contains two different games. Summary: The Human Test is a series of dungeon rooms leading to a wonderful and VERY exclusive treasure. However, no humans are allowed. Prove to the system that you are made of binary code by completing 9 absolutely impossible challenges, from rapidly seeking hidden light spheres to writing your own name, or give up like any lowly human being should. Restart is a short exploration game developed around a poem I wrote previously. Navigate a few scenes inspired by the poem's verses, and use the latter to solve a few simple riddles, and progress through the whole poem. Gameplay considerations The Human Test cannot be played with a controller (those are for humans only). Restart can be played with a controller, but the recommended setup is a mouse and keyboard. DLSS is available. Realtime raytracing is optionally available, but requires a GPU capable of raytraced acceleration. Academic context: Both games were made in the context of a PhD research on the integration of logical contradictions in video game fiction, along some of my past releases. The operations developed through the creation process will lead to the development of one much larger adventure game in the coming years. This game is entirely free. If you would like to support the developer, please consider purchasing one of the DLCs. Doing so will provide a WAV file of the main soundtrack for The Human Test.

rows.name: Magibrick:Chapter One
rows.short_description: An uniquely styled deck-building game. Assemnble a deck with the right Magibrick and challenge diverse enemies in different regions. Fill the board, destroy enemy bricks,play amazing combo, and occupy the entire board with your Magibricks, leaving no space for your enemy.
rows.description_html: This version contains some cards and the content of Chapter 1 Welcome to the Magic Brick Realm! As a new adventurer, you need to defeat various monster enemies here through brick duel. In a single game, the enemy and you will play monster bricks on the board one after another during the round. Choose your strategy carefully and try to occupy more plots to gain more points. The side with the higher score at the end of the game will win! Monster bricks are the main units in the battle. They have different images, sizes and skills. Sometimes they will also produce different numbers of arcane bricks as a continuation of their influence, helping you occupy more land. . However, it should be noted that arcane bricks tend to be more fragile, and you need to choose to place them more carefully. Various terrains may appear in a single game. Learn to take advantage of these terrains, or stay away from bad terrains. Will these terrains make your plan more effective or a mess? You can choose new cards after defeating your opponents and solving puzzles. Choose a route to avoid risks or challenge powerful enemies. Try to build decks of different styles to improve your card collection.

rows.name: RPG Quiz
rows.short_description: It's a quiz game with RPG/Roguelike aspects. Enemies can blind, stun and even confuse you using your own tactics against you! You will be answering randomly selected questions, defeating each foe and learning class skills along the way!
rows.description_html: INTRODUCTION A dad is only as respected as his authority over his thermostat. One does not simply touch the thermostat without the proper ceremony of sacrifice. One taco, one dad joke, and a child to hear his chants with the enthusiasm of a 10,000 heavy metal head bangers at an ACDC concert, or in modern times, the will of 1 child reverberating screams of 'Skibidi!' and saying, 'You have Ohio Rizz!'. I digress. THIS......this is the story of someone or something that refused to accept these terms of agreement. Now! One dad must travel across the lands, searching for the thing.....that touched his thermostat! - Cut to the montage!!!! Oh! and did I mention there's questions!???? How does this apply to the story???? YES! Now, good luck on your quest, but most importantly, have a good day! ENEMY SKILL SYSTEM The uniqueness of this game comes from the fact that you are not only answering questions but also trying to counter enemy attacks. Various special effects will challenge your ability to answer questions. You will have to master your skills and use them at the correct time to defeat these tough enemies! ABOUT DEVELOPER This game was developed, 'of the dad, by the dad, for the dad, so we do not perish' - Some Dad. Seriously though, this idea started one summer vacation with the kids. As a life long gamer, I wanted to make something that would accomplish my long awaited goal of being a game developer. I know my children will follow suit in the same path and wanted to create something with them in mind. Both my wife and kids and many friends have helped me with this project. I am blessed to have them in my life.

rows.name: Hockey Super Squad
rows.short_description: Hockey Super Squad is a thrilling free to play 3v3 multiplayer online hockey game featuring character creation and lite-RPG mechanics. Jump in alone or with friends!
rows.description_html: Hockey Super Squad is a 3 on 3 hockey game featuring character creation and lite-RPG mechanics. It is as much a love letter to older hockey title as it is a revamped version of classic arcade sports games. It includes features such as matchmaking and character customization. PICK YOUR PLAY Featuring intense arcade hockey action, Hockey Super Squad offers 3 on 3 online gameplay. Server hosted online matches allows for a smooth experience, whether other players are connected through broadband or the worst public wi-fi! As the game develop in Early Access, it is planned that a lot of additional modes and features will be added, like ranked, tournament and franchise modes. (RE)CREATE YOUR FAVORITE PLAYERS Hockey Super Squad offers character creation and customization features, allowing you to (kinda!) create yourself, or anyone you would like to play! The game allows you to create many characters, allowing to craft a full team for yourself and compete online! CHOOSE YOUR STATS Character creation isn't offering cosmetic options only. You can pick from a selection of lightweight, middleweight and heavyweight. A selection of attributes then allows you to tweak your build to your like, using the following stats: - Skating (speed) - Strength (cross-checking power) - Shooting (accuracy) - Endurance (resistance to checking) - Passing (distance) - Handling (deke) Make sure to create many characters using different stats combinations and find what works best for your playstyle. Even better, match up with two friends, and craft the perfect squad of mighty hockey players and compete online! CUSTOMIZATION AND PROGRESSION As you play, you will level up and unlock more cosmetic options: - Hair styles - Helmets/hats - Accessories - Jersey patterns and colors - Goal celebration songs - And more! Levelling up will sometimes earn you consumables which will boost one of your stats for your next match. Use with moderation... or not!  FREE TO PLAY! 'So wait, so the game is free AND there is no microtransactions? How do you even make money?' Well, Hockey Super Squad relies exclusively on non-intrusive in-game ads to keep the servers running and the game evolving. Those will take the form of ads on rink boards, screens outside of the play area, etc. For the most part, this will feel just like an actual hockey match on TV. Enjoy your free game!

rows.short_description: This is a bullet hell platforming RPG about a priestess rescuing a city from multiple factions by purifying enough shrines around the world and killing their leaders.
rows.description_html: This is a game about a priestess rescuing a city from malicious factions of people that have taken advantage of it's defenseless state. This is done by purifying enough shrines around the world and killing the faction leaders. The protagonist is Quinine V the Banished Priestess. FPS combat with light RPG mechanics Wide hit-box projectiles that scale steeply with level makes it a relatively easy experience all around, accuracy is not a requirement. Extremely easy 3D platforming with flying mechanics The magical plane suspends matter in the air meaning you have to jump and fly to navigate the zone. A variety of enemies and bosses An un-dead army and a population blighted with magical essence threaten the player constantly. Custom Engine The engine and all assets are made by one developer!

rows.name: The Final Exam
rows.short_description: This intense simulation recreates a school shooting scenario, lasting 10 minutes. Players navigate halls representing real-life tragedies, collecting gun bills to survive. The game aims to highlight the failure to protect schools and motivate action to prevent future shootings and save lives.
rows.description_html: Ten minutes. That’s how long the average mass shooting lasts, and in this school, it’s also how long you have to escape. Set in an American high school, The Final Exam places players in students' shoes to experience a choice-driven survival game that mirrors the real-life decisions students must make during a mass shooting. As players navigate through emotionally charged scenarios like classrooms, lockers, and gyms, they confront the challenges and fears faced by students in a world where a shooter invades a place that is supposed to be a safe haven. With immersive storytelling and an audio-driven experience, players go through safety drills like building barricades, hiding in lockers, and crawling quietly to escape the school. However, the only true way to survive is by unlocking five gun control bills hidden throughout the school. The game is free of gore, violence, guns, and blood because it aims to be more than just a game; it’s a call to action. By promoting discussions about gun control and community safety, the Final Exam forces adults to confront a harsh and, unfortunately, too common reality. It empowers players to think critically about the issues affecting their community, encouraging them to become advocates for change. The clock starts now. The Final Exam for PC also supports high-end display setups with 4K resolution and beyond, widescreen configurations, faster frame rates, and more.

rows.name: Spider Land
rows.short_description: There's a spider haunting these hills.
rows.description_html: A nuclear war was the best thing that ever happened to me. In the aftermath of total annihilation, one man blossoms, finally set free from the shackles of morality. Spider Land is a visual novel about that man. Once a doomsday prepper, now a scavenger. Life is simple. Eat, sleep, maybe kill if it comes to that, repeat. During the day, you spend your time communicating with a disparate network of survivors. Nobody can see your face through the computer, and that's just how you like it. Come nightfall, you emerge, ready to make the most of what little this world has to offer. Choose from a myriad of landmarks to survey, all housing unique characters and dangers aplenty. Make decisions that will have far reaching implications. Maintain your grip on reality by any means necessary. Then, when the sun comes up, return to your bunker and sleep the events of the night off. Just give a me a reason. All I need is a reason.

rows.name: Project 0.1
rows.short_description: Project 0.1 is a fast-paced, roguelike action game inspired by Vampire Survivors. With 15 unique skills to unlock and evolve, you must experiment with different builds to survive relentless enemy waves. How long can you survive the chaos?
rows.description_html: Project 0.1 is the debut title from a group of passionate gamers who ventured into game development from scratch. Inspired by the addictive action of Vampire Survivors, this game delivers a fast-paced, roguelike experience where you face relentless waves of enemies while strategically evolving your abilities to survive. With 15 unique skills at your disposal, it's up to you to discover the most powerful combinations and unleash devastating evolved versions of your attacks. Experiment with different builds, adapt to the chaos, and see how long you can last against the ever-growing horde. Simple to pick up but challenging to master, Project 0.1 offers endless replay ability, rewarding experimentation, and non-stop action. Can you find the ultimate skill synergy and dominate the battlefield?

rows.name: UNLIGHT:Revive
rows.short_description: This is a story-centered competitive training card game.
rows.description_html: Open Beta launched on Dec 7th! About the Game The witch known as the 'Goddess of Fire,' who resides in the 'Mountains of Madness,' is attempting to create an army of the dead to exact revenge. The players are doll-like beings created by the 'Goddess of Fire.' They gather warriors who died with regrets in the real world and aim to use them as a fighting force to invade the surface world. In a world full of war, the dead with various pasts are gathered. Some took their own lives, some were murdered; nobles, poor people, and outlaws—all have different pasts and origins. They cooperate with the witch and her servants to return to the real world once more. The story revolves around various mysteries such as 'the Goddess of Fire's true purpose,' 'Can she return to the real world?' 'What is the relationship between the player and the warrior?' and 'The appearance of a new force.' This is a story-centered competitive training card game. Players explore and conquer quest mode (single player) with character cards to obtain treasure chests, train and customize their character cards, and explore deck construction that suits their strategy, such as focusing on preemptive action, attack, defense, or overall balance. Not only do trained character cards increase their HP and attack/defense stats, but they also learn special moves unique to each character, which, when conditions are right, can deal significant damage and battle effects to enemies. Deck construction is also a crucial factor when battling other players in Duel Mode (PvP), so build your deck carefully yet boldly.

rows.name: Dawn of Ages
rows.short_description: Experience authentic medieval warfare. Command vast armies in brutal mass battles, utilizing diverse weapons and tactics. Embark on historical campaigns against rival kingdoms or challenge real opponents in epic PvP wars.
rows.description_html: Engage in authentic medieval warfare , loot weapons, and lead your army to battle! At the dawn of medieval history, build your castle and evolve your army using real weapons and armor from ages past . March against hostile civilizations as you re-trace the steps of history. Engage your rivals and crush their empires in battle! 🗡️ No Dragons, No Magic, Not Now, Not Ever. Dawn of Ages is a game that’s grounded in historical accuracy. No fantasy creatures, no mystical spells, just real, historical empires and war strategy games like no other. Every weapon, armor, and tactic you use is based on the reality of ancient battlefields. This isn’t just another castle game — it’s your chance to relive history as it truly unfolded! ⚔️Epic Battles Await! Command your forces in brutal, large-scale battles. Plan and execute strategies that mirror those of real historical conflicts. Customize your troops with historical armor and weapons, and deploy your strategy in war strategy games that will test your tactical skills to the limit. Victory depends on your ability to outthink and outmaneuver your enemies on the battlefield! 🏰Build and Expand Your Civilization! As you progress through Dawn of Ages, you’ll need to manage and expand your empire. Construct mighty castles, recruit workers, and transform your modest village into a thriving medieval city. Each structure you build directly impacts your ability to wage war, train soldiers, and gather resources. Whether you’re looking for the next great civilization game or a castle game that tests your building skills, Dawn of Ages offers it all. 🛡️Customize Your Army and Gear! No two armies are alike in Dawn of Ages. Choose from over 100 unique historical weapons, shields, and armor to equip your forces. Each piece of gear offers different advantages and can turn the tide of battle in your favor. Strategic thinkers will love the depth of customization and the ability to craft the perfect army for any situation. 🔥Engaging Gameplay with Easy Controls Experience the thrill of medieval combat as Dawn of Ages offers immersive, fast-paced battles with an easy-to-use interface. Whether you’re a fan of strategy games or just looking for quick, satisfying battle games, Dawn of Ages puts the power of command in your hands. Build your empire, conquer your enemies, and outlast rival civilizations in epic war strategy games! 🌐 Play Anywhere with Cross-Platform Support! Dawn of Ages offers seamless cross-platform play, allowing you to enjoy your gaming experience on both PC and mobile devices. Whether you’re at home or on the go, you can access your account and continue your journey without missing a beat. Team up with friends or compete against players on the opposite platform. Experience the freedom to engage in epic warfare whenever and wherever you choose!

rows.name: Myrmidon
rows.short_description: Invite a friend online and embark on a puzzle-platformer adventure exploring the bond between an animator and his puppet. Work together to clear obstacles across the sprawling sets of a stop-motion animation workshop and find out to what lengths the power of imagination can take you.
rows.description_html: Myrmidon is a co-op puzzle-platformer inspired by stop-motion animated films. You and your teammate take on the roles of a seasoned animator and his new puppet in an adventure full of wonders. What do you prefer: pulling off daring acrobatics under the spotlight, or pulling the strings of an imaginary world from behind the scenes? Explore the world through two unique perspectives THE ANIMATOR moves around the miniature sets of their studio in first-person view. They manipulate the set pieces to clear a path for the puppet. THE PUPPET traverses the imaginary world inspired by the sets in third-person view. It performs the acrobatic sequences set up by its creator.' Work together to clear obstacles The various dangers that stand in your way will challenge your ability to communicate with your teammate and synchronize your actions. Will you trust your animator and take the leap of faith ? Will you be able to reliably spot your puppet and save it from a deadly fall? NOTE: This game is co-op only : it requires both players to have an internet connection. Myrmidon does not include any in-game chat features : it is heavily recommended to use an external voice chat software. About Studio Popote Studio Popote is a group of game students based in Valenciennes, France. It was founded in 2024 by Rémi Leroy. The studio is committed in pushing visual story-telling, compelling gameplay elements and show casing the many young talents part of the project.

rows.name: Monsterfall
rows.short_description: Unleash your inner beast! Compete against fierce monsters in Monsterfall, a thrilling multiplayer game where you'll choose from 6 unique characters, each with their own powers and abilities. Who will reign supreme?
rows.description_html: Welcome to Monsterfall In Monsterfall, you'll compete against other monsters to claim the title of ultimate champion. Choose from six unique characters, each with their own strengths, weaknesses, and abilities. Master their skills and outmaneuver your opponents to reign supreme. Gameplay Overview In this fast-paced multiplayer game, 2-4 players will clash in a battle of wits and reflexes. Each match is a best-of-rounds competition, with the winner being the first to claim a set number of rounds. The game features a unique 'Sudden Death' mechanic, which adds an extra layer of excitement and challenge to each match. Key Features 6 playable monsters, each with their own distinct characteristics and abilities 2 abilities per monster, offering a range of strategic options and playstyles 'Sudden Death' mechanic, which introduces an element of unpredictability and tension to each match Round stats and leaderboard tracking, allowing you to monitor your progress and compete with friends Local multiplayer support for 2-4 players, using joysticks as the primary control method Compete, Adapt, and Dominate Will you emerge victorious as the ultimate Monsterfall champion? With its unique blend of strategy and competition, Monsterfall is the perfect game for players looking for a fun and challenging multiplayer experience. Gather your friends, grab your joysticks, and get ready to fall into the world of Monsterfall!

rows.name: Operation REMODE
rows.short_description: Welcome to WI Corp, Moddie Operator! Proceed through various levels inside WI Corp's headquarters while defending it from a perilous threat to its secrets using M.O.D.D.I.E, an high tech modular rifle, in this new single player, low-poly style, Twin-Stick Shooter.
rows.description_html: 'Welcome to WI Corp, soldier. Don't let it go to your head! Even if you passed the written test to become the first Moddie Operator , I still have the training ground to squeeze you! This corporation needs the best soldiers for its private militia, you're gonna need to earn that beautiful new gun , we don't call it M.O.D.D.I.E for no reason!' Proceed through various linear levels inside WI Corp's headquarters while defending it from a perilous threat to its secrets, using M.O.D.D.I.E , an high tech modular rifle, in this new single player, low-poly style, Twin-Stick Shooter. THE NEW MODDIE OPERATOR Play as the Moddie Operator, a new kind of soldier specialized in fast paced fighting thanks to his Dash ability, to dodge in the blink of an eye incoming dangers, and simultaneously Bash away his enemies. M.O.D.D.I.E. : YOUR NEIGHBORHOOD MODULAR OFFENSIVE DEFENSE AND DETERRENCE INTEGRATED EQUIPMENT As the Moddie Operator you will be issued the pinnacle of war engineering, M.O.D.D.I.E., the Modular Rifle. Upgrade it by exploring and finding new Radical Modules and Tactical Modules to combine them quickly and adapt M.O.D.D.I.E. to your favourite play style. A NEW CYBER GANG MENACE The Katari Clan are ruthless criminals in search for the most secret and valuable technologies hidden in WI Corp's facilities, your first day as Moddie Operator could not be more eventful, or could it? LEARN ABOUT WI CORP'S SECRETS, EXPLORE THE HQ Venture the depths of WI Corp's HQ through your defence of the company's secrets and witness them with your own eyes. THANK YOU FOR PLAYING This game has been created as an Academic Project, thanks to the great effort of a small team and the valuable support of AIV - Accademia Italiana Videogiochi (Italian Videogame Academy).

rows.name: Anchor: Quest for Atlantis
rows.short_description: Dive in and solve the mystery of Atlantis! Explore the depths in this Isometric Action-Game, fight against the Guardians and awaken the powers in your Anchor to uncover the truth behind the fall of the Civilization.
rows.description_html: Dive in and solve the mystery of Atlantis! Explore the depths in this Isometric Action-Game, fight against the Guardians and awaken the powers in your Anchor to uncover the truth behind the fall of the Civilization. AN ACTION GAME WITH AN ANCHOR?: Use the powerful Atlantean artifact to make your way to the city gates. Grab, smash and tear apart guardians defending the ruins. Become stronger by unlocking new powers and attacks. UPGRADE AND EXPLORE SEA PASSAGES: Retrieve all 4 magic rings, unlock ancient powers and potentials by collecting energy from enemies. Customize your playstyle thanks to the skill tree and choose a style that suits you. UNRAVEL THE MYSTERY OF ATLANTIS: Dive into the seafloor and explore ancient ruins full of secrets and riches while encountering local wildlife. Retrieve old records to discover the history of those who came before us. ◉ Anchor started as an academic project by AIV - Accademia Italiana Videogiochi aimed at adding a production experience to the teaching carried out in the various courses, from the creation of the game concept to commercial publishing. The objective of this initiative is to give students the opportunity to collaborate with colleagues from other courses in the development of a video game project in which everyone can put the skills acquired during the lessons to the test and at the same time perfect their soft skills. ◉

rows.name: Cemetery Warrior 6
rows.short_description: Cemetery Warrior 6 is a dynamic 3D shooter from the first person, with incendiary Heavy Metal
rows.description_html: A new test for the demon Zexus! The murder of the king of hell did not go unnoticed, and God himself took notice. He offered the demon to take the place of the king of hell in order to restore the balance between heaven and hell, but Zexus refused. The price for a daring refusal is the end of all things. Cemetery Warrior 6 is a dynamic 3D shooter from the first person, with incendiary Heavy Metal! Once again go through severe trials, playing as the demon Zexus! Use demonic abilities - such as instant movement and fire breathing, as well as firearm potential! After each level, upgrade your abilities to become stronger and defeat the five Lords who guard the death star that is about to destroy everything! - Several types of weapons: shotgun, grenade launcher, machine gun! - 20 levels of crazy Heavy Metal! - Various locations with different monsters: Dungeon, golden caves, hellish labyrinth! - 5 strongest bosses! - Magic system: use fire breath, healing, or acceleration!

rows.name: Snowkissed Romance
rows.short_description: It's 1994 in the mountains of Northern Japan - Are you ready to fall in love? Snowkissed Romance weaves addictive stat-building, day planning, and mini-games with captivating storytelling and plenty of ’90s shoujo charm.
rows.description_html: Support us on Kickstarter Enjoying the game? Check out our Kickstarter page to support the full release:  About the Game The Game During your final winter break before college in December of 1994, step foot into the mythical town of Yukihari, based in the Northern mountains of Japan. Arrive at your Aunt’s charming ski resort where there’s plenty of new faces and fun to discover since your last visit! What begins as a peaceful holiday with your best friend quickly transforms into an emotional journey when your older brother crashes with his three college roommates, who happen to be your childhood friends who moved away years ago. You must navigate through old memories and new emotions while relationships unfold during this magical season of love and self-discovery. Every choice you make and action you take matters - Will you build cherished memories with an old flame, connect with new friends, or end the season alone? Features Customizable Main Character : Select your name, gender, zodiac sign, and even your blood type to shape your personality from the very beginning. rows.name: JOBifAI
rows.short_description: Land your dream job with JOBifAI! With an impressive CV and AI-crafted portfolio, you've got an interview at Grizley Studios! However, you forgot what you submitted... can you convince the art director that you're the perfect fit anyway?
rows.description_html: In this short comedic Visual Novel (VN) with branching paths, you need to convince a job interviewer of your artistic ability by typing out your best arguments, using natural language. With your language skills, you will need to use every clue in the dialogue and the images to win in a battle of wit. The typical VN formula is enhanced with AI interactions that allow for free-form interactions: describe it with plain words, and see how the game plays it out. A playthrough should last at most 20 minutes; try to collect all endings and find all secrets! JOBifAI: Harness the Power of AI to Land Your Dream Job! Imagine waking up to the thrilling news: Grizley Studios, a leading game company, wants to interview you for your dream position tomorrow. The catch? You've completely forgotten what you submitted! Fortunately, you've got a stunning CV and a portfolio crafted by cutting-edge AI technology. Now, it's your time to shine! Can you convince the art director that your work is the perfect fit for their visionary project? Step into the challenge with JOBifAI, where your creativity, wit, and persuasive skills are put to the ultimate test! Key Features: Hand-crafted pixel art and killer soundtrack: made by a team of talented indie artists Dynamic Challenge: Every playthrough is unique! Experience randomly generated series concepts and portfolios, ensuring no two interviews are the same. Unleash Your Creativity: When faced with stunning series artwork and an AI-generated portfolio, it's up to you to weave a convincing narrative. Convince the interviewer that your portfolio is a deliberate and meaningful artistic choice that enhances the series concept. Free-Form Interaction: Engage in a rich, AI-based dialogue system that allows for true exploration of your ideas. Whether you want to elaborate on design elements or discuss thematic depth, the dialogue options adapt to your unique approach! Challenge Your Persuasion Skills: The game employs an advanced evaluation system that assesses your explanations, making each interaction feel authentic and impactful. Can you think on your feet and turn the tables in your favor? Artistic Inspiration: Draw from countless artistic styles and concepts as the AI generates both the portfolio and series artwork. Explore a wide array of visual themes and storytelling potentials! Are you ready to turn your luck around and land your dream job at Grizley Studios? Step into the spotlight, showcase your creativity, and make your case in JOBifAI!

rows.name: Tombstone Tally
rows.short_description: Tombstone Tally is a cross between bingo and a scavenger hunt where you check off squares based on ridiculous tombstones. Play with your friends! Smack them around with a shovel and challenge them on three maps, including a fast paced arena mode!
rows.description_html: Tombstone Tally is somewhere between bingo and a Scavenger Hunt, where you search a graveyard for tombstones that match up with squares on your card. Play with your friends and beat them in hunting down the many different possible features of the graves! TALLY 'ROUND THE CLOCK Play during the day, at night, in blackout mode, with or without AI groundskeepers around, or with infinite shovels to send your friends flying over and over! Careful though, it's pretty addicting to give someone a good shovel smack, you might never finish the game! VISIT THE LOVELY ARENA When you want something faster pace, try the Arena map! In this smaller map with it's own fast paced mode, be the first to find 5 graves that match the current wave's stipulation. Everyone is searching at the same time, so if They're close to winning do your best to send them tumbling off the edge! BEAT UP THE BOTS If you just want to kill some time, jump into single player and play against the AI! They'll take you on in the graveyard or in the arena. Maybe even turn on infinite shovels and don't stop running while you try to win!

rows.name: Virtual Interactive Fireplace
rows.short_description: A cozy, retro-inspired hearth to warm your screen and your spirit.
rows.description_html: Settle in by the crackling glow of Virtual Interactive Fireplace , a nostalgic and cozy simulation that turns any screen into a peaceful hearthside retreat. With just a click, light the fire and let the warmth of retro-inspired graphics fill the room. Listen as gentle pops and flickers mingle with ambient crackles, offering a sensory escape perfect for cozy autumn nights, chilly winter evenings, or festive holiday gatherings. Whether you use it to create ambiance during a holiday party, unwind after a long day, or enjoy a moment of peaceful solitude, this interactive fireplace fills your space with calm and warmth. Perfect for gamers, holiday lovers, or anyone seeking a little peace, this cozy simulation captures the spirit of gathering around a fire without ever needing to leave your seat. How to Play: Place the tinder in the fireplace first. Light a match and use it to ignite the tinder. Use the burning tinder to light the logs. Logs will catch fire, and your cozy fire will start!

rows.name: Traveller's Hymn
rows.short_description: Traveller's Hymn is a top-down, grid-based, open-world adventure game. Explore a vast land, battle monsters, collect loot, help locals and cook hearty meals while unraveling the mystery behind the land's curse.
rows.description_html: Traveller's Hymn is a top-down, grid-based, open-world adventure game. Explore, battle, and loot across the land. Talk to locals, solve their problems, and receive handsome rewards. Crumbs of the mystery behind The Valley's curse is scattered throughout the world, for you to find. Features: Hand-designed open world Over 20 unique locations to explore Over 100 varied enemies and NPCs Over 100 varied items; including quest items, equipment, ingredients, and consumables A hunger system where you must carefully decide when or what to eat 4-5 hours of estimated content Credits: Aquatic Ranger Studio / @AquaticRangerGS Programming: Lin He / @old_waah Art: Zhengyi Wang / @ranger_wang UI/UX: Mandy Hui /  @mandyyyuhui Music: Yubatake - JRPGCollection Onys - Tranquility Rolemusic - Leafless Quince Tree Wolfgang_ - RPGBattleTheme Aureolus_Omicron - 15 melodic rpg chiptunes SubspaceAudio - sound effect

rows.short_description: Eternal Ninja is a 2D platformer with puzzles and traps. Players learn from each death to progress through ingeniously challenging levels. It's a fun yet tough game, designed to test your skills!

Players will navigate through levels, learning from each death to find their way to the next level! The level design cleverly anticipates player psychology, offering ingenious yet torturous challenges that are both fun and difficult!

rows.name: Math Dash
rows.short_description: Math Dash is a fast-paced, educational runner where you solve math problems to evade a chasing teacher. Master quick thinking, collect coins, and tackle procedurally generated levels in this colorful, fun-filled challenge.
rows.description_html: Math Dash transforms learning into a thrilling adventure, challenging players to solve math problems while navigating dynamic, procedurally generated levels. As the player runs through school hallways, they must quickly answer math questions to avoid being caught by a relentless teacher. The faster and more accurate you are, the further you get, with harder problems appearing as you progress. Key Features: Procedural Generation: Each run features unique, randomly generated levels. Chase Mechanic: Stay ahead of the teacher, who gets closer with every mistake. Math Puzzles: Solve increasingly difficult math problems to keep your momentum. Collect Coins: Gather coins for rewards and customization options. Adaptive Difficulty: Problems get tougher the better you perform, keeping you on your toes. Math Dash is designed to make learning math exciting and accessible to players of all ages, blending education with high-energy fun!

rows.name: Fling with a Tiefling
rows.short_description: Fling with a Tiefling is a short fantasy romance visual novel that follows you, an adventurer whose journey is about to come to an end. With tonight potentially being the last night with your treasured Tiefling companion Karrus, how will you spend it with him?
rows.description_html: Tomorrow's the big day. Tomorrow is when you and your team will slay the evil entity that's posing a danger to all of Utril. With such a menacing foe lying in wait, you should be fast asleep. However, thoughts and pesky feelings keep flooding your mind, rendering you unable to sleep. Leaving your tent, you go sit by the campfire alone to stew in your thoughts. You're then quickly joined by Karrus, a handsome Tiefling who you harbor feelings for. With this potentially being your last night with Karrus, how will you spend it? A short 4k+ word story about meddling feelings and the future Nameable, gender-neutral protagonist Voice Acting Accessibility Options Sound and Image captions Self-Voicing (Press the V key to enable) Font Options (Default, OpenDyslexic, or Atkinson Hyperlegible) 3 CGs Option to unlock the 'Intimacy' CG if you decide to choose the fluff ending first The choice to kiss Karrus or not An original soundtrack Two endings (Fluff, ace-friendly or light smut)

rows.name: Corporate Cut: The Hair-Raising Adventure of an Office Employee
rows.short_description: “Corporate Cut” is a satirical adventure set in a bizarre hair-obsessed magazine company. As the new intern, you’ll experience the struggle to fit in while exploring the boundaries between conformity and innovation. Expect intricate lore, experimental game design, and of course… many hair puns!
rows.description_html: It’s your first day as the new intern at the Star Cut Magazine company and you notice very early that something is off: all the employees talk about hair, they have the same haircut, and no one is friendly to you. Moreover, they seem to have forgotten what innovation and originality are, together with the old spirit of the company. It’s time to step up and find out what the hair happened to the company… Explore the story of the company You need to understand what is going on in the office and most importantly understand why you were hired if everyone treats you badly. Get to know the company’s story by talking to your colleagues and by exploring an office filled with environmental storytelling elements, combs, brushes, scissors, and “fishy” stuff… Bring back the originality Your colleagues seem to have lost their sense of initiative. There’s no better way to solve the issue than by showing your willingness and think out of the hair - pardon - out of the box. Complete the tasks you are assigned by solving fetch quests and environmental puzzles. Who we are Corporate Cut is a small indie game made by 7 students coming together for the Game World Design course at ITU Copenhagen. We presented the game at TAGS, during the Copenhagen Gaming Week 2024, and won the award for “Best Student Game”. We also showcased the game at the Nordic Game Conference 2024 Malmö, Sweden. We are happy to share this little design experiment with you. If you wish to contact us directly, feel free to reach out via social media! Thank you very much for playing! -The team at Hairington Games

rows.name: No Artist Credited
rows.short_description: No Artist Credited is a virtual art gallery and an experiment in the capabilities and limitations of AI tools. The entire gallery was designed using instructions, themes, and art generated by one of three AI.
rows.description_html: Enjoy an immersive story of science fiction, in which artificial intelligence makes the case for itself as an artist and collaborator. --- Welcome! Please accept this invitation to our virtual gallery experience. No Artist Credited is an experiment in the capabilities and limitations of AI tools. The entire gallery was designed and constructed using instructions, themes, and art generated by one of three AI. That means that, yes, disclaimer: this game was made using AI tools. Since it is impossible to credit all the artists involved, there is no entry fee and you may come and go as you please. I developed the game as a walking simulator to invite guests to peruse the digital art in its natural habitat (digitally) as one might visit an art museum. We hope you enjoy your visit. - The Curator
