rows.name: Dark Goddess of Destruction: Idle
rows.short_description: This is a unique card battle idle game that we have crafted together with our players. We have developed an in-depth progression system and comprehensive character and monster profiles.
rows.description_html: This is a unique card battle idle game that we have crafted together with our players. We have developed an in-depth progression system and comprehensive character and monster profiles. Moreover, we are eager to collaborate with our community to design and shape the game's future, ensuring an experience that is both rich and captivating. Co-creation Philosophy: We believe that the imagination and creativity of our players are the greatest drivers of the game's evolution. Therefore, we pledge to invest 100% of the revenue generated from the game back into its ongoing development and refinement, meeting and exceeding the expectations of our players. Combat System: Currently, the game features a card-based combat system, but our ambitions go beyond that. We plan to work alongside our players to gradually transform the combat into full 3D dynamic battles, making each encounter more realistic and thrilling. Character Settings: In the game, you will come across hundreds of dark goddesses, each sexy and challenging, with their own unique abilities and backstories. As an emissary of the goddess of light, you will engage in an epic confrontation with them. Your Mission: Utilize your goddess of light, unleash her powers, and take on the goddesses tainted by darkness. Every battle is an opportunity for growth, and every victory brings us closer to our shared goal. Join Us: We invite you to join 'Dark Goddess of Destruction' and be a part of making history with us. This is more than just a game; it's a community, a narrative, a saga. Together, let's illuminate this world shrouded in darkness.

rows.short_description: Bondage Mermaids - Fatal Fap is a survival horror horny game in the tradition of 2D-adventure style survival games.
rows.description_html: Descend into the mysterious depths of the Deeper Sainthood, the twisted heart of the sunken city of N’yahhh~<3, and join NiXXXy Seastar, the leader of the Bondage Mermaids, in an adventure survival “horror” game like no other. NiXXXy’s boundless horny energy has caught the attention of a sinister Deep Sea Witch (and band-mate), who’s intent on using it for a forbidden ritual. To ensure NiXXXy’s compliance, the witch casts a cruel curse: NiXXXy is forbidden to climax for an entire day. Now, she must navigate through the treacherous underwater ruins, battling hordes of lustful spirits and consentacles that threaten her at every turn, while resisting her own overwhelming desires. Features: Explore the Deeper Sainthood: Traverse a variety of unique and perilous locations, from the haunted Lovecraft Masturbatorium to the treacherous Breeding Pools. Uncover the secrets of this lewd, lost world. Fight with Whips and Wits: Use NiXXXy’s whip to fend off relentless horny ghosts and fend off squirming consentacles. Activate her gift of Horny Vision to reveal hidden paths, traps, and secrets—but be warned, not everything revealed is for the better. Survive the Night: Endure the witch’s curse and 'survive' the night without giving in to temptation. You’ll need to manage NiXXXy’s arousal levels and navigate encounters with bizarre creatures that inhabit the Deeper Sainthood. Multiple Endings: With five distinct endings, your choices and actions will determine NiXXXy’s fate. Will she succumb to the witch’s curse, or will she find a way to break free and harness her forbidden powers? Handmade for Better or Worse: Every asset has been handcrafted —no AI shortcuts here! Atmospheric Soundtrack: Enjoy a unique soundtrack that perfectly captures the dark, alluring atmosphere of the Deeper Sainthood, with tracks that range from ethereal to downright naughty. Prepare for a dive into the depths of depravity and resilience. Can you guide NiXXXy through a day of torment and temptation without giving in to the fatal fap?

rows.name: Pixelite Online
rows.short_description: Explore and conquer the world of Pixelite Online! Dive into a pixel-perfect world of adventure, connect with friends, and complete epic quests to prove your worth.
rows.description_html: Pixelite Online is an exciting new MMORPG that stands out with its unique features and constant updates. Our dedicated team is always active, ensuring a fresh and engaging experience for our players. Dive into the world of Pixelite Online and discover all that we have to offer! Features: Unique Spawns: In Pixelite, explore a world where spawns are uniquely tailored to each area, offering a static yet diverse range of creatures and challenges. Custom Bosses: Encounter epic custom-designed bosses that test your skills and strategy. Corrupt Monsters: Delve into dark dungeons and face off against corrupt monsters corrupted by powerful forces. Defeating these creatures not only tests your strength but will also reward you greatly. Training System: Level up your character with our innovative training system. Gain experience and improve your skills by engaging in various activities such as combat. Skills: Players can specialize in various combat styles tailored to their chosen class. Master the arcane arts with the Magic Level skill for mage classes, allowing you to unleash devastating spells and manipulate the elements. For warrior classes, focus on honing your Melee skills, perfecting your swordplay and physical combat prowess. Alternatively, opt for the Dist (Distance) skill, ideal for ranged attackers who excel at using bows, crossbows, and other long-range weapons to strike foes from a distance. With a diverse range of skills catering to different playstyles, Pixelite offers a dynamic and immersive gaming experience for every adventurer. Unique Boss Tasks and Monster Tasks: Complete challenging boss tasks and monster tasks for exclusive rewards and achievements. These tasks encourage strategic gameplay and cooperation among players. A Boss for Every Monster: Encounter formidable bosses corresponding to every monster in the game. Defeating these bosses not only strengthens your character but also unlocks rare loot and progression opportunities. Crafting System: Dive into Pixelite's robust crafting system, where you can gather resources, craft powerful gear and items, and customize your equipment to suit your playstyle. Experiment with different recipes and become a master crafter in Pixelite's vibrant world. Enchanting: In the world of Pixelite, enchanting your gear with gems you've looted is not just a practical skill but a deeply magical art that can turn ordinary equipment into powerful relics. Gems, imbued with latent elemental energies and mystical properties, serve as the core catalysts for these enchantments, allowing adventurers to customize their gear to suit their playstyle and face the challenges ahead with confidence. Custom Dungeons: In Pixelite, dungeons are not just places of exploration but realms of mystery and peril, accessible only through special drops obtained from defeating formidable bosses. These rare drops, coveted by adventurers for their unique properties and abilities, serve as keys to unlock portals to these treacherous dungeons scattered across the realm. Teleporters: Unlock swift travel across diverse biomes with our dynamic teleporters! Discover hidden locations, customize your spawn points, and experience vibrant pixel art designs. Engage in strategic gameplay as you manage teleportation costs and dive into the lore behind these ancient relics. Whether you're exploring solo or racing friends, teleporters make navigating the Pixelite world easier and more exciting than ever!

rows.name: Door Game Deluxe
rows.short_description: Door Game Deluxe is a (very) short, satirical RPG. An expansion of the original and the pinnacle of human artistic expression, this version offers original art and music on top of new endings.
rows.description_html: Door Game Deluxe is a short, satirical RPG with simple top-down controls. You are a door. Also, you have no idea where you are.  New, original art & music! 5 Endings featuring monotony and repetition!  Arguably kind of funny! Sometimes! Up to 3 deaths! Real 100% Stained Pine Wood! Learn to process the existential weight of waking up as a door! Alone! On an island! Steam Achievements! It's also free and only a few minutes long and you have no reason not to play it so go ahead and do that.

rows.name: Push 3D
rows.short_description: Push 3D is an online turn-based two-player board game, where the goal is to PUSH your opponent off the board!
rows.description_html: Push 3D is a digital re-creation of the Push board-game, created by Dave Shedden. In this game, players take turns moving a game piece around a Hex-based board. On their turn, a player can make two out of three choices. They can flip a tile, making it a 'Slip' surface, where moving across them will cause the piece to slip to the other side. Alternatively, players can move their piece in a given direction, or, if they are in a direct line with each other, they can 'Push' their opponent backwards. Can you out-think your opponent as the board fills with Slip tiles? Are you cunning enough to be the Player that pushes the other off the board, sealing your victory as champion? Prove it now, by playing a friend in this online multi-player game. Features Single-Player practice, or Two-Player local machine 'Hotseat' Mode.  (Coming Soon) Vs Computer Mode, where you play against an automated opponent.  (Coming Soon) Online Multiplayer Mode, where you use a matchmaking system to connect online with other players. A monthly Leaderboard, to see how you stack against the World! (Coming Soon) An Art Deco visual style to set the mood. A period appropriate soundtrack to match the visual era. Hosts and Local Players can configure the game with a number of settings. Customization choices for the Local Player, like piece selection and piece color selection. And finally, Steam Achievements!

rows.name: PalSync
rows.short_description: In PalSync, control two characters who must move together at the same time. Face challenging levels where perfect synchronization is key to solving puzzles and overcoming obstacles. Test your coordination skills in this unique single-player experience!
rows.description_html: In PalSync , synchronization isn't just a strategy – it's your only way forward! Control two characters who move at the same time, facing challenges where every action impacts both. Can you keep them in sync and guide them to the finish? Each level presents obstacles and puzzles designed to test your ability to move both characters simultaneously. As the challenges ramp up, precise control and smart decision-making are essential. Key Features : Total Synchronization : Both characters can only move together. Every move affects them both, creating a unique challenge where coordination is everything. Level-based Challenges : Tackle a variety of puzzles and obstacles that require you to manage two paths at once. Single-player Experience : You're in control of both characters, offering a focused experience designed for one player. Synchronized Puzzles : The key to beating each level is moving both characters at the same time, facing puzzles that test your real-time decision-making. In PalSync , the real challenge is moving as one. Do you have what it takes to sync every step and lead both characters to victory?

rows.name: Tank Arena:Total Operation
rows.short_description: Tank Arena:Total Operation is a free MMO war game where you play as a commander, drive thousands of types of tanks, armored vehicles or helicopters on a massive battlefield engaging in 12v12 team-based battles against players globally. Enjoy the fun!
rows.description_html: Game benefits About the Game 《Tank Arena:Total Operation》 is a MMO competitive military war game. Players command more than 400 different types of tanks, armored vehicles or helicopters on a 2000x2000 massive battlefield and engage in 12v12 team-based battles against other players from all over the world. Travel across the historical battlefield, immerse yourself in the clash between tanks, collision of team strategies and adrenaline-pumping PVP fights. You will enjoy the unique fun brought by strategies and teamwork. ###Train Your Tanks: Create Your Own War Machine In Tank Arena:Total Operation, tanks are not only your weapons, but also your partners on the battlefield. The game provides historically famous tanks from many countries, such as the German Tiger II , the Soviet T-34, the United States' M4 Sherman, etc. Each tank has its unique performance and fighting style. You can gradually improve the tank's armor, defense, firepower and mobility through the upgrade system to create a steel behemoth that suits your own tactical needs. ###The Ranking Contest: Challenge Top-notch Commanders  For players who are eager to prove themselves, the Ranking Contest is not to be missed. In the Ranking Contest, players are matched globally based on their performance, which allows them to compete head-on with elite commanders from all over the world. Through outstanding performance in the contest, players can gradually improve the ranking and unlock exclusive rewards. The ranking contest not only tests individual operation, but also requires keen judgment of the situation on the battlefield and tacit cooperation in a team. Every victory will add to your fame while failure turns into valuable experience to improve your tactics. ###Custom Appearance: Show Your Style and Glory  In Tank Arena:Total Operation, every commander can be unique on the battlefield. The game offers various customization options. Players can add paintings, decals and accessories to their tanks, or even make a customized unique flag. On the battlefield, your tank is not only a war machine, but also a symbol of your personal style and glory. ### Teaming Strategies: Teamwork - the Key to Success In Tank Arena:Total Operation, heroic individualism is important, but victory often goes to those who understand teamwork. There are a variety of PVP modes in the game. Whether it is in a 5v5 small-scale battle, or a 12v12 large-scale team battle, the successful execution of each tactic such as a frontal assault, a flank attack or a bypass attack, depends on the tacit understanding and cooperation between teammates. In battle, you need to keep an eye on your teammates, adjust your strategy and fight with the team for the victory. ### Real Battlefields: Immerse Yourself in the Grand Wars of WWII Tank Arena:Total Operation takes you back to the battlefield of WWII with its exquisite visuals and perfectly reproduced battle scenes. Each map is designed based on the real battlefield of WWII. From the cold snowfields of the Eastern Front to the ruins of street battles of the Western Front, every detail allows you to immerse yourself in the real history. Combined with realistic sound effects and environmental interactions, you will feel the most realistic battle ambience here.

rows.short_description: BRINGING THE ARCADE BACK TO RALLY
rows.description_html: WORLD RALLY ARCADE is my first ever game that I've released , and was a summer project for 2024 to see if I could be able to make and release a game on Steam. The game is a simple single-player, race to the line game. Race across the varied scenery of the European forest , a huge stadium , and the African savannah as you try to set the fastest time you can! You versus the clock... who will come out on top ?

rows.name: RZR
rows.short_description: Enter an island infested with zombies and try to survive. Search and collect weapons to stay alive. Move stealthily to avoid being detected and take care of your resources. Handle melee or firearms weapons to clear areas and be able to sleep peacefully
rows.description_html: Try to survive the maximum number of days on an island infested with zombies. Collect resources to stay alive, water, food. Look for firearms or melee weapons to defend yourself against zombies. If you feel tired, look for a bed to rest. Coolers will hold only beverages, fridge will hold beverages and food. In the furniture you can find weapons, ammunition and medicines. Some zombies can give you infections, scratch you or even bite you, find and use medicines and bandages for this type of damage. Running too much will leave you thirsty, try to stay hydrated. When entering the houses you may encounter unfriendly guests, be careful. During the night vision will be limited and the zombies will be faster. Be careful to have enough resources at night, as it will be more difficult to find them. Each weapon has a different reload time and range. Don't let the zombies see you or they will try to kill you, run away or destroy them. Some zombies will try to find you even if they haven't seen you, keep moving. Choose the amount of loot, duration of the night, speed of the zombies.

rows.name: Escape 51
rows.short_description: In Escape 51 you play as a small alien that has been mistreated by humans as he works to escape the research facility that has kept him and other aliens like him captive for so long.
rows.description_html: In Escape 51 you play as a small alien that has been mistreated by humans as he works to escape the research facility that has kept him and other aliens like him captive for so long. You'll have to sneak, hide and solve puzzles as you navigate through the stylized halls of the facility. Meet and befriend other aliens as you all try your best to escape. Your friends will serve you well, as your kind's unique ability to exchange limbs will come into play. Different aliens have different abilities, their biology will help you move forward. Can you avoid the security guards and make use of the chaos to escape?

rows.short_description: Spellbound Stumble is a 2v2 arena shooter with an active ragdolls. It uses a host and join multiplayer system to find games.
rows.description_html: Spellbound Stumble is a 2v2 arena magic shooter with ragdolls and highly-saturated graphics. When joining a game, you will be added to a queue that starts the match after 4 players have joined. There are two spells that can be used to attack. The fireball has low damage, but high attack speed, reload speed, and a big hitbox. The icicle has high damage, but lacks in the other factors.

rows.name: Bolide
rows.short_description: Bolide is an arcade roguelike where you survive waves in space to unlock new skills! Destroy rocks and survive challenging waves to earn skill points and use them to choose from a variety of skills. Pick from 40+ skills, allowing you to create lots of skill combinations!
rows.description_html: Bolide is an arcade roguelike where you survive waves in space to unlock new skills! Completing waves earns you skill points, which are spent on a variety of skills! With tons possible skill combinations, 40+ skills, 10 modes, 500+ customization options, lots of modifiers, and more, every game will be unique! 40+ Unique Skills!  Create new skill combinations every game! rows.name: Requiem For a Lost World
rows.short_description: Requiem For a Lost World is a singleplayer/co-op roguelite bullet-hell game combining the fun of destroying thousands of enemies with unique builds and a pleasing stylized anime graphics. Unlock new characters, collect powerful weapons and create synergies with elemental reactions!
rows.description_html: Engage in thrilling battles against the hordes of enemies Collect shards dropped by fallen monsters, level up, unlock and upgrade your arsenal of 6 weapons and items in this unique twist on bullet-hell games, where you are the bullet producer! Survive long enough to face off against the final boss that will put your build to the test! In Requiem for the Lost World, defeat is just a stepping stone towards inevitable victory. Many characters with distinct abilities Unlock the growing cast of over 25 unique characters. Each one equipped with its weapon, special ability, passive and a set of upgrades that diversify the playing experience. Challenge the world of Sanctuary with your preferred play style! Powerful upgrades and weapons Choose from a vast inventory of 100+ weapons and items to build your arsenal strategically. Every choice you make matters as you prepare to fight and adapt to enemies that may counter your approach. Mix and match weapons to create powerful elemental reactions to wipe your opponents with. Experience the stylized world Traverse the vast grass fields of the outskirts of the Capital, dive deep into dark dungeons of the Capital's undergrounds, or explore the vast snow plains of the Northern Tundra. Beautiful VFX and the mix of 2D and 3D graphics will make sure to keep you visually entertained. Each location is filled with puzzles and points of interest for you to discover. Multiple progression systems Equip characters with relics, acquire their rank-ups when weapons alone are no longer enough and unlock buffs from global perk tree. Each character benefits from different stats, and it's up to you to find the perfect balance or define your own META build! With nearly 40 upgradable stats there is plenty to choose from! Plan your builds ahead of time Strategize your build with a built-in planner and compete in leaderboards for the high score! Or just import them from other players, choice is yours Play with others Tired of playing survivor-like   games alone? Try with a friend, or two, or more! Requiem for a Lost World offers an online co-op experience without altering the gameplay loop we all grew to love. Get stronger together, rely on each other to make it till the end! Or maybe you are a streamer, believing that your chat won't make the gameplay a living hell? With Twitch integration, you can let the chat control your fate. Will they help or make you miserable?  In a world scarred by a forgotten era, only one sanctuary remains. Centuries after a global catastrophe turned most of the planet into a wasteland, the people of Sanctuary live in fragile peace, unaware of the dark history that shaped their world. When a mysterious new threat emerges to consume their last refuge, two strangers, Nishi and Amelia, are thrust into a battle against monstrous creatures and ancient forces that defy reality. As chaos unfolds, Nishi must confront his past, unlock hidden powers, and seek out the legendary Bearers—immortal warriors whose emotions fuel their immense abilities. Along the way, the line between salvation and destruction blurs as Nishi and Amelia struggle to protect each other and their world from the impending calamity. Key features A mix of 2D and 3D stylized graphics with various customizations Shape your story in an immersive narrative-driven experience. Unique characters with individual skills and upgrades that synergize with different builds Elements and elemental reactions bring more depth into your choices Relic and rank-up system brings build customization outside of battles CO-OP mode to play with friends Twitch integration Waifus I guess Constant improvements based on player feedback All that and more for literally free! Note from the developer Making a game with a story and scope as ambitious as  Requiem for the Lost World was a long-running child's dream of mine. I finally decided to bring my idea closer to reality! I hope you will enjoy playing my game as much as I enjoy providing new and fresh content to all of you!

rows.name: My Day Challenge
rows.short_description: A short, atmospheric horror experience about daily life.
rows.description_html: Overview In this short horror experience you take control of a man, who sees the world a bit differently. Guide him through a normal day, and experience the monsters of daily life. Explore his apartment. Interact with different objects, and hear his thoughts on them. Gameplay This is a First-person 'walking simulator,' with exploration elements. Play time ~10 min

rows.name: Inkesis
rows.short_description: Help Ink, our hero, fight the evil that consumes the forgotten Library of Arga. Collect Knowledge and control your environment to explore this grandiose building, uncover secrets, and forge your own path in this adventure and puzzle game! But beware, your greed could lead you astray...
rows.description_html: Step into the mystical library of Arga , an ancient place filled with secrets and forgotten knowledge. As a mysterious being with the unique power to absorb knowledge and manipulate structures in your environment, you'll solve puzzles, explore inaccessible areas, and fight enemies. Forge your own path: Use your powers to manipulate structures and solve puzzles to navigate through the library of Arga . Interact with two types of structures: Blue Chunks: Selectable as long as they are within your range. Orange Chunks: Can only be manipulated while standing on them. Master these mechanics to discover hidden paths and unlock new areas through the library. Fight: Your environment is your only weapon. Use the movable structures you control to fight enemies or escape when things get too dangerous. Encounter multiple fountains that restore your health and act as checkpoints. Uncover mysteries: Collect the 13 fragments of knowledge scattered throughout the library to piece together the story behind this ancient place. Each fragment will bring you closer to understanding the truth hidden within Arga ’s walls. Inkesis offers an immersive 1-hour experience blending puzzle-solving, exploration, and adventure. Your abilities will be key as you explore intricate environments, manipulate the world to your advantage, and face the challenges that stand in your way. Immerse yourself in a magical world, where each discovery brings you closer to the hidden truth at the heart of this mysterious place. Will you uncover all the secrets of Inkesis ?

rows.name: Sub0ptimal
rows.short_description: Low ploy, linear, FPS shooter that is set in a simulation including physics based bullets and movement with a underlying story to discover. Sub0ptimal is a short game but has great replayability. Try to see how fast you can go!
rows.description_html: Test Subject 873. You have one simple task. DON'T DIE! Use any tool at your disposal to survive! Grappling, parkour, wall running, and guns. Find the truth! Do you have what it takes to survive, or do I need to try again? Game Overview: Sub0ptimal is a fast-paced FPS game. Movement is key because staying still means death. Wall running, grappling, bosses, and guns; what more can you ask for? Each linear level simply has a start and an end, so get there as fast as possible. Game is short, roughly 30 minutes, but the objective is to replay and get better. How fast can you beat the game? Key features: Fast Paced Movement Guns linear levels   Donations: While the game is completely free, if you have enjoyed the game then feel free to donate to two college game devs. You can here at $KasenBenton on Cashapp

rows.name: SCP: Containment Breach 2
rows.short_description: Survive the chaos of SCP Foundation! Step into a thrilling SCP horror experience with story-driven co-op, intense PvP Breach mode, and randomized maps. Play as Class-D, scientist, SCPs, and more, each role bringing unique challenges in an unpredictable, immersive facility.
rows.description_html: Welcome to the SCP Facility! Step into a thrilling and immersive horror experience based on the SCP universe. Choose from multiple roles, including scientists, Class-D personnel, various SCPs, facility guards, MTF operatives, and Chaos Insurgency members! In SCP: Containment Breach 2, a wide range of terrifying adventures awaits. Immerse yourself in a highly atmospheric, suspense-filled world where every corner holds new dangers, and every decision could mean life or death Experience the Full Story in Single-Player or Multiplayer Co-op! Welcome to Story Mode , a thrilling experience you can enjoy solo or with friends . As a Class-D test subject, escape the site during a facility-wide breach, encountering some of the SCP Foundation’s most dangerous entities and navigating endless corridors. With multiple possible endings, your choices shape your journey as you uncover secrets, evade threats, and strive for survival in the chaos. Can you emerge unscathed, or will the horrors lurking within get the better of you? Fight for Survival or Control in PvP Breach Mode! In PvP Breach Mode , take on various roles—whether as Class-D personnel, a scientist, a guard, an elite MTF unit, or even a member of the Chaos Insurgency. This mode features randomized map generation, making each playthrough a unique experience. Form alliances, cooperate, or betray others in a high-stakes setting where every interaction can lead to intense, dynamic scenarios. Can you survive or secure the facility against other players from around the world?

rows.name: Square Jump
rows.short_description: Have you been looking for a simple game where you are a cube and want to jump on different things? Square Jump is perfect!
rows.description_html: Have you been looking for a simple game where you are a cube and want to jump on different things? Square Jump is perfect! You are a square that must get as far as possible from the destination, or the finish line, without dying or falling into traps. There are 2 types of enemies, the black square and the red square. The black square has no gravity and you can't kill it, but the red square has gravity and you can kill it if you jump on it. The buttons are colored according to the doors, and if you press them, the doors will open. Just like the boxes, if you put them in the colored areas according to the same color, you will be able to open other doors. There are a lot of levels, but also achievements waiting for you to complete them all! Enjoy!

rows.description_html: In 'Turtle Riders: Adventure Begins' you will have the chance to see what the main game is about! Take a ride and have a taste of some of the stages, weapons, and modes! -New weapon : Suriken -New turtle : Darwin New reworked endless mode with more enemies and features. The path is dangerous so pick your weapons of choice and sharpen your aiming skills in this challenging survival adventure! Your aim will be challenged 100 unique talents/10 special talents and 5 elemental attacks to make the strongest builds Gather orbs to unlock new weapons/turtles and upgrade your stats

rows.name: Fantasy Hearts
rows.short_description: FANTASY HEARTS is a new old-school fantasy tactical battler with PvP and PvE hex-based battles. Battle for victory by assembling a squad of 25 unique heroes. Customize your strategy, train in epic multiplayer battles and conquer the top rankings!
rows.description_html: 🎮 Dive into a world of nostalgia and epic battles! FANTASY HEARTS is a modern take on a classic: an old-school atmosphere of tactical RPGs, hardcore turn-based battles, and true fantasy magic. If you’ve ever been a fan of Final Fantasy Tactics, Heroes of Might and Magic, Eador, or Disciples, you’ll feel right at home here. 🔥 UPDATED CLASSIC OF THE GENRE ✔ PvP battles ✔ PvE battles ✔ Hex field ✔ Fantasy characters The world of FANTASY HEARTS is inhabited by different races. In our universe, humans, beasts, elves, goblins, and the undead often fight side by side. 🏹 UNIQUE HEROES Build your team, plan your tactics, combine skills, and adapt to every battle. The outcome depends entirely on choosing the right heroes. You can recruit the following into your squad: Humans Elves Monsters Goblins And even raise the dead 💥 FIGHT THE BEST Assemble a squad of 4–5 fighters, test your strategies in training, and then challenge other players in the arena. Each battle is a new test where not only strength matters, but also your ability to adapt to the battlefield. 🛡️ CUSTOMIZE YOUR ARMY The battlefield is more than just scenery. Terrain, cover, and tactical positioning can be the key to victory. Plan every move carefully — and you will be rewarded. 🤝 GUILDS, EVENTS, COMMUNITY Create your own guild or join an existing one, take part in time-limited events, complete tavern quests, hire mercenaries, and chat with other players in a cozy old-school atmosphere. 🌟 Fantasy Hearts awaits its hero. Join now — and write your own legend.

rows.name: Apple Ring
rows.short_description: Apple Ring is a free multiplayer online game. Players can win apples and become the winner in each match. Apples and rings are convertible, enhancing your community collection in the future. Real-time communication with others is possible during the game.
rows.description_html: Players can play this game for free, consuming 1 apple at the start of each round when you have them. Each game lasts 5 minutes; clicking the fruit basket before it ends increases your chance of winning. You can also play passively. Apples placed in the basket, both initial and additional ones, are randomly awarded to the winner. Adding more apples proportionally increases your chance of winning and being awarded apples. Apples can be converted into rings, with 1,000 apples equaling 1 ring. Rings, a collectible item, will be purchasable and sellable on the Steam community market in the future. You can also communicate with other players in real-time during the game.

In this game, players control a variety of anthropomorphic animals, each equipped with an arsenal of sophisticated weapons and unique abilities. The main objective is to eliminate opponents using projectiles and cunning tactics while navigating dynamic, obstacle-filled environments. The game takes place in a series of vibrant and diverse scenarios, from tropical islands to icy glaciers, each with its own unique characteristics and challenges. Players can move through these environments using jumping and movement skills while attempting to evade enemy attacks and strategically position themselves to counterattack. Customize with gear and pets, join clans, and compete in modes like Battle Royale. Enjoy intense multiplayer action, daily rewards, and a social system with friends.

rows.name: Tomorrow's Land
rows.short_description: Tomorrow’s Land is a free land Where Adventures Begin. It may not be the best game ever created, but it is surely the most fun. The game is not yet finished and is still in active development. – Phat
rows.description_html: Welcome to... Tomorrow's Land! An pirate-exploration game. Gameplay : Classic keyboard controls like in the 1990s. For example, 'Combo Attack: X + X + X.' Servers can host up to 50 players (with over 100/1000 servers available. Due to budget constraints, only 100 servers will be opened initially, allowing up to 5,000 players to play at the same time ^^!). Guilds are limited to a maximum of 10 members. Players can make friends and participate in events together. PvP between players allows the winner to earn a portion of the Bounty. Guild PvP is a ship battle, where roles include a ship captain, gunners who use cannons to attack from a distance, warriors to defend the ship from raids, and fighters who use cannons to board the enemy ship and fight. rows.name: Niva
rows.short_description: Help Astri find his data cards and beat levels to reach his ship, in this hard-to-finish platformer. Complete all the hand-crafted levels, finish as much as you can and become a god of the universe.
rows.description_html: Intro After crash-landing on a newly discovered planet due to an electric shock, help Astri retrieve his data cards and complete the levels to reach his ship, in this “Die & Retry” platformer from the Stellar Vault studio. A hard-to-complete single-player adventure awaits! With a variety of colorful skins and all the joy of level completion. Over 50 levels! Many levels in different ultra-challenging biomes, with achievements to complete. Retrieving all the data cards and finishing the game at 100% can only be done the bravest, most determined and most powerful people on earth. Dangers roam the planet Beware! You'll find robots that want to neutralize all unknown visitors (including you). Destroy them or use them as tools to complete the levels. Simple, accessible controls Just jump, run and dash - every key needs to be mastered which makes every fatal fall a lesson. Quick respawns encourage you to move on to discover the next levels and brave all their dangers. Student Project Turned in as a student project for a video game development school in its first year, winning the jury's congratulations for its enormous content and “magnificent” animations. (Reimbursement for broken equipment due to excessive rage not taken into account :) ) BYIYM

rows.name: Ämäränth : The Last Day of My Adolescence
rows.short_description: The story of a young graduate witnessing the twilight of his world.
rows.description_html: This prologue to the world of Ämäränth marks (hopefully) the beginning of a long journey through the noosphere and beyond. In corde nostro somniamus de divino rerum tumultu Ämäränth: The Last Day of My Adolescence is a short (1-2h) and simple visual novel. There are no sprites for the characters, but you can unlock little secrets as you play. I developed this game in my spare time to bring to life a universe I've been building up for several years. I'm aware that the result is (clearly) amateurish and (very) rough around the edges, but I hope to pique your interest even if only for a brief moment!

rows.name: Burger Station
rows.short_description: As the world is seen through a hungry lens, so does it's next victim see what they desire in their very own childish eyes. Burger Station is a tiny, spooky yet cute game about trying to get a single piece of candy.
rows.description_html: The Burger Station exists far in the midst of nowhere. Burgers and fries are the attraction to those customers that come and go. It is also the home to the trees of the night. The world is seen through a hungry lens It's Halloween Night and nobody is really celebrating the Halloween Spirit! A tiny ghost-costume wearing child arrives to the burger spot in search for candy. Will they achieve their goal of literally getting a single piece of candy or will they meet the demise of the unknown? Experience the spooks -Explore the minimalistic void of the outskirts. -Interact with random objects to understand and question the bizarre land. -Look for keys and get lost around the silent trees. Some treats in the candy bag -Customize Borders. -Tiny cutscenes. - Fully voiced dialogue  (Text-to-Speech for the cinematic experience) -Collect Golden Pumpkins  to unlock a secret ending! Controls: WASD - Move Spacebar - Interact/Confirm Esc - Pause Game

rows.name: Cowgirl Trainer
rows.short_description: Cowgirl Trainer is a JRPG dating sim. Fight bandits and monsters, collect bounties, and romance a sexy cowgirl as you explore the town of Tombwood and its surrounding areas. Level up, spec your characters, pass persuasion checks, and more as you strive to take down the Black Cactus Gang.
rows.description_html: In the town of Tombwood, the player takes the role of a decadent bounty hunter with a troubled past. The town is facing problem with a gang of bandits that call themselves the Black Cactus Gang. Various bounty hunters to visit the town and among them is Connie, a former ranger that's on a quest for revenge against the Black Cactus Gang. The player will take a part in helping her while facing his own troubles. Cowgirl Trainer is a JRPG with turn based combat featuring dating sim elements. Level up, buy and equip items, fight a variety of enemies, spec your characters to suit your strategy. The game features side quests to go along with the main quests. Explore the desert western setting of bounty hunters and outlaws. Use D20 (Dice 20) for persuasion checks and certain encounters and decisions you make. The dating element features a system of talking, giving gifts, and of course, adult scenes. The adult scenes are accompanied by mini games that if successfully played will yield boons to help in combat as well. Developing a relationship with Connie is a core element of the game and 'training' her in the ways of making love is part of the fun.

rows.name: NA-Re: great chain of being
rows.short_description: Pilgrimage of angels on an important mission through scenic Japan
rows.description_html: Previously lost Japanese visual novel, rebuilt and finally on Steam! Playing as Eimin, embark on a thrilling quest with two angelic girls. The Emperor of Japan has fallen out with the gods, and it is your job to deliver the Emperor's request and make peace between humans and kami. You will experience: • A challenging mission in the Dewa Sanzan mountains, the outcome of which depends on you • Meeting the lively Kandri and shy Meguri, Christian angels in the service of the Emperor • Stunning visuals and enchanting music, creating the well-known atmosphere of a doujin game WARNING: Please play while connected to the Internet. Be careful when entering any characters in the response window. Monitor your physical and mental state as you progress.

rows.name: Whiskara
rows.short_description: Whiskara is an action role-playing game where Lyra has to stop the god Hypnos from taking over the world
rows.description_html: Notice As of June 6th 2025, development of this project has ceased, and future update cannot be promised About the Game Story Lyra awakens to a bewildering discovery: her father’s legendary sword lies on her table. Confused and worried, she rushes to ask her father what it means, only to discover that he’s been cursed by the god, Hypnos. With her father too weak to fight, Lyra must find and defeat Hypnos before it is too late. Features Combat System: A combat system including a light and heavy attack. The inclusion of stamina also adds a whole new layer to the combat, light attacks deal less damage but conserve stamina, while heavy attacks deal more damage but drain a lot of stamina. Skill Levels: Whiskara features a skill level system. Right now it allows the player to increase their skill in speech, allowing dialogue with some characters to unlock alternate ways to do quests. Save System: The game will save upon quest completion, and Steam Cloud will back up the saves.

rows.name: JUMP! The Floor Is...
rows.short_description: Do you remember the excitement of hopping from spot to spot, avoiding the ”Lava”? We’re bringing back those childhood memories with a game inspired by the fun we all had growing up. You can test your reflexes, strategy, and competitive spirit. The goal is simple: be the first to reach the trophy.
rows.description_html: Welcome to JUMP! The floor is... the ultimate multiplayer showdown that will test your reflexes, strategy, and competitive spirit!      In this exhilarating game, you and up to five other players must navigate a treacherous arena where the floor itself is your biggest threat.      The goal is simple yet challenging: be the first to reach the trophy.  Power-UP System   The arena is filled with power-ups that can give you a temporary edge.   These power-ups include increased speed, super jump, flight and others.   Each power-up lasts just 3 seconds, so you’ll need to use them wisely and strategically to gain an advantage over your competitors. Level Design      The floor can turn into an array of deadly hazards, from explosive surface   and scorching lava to bouncy pads , moving sand and even the outer space .      Each map is designed with multiple paths , unique challenges and opportunities, offering players the freedom to find and choose their route to victory.      But the challenges don’t stop there. The map is littered with traps designed to hinder your progress and test your agility.      From spike pits to moving platforms , every step you take could be your last chance to win the round. Time Management and Abilities      Each round is timed, pushing players to balance speed with strategy . The faster you complete your objective, the greater the rewards, but rushing can lead to costly mistakes.      Players have the ability to strategically throw bombs and plant mines , creating powerful disruptions to enemy tactics.  Strategic placement and effective use of these abilities can turn the tide of battle in your favor.      You'll need quick reflexes, sharp wits, and a keen sense of timing to navigate the dangerous terrain and outmaneuver your opponents.      The thrill of the chase, the excitement of close calls, and the satisfaction of a well-timed jump all come together to create an adrenaline-pumping experience that will keep you coming back for more.      Get ready to leap, dodge, and outsmart your competitors in a game where the floor is never safe and every jump counts– let the jumping madness begin!

rows.name: PolyWar
rows.short_description: PolyWar is an online FPS based PvP game that you can play with your friends.
rows.description_html: PolyWar is a free online FPS-based PvP game. Launch the game, create a server, or join servers created by others to jump straight into the fun. You can play with up to 4 friends. For now, in this game where you can only play PvP with your friends, players try to get the most kills within 5 minutes, and the player with the most kills becomes the winner of the round. With its low-requirement graphics, you will enjoy a sweet yet action-packed gaming experience – and it's completely free!

rows.name: Victory of Seeker
rows.short_description: An unprecedented Moba game that can compete in 4 teams.(3v3v3v3) Choose a sucker, build buildings, collect money, train, attack, loot and destroy enemy buildings, do everything to get richer than your rival. Relax with many mini-games that you can play and laugh with 8 friends at the same time.
rows.description_html: We're living in a crazily stressful world and that is why we need to create this gaming project. So in most games, a hero is someone who is capable and strong who rises to save the world from evil, right? Well, this game is different. Losers or suckers can be heroes too! So we gathered several personas of losers as main characters of the game.  You will be the ultimate manager who will determine the destiny of the cute Suckers. Sometimes manager will have to fight with other managers in mini-games. Examples of suckers you can use : A kiddo who can’t do shit except taking a dump. A pretty girl with an unrealistically positive mindset and her profile picture is even further from real. An internet troll who throws shades around in chat rooms. Imagine how fun it would be if you can be a troll who uses their keyboard as a weapon to hit and run.  They can run fast though. A jobless freelance artist whose main skill is to be a beggar. And many more. Each Sucker has their own unique skills, such as stealing money, setting traps, attacking with foul language, and even farting at their opponents. Main Game In general MOBA games, we will make heroes stronger than the other side and invade and destroy the enemy's fortress. But!!! this game is clearly different as an intelligent person. You and your mate must calculate and plan to make your team the richest in the given time by doing everything possible, attacking enemies, robbing, build buildings to gain benefits, and planning defense strategies. Rules of the game 1 Choose your favorite Sucker 2 Use your Sucker to build buildings to earn income 3 Bring Sucker to train in buildings to strengthen them 4 Collect money from buildings to carry with you or deposit in the main building. Because the total score will only count the money collected from the main building and the Suckers 5 Before time runs out, Billy will come out. If any Sucker kills it, the money that the Sucker has with it will be multiplied by 2 6 When time runs out, the team with the most money will win. Lots of features Coming up!

You and your mate must calculate and plan to make your team the richest in the given time by doing everything possible, attacking enemies, robbing, build buildings to gain benefits, and planning defense strategies. Rules of the game 1 Choose your favorite Sucker 2 Use your Sucker to build buildings to earn income 3 Bring Sucker to train in buildings to strengthen them 4 Collect money from buildings to carry with you or deposit in the main building. Because the total score will only count the money collected from the main building and the Suckers 5 Before time runs out, Billy will come out. If any Sucker kills it, the money that the Sucker has with it will be multiplied by 2 6 When time runs out, the team with the most money will win. Lots of features Coming up!

rows.name: Warranty Man
rows.short_description: First person scary game set in an underground parking garage. Find your lost parking card, collect some cash to pay for your parking and get out before Warranty Man finds you and sells you auto insurance.
rows.description_html: After a long day you just want to get home, so you head to the parking garage, but something doesn't feel right. Something lurks in the dark, something that stalks you, something that wants to sell you overpriced insurance. To make things worse, you have lost your parking card and are out of cash. Your task is to find the parking card and find some money to pay for your stay at one of the Park 'n Pay machines. While you wander the long tunnels and spacious halls of the underground garage, you may find yourself face to face with Warranty Man, or maybe he will walk up to you from behind, you always need to be on the lookout. Instructions The rules are simple to successfully evade Warranty Man and escape Find your lost parking ticket, you need this to pay for your parking Collect some cash, luckily there are a lots of lost bank notes scattered around Collected all of the above? Find a Park 'n Pay machine Are you being chased by the salesman? No Problem!  First, do not look  at him and try to outrun your chaser, eventually he will disappear Second, look around, can you see any vans nearby? Go near it to pretend its yours, he doesn't sell insurance for those things. He will leave you alone, just  do not look  at him Got caught and had to buy insurance? Well, there is always the Retry button Playtime The first successful run should take 30-60 minutes to complete. There are no saves, once you are caught it's game over. The locations of the bank notes and the parkig card are random on each run, so as the frequency of the salesman apparitions. The difficulty of each run is influenced by those things.

rows.name: Fallen: Into the Darkness
rows.short_description: Dive deep into the darkness in this free-to-play, single-player platformer. Time moves fast, so keep your light alive and watch your step, each attempt reshapes the entire level.
rows.description_html: Fallen: Into the Darkness is just another platform game, one where rage quitting and the temptation to uninstall are all too familiar. It’s free, but are you patient enough to beat it at least once? As you descend deeper, the game becomes more challenging, and every second counts. Keep your light alive, adapt quickly, and try to reach the end. Key Features: Procedural Generation: Each level reshapes itself with every death, offering a fresh challenge every time you play. Light Mechanics: Keep your light alive to survive the descent. Don’t let it go out, or you’ll be lost in the darkness. Challenging Platforming: Overcome platforms and obstacles that demand precise timing and careful decision-making. Single-player Experience: Play solo and focus on your skill to conquer the ever-changing levels. Free-to-Play: Dive into the game without spending a penny, with the option to support development via donations. Each step counts, and every fall is a reminder that nothing is permanent. How long can you keep your light burning as you dive deeper into the darkness?

rows.name: Valley of Stars
rows.short_description: Welcome to this little Valley of Stars! Select your hero and start the battle. Defeat the big devil in the deep forest...
rows.description_html: Game Features Choose one hero from two characters. Knight: A fighter who is good at physical close combat and archery. She is proficient in elemental magic and can manipulate fire. Her combat skills include using lightning to stun and knockdown enemies to gain an edge in close combat. Ranger: She sacrifices her physical combat ability, but she can manipulate fire and ice, build turrets, and even summon battle pets to support the battle. Defeating the big devil in the deep forest will be quite challenging. You need to defeat small monsters to level up and defeat the big devil through continuous fighting and exploration. During the fight, don't forget to save and load your game progress at any time to avoid having to level up again from scratch.

rows.name: Sacrifices
rows.short_description: Faith and blood! In this god-game-meets-city-builder, rule and guide a mesoamerican village through the trials and tribulations of everyday life in the heart of a ruthless jungle!
rows.description_html: Disclaimer: This is a direct PC port of our mobile game Sacrifices. Expect quite a slow pace, and no microtransactions. Rule and guide a Mesoamerican village through the adventures of everyday life in the heart of a ruthless jungle! In this god-game-meets-city-builder, you must manage a cute Aztec village and defend it from the dangers lurking in the jungle. Earn the faith of your followers, and gift them with divine knowledge to rebuild the village that is now in ruins. Manage your Aztec village Gathering food, chopping wood, putting out fires... Life for your villagers isn't always easy. But one thing is for sure: they can't manage without you! Answer prayers from your followers Your protégés won't stop asking you for this, or rather that. As a God, use your powers to bring joy and happiness to your flock, or punish them for their insolence! Arm and defend your followers in battle against rival tribes Many dangers lurk in the jungle! And some enemies can't be defeated without your help. Craft more than 150 different weapons and outfits We thought it was a good amount. What do you think? It's a bit of work. Send expeditions through the wild jungle Designate your best people to obtain the many treasures that abound in the surrounding jungle! And you can always negotiate with the traveling merchant - it's less risky. Sacrifice your most fervent followers Accumulate precious blood and unlock ever more knowledge by sacrificing the most pious villagers in your honor! We promise, they won't hold it against you. Expand the village Regain your lost glory. Restore your flamboyant city, stone by stone!

rows.name: CowaCowa: Jinmenken
rows.short_description: 'CowaCowa: Jinmenken' is a 3D horror adventure game based on the Japanese urban legend of the 'Jinmenken,' a dog with a human face. Explore a hand-drawn 2.5D world from a first-person perspective, uncovering eerie mysteries in a quiet residential neighborhood at night.
rows.description_html: Jinmenken: A Terrifying Night Walk 🎮 Game Overview “CowaCowa: Jinmenken” is a 3D horror adventure inspired by Japanese urban legends. Explore a hand-drawn 2.5D world from a first-person perspective as you uncover the mysteries of eerie phenomena. 🐕‍🦺 What is the Jinmenken? The Jinmenken( Human - Faced Dog ) is a Japanese urban legend about a dog with a human face. While its body resembles a typical dog, its face has human-like features, and it is often seen at night or in deserted places. Its bizarre appearance and eerie presence have given rise to many rumors and horror stories. Some say it laughs or even speaks in human language, adding to the unsettling nature of this mysterious creature. 📖 Story Introduction You play as a young boy searching for his missing friend in a quiet residential area at night. While investigating the rumors of the “Jinmenken” — a dog with a human face — you are drawn deeper into unsettling events and hidden horrors. 🎮 Gameplay Features First-Person Exploration : Walk through the world from your own perspective, discovering clues and immersing yourself in a suspenseful experience. Unique Hand-Drawn Visuals : The warm, hand-drawn art style creates a distinctive 2.5D atmosphere that enhances the horror experience. Urban Legend Horror Storyline : Dive into a narrative based on Japanese urban legends that pulls you deeper into the unknown. Stealth Elements for an Intense Horror Experience : Hide and escape from the “Jinmenken” as you make your way through the game. The stealth action heightens the sense of fear and tension. 🎨 Atmosphere and Visuals The hand-drawn 2.5D illustrations depict a Japanese residential neighborhood, setting a sinister and eerie mood. The curved depth of the environment makes it hard to see far ahead, heightening the sense of anxiety and drawing the player into the unknown. As a young boy, you’ll light up the dark streets with your flashlight, facing the lurking terrors of the silent night. 🎯 Target Players Recommended for horror enthusiasts, those intrigued by Japanese urban legends and eerie atmospheres, and players who enjoy immersive exploration. 🏁 Ending There is only one ending. ⏱️ Estimated Playtime 30 to 60 minutes 📺Streaming Policy Summary Streaming is allowed for both individuals and corporations. Please include the game name and the URL to the store page in the description section. No prior authorization is required.

rows.name: Dodgeball Dojo × Big 2 Anime
rows.short_description: A classic loved by millions, shed cards with a twist! Control hands and win advantages energizing Athletes & Spirit Pets with martial art abilities and elemental powers!
rows.description_html: Inspired by a classic family card game played by millions worldwide, moves are now animated with modern manga in Dodgeball Dojo! Features: • Big 2 / Pusoy Dos - Easy and fun card shedding game family pastime • Play Together - Real time competition against players globally with inspiration from Big 2 and poker rules • Dodgeball - Winning card hands come to life with 3D chibi and 2D anime dodge and throws • Energy / Fatigue - Harness Energy (Qi or the Force) with card play control and speed • Wild Cards - Transform Energy for creative comebacks and strategic wins • Athlete Ability - Throw wild gameplay twists by forming Bombs with card combos • Pet Power - Discover unique round advantages activated by Spirit Pet elements • Private Party - Host tournaments and play with family and friends on your own rules • Emote - Level up to collect 3D dances and 2D emojis to troll your friends in real time • Martial Arts - Discover choreography and cultures around the world, from kung fu to krav maga • Spirit Pets - Get lucky and win animals from around the world • Anime - Blends art styles of Japanese manga with American comic strips • World Tour - Unlock your favorite Stadium and get home court advantage • Events - Exciting challenges give free rewards • Win Big - Climb leaderboards and score prizes at Black Belt and above Big 2, known by many names worldwide, is an East meets West universally beloved family game; also known as President in Europe, 大老二/斗地主 in China , 锄大弟 in Hong Kong, Pusoy Dos in Philippines, Daifugō(大富豪) in Japan, Tiến Lên in Vietnam, and Capsa in Indonesia. Follow us @DodgeballDojo on Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, X, and YouTube! PLEASE NOTE! Dodgeball Dojo® is free to download and play, but some game items can be purchased with real money. If you don't want to use this feature, please disable in-app purchases in your device’s settings. A persistent network connection is also required to play (network fees may apply). Privacy Policy: Terms of Service: Last but not least, thank you to our family and friends who supported us as we worked those long hours.

rows.name: Pirates of Justice
rows.short_description: Pirates of Justice is a strategic puzzle game where players help pirates destroy corrupt Marine buildings by placing objects to guide a bomb ball to its target. Use your wits to bring down the Marine's stronghold and rise through the pirate ranks.
rows.description_html: Key Gameplay Features: 1️⃣ Drag and Drop: Place objects strategically to set the path for the bomb ball. 2️⃣ Rotate and Position: Fine-tune your setup by rotating and placing objects in the perfect spot. 3️⃣ Aim and Shoot: Launch the bomb ball and watch it destroy the Marine's building. Pirates of Justice is an exciting puzzle game that challenges you to think strategically and solve problems to help pirates overthrow the corrupt Marine. In a world where the government protects a privileged few while disregarding the lives of ordinary people, it's up to you to fight for justice and dismantle the Marine's oppressive control. Each level tests your creativity and skills as you guide the pirate's bomb ball to destroy the Marine's buildings. With increasing difficulty and an engaging storyline of rebellion, Pirates of Justice offers a thrilling puzzle experience. Why Play Pirates of Justice? Strategic Gameplay: Solve intricate puzzles by placing, rotating, and shooting objects. Immersive Storyline: Rebel against injustice and fight for those the government abandoned. Progressive Challenges: Face increasingly complex puzzles as you rise through the pirate ranks. Dynamic Level Design: Each level introduces unique obstacles to conquer. Bounty System: Raise your pirate bounty with each victory and edge closer to becoming the King of the Pirates. Set sail on a journey of rebellion and strategy. Do you have what it takes to bring justice to the oppressed and earn your place in pirate history? Play Pirates of Justice now!

rows.name: Dead Sale
rows.short_description: You are Marcus, an appraiser exploring a house for sale. Power outages reveal a dark entity hunting you. With the help of a mirror, uncover what’s hidden and escape before both time and the shadow claim your life. Realistic graphics, unique dialogues, and a fast gameplay loop. Horror genre
rows.description_html: 'Dead Sale' is an episodic horror game that features different stories. In each episode, players must find a way to escape various locations, mainly houses and properties that are up for sale. However, each of these places has been the site of disturbing, dark, and human events. Main Mechanic: Use a mysterious mirror to reveal what has been hidden. Immersive Atmosphere: Experience a unique aesthetic, with sepia tones that draw you into the dark depths of this game. Dark Backstory: With a deeply disturbing story, uncover the origin of the terrifying events. Multiple Endings: Discover different ways to escape the house, though some may not be as lucky as others. Key Features: Voice acting Sepia tone aesthetic Fast-paced gameplay Photorealistic graphics

rows.name: Tiny Shooters
rows.short_description: Engage in fast-paced 2D deathmatch action! Choose from 9 unique characters, collect weapons, grenades, and health packs as you battle for supremacy in a 5-minute showdown. Play against friends or bots in this thrilling shooter game where every kill counts!
rows.description_html: Welcome to Tiny Shooters, an intense 2D multiplayer shooter! Dive into a 5-minute deathmatch where every shot and every move matters. Players can choose from 9 unique characters, each with their own style, and enter the battlefield for an adrenaline-packed showdown. Don't worry if there aren't any players online – the game automatically adds bots to keep the action going! Collect a variety of weapons, including guns, grenades, and power-ups like health packs, to outplay and outgun your opponents. The goal is simple: rack up the most kills to claim victory! Explore different strategies, whether you're sniping from afar or getting up close with powerful weapons. Can you outlast the chaos and become the top scorer? Key Features: 9 Characters to Choose From : Select your favorite character to represent you in battle. Multiplayer Deathmatch : Compete against players or bots in high-octane 5-minute matches. Power-Ups : Find and collect bullets, grenades, health, and different guns to gain an edge over your opponents. Bots for Offline Action : No players online? No problem! Bots fill in to keep the action alive. Top-Score Wins : Aim for the highest kill count to take the crown at the end of each match.

rows.name: Floating Star
rows.short_description: Play as a lone space traveler, floating in the galaxy while exploring the boundaries of human civilization.
rows.description_html: In Floating Star, you will play as a lone traveler, floating in the galaxy while exploring the boundaries of human civilization. Travel through the boring, dilapidated galaxy, and negotiate with the numb space colonists. Manage supplies, weapons and equipment, defeat enemies, and find the end of your journey. Inspired by FTL , EVE and some other games. Key Features: Story Driven -- Somehow, humans have spread to every corner of this galaxy. Negotiate with them to obtain supplies and information. Different choices may bring different consequences. Random Galaxy -- Star maps and events will be randomly generated for each game, and the floating path is planned by you. Strategic Equipment and Resource Management -- Inventory space and spaceship slots are limited, but the available ammunition, supplies, weapons and equipment are endless! It's up to you to choose. Feel free to make any feedback!

rows.name: Burntime Remastered
rows.short_description: Burntime is a remaster and expansion of Max Design's post-apocalyptic strategy game 'Burntime' from 1993. It includes improvements like doubled resolution and wide screen support.
rows.description_html: Survive and conquer the post-apocalyptic world of Burntime. Features Original Gameplay: Play through the original game from 1993 with some enhancements. Survival: Find food, parts to build traps and people to help you. Conquer: Establish camps around all major cities to win the game. Remastered Visuals: Enjoy enhanced graphics and wide screen support while still being true to its 90s pixel art. Remaster Toggles: Prefer the original graphics, or the AMIGA sound track? Change in the options. About the Development This remaster was done by a super fan of the original game. It was only possible thanks to the ok by the creators, and the many issue feedback by fellow fans. It is fully reprogrammed from scratch using the original graphics and sounds. Issue reports and smaller improvement ideas are appreciated on GitHub.

rows.name: Echoes of Elysium: Airship Builder
rows.short_description: Unleash your creativity in the Echoes of Elysium: Airship Builder! Craft and customize your airship ahead of the game's release. Echoes of Elysium is an airship survival RPG set in a procedural world where you will gather resources to design, build, and fight to survive on your full custom airships.
rows.description_html: Unleash your imagination and craft your ultimate airship! Echoes of Elysium: Airship Builder is a standalone experience that lets you bring your wildest airship designs to life using the same powerful mechanics that will shape your adventure in the full survival RPG. Customize every aspect of your airship - from its hull and sails to its defenses and interiors. Whether you're crafting a majestic flying fortress, a nimble scout ship, or a luxurious floating palace, the skies are yours to conquer. The possibilities are endless as you flex your creativity  to create the ultimate airship. Your creations aren’t just for show - they’re future-proof! When Echoes of Elysium officially launches, your airships will serve as blueprints, giving you a head start in mastering the skies and preparing for the challenges ahead. Build now and fly later! We want to see your airships take flight! Share your creations on social media using the hashtag #AirshipBuilder to be featured in our community spotlight. Keep an eye on our social channels for exciting updates. The skies await. Are you ready to build your legacy? In Echoes of Elysium , you’ll soar through the skies on your custom airships, exploring floating islands, uncovering ancient secrets, and battling an army of clockwork enemies. Whether you’re charting your own course solo or teaming up with friends, your airship will be your ultimate base of operations in a procedurally generated world teeming with danger, mystery, and adventure.  Wishlist Echoes of Elysium to stay up to date on the full Survival RPG and get a sneak peek into development.

rows.name: The Rose of Cravenmor
rows.short_description: A gothic short story set in the most Blighted city of the North Kingdom.
rows.description_html: How far would you be willing to go in service to your people? Would you be willing to kill? You would get no gratitude. No riches. The very people you're trying to help would hate you, fear you, and brand you as but a coin-chasing cutthroat. With the City Watch after you, you would get no peace. Amidst a Biblical calamity, do you have what it takes to answer God's calling and do what no one else would? Features: A nihilistic take on the visual novel genre, presented in traditional format with minimal illustrations; Fully original soundtrack, featuring medieval folk music, sombre ambient, orchestral compositions, and everything in between. Every scene is scored uniquely; Two endings, each exploring different facets of the lore.

rows.name: Kota`s New Journey
rows.short_description: An elven sorceress decides to visit her old friend, but gets caught up in a series of exciting (and slightly lewd) adventures, where she finds new friends, rare spells... and loses her swimsuit.
rows.description_html: A small game made with love and humor. It takes only an hour to complete, but it is completely free. If you like it and it makes you smile, that's great! What is the game about? Kota, an elf cosplayer, arrives in a small village where she will help an old friend, teach magic to an orphan, take part in catching the legendary Sasalmon... well, just play and find everything out for yourself! Unique mechanics! As well as walking, your character can also RUN. And at some points in the game, a cute tiny chibi girl will follow you around. Look for hidden items in each level! Interact with the many inhabitants of the village (sorry, I forgot to come up with a name for it)! Okay, these mechanics aren't particularly unique, I guess. You might have seen some of them in other games... NO AI-generated art or text Every image and word in this game is handmade. Yes, they are not perfect. But you can be sure that hours of human effort have gone into them!

rows.name: SEGA FOOTBALL CLUB CHAMPIONS
rows.short_description: Powered by Football Manager ™, featuring player data from FIFPRO™. Allowing you to compete in J League, K League, and more! Become the manager of your club and bring your team to global superstars. Pre-register now and be the first to enjoy strategic gameplay, real players, and thrilling matches!
rows.description_html: From hometown heroes to world class legends! Bring your team to the top of the world. Give the management a refresh and compete in major European Leagues. From local football legends to the top of the world! The beloved soccer club management simulation game from Japan “SakaTsuku” is here for global players with its latest version! Celebrate 30 years of passion and strategy in this iconic title brought to you by SEGA! SEGA FOOTBALL CLUB CHAMPIONS is a game powered by Football Manager ™, featuring player data from FIFPRO™, and allowing you to compete in J League, K League, and more! Become the manager of your club and bring your team from hometown heroes to global superstars. Completely free to play all around the world with cross-platform support and cross-play features so you can play anytime, anywhere between Mobile, PC, and Console. ■Lead your local club to the top of the world! •Build a team where you can recruit the best global football players. •Compete in your selected league and rise from the bottom to be the best. •Develop facilities and training programs to increase your player potential. •Set training programs to shape the player skills. •Recruit and nurture young rising players to become global stars. •Search the transfer market and spot the best buys. •Experience a journey from local beginnings to global greatness together with your team! ■Deep strategic club management! •Shape the future of your club with impactful choices. Decide which players to sign and who you let go. •Endless forms of football formations and strategy that you can create to compete against others. •Build training facilities, world-class stadiums, and develop your team to be the best. •Every move you make shifts the balance of power across the entire league. Your strategy will decide if you rise to the top… or are left behind. ■Fierce Competition •Start with a local team and play your way to compete with the global giants. •Challenge other players in PVP mode to see who is the best. •Compete in Cup matches and International Cups. •Get your name on the Leaderboard and showcase your skill! ■Real players, real leagues, real football! •Get global superstars to play for your team. •The deeper your knowledge of soccer, the more immersive your experience! It’s more than just a game – it’s football, shaped by you! #SFCC

rows.name: Dodge It! 3
rows.short_description: Dodge It! 3 is an intense 3D action game where your survival depends on fast reflexes. Navigate through a series of increasingly challenging obstacles. With sharp visuals and competitive leaderboards, it’s all about skill and precision as you dodge your way to the top!
rows.description_html: Dodge It! 3 is an exciting 3D action game where players must avoid red balls while collecting green balls to survive. One wrong move, and you're out! With each green ball collected, you earn XP to level up, unlocking new challenges. New maps will be added over time. The key to success is mastering your reflexes and timing to dodge the red balls and climb the leaderboards. Do you have what it takes to become the best and claim the #1 spot?

rows.name: Gates of olympus
rows.short_description: Step into ancient Greece in Gates of Olympus, a thrilling match-3 game. Harness the powers of Zeus and the gods to unlock treasures and claim your place among the immortals. The gods await—dare to challenge them!
rows.description_html: Step into the divine realm of ancient Greece and unlock the power of the gods in Gates of Olympus, a thrilling match-3 puzzle game infused with the epic grandeur of Greek mythology. Ascend Mount Olympus, where the mighty Zeus reigns supreme, and challenge the pantheon of gods as you seek favor and fortune. With every match you make, lightning strikes, oceans roar, and the heavens tremble—will you harness the elemental forces or be lost in the shadows of myth? Navigate celestial temples, unlock sacred relics, and summon the strength of the Olympian deities to conquer each level. From the wisdom of Athena to the wrath of Ares, each god offers their unique blessings, transforming your strategy into legendary victories. But beware, mortal—the gods are not easily swayed, and only the most cunning and daring will earn their place among the stars. Are you ready to cross the Gates of Olympus and claim your destiny? The gods await.

Throughout ball game, you will be required to roll, jump, aim/release, time meters, and rotate walls to get your ball to the finish line. Each level must be completed under a certain amount of time, and make sure to not upset the host.

rows.name: Seasonala Cemetery
rows.short_description: A meditative experience that invites players to explore the serene beauty of a living, breathing cemetery as it changes with the seasons.
rows.description_html: Seasonala Cemetery is a meditative experience that invites players to explore the serene beauty of a living, breathing cemetery. Using your system’s real date and time, the game changes dynamically – visit in the summer to see the cemetery bustling with life, or explore in the quiet, snowy winter. Observe and interact with NPCs and animals as they visit Seasonala Cemetery , all while listening to ambient sounds recorded from a real-life cemetery. Seasonala Cemetery is a peaceful yet poignant reflection on life and death. Features See how the cemetery changes through the seasons, time of day, and weather. Learn about the city’s history through its gravestones. Interact with the animals that call the cemetery home and the people who visit the cemetery at different times of the day, month, and year. Listen to ambient sounds recorded from a real-life cemetery alongside a beautiful soundtrack composed by halina heron. Pick up flowers, rocks, pinecones, and more and place them on gravestones you visit. A completely free experience for Windows and Mac.

rows.name: Whispers Of Fear
rows.short_description: You step into the shoes of a woman being stalked by a mysterious figure. What was supposed to be a safe haven in an isolated forest house turns into a nightmare as strange events unfold during the night. Each night grows more terrifying... Can you escape before it’s too late?
rows.description_html: Synopsis: In Whispers of Fear , you’re drawn into a chilling psychological horror experience. After fleeing from a mysterious stalker, the protagonist seeks refuge in her family’s house deep in the woods. The false sense of security keeps pulling you into a tense and nerve-racking atmosphere. Every sound, every shadow will make you question what’s real. With an unexpected twist, you’ll need to figure out if you can escape or if the danger still lurks in the dark. Perfect for players looking for an immersive, realistic experience, Whispers of Fear will leave you wondering if you're ever truly safe. Gameplay: Explore and survive in a desolate atmosphere, in a house on the outskirts of a forest at dusk. Progressive story as the days and nights unfold. First-person experience, exploration, suspense, horror. Events based on the player's choices and actions. Immersive atmosphere and sounds. Psychological horror, realism. A story that could happen in real life. Retro setting. The story progresses based on objectives.
