rows.name: Motorbike Evolution 2025
rows.short_description: Your favorite indie motorbike MMO is back! Experience the evolution of motorbikes with up to 39 friends!
rows.description_html: I have been creating this game since high school and have worked hard through my studies at Charles University in Prague. My aim for this year is to carry over my Ph.D. research about procedurally generated nature into my game. I aim to capture 150 years of racing in a game one day. Motorbike Evolution is a multiplayer racing game that uses principles similar to those of World of Tanks. With each race against 39 other players, you gain experience and credits, for which you can buy various upgrades for your vehicle or unlock newer vehicles. You start with machines from the 1900s. Can you get to the very top and ride on modern machinery? Controls are simplified enough to give you still the passion of riding but not too complex to take you hours to learn. It mainly focuses on providing players with the best enjoyment from racing fights. The game's core is short, dynamic races with a high action density. The feeling from the ride is very reminiscent of older games; do not expect a hardcore simulator. On the other hand, it's not a mario kart racing game - there are physics, and you need to keep that in mind. - 80 motorbikes from 120 years of history - 50 real and custom tracks - 1000+ various vehicle setups - 30+ vehicle patterns, each customizable - 10 different biomes Using a simple yet rich customization system, you can customize your vehicle and rider as much as you want. For example, you can paint your motorbikes with any combination of colors or use any of the available patterns to customize them! The game is based on custom cloud-saving technology. As part of that, it contains many classic MMO features like cloud save, leaderboards, daily missions, achievements, and stats! Compare yourself to other racers!

rows.name: Reindeer Racing
rows.short_description: Reindeer Racing is a quirky and casual racing game where you race against up to 8 players worldwide. Use falling trees and a variety of other obstacles to hinder your rivals as you race to victory and climb the leaderboard.
rows.description_html: Reindeer Racing is a quirky and casual racing game where you race against up to 8 players worldwide. Sabotage the environment to cross your opponents, throw snowballs or ram into objects to trigger these traps. You are a reindeer racer in a no-holds-barred race in the cold north, which means you will have to do anything to get ahead of your opponents on the track and win the race, even if it means playing dirty. Race Easy to learn, fun to master: Jump into the game whenever you want, and master along the way. Chaotic, fast-paced gameplay: There is always something going on, and something to do on the track, whether it is navigating dangerous roads, setting traps for opponents or clashing with other racers. Quirky controls: Control the chaotic and unruly reindeer that pull your sled through the harsh conditions of the cold north. Sabotage Dynamic environment: Interact with the environment around the track to give yourself an advantage in the race. This could be through traps, obstacles or secret routes. Variety of sabotaging: Activate traps in the environment by hitting them or throwing snowballs at them. These can be falling icicles, exploding tree trunks or even large snowballs. Multiplayer Play with friends: Play against your friends with up to 8 players. Note This game was made as a school project by a group of 7 students from Kajaani University of Applied Sciences, Finland.

rows.name: SCARY MAGIC ZOMBIE
rows.short_description: EVIL SCIENTISTS have created a SCARY MAGIC ZOMBIE! Play as a top secret spy, who enters the zombie facility, and collects information about the zombie. But be cautious! The zombie is very dangerous!
rows.description_html: SCARY MAGIC ZOMBIE is a short first-person horror game. The story is: Evil scientists have created a SCARY MAGIC ZOMBIE. You play as a secret spy, who enters the facility, and must collect information about this zombie. But watch out! The SCARY MAGIC ZOMBIE is extremely dangerous. Be very careful. - The gameplay is very simple. You walk through the facility, and use the left mouse click button to open doors and pick up documents. You control the player camera with the mouse, and use the WASD keys to move. The controls are: WASD keys for movement mouse movement for camera control left mouse click to interact with game objects ESCAPE key to open and close the pause menu TAB key to view the current game objective F key to toggle the flashlight The game is designed for people who enjoy short, suspenseful, frightening experiences, with a highly immersive atmosphere. Average completion time: 10-20 minutes.

rows.name: the legend of tomoko
rows.short_description: In this game, you have to defeat various monsters that have invaded the village and the nearby forest. Can the villagers return? You can use swords, cast wateR and Fire magic. reading this description carefully could be strong weapon to defeat your enemies.
rows.description_html: 'If you are brave, please help!!' This is a action game where you play as a female samurai, Tomoko, and save a cursed village. The year is 7900. A village with a beautiful shrine and nature has been invaded by the Demon King's army. Driven by fear, the villagers have fled, and now no one is in sight. The villagers want to make the village a safe place to live again. Tomoko, a beautiful samurai with a spirit rooted in Japanese tradition, decides to fight the Demon King's army to lift the curse on the village and bring hope back to the people. Armed with a legendary sword and magic, Tomoko faces enemies one after another. Dodge attacks, defeat enemies with your sword, and carefully plan your strategy. When your stamina runs out, the game is over. Defeat formidable enemies! The thrill of defeating enemies... it's also great for relieving stress. [How to play] The current combat system is very basic and simple * Right click mouse ⇒ dodge Roll * Left click mouse ⇒ Melee attack * Click F and R buttons ⇒ Access two ancient magic spells This game is a small stepping stone to a bigger project to be released next year. It will be a Souls-like video game showcasing our new Vtuber Mochiko.

rows.name: Awaria
rows.short_description: Awaria is a short game about working in haunted maintenance tunnels.
rows.description_html: Welcome to the tunnel maintenance crew. If the generators fail, it's your job to fix them. Check what's wrong, craft all the needed parts and deliver them. It's simple. Just stay clear of anything that randomly cracks bolts of electricity, spews fire, throws sharp pieces of scrap at high-velocity or radiates with ominous green light. Features: Enjoy claustrophobic penal labor. Break and panic under constant time pressure. Dodge deadly projectiles and safety violations. You may even... kiss a ghost?

rows.name: Storm the Swan - And the Power of FRIENDSHIP and IMAGINATION
rows.short_description: Make Cute Animal Friends in this 8-bit Gameboy-inspired adventure! But there's something lurking in the woods, with DARK SECRETS you'll need to uncover!
rows.description_html: You just moved to HEDGEHOG HILLS, a small village full of ADORABLE CUTE ANIMAL CHARACTERS!  You get your own HOUSE, and can visit the many places in this PEACEFUL area! There you meet STORM THE SWAN, a ZANY and WACKY character who is always SCARED of something.  STORM says there's a MONSTER in the WOODS, but surely, they're only imagining things! Enjoy this CUTE and EDUCATIONAL 8-bit adventure on your own portable 'Data Kid Entertainment System' available in select toy stores in the California area!   STORM THE SWAN is an 8-bit style Point 'n' Click / Visual Novel Retro-Horror heavily inspired by the era of the Gameboy and children's cartoons of the 80s and 90s .  You're  a player for the newest children's game for a portable gaming system, but something is happening with the game (as well as the world around you) that is getting increasingly strange and scary.   Meet and befriend several cute animal characters in HEDGEHOG HILLS, live and CUSTOMIZE your HOUSE, UNCOVER deep secrets in the game and witness the collapse of your own world.   Storm the Swan is another addition to the 'Data Time Software series', or 'Date Time Universe'.

rows.name: Coffee Break
rows.short_description: It's time for a well-deserved break from your space-engineering stuff. Unravel the functioning of your freshly repaired coffee machine, while trying not to destroy the Earth. The fate of all humanity lies on your mug!
rows.description_html: 30 minutes of hard work have passed, and it's finally time for a well-deserved break! Your objective is simple: brew some delicious coffee with the stuff your crew stored inside your spaceship. A task rather simple if you squeeze your brain and think about it. It would be terrible, however, if your colleague connected the wrong red button to the USA nuclear arsenal launch sequence and your daughter is joyfully going to school, completely unaware of it Relax in the chill atmosphere of deep space, while playing this short-and-sweet Point and Click Puzzle game: you only need your dominant hand (or hook, if you are a space pirate) and a mouse to navigate through the playful systems of the game. Brace yourself, here are some of them: Multiple Endings: 11 Bad Endings are hidden, for you to avoid them! Lots of hints are scattered as notes and other secrets , for you to find them! Franco. Epic Interactions: grab and toss around the items your crew left around in the spaceship, with custom sounds and properties Revolutionary liquids mixing system (source: trust me, bro). Original Radio Stations , achievements and much more! Other cool features included: Real time text translation from Russian Cool space squids Betrayals, tears and drama 64% accurate solar system representation 'More moons in Earth's orbit' FREE DLC 'Coffee Break was first developed by the craziest AIV students during the Virtualverse, a Game Jam where the top game development schools of Italy battle to the Death for fame and glory. It was a tough clash, but Coffee Break came out as the winner, bringing home three of the available five prizes, including best game overall.'

rows.name: Myrmica
rows.short_description: Myrmica is an investigation and puzzle adventure viewed from an isometric perspective. Explore a petrol station while chased by a time anomaly. Manipulate the routines of 5 unique characters to achieve your goal, create your situations trapped in a time loop, and uncover the truth of Complex B13B
rows.description_html: The year is 2058. In a dystopic future where the USA leads as the de facto only world power, play as Liv: An agent of the S.I.N (Supernatural Investigations Network). You will be sent to an oil station in the middle of the Pacific, stuck in 1982. Your mission? Discover what’s causing problems in the system so the station can continue working without being noticed. But this place is full of secrets and Liv is just a cog in the machine. Explore a petrol station (Complex B13B) full of secrets and mysteries. The environment and the people who live in it will react to your actions and the events happening at the station. Rooms, lights, dialogues, and so much more will change... with time.  Explore and test the possibilities of the time loop while making your way to uncover the truth. Meet Frank, Alice, Needle, Kira, and The Archivist. Learn their stories, secrets, and motivations. Everyone has a key role in Complex B13B and yours will be to find it. With a sprawling dialogue system that’ll let you confront them as you please. Good cop or bad cop? And more important. What would you do when you discover their stories? The T.M.R (Time Manipulation Recorder) is the main tool of Myrmica. With it, you can investigate and manipulate the characters and the world around you. Thanks to the T.M.R, you can create your own solutions and situations, use their routines to your advantage, and explore the way to solve the mysteries the station holds. This game is a university project by students at U-tad. The masters involved are design, art, programming, modeling, concept, animation, rigging, and production from U-tad and the master's degree in musical creation and production from Loyola University.

rows.name: Hexed Time
rows.short_description: Play as a witch living in secret among villagers in this hand-drawn narrative puzzle adventure. An attempt to change fate traps her in a time loop. Help the witch and her cat escape without getting caught by the inquisition. Your choices shape the outcome.
rows.description_html: Hexed Time is a hand-drawn point-and-click puzzle adventure set in a quaint medieval village. You play as Amelia, a seemingly ordinary grocer who lives among the village folk—though her simple life hides a powerful secret. Amelia is a witch, skilled in casting spells and brewing potions. When a prophecy revealed through a crystal ball foretells a terrible fate for her dear friend, Amelia takes desperate action, trapping the day in a time loop. The loop will end only if her friend survives until midnight. However, she didn’t anticipate the arrival of the Inquisition, whose sole goal is to uncover and burn the witch. What will be your way out of the repeating day? Cast Spells and Brew Potions As a witch, Amelia has a range of magical abilities to help her manipulate the world around her. Cast spells and brew potions to solve puzzles, change outcomes, and shape the flow of the time to your liking. Explore the Village The village you inhabit is more than just a setting—it’s a dynamic world where your actions have consequences. Visit various locations, interact with villagers, and uncover hidden secrets as you explore. Discover how your decisions affect the lives of those around you and the path to breaking the loop. Reach Multiple Endings Your choices throughout the game will determine the outcome. Will you find a way to save your friend and yourself, or will your magic and choices lead to an unexpected fate? Explore different paths and unlock up to three unique endings. Which one will you choose?

rows.name: FSKN
rows.short_description: From an agent embedded in a group of Russian mafia, serving the drug cartels, the FDCN of Russia receives information about the supply of heroin by sea. The agent gives the approximate coordinates of the place of the goods, which should take place near an labor camp on the Pacific coast of Russia.
rows.description_html: FSKN is a high-tech game with an interesting plot and exciting gameplay in the action genre, based on an important problem of modern society, which has not yet found sufficient coverage in computer games. The genre of the game assumes high dynamics of the gameplay, fully three-dimensional environment, a large number of characters in the game and an easy-to-understand storyline. From an agent embedded in a group of Russian mafiosi, serving the transportation of drug cartels, the FDCN of Russia receives information about the supply of heroin by sea. The agent gives the approximate coordinates of the place of transshipment of the goods, which should take place near an abandoned labor camp on the Pacific coast of Russia. According to the agent's information, the drug is to be distributed throughout the country. This edition also includes the “Old Fort” add-on! During a special operation to uncover drug trafficking through Europe, an undercover agent is kidnapped and placed in an old abandoned fort infested with criminals. Your task is to get out of the mess and solve the case! Features: Exciting missions in the spirit of a spy thriller reminiscent of action-packed action movies! A shocking storyline based on real events. A detailed recreation of the coordinated work of the Russian Federation's anti-drug police department. Detailed locations. Real-life weapons. Unexpected plot twists.

The game offers 20 completely varied levels, each with an entirely different playstyle and way of killing. Do you like a challenge? Don't worry. A twisted story with revealing motivations. Numerous interesting characters to kill or to love. Crime solving sub-levels as a detective. Tons of dark humor and horror movie references. Lots of gore and guts.

rows.description_html: Explore the adventurous world of Gloop, a retro 2D platformer that blends nostalgic gameplay with a unique companion mechanic. You play as a young girl exploring the depths of an abandoned mine where you meet Gloop, a slime-like creature who becomes your trusted ally against dangerous foes. Work together through challenging levels to defeat the mage that has haunted these mines in this lighthearted and mysterious adventure.  Features: Classic Platformer action: Run, jump and explore the depths of the mines Companion abilities: Use Gloop to attack any enemies that may attack you. Retro style: Pixel art visuals for a simple yet nostalgic feel. Accessible gameplay: Whether you are a keyboard or a controller player, enjoy all levels on your top preference. Development in Progress: The game is still being developed, and we’re actively working to make it the best it can be. Feedback from players is incredibly important to us, and we’re excited to hear your thoughts as we continue to improve and expand the game.

rows.name: Chess 'n' Blocks
rows.short_description: Have you ever considered playing Chess and Tetris simultaneously? Guess what? My strange brain did for years; I don't know why. But I finally took the time to create this game. And that's how chess 'n' blocks was born.
rows.description_html: Have you ever considered playing Chess and Tetris simultaneously? Guess what? My strange brain did for years; I don't know why. But I finally took the time to create this game. And that's how chess 'n' blocks was born. The game is designed to be straightforward. Two players engage in a fast-paced chess match, known as blitz mode. You both have 5 minutes to play all your moves. When it's your turn, a timer decreases until you make your move. If this timer reaches 0, you lose. Simple right? But that's not all. Once the first move is done, Tetris pieces start falling! And if you lose at Tetris or chess, you lose, too! But I also wanted to connect both games; how? That's the funny part: if you take a piece at chess, a line spawns at the bottom of your opponent's Tetris, making it harder for them. But what if it's not your turn at chess? Then try to break three lines on your Tetris to add two to your opponent's one! Or make a Tetris by breaking 4 of them and adding three lines this time! Quite simple, right? Focusing on both games is not easy at all! But it's the spice!

rows.name: Horizon Walker
rows.short_description: Eat God, and you will have everything—the story of a human who devoured God.
rows.description_html: Horizon Walker is a turn-based RPG with a unique storyline and captivating graphics. ​ Join forces with stunning characters from beyond the dimensions and fight against the gods.​ Story Overview Mankind’s thriving civilization was brought to a halt by the sudden appearance of dimensional “Rifts.”​ From these Rifts, divine beings emerged, ruthlessly destroying and pillaging civilizations. rows.name: HappyHazard
rows.short_description: A survival adventure game where players explore vast stages, solve puzzles, and find treasure while avoiding or battling enemies. Limited resources and inventory management require strategic play, offering tension and challenge without horror elements.
rows.description_html: This is a survival adventure game inspired by Resident Evil 2, but without the horror element. The player receives a mission to find treasure, exploring vast stages, solving puzzles, and either avoiding or defeating enemies while trying to escape. Strategic gameplay is required due to the limited resources and inventory system, offering tension and a sense of challenge without relying on fear. Key Features Puzzle Solving and Treasure Hunting: Players must find hidden treasures and solve puzzles across various stages, with the ultimate goal of escaping. Combat or Avoidance: Throughout the stages, players encounter enemies that can either be defeated or avoided, depending on the situation. Limited Resources: The number of consumable items, such as bullets, keys, and healing items, is limited, making efficient resource management essential. Inventory Management: With limited inventory space, players must selectively carry important items, and these choices have a significant impact on the game's progression. Messages from Predecessor Agents: Scattered across the map are tips left by previous agents. Reading and using this information can be helpful during gameplay. Controller Support Gameplay is only available through mouse & keyboard controls.

rows.name: The Trio
rows.short_description: The Trio invites you into a world shrouded in mystery and danger. By day, gather resources and reinforce your shelter, but as night falls, sinister creatures rise from the shadows, driven by a dark curse. Survival becomes a desperate fight against cursed creatures that stalk the land.
rows.description_html: The trio is a survival PVE experience. Gather the resources of the ancient forest by day and with the help of your resident-lumberjack. Craft your defense and prepare for the monsters that will attack at nightfall as survival becomes a desperate fight against the skeletons that stalk the land. Break the curse and save the forest!

rows.name: CyberSeas
rows.short_description: Race around sunken streets in your jet ship, swing between collapsed skyscrapers with your trusty harpoon and build your reputation amongst the colourful inhabitants of the CyberSeas!
rows.description_html: Welcome to the CyberSeas, a post-apocalyptic near-future where cyber pirates rule the flooded remains of civilisation. Your jet ship comes equipped with a harpoon, allowing you to grapple and swing around the environment. Complete missions for a colorful cast of characters, including competing in races, performing tricks, finding collectibles and more! CyberSeas contains three unique maps to explore, dozens of missions to complete, upgrades to equip your boat with and many hours of fun.

rows.name: Drinking in the hot spring!
rows.short_description: 'How about a drink?' In this heartwarming, conversation-driven visual novel, you step into the role of the leader of a hot spring drinking club. You'll help its colorful members navigate personal troubles, sometimes with the aid of a drink or two, and see their challenges through to resolution.
rows.description_html: 【Important Notice】 - You can change the language settings via the following steps: Steam 'Library' → Game 'Manage (Gear Icon)' → 'Properties' → 'General' → 'Language'. Once the change is made, the update will begin automatically. - Please note that changing the language may make your save data inaccessible. 【About the Game】 In this humor-filled human drama, you take on the role of the leader of a hot spring drinking club, spending enjoyable moments with a diverse group of members from different ages and backgrounds. As you bond with them, you’ll support them through their worries and troubles, sometimes with a little help from alcohol, and help to heal their hearts. The issues faced by the members—such as relationships, career paths, and marriage—are universally relatable, making for a heartfelt and engaging story. As their leader, and sometimes as their companion, enjoy the relaxing ambiance of the hot spring, savor drinks together, and soothe your own tired spirit in the process. - Be sure to immerse yourself in the atmospheric sounds and music! - Approximate playtime: about one hour. 【Route】 One ending (with minor branching paths that converge quickly). 【Controls (Keyboard)】 Enter : Advance dialogue Ctrl : Skip (follows the unread skip setting in Config) A : Start Auto Mode M : Open Menu Space : Temporarily hide the text window 【Streaming & Sharing】 You are welcome to stream or share your playthrough up to the ending. Monetization of gameplay content is also permitted. No prior contact is necessary, but we’d appreciate it if you could include the game’s name and a link somewhere in your content. Fan creations are also encouraged! 【Caution】 While the game maintains a lighthearted tone, it includes depictions of alcohol dependence. Additionally, please take appropriate precautions if you choose to enjoy alcohol in a hot spring in real life. 【Credits】 - Planning, Script, Direction : Saku Yuki (遊木さく/Hummingway) - Illustration, Design : Esuko Era(江良エス子) - Script, Programming : ahTama(嗚呼タマ) - English Translator : Roh - Simplified/Traditional Chinese Translator : Subarun(スバルン) 【Assets】 ▼BGM : - RYU ITO (details in end credits) ▼Sound Effects : - ma-tari (Audiostock) / PIXTA - TrickSTAR MUSIC (Audiostock) / PIXTA - Silent Wave (Audiostock) / PIXTA - Studio Seven(スタジオセブン) (Audiostock) / PIXTA - Sound of Diving into Water(飛び込む水の音) NHK ▼Plugins : - Batch Theme Conversion Plugin #13(テーマ一括変換プラグイン その13) (Free Material) Source : Kuso Kyokusen(空想曲線)

rows.name: Van Simulator
rows.short_description: Van Simulator is a delivery game where you drive a van, pick up packages, and deliver them. Expand your business, upgrade your van, and manage deliveries efficiently. Enjoy urban delivery in a low-poly environment.
rows.description_html: Get behind the wheel and experience the life of a delivery driver in Van Simulator ! Drive through bustling streets, pick up packages, and deliver them to their destinations. Manage your time efficiently and maximize your earnings as you expand your delivery business. With each successful delivery, you'll earn money to upgrade your van and take on bigger challenges. Whether you're navigating tight alleyways or racing the clock, every delivery counts. Do you have what it takes to be the best courier in town?

rows.name: Switch Poker
rows.short_description: The poker trader. Switch Poker is a fast-paced, rewarding handbuilder where you trade cards with other players, strategize against opponent playstyles, and create the best poker hand.
rows.description_html: Switch Poker is an online poker hand builder all about trading cards with your opponents! Keep strong cards for yourself and give away the rest to create the best hand possible. You'll need every edge you can get to win when playing against up to 8 other players. Think about what cards your opponent will trade with you to stay one step ahead! The definitive online poker trading experience. In-game chat - deceive your opponents by lying about what card you need, or form short-term alliances to take down those in the lead. Multiplayer mode includes public and private lobbies, quick join, and join codes! Immerse yourself in Switch Poker's lounge-inspired world, complete with sleek, modern art. Let the jazzy soundtrack get you in a rhythm to enjoy a thrilling poker trading session!

rows.name: Forest Ranger Services: Episode 1
rows.short_description: Horror game series about the investigation of missing hikers in the U.S. National Parks. Follow the story of a wannabe reporter who got a job as a ranger to investigate the disappearances - several episodes that tell one story! Based on true events.
rows.description_html: ONE STORY THROUGH MULTIPLE EPISODES - LIKE A TV SHOW! Story that unfolds across multiple episodes, each with new mysteries and thrilling twists and explanations of what's happening. You play as the same character in all episodes, but sometimes you may play as side characters in the story. Start your journey in Episode 1 by exploring atmospheric locations and piecing together the start of the narrative of Forest Ranger Services. EXAMINE YOUR SURROUNDINGS Explore the levels and find details, lore and clues - Try to figure out the plot of the series. DRIVE Go for a ride in a forest and listen to a radio station podcast about missing hikers and UFOs all based on facts, documented reports and real life events. YOU ARE THE MAIN CHARACTER OF THE SERIES! Experience the events that start the Forest Ranger Services series where you are the main character. Find all the clues in the first episode. Piece together the creepy start of the series - a non-linear story! Talk to strange individuals - meet some of the main characters and follow their story through the episodes! Casual driving with a twist! The Forest Ranger Services series are based on real life events and personal accounts of hikers. The narrative has been altered for entertainment purposes. There are thousands of missing reports filed each year in the U.S National Parks. Many cases remain unexplained.

rows.name: OUTL1NED
rows.short_description: Fast-paced 1D arcade shooter. The Y and Z axis are overrated, it's time to play a game that pushes X to the limit. OUTL1NED.
rows.description_html: OUTL1NED is a manic One-Dimensional arcade shooter where you last as long as you can while enjoying a colourful lightshow in the background. Even though enemies can only come from 2 intense directions rather than 360 flaccid degrees , you will have to focus to keep the pressure at bay and manage which direction needs your attention. You will be challenged to manage your constantly-regenerating ammo and collect a variety of diverse upgrades as you go in order to last as long as you can. Battle a variety of colour-coordinated enemy types that will vary in speed, health, and visibility that will force you to make tough decisions as they close in. Enemies aren't the only danger as you will occasionally pick up debuffs that will obscure your vision and change up how you see the world. Compete to get the highest score globally on the global leaderboard .

rows.name: Kosmolaris
rows.short_description: Kosmolaris is a relaxing puzzle game where you'll have combine a wide variety of elements to create new ones, starting with four basic elements: Air 💨, Fire 🔥, Earth 🍃, and Water 💧.
rows.description_html: Kosmolaris is a relaxing puzzle game where you'll have combine a wide variety of elements to create new ones, starting with four basic elements:  Air 💨, Fire 🔥, Earth 🍃 and  Water 💧. Some elements are based on chemical principles, while others rely more on common sense or reverse engineering. There are two types of elements:   Common and  Special . Common: These are public knowledge, and you can unlock all of them without any restrictions, just by applying chemical principles and common sense. Special:  These are mainly easter eggs , and unlocking them may require specific knowledge about certain topics. They often aren't real elements but come from fictional sources or iconic moments from our lives and the world at large (possibly). Don’t worry if you don’t find them—they aren't the main goal of the game. But if you're curious... Some features: 6 languages for now: Spanish (Latam), Spanish (Spain), English, Italian, Portuguese and French. Outstanding elements art! +200 common elements. +15 special elements (fiction, easter eggs). +30 achievements. Auto-save for each movement. Relaxing background music.

Unlock Mystical and Alien Realms Progress through beautifully crafted realms, each with its own unusual tile sets and atmospheric themes. From tranquil zen spaces to eerie alien worlds, every realm offers a distinct experience. Puzzle Editor & Steam Workshop Integration Craft your own puzzles with the intuitive editor and share them on the Steam Workshop. Browse a growing collection of player-made layouts for endless replayability and challenges. Immersive Music & Visuals Each realm is brought to life with custom music tracks and striking visuals, creating a deep, immersive atmosphere that evolves with your journey.

rows.name: Draconis 8
rows.short_description: Draconis 8: A fast-paced, highly accessible tactical card game. Each booster pack is also a fully playable, unique deck with 1 Dragon, 7 Champions, and 1 Terrain. Unlike other TCG-style games, each card is not only unique, but balanced. Play single-pack, constructed, or triple-pack - online or solo.
rows.description_html: Unique Decks • Tactical Duels • Compact Strategy What is Draconis 8? With iron, heart, scales, deadly breath weapons, and unmatched intelligence, dragons reign supreme. But when disputes arise between these mighty rulers, they are not settled by armies… but by the  Draconis 8 . Each dragon gathers a warband — themselves and  seven legendary champions  — to battle another dragon’s team. These duels decide the fate of empires, played through a fast-paced, deeply strategic card game. 8-Card Decks Every duel begins with a lean but powerful force:  one mighty Dragon ,  seven Champions , and a  neutral Terrain card  that sets the stage. This compact design means there's no wasted space — every card has weight, and every decision matters. Your Dragon is your ace, boasting multiple abilities and devastating stats, but the Champions you surround it with will determine how battles unfold. Your deck might pair a fearsome Red Dragon with orc warriors, elven archers, and a sly goblin trickster — each one contributing a unique way to score or disrupt. Simultaneous Play Unlike most card games where players alternate turns, some parts of Draconis 8  is played in real-time mind games . Both players draw, then secretly choose a card to play. When revealed, the card with higher initiative earns a point and resolves first. This keeps the pace brisk and tense: you're always thinking ahead, bluffing, and trying to predict your rival's next move. Will your opponent commit their Dragon early for raw power, or hold it back for a decisive late strike? Do you counter with a solid Champion… or risk everything on a bold play? Tactical Positioning Cards don't just hit the table —  where you place them is just as important as what you play . Each card you add connects to the growing battlefield, scoring when adjacent to foes. Initiative determines first placement, but positioning unlocks deep tactical layers: block off scoring lines, rotate enemies, or create chains of allies that amplify one another's abilities. Your Champion of Fear rotates an enemy Paladin just enough that their strong side no longer scores points — swinging the round in your favor. Unique Abilities Every card carries a special ability that warps the rules in your favor or sabotages your foe. Dragons often wield multiple powers, but even humble Champions can deliver game-changing effects. Some bend the battlefield (rotating, swapping, shielding), others manipulate scoring (stealing, multiplying, or redirecting points). Combined, they create endless tactical puzzles — and no two decks play the same. A stealthy Rogue Champion lets you sneak victory beads from one card to another, while your Dragon unleashes a devastating ability that clears a row of enemies. Victory in 7 Rounds The battle is short, sharp, and conclusive: after  seven rounds of simultaneous duels , the player with the most victory points claims the match. No endless grind, no drawn-out stalemates — just pure, focused strategy packed into 15–30 minutes. You're tied in points after round six. In the final round, your Dragon enters the field and tips the balance, claiming the decisive victory. Glory is yours. Why Draconis 8 Over Other Games? Board Game & TCG in One Play right out of the box, or customize decks like a trading card game. Physical & Digital Integration Scan your terrain card to unlock your exact deck in the  Draconis 8 app . Instant Digital Play Battle the AI, join global matchmaking, and compete in tournaments. Endless Replayability Every card is algorithmically generated with  millions of possible combinations . They are also mathematically balanced, with no rare cards to chase. Every Pack is Tournament Legal No wasted pulls — all cards are balanced.

rows.name: Life is Feudal: Arden
rows.short_description: Life is Feudal: Arden is a new free-to-play open-world MMORPG set in the Middle Ages, built on the foundation of Life is Feudal: MMO. Engage in thrilling PvP combat, navigate political intrigue, master a variety of professions and craft unique items. Forge your own path to power and greatness!
rows.description_html: New lands Explore a hand-crafted map offering distinct PvP and PvE zones, ensuring that there’s something for everyone. In special PvPvE areas, you can hunt dangerous Knools for valuable resources. Stay alert at all times, as you may become the hunted if other players are after the same treasures. Enhanced crafting and construction Gather resources to forge high-quality weapons and gear. With streamlined and clearer recipes, you can spend more time focusing on other essential aspects of the game. Build everything from modest shelters to prosperous villages and impregnable castles. The scale is limited only by your imagination. Dynamic character progression Gone are the days of needing multiple characters for different professions. In Arden, you can switch skills on your main character whenever you like. Visit a monument and become a blacksmith, farmer, or swap your tools for a sword to jump into battle. The choice is always yours! Realistic trading system    Trading in Arden is as close to reality as it gets. With limited spots for trading posts, you’ll need to choose your locations wisely. There’s no instant delivery; you must personally transport goods for sale. And beware—bandits lie in wait, ready to raid your caravan. Whether defending your goods or threatening others, stay vigilant on the trade routes. Unique combat & epic battles   Combat in Life is Feudal: Arden is both intuitive and realistic—striking your enemy requires precision, and physical stats matter. Fight alongside allies in massive battles, participate in sieges, or hone your skills in the arena with PvP duels or group PvP skirmishes. The battlefield is your playground. Power struggles & political intrigue    Step into a real political sandbox where alliances are made and broken. Participate in large-scale sieges and territory wars, conquer land on a real-world map, and tax those you defeat. In this world, might makes right—winners write the history books. Create your own medieval realm Step into a realistic medieval world with limitless possibilities, where your decisions shape not only your in-game experience but the game’s development itself. Life is Feudal: Arden was made in close cooperation with players, with feedback driving important choices. Your voice plays a direct role in the future of the game.

rows.name: Stellar Stables
rows.short_description: In Stellar Stables, you are an intergalactic alien-horse farmer, making your way through point and click puzzles and intriguing mini games to obtain horses and food for them. Watch as your Horse Happiness Meter grows and your stables fill up with all kinds of unique and lovable creatures!
rows.description_html: Dive into an enchanting world of adventure and discovery! In this exciting space horse-collecting game, players explore detailed, colorful illustrated landscapes in search of hidden items, interactive elements, and minigames. Discover puzzles, find food, and embark on a quest to bring your new equine friends home. Start your journey and see how many unique horses you can add to your collection! Features: Exploration: Find and solve puzzles in three wildly different biomes on this alien planet, as well as a smaller location around your Home. Puzzles: Click around and read clues to find items, enter minigames and collect horses. Minigames such as: Fishing Musical gauntlet Renewable Food Sources: Click various objects to collect food for your horses. Alien Horse Stables: Interact with, move and feed the horses you collected in your Stables. Story Elements: Learn about the planet by reading descriptions of curious objects. Credits: Made by SpaceVibes! rows.name: Exsanguination
rows.short_description: Exsanguination is a fast-paced, first-person melee combat game where you play as a former vampire hunter turned into a vampire. With your new vampiric powers, fight against your enemies to reclaim your humanity in a dark, brutal world.
rows.description_html: Exsanguination is a fast-paced, first-person melee combat game where you play as a former vampire hunter now turned into a vampire. Move quickly and masterfully using your grappling hook, and challenge yourself with a speed-run timer for an added layer of excitement. Will you survive the night or become a victim of the very creatures you once hunted? Features Use your newfound vampiric powers to dash, slide, and engage in brutal melee combat against hordes of ghouls and bats. Block enemy attacks, reflect projectiles, and strategically use your wooden stake to heal yourself and finish off foes. Explore a dark, treacherous world filled with traps, secrets, and hidden challenges, including an epic boss battle with the mysterious figure who turned you into a vampire. Credits Charles Silvennoinen  -   Product Owner, Environment and Level Design, Art Direction Aapo Vanhainen  - Producing, Publishing, Design, Audio, Programming Kimmo Riipinen  - Lead Programmer, Audio, QA Lead Emilia Hietikko  - Programming, Visual Effects, Design, Scrum Master, Narrative Vili Jalonen  - Narrative, Business Jesse Kauhanen  - Junior Programmer, Testing Special thanks to Sanni Ouli for producing the level music and Severi Boesen for producing the boss fight music for this game. *This game is a student project created in a period of 9 weeks.

rows.name: Happy Home: Prologue
rows.short_description: Explore the beginning of a new horrifying story in this mixture of a text-based and a 2D game. Emily's world is about to turn upside down, maybe in more ways than anyone is able to realize yet.
rows.description_html: 'Spiders live in a happy home.' Explore a story of real life horrors mixed with supernatural. In this prologue, you play as Emily, whose life is about to change in a way that no one could have predicted. Dive into an intriguing story with amazing hand-drawn visuals in this mix of a text-based game and 2D exploration. Begin a new mystery Make decisions while progressing through the story Explore Emily's home Fight things that scare you with a flashlight Just a bite The prologue will take approximately 10-20 minutes to play, depending on your reading speed. It is an introduction to a longer story, although the future of the game is still uncertain. First project This is a student project created as a part of a course at JAMK University of Applied Sciences. This was the first full game project for everyone in the team, and was made in approximately 9 weeks. Any and all feedback is welcome!

rows.name: Lumen: World of Color
rows.short_description: Lumen: World of Color is an action adventure game made as a student project.
rows.description_html: In Lumen you take on the role of a druid seeking to cleanse an ancient fortress and stop it from spreading its corruption to the forest.  Lumen is a third-person action-adventure with stylized pixelated graphics. You progress through the game by solving puzzles and clearing corruption.  Companion  You'll be accompanied by a spirit along your journey, giving you helpful tips and commenting on the environment, in a supposedly non-annoying way.    Cure the land  A corruption is draining the land of its life force and leaving only its roots and minions to inhabit the landscape.  Find sources of corruption and destroy them to remove the corruption and bring back life that was drained from the land.    Puzzles  Solve multiple types of puzzles to access new areas.  The game has three types of puzzles that you’ll find along your way and need to solve to finish the game.  Crafting  Around the world there are useful materials to make weapons and potions, to help your journey.  At the moment the game has two melee weapons and two ranged weapons. And the ranged weapon needs arrows to shoot.  Fighting  Third person real-time combat with melee and ranged attacks.  Boss fight  At the end you’ll face off with the source of the corruption. Evil mage that has encased their soul into a skeletal statue.  Lore  On your adventure you’ll find the story of the world in books and dialog telling the rich history of the land.   Music  Lumen has a lot of ambiance, and adaptive music.  Thank you for reading. This is a school project that was made in about 3 months, and the group will disband after publishing.

rows.name: Providentia Academy
rows.short_description: Providentia Academy is a 2D visual novel with the themes of romance, mystery and horror.
rows.description_html: Providentia Academy is a captivating 2D visual novel that immerses players in a world of mystery, romance, and supernatural intrigue. Set within the prestigious walls of Providentia Academy, players will follow the story of a talented student who unravels the academy's hidden secrets. As players navigate through the story, they'll make choices that shape the protagonist's relationships, influence the plot, and determine the ultimate fate of the academy. With stunning visuals, evocative music, and a compelling narrative, Providentia Academy offers a unique and unforgettable gaming experience. This is only the first chapter and not the full game. It serves as an introduction to a longer story, although it's still uncertain if we're going to continue this project. This game is a student project created in a period of 9 weeks. Credits: Made by GEOMS Entertainment Saku Raitanen - Product Owner, Design, Narrative Essi Pirttivaara - Technology, Scrum Master, Producing & Publishing Gabriel Nwaoha - Audio, Implementation, Producing & Publishing Mairiin Kask - Art, Business Oliver Valtonen - Art, Q&A Special thanks to: Tero Korpela - Technology

rows.name: Krax Ca-caw's Concoction Chaos
rows.short_description: You are Krax Ca-caw’s new intern. Learn the craft of potion brewery, memorise the recipes, and become the next best potion maker. Fill the cauldron with the correct ingredients and stir. Don’t let it overflow!
rows.description_html: Krax Ca-caw’s Concoction Chaos is an arcade-style potion crafting game. You have been accepted as the intern of master potion maker Krax Ca-caw. With him as your teacher, learn the intricate craft of potion brewery. Memorise the sacred magical recipe book, fill the cauldron with ingredients, and stir the mixture without letting the cauldron overflow. With this practice, you will be the next potion master in no time. ((Warning: this game contains imagery that may be harmful to players with photosensitive epilepsy or other similar conditions, if you experience any seizure symptoms IMMEDIATELY stop playing and consult a doctor.)) Key Features Mix a variety of magical potions! Pick from a variety of fantastical ingredients, stir the mixture in the cauldron, and make one of the many magical potions available in the game! Play different game modes! Choose between three different game modes: high score, speedrun and endless. Choose your own difficulty!   If standard difficulty isn't for you, you can choose from randomised recipe book pages. Or try blackout mode with reduced brightness.

rows.name: SPACEUM
rows.short_description: You're stranded on SPACEUM, a sprawling space base with a deadly alien parasite hiding in the shadows. To escape, you’ll need every ounce of energy you can find. Can you crack the code to freedom, or will you face down the monster that stands in your way? How far will you go to make it out alive?
rows.description_html: Dangerous creatures have made their way here! This is the SPACEUM space base and I need to get out of here urgently! The shuttle will pick me up, so I need to activate the code and enter the access code to board! To find out the code, turn on 1) Green 2) Red 3) Blue and 4) Yellow - the levers in the correct sequence! Find each of them and send the code through the input console or try to put down the alien to get the spare transmitter he has - look for weapons and ammo. You will be saved! SPACEUM IS: Realistic graphics, cut scenes, atmospheric sound design Two ways to complete the game with different elements of the gameplay During the game you will immerse yourself in the atmosphere of science fiction horror films about space Random - the game starts from different points, quest places and items, and also a random alien from 4 types This is an indie horror, with elements of stealth, shooter, horror, survival puzzles.

rows.name: DIMAWORLD
rows.short_description: Help Misha search for Dima in a comedic, post-Soviet inspired world, filled with unique details and lovingly created by one man indie developer. A hand-crafted open-world adventure unlike any other!
rows.description_html: Misha is searching for Dima. He must scour a fictional world  (CHECK 230 / 236 PLACES) whose landscapes vaguely resemble areas around major Eastern European cities in the early 21st century—reimagined in a humorous alternate reality. DIMAWORLD IS: Realistic visuals, cutscenes, and immersive sound design A single-player open-world experience, offering several hours of gameplay packed with diverse elements: large-scale events, occurrences of natural phenomena, and unexpected encounters. You’ll interact with various physical objects and entities, robots, and weapons—purchasing and using them, and pursuing additional tasks along the way. Control different vehicles, ride trains, and survive in third-person perspective, confronting humans, wild animals, robots, and even mutant monsters. Immerse yourself in a fictional world with a slightly comical atmosphere of an early 21st-century alternate reality. An indie open-world explorer with elements of survival, action, object searching, and an intriguing storyline.

rows.name: Operation : Strike & Secure
rows.short_description: Operation: Strike & Secure is a tactical and realistic FPS where every shot matters, designed for intense solo or team-based online combat.
rows.description_html: Operation: Strike & Secure  is an immersive first-person shooter (FPS) game that focuses on tactical and realistic combat. Immerse yourself in a world where strategy and precision are essential to victory, whether in solo, online co-op or intense multiplayer battles. If you're looking for a challenging FPS where every action counts, Operation: Strike & Secure is for you. Main features: Realistic FPS Experience: Intense combat where precision and realism are at the heart of the gameplay. Online Multiplayer & Co-op: Work as a team to achieve your goals. Tactics and Strategy: Plan your attacks and use the environment to your advantage to gain the upper hand over your opponents. Varied game modes: Play solo against the AI ​​(PvE) in Team Deathmatch or Rescue. Procedural generation: Enjoy always different maps and missions for a renewed gaming experience. Operation: Strike & Secure combines the best of shooting games and military tactics to deliver an intense and authentic gaming experience.

rows.name: Eros Raiders
rows.short_description: Welcome to Eros Raiders, the ultimate fusion of waifus, sci-fi, mechas and hentai!
rows.description_html: Welcome to Eros Raiders, the ultimate fusion of waifus, sci-fi, mechas and hentai! Recruit and train your team of beautiful full animated female pilots and explore pretty hot stories. Get ready for thrilling 5 vs. 5 3D turn-based mecha battles, piloted by stunning women who want nothing more than to get in your sheets. Perfect for fans of anime, RPGs, JRPGs and mechas, Eros Raiders offers a rich and, above all, attractive experience that will keep you hooked for hours. Key Features Recruit and Train Your Waifus Beautiful Waifus: Recruit a diverse cast of Waifus, each with unique abilities, personalities and “ tastes”. From fierce warriors to cunning strategists, find the perfect team for your play style, or simply choose the ones that warm your heart (or ANY other part of your body) the most. Training and Enhancement: Train your pilots to improve their power and performance in combat. Develop their skills, unlock new abilities, and customize their appearance to suit your 'preferences'. Strategic Combats: Turn-Based Action: Plan and execute strategies to defeat your opponents in intense 5v5 battles. Use your tactical prowess to outmaneuver and outsmart your enemies. Giant Mechas: Unleash the power of your mechas and use special abilities to turn the tide of battle. Command awe-inspiring robots equipped with cutting-edge technology and devastating weaponry. 3D Battles: Experience immersive 3D combat with stunning visual effects. Enjoy dynamic, action-packed battles that bring the excitement of mecha warfare to life. Diverse Game Modes Adventure Mode: Experience the main story and discover the secrets of the cosmos. Participate in epic missions, get to know your soldiers intimately and immerse yourself in a narrative that encompasses all the stars. Challenge Mode: Face unique daily challenges to test your skills. Every day brings new obstacles and rewards, pushing you to strategize and adapt. League Mode (PvP): Battle other players, climb the ranks, and earn exclusive rewards. Prove your worth in competitive matches and rise to the top of the leaderboards. Event Mode: Participate in limited-time events with thematic side stories and special rewards. Celebrate seasons and holidays with unique challenges and exclusive content. Immersive Experience High Quality Graphics: Enjoy stunning visual effects and fluid animations. Marvel at the detailed environments, explosive battle sequences, beautiful character designs and the “interesting” situations in which they end. Deep narrative: Immerse yourself in a rich and captivating story that will keep you on the edge (of your seat, of course). Explore a universe full of mystery, danger and adventure, alongside your beloved girls who will help you when you need it, if you do the same for them, of course.

rows.name: SQUID'S MANSLAUGHTER
rows.short_description: You will wander the earth as the most pathetic and sad organism in existence searching for meaning. At the end of the day though, there isn't any, you're just an empty husk with nothing to lose, might as well gamble your life away...
rows.description_html: Have you ever been so miserable, that you desired to cease all bodily functions, leaving your body as a slaughtered, bloodied, mess? Well, now you can do it virtually in 8 different ways for the price of nothing, in this quirky, Earthbound and Undertale inspired videogame! Play as the miserable introvert, Zeke, as he finally ventures outside of his dwelling place. only to see now that the world is corrupted through the lack of spiritual order, the only deity that exists is false. He is the pathetic and negligent fool known as, Joel.  Meet several eccentric weirdos, as you go on a politically driven JRPG quest that probably has absolutely no meaning to anyone, waste your valuable life away just as Zeke has. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- T H I S   G A M E   F E A T U R E S. . .  Bitter Commentary about the state of indie JRPGs. Over 100+ hand drawn images. Gameplay that'll always keep you guessing, don't know if you're into that...? Interpretive cryptic plot. 6 endings, most of which can be gotten in one playthrough. Branching path based on your loyalty to your job. Sporadic gameplay. Around 3+ hours of gameplay, short and sweet. Voice acting for major cutscenes. The ability to talk to enemies, giving battles several different outcomes. Several gambling and card minigames, designed to maximise your profits...! Demonstrates the pointlessness of ones existence in game form. Subliminal messaging. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- C L O S U R E . . . Thank you for checking out this game~! ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

rows.name: Tales Beyond The Tomb - Pineville Night Stalker
rows.short_description: After her mother's unexpected death, Megan receives a call about a mysterious inheritance awaiting her in the town of Pineville. With her work friend, Lenny, she embarks on a journey that should be simple, but quickly turns into a web of danger and deception.
rows.description_html: “Tales Beyond The Tomb” is a chilling episodic horror series that immerses players in the shadows of real-life cases. Inspired by the gritty, atmospheric horror of the 80s and 90s, each episode simulates the frightening experiences of real people, mixing nostalgia with unrelenting suspense. This is the first episode of the series: Episode 1: Pineville Night Stalker After her mother's unexpected death, Megan receives a call about a sudden and mysterious inheritance awaiting in the desolate town of Pineville. With her work friend, Lenny – she embarks on a journey that should be simple, but quickly turns into a web of danger and deceit. Key Features VHS Aesthetic — Step back in time with visuals inspired by classic horror films of the ’80s and ’90s. Photorealistic Graphics & Immersive Environments — Feel the dread with lifelike visuals and haunting settings. Voice Activity — Interaction system with your microphone (no microphone is needed to play, but this increases your interaction and involves a complete experience). Dialog Text System — Immerse yourself in the plot with dynamic, narrative-driven dialogues. Gameplay A first-person exploration experience (walking simulator), where realism is fundamental. Navigate immersive locations, discover disturbing truths, and face your fears.

rows.name: NumX
rows.short_description: NumX is a party-game with several mini-games, in which you play as a simple cube.
rows.description_html: NumX is back! After 2 years, NumX is back with an improved version. Rediscover old mini-games and discover new ones, alone or with friends, in the same room or on the other side of the world. New game modes are also planned to bring a new experience around the mini-games. Original NumX content such as old skins and music will also make a comeback. NumX is a party-game containing several mini-games that can be played alone or with others, in which you play as a simple cube. And yes, sometimes simplicity is best. You can play online with a friend, or locally on the same computer. NumX has a variety of minigames that you can play such as : Survival VS In VS Survival your goal is to avoid the grey cube for as long as possible! Air Hockey In Air Hockey, you have to be the first team to score 5 goals to win the game ! Obstacles In Obstacles, you have to avoid the obstacles that appear so that they don't push you into the water! And more...! In NumX, you can play with up to 4 friends locally or online and compete for victory! Each player can play on the same keyboard or connect their controller! If you decide to play NumX minigames alone you will be awarded coins at the end of each game! With coins you can buy skins to customize your cube, backgrounds for the play frame, titles to display on your profile or emojis to use while playing online! During events that are sometimes held, you even win double the amount of coins, so make use of them! We hope you will have fun on NumX!

rows.name: Molehill Empire 2
rows.short_description: Lively gnomes, gardening and research - your garden plot is the place to be!
rows.description_html: You’re an enthusiastic hobby gardener, you can tell apples from oranges, you like your harden, and you love growing vegetables and more? Then team up with the cute and quirky gnomes of Molehill Empire 2 on your way from a self-sufficient gardener to an international supplier of sustainable and organic products. MOLEHILL EMPIRE 2 – MORE THAN JUST A FLOWERBED! Gardening with a green thumb: alone or in a team – there’s always plenty to do! Co-op and communication: a built-in messenger helps you trade with friends Research and field work: Discover new plants and upgrade your garden Heirlooms and achievements: Collect accolades and trophies to impress your friend ORGANIC GARDENING GAME In Molehill Empire 2, you’ll experience a skillful blend of garden game, hilarious and quirky moments, and a complex tycoon right in the comfort of your garden plot. Sow, harvest, and sell crops; research new cultivation methods, and unlock new plants. Conquer the top of the world – alone or with friends! TRADE AND GROW: YOUR EMPIRE IS FLOURISHING The way to the top is not always easy. That’s why teamwork is of utmost importance in the Molehill Empire app. Even the most clever gnome could sometimes use a helping hand! Invite friends to trade, chat, and have fun with you. In this engaging community game, helping each other is the best part! The Molehill Empire 2 app cannot be linked with your Molehill Empire browser game account. Molehill Empire was funded in part by the FilmFernsehFonds (FFF) Bayern.

rows.name: RoboSoul
rows.short_description: The game features a dynamic left-and-right hand weapon system, allowing players to freely mix and match weapons for maximum carnage as they face relentless waves of enemies. With its retro pixel art style and intense action, ROBOSOUL delivers a nostalgic yet exhilarating arcade experience.
rows.description_html: ROBOSOUL is a thrilling 2D top-down shooter that puts you in the metallic shoes of ROBO-07, engaging in a desperate struggle for survival amidst a treacherous, robot-filled stronghold. With its endless gameplay loop and subtle roguelike twists, each run promises a fresh challenge, keeping the action intense and the surprises coming. One of the standout features is the game's innovative dual-wielding system, enabling you to mix and match weapons for both your left and right hands, and tailor your combat approach to your preferences. The game's retro pixel art style adds a nostalgic charm, while the execution of special finisher moves—executed with flair—adds a satisfying layer of skill and style to the gameplay, ensuring that no two battles are the same.

rows.name: Mortimer: First Launch
rows.short_description: A whimsical stealth-puzzle adventure starring Mortimer, a curious raccoon 🦝
rows.description_html: Mortimer: First Launch is a 3D puzzle stealth adventure starring Mortimer, a raccoon with big dreams and a scientific mind. Set in a whimsical, fantasy version of Florida's Hatbill Park near the Kennedy Space Center, Mortimer navigates his environment, solves puzzles, and collects the parts he needs to build a rocket and achieve his dream of reaching the moon, all while avoiding humans and predatory wildlife along the way. The First Launch version of the game includes the tutorial, taking place at Mortimer's home and the nearby Hatbill Park camping area. Mortimer: First Launch is a work in progress by a team of students from Jyväskylä University of Applied Science in Jyväskylä, Finland. What You’ll Do: - Run, walk, crawl, climb and swim through the swamps, rivers and campgrounds in the Hatbill Park area. - Solve environmental puzzles integrated into the game world. - Sneak past humans, wildlife and other obstacles using stealth and cunning. Features: - Puzzle-Stealth Gameplay : Use a combination of logic, physics and deductive reasoning to overcome challenges and obtain rocket parts. - Stylized Art : A medium-poly world brought to life with toon shading and vibrant colors. - Interactable Environments : Each area contains interactable elements, environmental storytelling, and a few hidden secrets. - Narrative Cutscenes : Story beats are conveyed through a mixture of animated cutscenes and custom 2D art. - Immersive Audio : Ambisonic audio crafted using custom made generators help the world feel alive and believable. - Accessibility : Mortimer: First Launch features no spoken lines, instead relying on facial expressions, 2D art and animated thought bubbles to convey information. - Visual Effects : Comic book inspired visual effects accompany certain key actions during gameplay. Join Mortimer on a journey that’s as much about solving puzzles as it is about dreaming big! Team Core team: David Vanderheyden - Scrum Master, Programmer, Design Lead, Publishing and Marketing Co-Leader Jeremy LeBlanc - VFX Artist, Environmental design Pyry Kääriä - Audio, Manuscript Sami Huttula - 3D Art, Publisher Tero Korpela - Game programming Special thanks: Dion Dimache - 2D Art Flavio Florovits - Game testing Juulia Kääriä - 2D Art Unia Kääriä - Typeface designer

rows.name: Scrapped
rows.short_description: Gestalt Industries, Ltd. is looking for a qualified candidate for the Art Generator role. Complete your work orders by creating collages using an array of snippets: from photographs to posters to Victorian etchings. Hang out by the virtual water cooler for fun, company sanctioned small talk!
rows.description_html: Get ready to work at your corporate job as an Art Generator. Incoming work orders range from heartwarming birthday cards to ominous threats. The convenient projector-printer makes it easy to find all the images you're looking for and print out as many copies as you need. Time flies when you’re making collages! After work, talk to your coworkers at the virtual water cooler during your designated break time! Your manager seems quite nice but… What’s with all the rules against personal details? Working here, you feel like a number. Just a number… Create Collages! Use the projector-printer and a variety of reels to print out pictures to use in your collage. Move, rotate, scale, and flip the artwork to put together your perfect composition! Then it's ready for your eager customer to use! Answer Commisions. Every collage made in “Scrapped” is made using artwork in the public domain. That means YOU can use any collage you create however you’d like!  Uncover company mysteries... After every work day, head to the virtual water cooler to discover a gripping story about three souls unable to put their personality aside in a corporate dystopian world that discourages individuality. Despite the looming threat of unemployment, these humans can’t help but be, well, human.  A Collage of Commentary Scrapped blends thoughtful commentary about the ethical concerns regarding AI and capitalism. Corporations threaten to deindividualize people meanwhile AI threatens the same towards art. The looming threat of commodification is peppered throughout the narrative advanced and complemented by the mechanic of collage making.

rows.name: Bilge Junction
rows.short_description: Welcome to Bilge Junction, population 8: a dying town on the arctic highway. With the promise of a cheap roof over your head, you ran from your problems and wound up here. But winter's setting in, and the fire keeps burning. A storm is on its way.
rows.description_html: My body burned in the cold, until I felt nothing. When I opened my eyes, I was back where I started… Welcome to Bilge Junction , population 8: a dying town on the arctic highway. With the promise of a cheap roof over your head, you ran from your problems and wound up here. But winter's setting in, and the fire keeps burning. A storm is on its way. There's something lurking in the pipeline that built the town. In three days' time, it's bound to escape. Enter a world with a life of its own.   The townsfolk of Bilge Junction follow their own routines from day to day. The town works on its own rules. As the storm draws closer, Bilge Junction grows more erratic with each passing hour. Survive. Explore. Earn the townsfolks' respect. Weather the harsh climate and earn your keep, learning what makes each person here tick. Hear out their stories, gain their trust, and survive together. Discover what lies beneath the surface of Bilge Junction. And whatever you do, don't let the fire go out. Bilge Junction was initially developed over a span of 5 weeks for IndieCade's Climate Jam 2024. The premise was meant to express several experiences I personally had when returning to my hometown, as well as confront the destructive, extractive, colonial past and present of Alaska. Inspirations include ThreeStep , Pathologic , Chulip , and Paper Mario. Credits Gage Tilly - Director Will B. Francis - Narrative Designer, Engineer Jorge Zamora Salguero - Composer, Sound Designer Luke Cravey - Artist David Norton - Narrative Designer

rows.name: Absolution
rows.short_description: Absolution is a first-person psychological horror experience where you face THE JUDGE as they peel apart your very soul. Uncover dark truths and navigate moral dilemmas as you're questioned about your past deeds. Every lie has consequences.
rows.description_html: Absolution is a first-person visual novel. In the eerie depths of this psychological thriller, face THE JUDGE and a twisted tale of grief, guilt and murder.  Confront your sins. Reflect on your morals. Liars will be punished. Immersive Horror Experience : Come immerse yourself in an experience that blends eerie visuals with haunting soundscapes as an unnerving story unveils before you. Unnerving Questions : Answer THE JUDGE’s probing questions, where honesty is key—liars will be punished. Chilling Narrative : Witness the unraveling of a tale filled with desperation, guilt, and the lingering hope for redemption. Compelling Characters : Meet the characters of this horrific story. Can they be saved from their fatal fates? Absolution was developed within the University of Southern California's Games Program. For more information about the USC Games Program, check out their website.

rows.name: Lanesplitterz
rows.short_description: Lanesplitterz is a 3D arcade-style bowling game. Join Hiro as he competes in a brutal bowling tournament to become King of Neo Las Vegas!
rows.description_html: Lanesplitterz is a 3D arcade-style bowling game where you compete to rule over Neo Las Vegas, the last remaining city in the aftermath of a nuclear winter. In this extreme evolution of bowling, thrill-seeking daredevils shoot themselves from cannons down the Vegas strip toward bowling pins the size of buildings. Face off against the city's top Lanesplitterz in a battle against corruption to win the tournament and become the King! BOWL: Be the ball as you bowl against 3 unique anime-style bosses. CHALLENGE: Experience each boss' dramatic story, each with custom over-the top character art, special abilities, and custom music. DOMINATE: Save Neo Las Vegas from the tyrannical rule of King Julius Caesar!

rows.name: Pig & Chikin
rows.short_description: This is the tale of 🐷Pig & Chikin🐔. In a world where pigs have wings, Pig loses her wings in an accident. Her dear friend, Chikin, takes her on a journey to learn to fly again. On the way, they meet magical places and creatures who offer insights into companionship, community, and acceptance.
rows.description_html: About This Game Pig & Chikin is a 3D platformer where the core movement abilities get weaker as a metaphor for physical disability and aging. In a world where pigs have wings and can fly, Pig loses her wings in an accident and desperately wants them back. Her friend, Chikin, joins her on an adventure to learn how to fly again. Their journey brings them to magical places where they meet creatures who offer insights into themes of companionship, community, and acceptance of immovable change. Gameplay Features Fly, flap, and slide through a globe-trotting adventure Explore magical environments and meet charming characters Live out a heartfelt fable of companionship, acceptance, and the beauty of community About Development Pig & Chikin began as Quentin Burley’s MFA thesis project at USC. Personal experience inspired the story of an accident, an aging caregiver, and the emergence of a caregiving community, with several characters inspired by relatives. After its feature at USC Games Expo 2024, the game was completed and released as a passion project. After its feature at USC Games Expo 2024, the game was completed and released as a passion project. rows.name: Kai UnEarthed
rows.short_description: Explore an afrofuturistic 3D world scavenging and journaling your way to becoming a wildtender: someone who heals the relationship between humans and more-than-human beings. Reflect on the choices you make, the artifacts you leave behind, and the worlds that will grow out of them.
rows.description_html: Kai Unearthed is a meditation on an unpoliced future healing from climate change. In this interactive 3D world, you can become a Wildtender, someone who heals the relationship between humans and more-than-human beings. Reflect on the choices you make, the artifacts you leave behind, and the worlds that will grow out of them, through a journal, an interactive story, and a psychedelic scavenger hunt. Jump into a psychedelic Afrofuturist world as you take on the role of Kai, an aspiring Wildtender! Nurture relationships through an interactive dialogue system. Choose what you want to say, and how you relate to your crush and your elders. Nurture relationships as you tend the wildness of a regrowing planet! Connect with your ancestors and the artifacts they left behind during the volatile final decades of the Capitalist Era. Use an actual journal that accompanies you throughout the game! A pdf of the journal sits within the download folder of the game (check where steam holds your folder!). Throughout the game you will use the journal to participate in meditative practices, learn something new, or unlock something in the game! For Mac users: The Mac version of Kai Unearthed can be found on its itch page through the Kai Unearthed official website.

rows.short_description: 『250ms』 is a platform game that tests the player's reaction speed. The name '250ms' refers to the average human reaction time. Players progress through stages by quickly defeating various enemies.
rows.description_html: ABOUT : 250ms 250ms refers to the average human reaction speed.  ▽ Use the arrow keys or WASD keys to control your character.  [img][/img]. Enemies will briefly turn green for 250 ms, after which you can click the mouse to destroy them. Destroy all enemies to progress to the next stage. ▽ Test your skills against various types of enemies. [img][/img]. ▽ Try to complete the game with as few deaths as possible. [img][/img].

rows.name: Hyperborea
rows.short_description: Graphically high fidelity 3D maze first-person shooter with jump scares, fight through hordes of horrifying and creepy doom-esque monsters armed with a very capable shotgun to get to your mysterious destination in this all-ages horror, miss one shot and it could be your last!
rows.description_html: Hyperborea is a modern take on the classic First-person shooter game Wolfenstein 3D - the game that kick started the FPS revolution has been re-imagined in modern high definition graphics that is sure to push modern graphics cards to their limits. Fresh and exciting visuals for a hyper-eccentric modern era. This game is not for the low spec'd. 😉 A game, a modern benchmark, a fun and relaxing shooter, will it run Hyperborea? You play the entire game armed with a very capable shotgun; but missing a shot will double the cool down time for the next shot. Staying in flow is vital. Always watch your back because it's side swipes from enemies when turning corners that can catch you out. There is no health in this game, if a monster gets near to you - that's it you die. You will however obtain a crucifix/caduceus for every 4 kills which will give you a short protection if caught by a monster, this protection lasts 3 seconds and protects you from the initial monster that caught you and any further monsters in the next 3 second time period. Monsters make no noise until you kill them, your only way of detecting them is visually when you see them or when the way-point hand begins to shake, it will shake more aggressively the closer you are and it will only shake when an enemy is somewhere in the direction you are currently facing. Fight your way through the hordes of enemies and complete the game, there's no story-line, just a mindless shooter with a progression through new and interesting high definition 3D content and world geometry, think of it as a relaxing adventure through a modern take on the classic Wolfenstein 3D game, the game-play is a satisfyingly repetitive shooter set in memorably themed environments where the visuals are ever changing as you progress from environment to environment on your quest to the ultimate final goal - whatever that may be. Wow crazy sounds bro! Did you steal those from Doom? Thanks, you are right those sounds are pretty wild! Believe it or not I did not steal those sound effects from Doom - actually the circumstances are far more interesting; Those sound effects have been created entirely from scratch by Per Kristian Risvik, the original Doom sounds having only been sampled at a measly 11 kHz Kristian took it upon himself to remake them from scratch in 32 kHz and did a marvellous job in doing so, sounding identical to the original sound effects in many cases but in a higher quality! Having based my game around providing an up-to-date Doom-esque/Wolfenstein 3D experience it just made complete sense to also include Kristians sounds! Check out Kristians website for more information about how he remade these remarkable sound effects from scratch, audio reverse engineering at it's finest! Dude this game looks nuts  ᕕ( ᐛ )ᕗ You're right the game does look different, and it is technically quite a unique game indeed. At any point in the game your GPU could be rendering around 30 million triangles! If you are lucky the minimum it might be rendering in a single frame is 8 million triangles! In just 6 GB of disk space we are able to cram a whopping 184 million triangles of unique 3D content!! (184,597,952 triangles using 92,546,029 vertices to be exact). Not even a AAA game attempts to render the amount of triangles per frame that Hyperborea does - and get this, we even force the game to start in 16x MSAA if your graphics card supports it, otherwise we use the highest MSAA the GPU will let us use!  (really, when was the last time you saw a AAA game even let you select MSAA, let alone upto 16x MSAA! this is real anti-aliasing not some temporal TSAA or DLSS AI slop).  We render so many triangles that the bottleneck on most GPU's is the triangle rendering stage of the rasterization process! That means the MSAA or screen resolution in most cases makes little to no difference to the FPS - even at 1440p with 16x MSAA (that's 59 million pixels!!!) an original Intel Iris Xe iGPU from 2020 will get 30 FPS in this game. If you compare the performance of Iris Xe iGPU's since it's first release in 2020 and a modern intel CPU in 2025 the performance difference is only +13% making the Iris XE a good test case. That's why we call Hyperborea a benchmark, it is a benchmark of triangle rasterization!

rows.name: Man in a suit in a building in a city
rows.short_description: A tale as old as machines. Everyday wake up and plow the land of your lord, as you need the shine of the coin. Requiem for the common man.
rows.description_html: Deep in the never-changing autumn, surrounded by the tall buildings of the city. Men in suits move like shadows between the asphalt bridges. Can the songs of their childhood and the sweet taste of a drink make them forget the lies they find in a melancholic sunset? A short almost-linear novel game written for the common man. -Reading time of 5-10 mins. -Almost no sounds, or music. Disturbing noise loops. -Graphics picturing the loud emptiness of a city full of people.
