rows.name: The Dispatcher
rows.short_description: Step into the role of Dominic, a dispatcher in Heavenbrook, where your choices shape a gripping visual novel and adventure game filled with suspense, mystery, and dark secrets. Unravel the chilling mysteries as the shocking events in the city unfold before you.
rows.description_html: Overview: Dive into the world of The Dispatcher , a 2D visual novel, adventure game where you take on the role of Dominic, a dispatcher navigating the complexities of urban life. As you carry out your duties, you start to uncover dark and mysterious aspects of the city that may be linked to a sinister cult. Heavenbrook is no longer the quiet town you once knew. Unexplained phenomena and terrifying situations begin to unfold, shocking and disturbing the city's residents. Key Features: Intriguing Storyline: Explore the dark atmosphere of Heavenbrook and uncover the secrets it holds. Engaging Gameplay: Make decisions as a dispatcher and witness their consequences on the story and characters. Stunning Aesthetic: Enjoy beautifully pixel art graphics that bring the city's atmosphere to life. Are you ready to explore the mysteries of Heavenbrook? Join us to uncover the truth hidden in the night!

rows.name: Ignited Entry
rows.short_description: Ignited Entry is a full length narrative driven psychological horror game with voice acting, dreamish visuals, and horror elements that will keep you on the edge of your seat. Some doors should never be opened. But you must go in.
rows.description_html: You abandoned your old life as a firefighter, fleeing from the tormenting memories of a family you couldn't save from a house fire. But why do you feel like something isn't right? What is that noise? And why do I feel like it's calling me back to the house? The deeper you venture into the shadows, the more you begin to question. Is there someone waiting for me beyond the afterlife? Ignited Entry is a full length narrative driven psychological horror game with voice acting, dreamish visuals, and horror elements that will keep you on the edge of your seat.  Some doors should never be opened. But you must go in. Voice Acting Full Length Play Session Full Story Progress Saving Level Jumping 8-BitRyan Hollow TUV SWOL Cyccubus That Plush Jordan Lindgren

rows.name: KEEP LOOKING
rows.short_description: This is a nerve-wracking horror game that puts you in a dark, claustrophobic cave with a relentless creature. Survive by flashing your dying flashlight at the right moments, too soon or too late, and it’s over. You must keep an eye on the creature, but beware: staring too long is just as deadly.
rows.description_html: KEEP LOOKING is a nerve-wracking horror game that puts you in a dark, claustrophobic cave with a relentless creature. Survive by flashing your dying flashlight at the right moments, too soon or too late, and it’s over. You must keep an eye on the creature, but beware: staring too long is just as deadly. You are face-to-face with a creature that only moves when you can't see it. Occasionally, the light will fail, and you'll need to time your flashlight flash perfectly. Just remember: KEEP LOOKING, or it might get you. Try to survive until the timer runs out, and don't get tricked by the creature.

Includes: seven jellyfish, arts & crafts, a bonus dress-up minigame, and maybe the option to die a couple of times.

rows.name: AN OUTLAND VILLAGE
rows.short_description: Father and mother visited their daughter's home in Beijing to discuss their father's understanding of life and memories of their past relationship with their mother. The Story of Chinese Families
rows.description_html: This game is a free independent short narrative game. We hope to bring players a unique immersive experience through a concise and profound plot. Although the game time is not long, we have devoted our efforts to every detail. Thank you for taking the time to enter our world. We hope that your journey can arouse some touching and thinking in you. Story summary My father retired, and he, who had been living with his mother, finally had some free time. I thought it would be better to go find my children who were far away, and they just happened to move back to Beijing. The mother was unwilling to leave this rural town, but her daughter persuaded the mother to finally leave. 'My father and mother visited their daughter's home in Beijing. They talked about my father's understanding of his own belonging and the memories he had with his wife in the past.' Although the family members in the past memories are separated by a long distance, they feel the warmth during the two phone calls apart. But the two people who came to Beijing felt that distant village Game features Story style of literature in the 1990s Advance the plot through dialogue and exploration Beautiful hand-drawn art style Operation mode WASD: moving character Enter: confirm/select

rows.name: Grid Tactics: Duel
rows.short_description: Grid Tactics is a cosmic colonization adventure game that combines strategic board tactics with deck-building gameplay. Lead your expedition team as you land on diverse planets with shifting seasons, build a customized deck, and engage in tactical battles on an 8×8 grid battlefield.
rows.description_html: The world stage is built on a universe of diverse planets, where different factions clash for colonial rights and dominance through card and tactical matchups. The worldview varies by planet, and victory depends on your construction and decisions. Every planet is a completely different worldview— Medieval Fantasy, Steampunk, Magical Civilization, Technological Hegemony, Primitive Tribes... ■ Game Features ♟ Strategy Board × Card Battle This is not a simple card matchup. The battlefield is an 8×8 strategic board , where every card played is a choice of position, timing, and resource management. You can summon units, build facilities, and deploy traps, gradually constructing your own tactical frontline. Cards feature clear and predictable effect designs, like Hearthstone and Magic: The Gathering Board layout and positioning inherit the spatial thinking of tactical games A dual-cost resource system brings deeper deckbuilding and decision-making space Complex tactics like frontline, defense, area attacks, and multi-directional selection can be freely combined Every turn is a head-on clash of strategy and anticipation. 🃏 Custom Decks, Develop Your Own Tactical Direction You can freely combine different combat strategies based on card effects, resource allocation, and board interaction. The game does not preset fixed archetypes or limit standard solutions. Every deck is a player's personal choice within the framework of rules. Differences in construction will directly affect your rhythm, resource utilization, and tactical trade-offs during the matchup. The card craft system allows you to dismantle unwanted cards to produce almost any card in the game; the pack design balances beginner experience and long-term fairness: Before the collection reaches 30 cards, drawn cards will not repeat Legendary cards feature a pity mechanism, guaranteed within a maximum of 41 draws 🌐 Real-time Online Battles / Ranked Challenges Engage in real-time battles with explorers from all over the world. You need to precisely configure the board, anticipate opponent moves, and manage resources effectively to gain an advantage in every clash. The following will be added in the future: Seasonal ranked system Specialized tactical routes Faction specialization and environmental bonus gameplay The battle situation will change, but strategic depth will only continue to stack. ■ A Work Born for Strategy Players If you love: Hearthstone Magic: The Gathering Tactical games (such as Fire Emblem , Into the Breach ) Deep deckbuilding, resource management, and long-term strategic thinking Then this strategy game, blending Cards × Board × Interstellar Exploration , will bring you a brand-new experience different from existing works.

rows.name: Maestro Level Editor
rows.short_description: Maestro Level Editor is both a Virtual Symphony Simulator and a Level Editor for Maestro VR. Customize your orchestra, mix real audio tracks, and sync realistic animations. Design rhythmic levels and share your creations on Steam Workshop. Conduct your own music!
rows.description_html: Maestro Level Editor is the ultimate tool to bring your music to life. It serves both as a complete Virtual Symphony Orchestra Simulator and as a powerful Level Editor for creating content for Maestro VR and upcoming games in the Maestro saga by Symphonic Games. Create Your Virtual Symphony Orchestra: Choose from multiple concert halls with unique acoustics and configure your ensemble. Edit each instrument track by track, loading your own audio files (MP3/OGG) to place them in 3D space. Use individual tracks (STEMS) for maximum control or simulate an orchestra from stereo recordings for a unique immersive journey. Hybrid & Realistic Animation: Watch your virtual orchestra perform in real time. Animate musicians manually with drag-and-drop icons, or use the Smart Animation system to generate movements automatically from audio. For professional precision, import a MIDI file to sync bow strokes and fingerings with every note, and enjoy customizable lip-sync for the choir. Create Levels for Maestro VR: Craft personalized rhythmic levels for Maestro VR . Use an intuitive interface with Smart Tempo tools to define conducting patterns, dynamics, and cues, designing your own symphonic challenges for the Virtual Reality game. Share via Steam Workshop: Export your creations directly to the community. Share your original compositions as simulatable concerts for others to watch, or publish challenging gameplay levels for players to conduct. Ideal for Composers and Gamers: Whether you want to visualize your own symphony or expand your game library, Maestro Level Editor allows you to simulate a realistic concert of your musical piece. It is the perfect bridge between music production and rhythm gaming. Start creating, simulating, and sharing with Maestro Level Editor and take your passion for music to the next level!

rows.name: Go Go Fight
rows.short_description: Very simple to enjoy the happy multiplayer VR Game. Tapping hands to move, jump and grip to climb and hold, no more things to learn. Dodge obstacles, bump into others, and rush to the finish line to scoring points.
rows.description_html: The Go Go Fight is a very simple-to-play multiplayer VR Game. Dodge obstacles, Trigger props, bump into others, and rush to the finish line to scoring points. All you need to do is take your hands tapping the floor to move forward and jump, And the base VR grip trigger and climb -- that`s it! By the way, you can use your eyes to have interaction witch UI. (Dont worry about if the eye tracking need in HMD, I had Already CREATE the Eye Tracking for you, ahahhh, just look at and use Trigger to confirm!) The Game currently has 20 levels and 11 props for randomly spawn, You can make full use of the levels and items to enjoy your party process. Winning or losing is not important, happiness is the most important! The game features voice chat and open mic as default, so let's communicate kindly and avoid any unpleasantries. Harmony brings prosperity! Lastly, GoGoFight is independently developed Game. Feel free to provide feedback on any aspect of the game, and I'll update it as soon as possible!

rows.name: What in HELL is Bad?
rows.short_description: What in Hell is Bad? is a sinful otome strategy game where seductive devils fight in real-time tower defense battles. Touch, tease, and tempt your way through Hell while commanding the infernal armies—led by seven dangerously handsome devil lords and the 72 devils of Solomon.
rows.description_html: Descend into a devilishly romantic war between Heaven and Hell in What in Hell is Bad?, an immersive otome strategy game where love burns hotter than fire and danger lurks behind every kiss. Play as the last descendant of Solomon, bound by fate to seven alluring demon lords and the legendary 72 demons of Hell. Trapped in a world where angels wage war, devils scheme in shadows, and your heart becomes the ultimate battlefield, you must form pacts, awaken power, and navigate a web of forbidden desire. Command powerful units in real-time tower defense battles. Unlock intimate full-voice scenes. Touch, tease, and grow closer to your demon companions with every interaction — even as Heaven plots your downfall. This is more than a game of love. It’s a fight for the soul of Hell itself. KEY FEATURES 🔥 Sinful Romance Meets Strategic Combat – Experience an intense blend of real-time tower defense and otome storytelling. Every battle and every choice draws you deeper into a twisted love story. 😈 Seven Devilishly Handsome Demon Lords – From the prideful Lucifer to the lazy but seductive Belphegor, fall for a cast of unforgettable lords each representing one of the seven deadly sins. 🔮 Summon the 72 Demons of Solomon – Build your army from legendary infernal beings and lead them into stylish, fast-paced battles against angels and rivals alike. 💋 Touch, Tease, and Tempt – Get closer to your chosen demon through interactive touch mechanics and unlock scenes that are fully voiced and filled with temptation. 🌌 A Dark Fantasy Like No Other – Unfold a story of forbidden pacts, tragic secrets, and unexpected tenderness in a war-torn realm where even Hell can be beautiful.

rows.name: Mpirimpa
rows.short_description: Mpirimpa / Buraco / Canasta/Baraziliya as called in different countries is a game which combines strategy and luck. It is easy to learn and can offer you countless hours of fun with your friends or other players from all over the world. You can play one Vs one or two Vs two.
rows.description_html: Mpirimpa / Buraco / Canasta/ Baraziliya is a free online card game which allows you to play for free with your friends and other players one Vs one or in two pairs opposing each other. The game is widely played in Greece, Italy and South America. In Italy the game is called Buraco and in South America Canasta. The game is offered in two versions, the classic Mpirimpa and Mpirimpa Pro which requires players to 'justify' taking the cards from the pot and only allows players to make melds with sequences and not identical cards. The objective of the game is to reach first the points set by the person who creates the table. Players play with chips against other players and the winners take their opponents' chips less a percentage taken from the platform. Users get free chips upon registration and they get additional free chips daily through a scratch card or daily bonus or by watching reward ads. If they run out of chips they can buy additional chips from the shop. They can also send messages to other players using our online messaging tool and can also send pictures. Players who become VIP through purchasing VIP chips are also allowed to upload their own avatar and change their user name. Players can also make friends and invite them to private tables that only them can join. Please check out our website for instructions of how to play. * By logging in, you agree to the Orderear's Terms of Service & Privacy Policy for the current website.

rows.name: Five Nights at Roner's: Remastered
rows.short_description: You are an ambitious paranormal investigator searching for his big break. When you're presented the opportunity of a lifetime--$25.99, to be exact, you jump at the offer. But everything comes with a catch, and Roner and his friends are keen to teach you that...
rows.description_html: You are 19 year old Tyrone Watermelon -- ambitious paranormal investigator and convenience store clerk, eager for a big break. When you receive a call from a man calling himself Roane Vaydich asking you to investigate his haunted house, you are ecstatic. Finally, a chance to get your name out there! At the end of your perilous journey lies a fat paycheck -- $25.99, to be exact -- enough to kickstart your career, or maybe even pay off that old guy that sold you those funny-looking brownies the other day... But these ghosts are different... spooki er ... scari er ... retarded er ... Five Nights at Roner's: Remastered is a ground-up recreation of the original game, which was made in three days. This remake brings it up to the standard set by Five Nights at Roner's 2, which was made in six months. Complete with a full visual overhaul, several gameplay improvements/additions, and a (finally) coherent story, Five Nights at Roner's has never been better... So, without further ado, can you survive... FIVE NIGHTS AT RONER'S?

rows.name: akabos
rows.short_description: Do you hate squares? Then this game is for you! After all, the dog also hates squares. Help the dog to destroy all the squares!
rows.description_html: It's a dog and it hates squares.                   You are the voice in it  head and must help destroy all the squares.                                                                     This is Anton. akabos is a clicker game where you need to touch your dog to destroy squares. The game has a plot and several endings that depend only on your choice. Features: The game has sound. The game has no saves and must be completed in one game session. This game supports mouse and keyboard.

rows.name: GeoJet
rows.short_description: Blast through neon courses, dodging obstacles and grabbing power-ups in this intense arcade racer. Chain combos and hit the finish line with the highest score!
rows.description_html: THIS IS GEOJET!  GeoJet is a high-octane arcade experience that throws you into the pilot seat of a sleek ship racing through vibrant, neon-drenched courses. It's easy to pick up but challenging to master, offering addictive gameplay that will keep you coming back for more. Master the Tracks: Navigate twisting tracks, dodge obstacles, and collect score boxes to build your combo and boost your speed. Chain together boosts and utilize the air roll maneuver to achieve blistering speeds. With tight controls and responsive handling, GeoJet demands precision and skill to conquer its challenging courses. Key Features: Easy to Learn, Hard to Master: Intuitive controls make it simple to jump in, but true mastery requires skillful maneuvering and strategic use of power-ups. Air Roll: Quickly dart left and right to dodge obstacles and collect those crucial score boxes. Boost System: The more boxes you collect, the faster you go! Chain together combos for maximum speed. Overdrive Boosts: Strategically placed overdrive boosts give you the edge you need to navigate tricky sections of the track. Pulse-Pounding Synth Soundtrack: Immerse yourself in the retrowave aesthetic with a pumping synth soundtrack that complements the high-speed action. Tight Controls: Responsive and precise controls give you complete command of your ship. Arcade Action: Classic arcade gameplay with a modern twist, delivering a thrilling and addictive experience. Challenging and Engaging: Push your skills to the limit and strive for the highest score across a variety of challenging courses.

rows.name: Virtual Towers Online
rows.short_description: Virtual Towers Online, a passion project with over 10+ years in development from a very small team, is a replica of the Alton Towers theme park, designed to be as close to realism as possible allowing players to explore the park, ride and operate the attractions from anywhere across the world.
rows.description_html: Virtual Towers Online is an unofficial free-to-play realistic, to-scale replica of the Alton Towers theme park created in the Unreal engine. It is designed to be as close as possible using architectural plans and thousands of photo references. It has been in development for over 10+ years with a very small team, allowing players to roam freely around the park riding and getting to operate some of the available attractions in the game.  Please note! This is an ongoing work-in-progress game so many features will change over time and get added or removed. There is a key shown on the maps in the game that shows which rides are available to ride and what kind of operation mode they have, for example, 'Nemesis' is fully automatic so players can ride it without interacting with it, or can take complete control to operate it, whereas 'Ripsaw' has only a manual control mode and whilst can be ridden, has no auto mode. There are likely to be bugs within the builds despite our best attempts at trying to remove any possibility of any issues you may experience however being such a small team, things get missed. It is unoptimized, we know it has a long way to go but it will take time with so few people working it, please give us a chance! The end goal is to have a multi-player environment where users from all over the world can interact with each other throughout the entire park, players can take on roles at attractions to operate it together, as well as a career mode where skills are developed while playing. Please join our Discord Server for regular updates about Virtual Towers Online and to get involved with its development.

rows.name: DEMON COMPASS
rows.short_description: This occult item will guide you through a bizarre in-between world and help you to confront past demons as well as piece together former memories that may lead to closure. Seek a better understanding of who you were, who you’ve loved and how much you’ve lost in this 3rd person horror adventure game.
rows.description_html: 'There is a piercing light that obscures your vision, you try to remember how you got here, but your memories are hazy and disjointed. You feel a weight in your hand, and upon examining it, you find a cursed looking compass. It seems to be glowing in a certain direction, as if it’s guiding you towards something…' DEMON COMPASS is a third person horror adventure game focused on exploration, light puzzle solving and abstract narration. Navigate through three separate storylines, each with distinct characters, environments, and challenges. Features : Late 1990's 3D graphics style Unlockable characters and Storylines Unique Bossfights A strange world to explore based on the PROVOKER universe

rows.name: Braise Satan
rows.short_description: BRAISE SATAN is a frantic cooking game set in Hell. Chop, fry, and blend your way to heaven, while fighting off the mischievous imps.
rows.description_html: Unfortunately, you are in Hell You find yourself in a land full of lava, fire, and vegetables? You have been selected for the opportunity to serve the devil himself, and perhaps earn your freedom from damnation. Follow the recipe! Thanks to those countless fools who came before you, Satan's tastes are refined and demanding. Do not disappoint. Your task will be easy... as long as you follow the recipe. Read the instructions or face his wrath and hunger. The pantry comes magically stocked with everything you will need. Prepare your dish! Chop, fry, and plate your ingredients in the kitchen! Defend your ingredients! Mischievous imps will do their best to get in your way. Stop them from stealing your ingredients (and maybe throw them in the lava while you're at it). Finish before the time runs out! As you cook the lava will rise; submit everything before the time runs out! If Satan's appetite isn't satisfied, who knows what he'll do!

rows.name: Hentaimon Prologue
rows.short_description: Hentaimon is a old-school classic monster-catcher with a special lewd twist. Bond with Hentaimon and explore a broad world filled with thrilling turn-based battles, a mysterious threat awaiting defeat, and lots and lots of hentai. It's time for you to explore the wonder world of these monster girls!
rows.description_html: Embark on the ultimate monster-catching adventure in Hentaimon Prologue! Discover a vast and unexplored world filled with unique monster girls, each waiting to be discovered. Unravel the hidden mysteries within forgotten lands and form special bonds with your companions. With engaging gameplay mechanics, special interactions, and a cast of captivating characters, Hentaimon Prologue is your gateway to an unforgettable journey where friendship and strategy meet. Are you ready to capture, train, and battle alongside your allies and unveil the world’s secrets together? Your adventure awaits – a world of wonder and intrigue is just waiting to be discovered. 15 Maps: Explore the world of Hentaimon Prologue, with lots of biomes and secrets hidden throughout the world More than 25 Rewards: In Hentaimon Prologue we have lots of types of hentai scenes to choose from. More than 20 Monster Girls: Various types of monster girls to please all your desires. Upgrade your skills: By using your skills, you'll upgrade them and become stronger as you progress through the game. Quest System: You have lots of quests to find and complete. From the main quest to personal quests with the Hentaimons. Battle System: Fight your foes and make they get naked to you. Build your team: Choose 5 of your favorite Hentaimon to join your adventure and help you save the world. Become more than friends: Increase your affinity with your Hentaimons to gain gifts, special quests, evolve and special scenes. Story Rich: This world is just waiting to tell it's story. All characters in the game are over 18 years old Explore the world to encounter all different types of Hentaimon! Each one of them have their own abillities, traits, interests, personal quest and much more.

rows.name: Stock Market Tycoon: Challenge
rows.short_description: A competitive multiplayer real-time stock market investment game where players compete globally to achieve maximum investment returns. Trade live stocks in a simulated economy and manage your portfolio in a real-time virtual stock exchange.
rows.description_html: Stock Market Tycoon: Challenge is the ultimate multiplayer stock market investment game where you can put your trading skills to the test, competing with players from around the world, to outperform your competitors and become an investment tycoon! The game provides a realistic and dynamic stock trading experience in a simulated fast-paced economy. Manage your portfolio, either searching for the best dividend returns or making short term gains from momentum trading. Each 'season' lasts one month, with dividend returns daily. Key Features: Real-Time Stock Market Simulation: Trade live stocks in a simulated economy and manage your portfolio in a real-time simulated stock exchange. Buy, sell, and hold shares to maximise your profit and outperform other players. Multiplayer Competition: Challenge friends or compete with thousands of players globally in a battle for returns. Every percentage gain will count against your competitors. Rise up the leaderboard and showcase your skills, proving you are the ultimate Stock Market Investor. Seasonal Competition: Each season lasts one month (allowing for 28-31 'years' of dividends). Competition will be fierce as investors scramble to maximise portfolio returns. Leaderboards, Rankings and Ratings: All active players are ranked in the season will be ranked, and an overall investment rating will be calculated from your overall performance across many seasons. Awards: Players earn awards for achieving trading profit milestones, as well as ranking well at the end of a season. Accumulate and show off your awards. In-Game Market Events, News & Recommendations: Market news provides players with timely information on changes and performance of the overall economy, individual sectors or stocks. Keep up to date, and make timely portfolio decisions. Portfolio Management: Trade for the long term, seeking high dividend yields, or trade more frequently, chasing the short-term trading gains. There are multiple paths to success; be first, be smarter, or be sneaky. Create Investment Firms: Create and investment firm and join with your friends. Play competitively or cooperatively to ensure your firm ranks among the highest. There are no rules here against working together to manipulate the market. (Not saying you should, but not saying you shouldn't...) Why play Stock Market Tycoon: Challenge? Are you fascinated by the world of stocks and investments? Do you think you have what it takes to dominate the stock market and outperform the competition? Do you just love the challenge and enjoy seeing your value increase? Whether you are working toward your own goals, or fighting over the leaderboards, Stock Market Tycoon: Challenge gives you the perfect platform to test your trading abilities in a fast-paced, competitive environment. The game combines entertainment and education, making it ideal for players who want to improve their financial literacy while having fun.

Key Features: Real-Time Stock Market Simulation: Trade live stocks in a simulated economy and manage your portfolio in a real-time simulated stock exchange. Buy, sell, and hold shares to maximise your profit and outperform other players. Multiplayer Competition: Challenge friends or compete with thousands of players globally in a battle for returns. Every percentage gain will count against your competitors. Rise up the leaderboard and showcase your skills, proving you are the ultimate Stock Market Investor. Seasonal Competition: Each season lasts one month (allowing for 28-31 'years' of dividends). Competition will be fierce as investors scramble to maximise portfolio returns. Leaderboards, Rankings and Ratings: All active players are ranked in the season will be ranked, and an overall investment rating will be calculated from your overall performance across many seasons. Awards: Players earn awards for achieving trading profit milestones, as well as ranking well at the end of a season. Accumulate and show off your awards. In-Game Market Events, News & Recommendations: Market news provides players with timely information on changes and performance of the overall economy, individual sectors or stocks. Keep up to date, and make timely portfolio decisions. Portfolio Management: Trade for the long term, seeking high dividend yields, or trade more frequently, chasing the short-term trading gains. There are multiple paths to success; be first, be smarter, or be sneaky. Create Investment Firms: Create and investment firm and join with your friends. Play competitively or cooperatively to ensure your firm ranks among the highest. There are no rules here against working together to manipulate the market. (Not saying you should, but not saying you shouldn't...) Why play Stock Market Tycoon: Challenge? Are you fascinated by the world of stocks and investments? Do you think you have what it takes to dominate the stock market and outperform the competition? Do you just love the challenge and enjoy seeing your value increase? Whether you are working toward your own goals, or fighting over the leaderboards, Stock Market Tycoon: Challenge gives you the perfect platform to test your trading abilities in a fast-paced, competitive environment. The game combines entertainment and education, making it ideal for players who want to improve their financial literacy while having fun.

rows.name: Finity
rows.short_description: Fuse monsters, build strategic decks, catch wild beasts, and battle players worldwide in the ultimate monster MMO!
rows.description_html: Embark on a Modestly Epic Monster-Fusing Adventure Crafted by Yours Truly! Welcome to a somewhat expansive MMO world where you—yes, you—can become a monster master without the need for a massive gaming studio behind you (trust me, I would know). In this game, developed entirely by one sleep-deprived indie dev (that's me), you can: Fuse Monsters (Because Why Not?) Combine creatures to create new, possibly questionable hybrids. Ever wondered what happens when you mix a fire-breathing salamander with a timid bunny? Neither did I until 3 AM last night! Strategic Deck Building (Or Just Wing It) Build decks based on your unique monsters. Plan out your strategies or throw random creatures together and hope for the best. I'm not here to judge. Explore and Capture (Gotta Catch a Few) Traverse through landscapes that I painstakingly designed pixel by pixel. Capture wild monsters to expand your collection and maybe impress... well, someone. Global Player Battles (Show Off Your Wi-Fi Connection) Challenge players from around the world to see whose monsters reign supreme. Or at least whose game doesn't lag. A Solo Indie Endeavor (Powered by Coffee) This game is the result of countless hours, numerous caffeine-fueled nights, and a dream to create something fun. So, you know, give it a whirl? Join a community of adventurers who are probably just as surprised as you are that this game exists. Your journey to becoming a legend (or at least mildly famous) starts here. Ready to fuse, strategize, and maybe conquer? No pressure.

rows.name: Hollywood Story®: Fashion Star
rows.short_description: Dreaming of Hollywood stardom? Hollywood Story offers you the chance to turn dreams into reality! Step into the star-studded streets of Hollywood and carve your own path to fame. Dominate the red carpets, mingle with celebrities, and build your fashion empire to become the ultimate Hollywood icon!
rows.description_html: Ever wanted to become a movie star and live a glamorous Hollywood lifestyle? Build your career, shoot movies, hang out with celebrities, and unlock different cities! CREATE YOUR HOLLYWOOD STAR Customize your avatar with an incredible selection of clothing options, fashion styles, hairstyles, and makeup choices. Leave your unique mark on the industry as you perfect your look, from glamorous gowns to chic streetwear! SHOOT BLOCKBUSTERS Land auditions, star in blockbuster films, and promote your movies to earn legions of devoted fans who will solidify your status as a megastar! From action-packed thrillers to heartwarming romances, your on-screen presence will captivate audiences worldwide! DIVE INTO FASHION Connect with renowned designers and flaunt exclusive couture made just for you! Experience the excitement of fashion showdowns as you take center stage, showcasing your impeccable style and trendsetting designs! Project your unique sense of style and become the ultimate fashionista! BUILD YOUR FAN BASE Launch your own fashion line, develop signature fragrances, and amass a dedicated fanbase! Leave an impression fit for royalty as you grace the covers of fashion magazines and inspire millions with your unparalleled elegance and charm! DATE CELEBRITIES Rub shoulders with Hollywood's elite at lavish parties and exclusive events—live the dream and mingle with the stars! From A-list actors to chart-topping musicians, your social circle will be brimming with excitement and glamour! EXPLORE ICONIC LOCATIONS Unlock new destinations like Hollywood, Beverly Hills, Manhattan, and Las Vegas as you progress! Immerse yourself in style games and explore glamorous locales, from luxurious penthouses to chic boutiques, as you soak in the glitz and glamour of the entertainment industry! GRACE THE COVERS With great fame comes great media frenzy! Paparazzi will be waiting outside your home, ready to snap your picture for tabloid covers. Embrace the spotlight and showcase your makeover skills to stun the world, dazzling on every magazine cover and red carpet event! CONNECT AND SHARE Meet new friends, visit their homes, and showcase your achievements to the world! Connect with fellow stylists and share your style tips, as you inspire and empower others to chase their dreams and conquer the world of fashion and entertainment!

From ancient tomes to powerful grimoires, your shop is the go-to place for wizards, witches, and magical beings seeking rare and enchanted books. Engage in dialogue puzzles where you’ll need to interpret subtle clues to determine which grimoire or spell they seek. Manage and Expand Your Magical Inventory Stock your shop with a variety of grimoires Craft Powerful Spells Combine different types of spells on your arcane table to create new and unique magic. Unravel Mysteries and Secrets There's more to these ancient grimoires than meets the eye. As you dive deeper into your collection, you'll uncover forgotten knowledge, cryptic messages, and hidden powers that could change the magical world forever. Respond to the Shifting Trends of Magic Keep an eye on the town’s magical newspaper to learn about trending spells, curses, and magical phenomena. Become the Most Renowned Magic Shopkeeper Build your reputation by mastering the art of magic retail. Make the right sales, complete quests, and manage your shop efficiently to become the most well-known magic seller in the realm.

rows.name: POCKET MYSTERY EP DX
rows.short_description: A surreal, murder-mystery puzzle game originally designed for the GameBoy.
rows.description_html: A surreal, short-form puzzle adventure / horror game built for the GameBoy, POCKET MYSTERY EP DX updates the original POCKET MYSTERY EP with full color graphics, re-designed puzzles, updated music and sound effects, and additional content. FEATURES A STRANGE MURDER:  As Detective Walker Rylance, explore the mysterious Minerva’s Nocturne hotel, investigating the locked-room murder of four colleagues. Nothing is quite as it seems, however. A COLORFUL CAST OF CHARACTERS:  Interview the colorful staff of the hotel - from the sophisticated concierge to the hyper-anxious cleaning staff and beyond. Relive the final moments of the victims and learn about who they are and their relations to each other. DESIGNED FOR THE GAMEBOY:  Built in GameBoy Studio, POCKET MYSTERY EP DX was originally built for, and is playable on, Game Boy Color. We’re not just riffing on the aesthetics of GameBoy games, this is built for the actual hardware. ESCAPE A LIMINAL SPACE:  Solve puzzles in a mysterious place seemingly inside the hotel, pushing blocks, activating switches, and more to escape a mysterious killer. DEVELOPMENT HISTORY Development of POCKET MYSTERY EP began in summer 2022 in Game Boy Studio and released about a year and a half later on Itch in December 2023. Its development was honestly frustrating and didn’t quite go as planned. Rather than giving up, the game was re-configured to try and acknowledge the difficult development.  In August 2024, with a variety of improvements and updates to Game Boy Studio, the idea to update the game, replete with GameBoy Color support, was sparked. This deluxe, or DX, re-release doesn’t aim to fully deliver on the game’s original vision, but it does seek to fix bugs, update the music and sounds, and add some additional content hinting at what might’ve been. This isn’t the end for POCKET MYSTERY EP either. A full remake, titled Nocturne: POCKET MYSTERY Remixed , is in development targeting a 2026 release.

rows.name: Snake King
rows.short_description: Snake King is a modern twist on the classic Snake game. Guide your snake through an open arena, eating fruit to grow longer while avoiding walls and your own tail. Simple to play, with increasing speed and difficulty—challenge yourself to beat your high score and become the Snake King!
rows.description_html: Game Description: Get ready to claim your throne in Snake King , a fresh, addictive take on the classic Snake game! In this retro-inspired arcade experience, you'll guide your snake through a simple, open arena, devouring fruit to grow longer with each bite. But the longer you grow, the more challenging it becomes to avoid crashing into the arena walls or your own tail. With increasing speed and length, every move counts! Features: Classic Snake Gameplay : The goal is simple—eat fruit, grow your snake, and avoid collisions with walls or yourself. Fruits & Growth : Collect fruit scattered throughout the arena to make your snake longer. The more you eat, the larger—and more difficult—the game becomes. Score and High Score : Track your current score as you play and try to beat your personal high score with each new game. Customizable Snakes : Unlock and choose different skins and colors for your snake, allowing you to personalize your gameplay experience. Gameplay: In Snake King , you control your snake with simple arrow key movements, navigating an open arena as you collect fruit and grow longer. As your snake grows, it becomes harder to avoid your own body, and the increasing speed adds to the difficulty. With its nostalgic gameplay, easy-to-learn controls, and challenging progression, Snake King offers endless hours of fun. Can you beat your high score and become the ultimate Snake King?

rows.name: UWAR
rows.short_description: UWAR is a game about the conflict between Ukraine and Russia, where players can capture territories, control artillery, FPV drones, and vehicles on real battle maps in the game!
rows.description_html: UWAR is a new, thrilling multiplayer shooter that transports players into modern combat based on real events. The game focuses on the conflict between Ukraine and Russia, giving players the chance to test themselves on the front lines. Locations like Koksohim, Irpin, and Serebryansk Forest recreate real battle zones, immersing players in dynamic operations of capturing positions, destroying ammunition depots, and fighting for strategic advantage. UWAR offers seven unique game modes, each testing players' tactical skills and providing a varied gaming experience: Conquest: Capture key points on the map to bring your team closer to victory. Rush: Attack or defend objectives, using a limited reinforcement pool. Kill Confirmed: Take down opponents and collect their tags to score points. Team Deathmatch: A classic mode focused on kill count. Capture The Flag: Steal the enemy’s flag and return it to your base. Free For All: Compete for the highest score in a “every player for themselves” format. Search and Destroy: Destroy objectives with only one life per round. UWAR is more than just a game. It honors the courage and resilience of people in challenging times. By purchasing the game, you support a project that connects players to real events in modern history, making a valuable contribution to the development of the military shooter genre.

By purchasing the game, you support a project that connects players to real events in modern history, making a valuable contribution to the development of the military shooter genre.

rows.name: TCG Master Trader
rows.short_description: Claim a free pack of cards every few hours and expand your collection! Discover hundreds of unique cards with different styles, rarities, and visual effects.
rows.description_html: TCG Master Trader is a free to play card-collecting experience where every few hours brings new surprises and new cards to discover! Real Time Based Drops Every 4 hours, players can claim a fresh pack of 5 random cards, added straight to their personal collection. Card drops are real time-based , meaning the timer counts down even while the game is closed — you don’t need to be online or actively playing. Just come back to claim your rewards… or enable Auto-Claim to receive your packs automatically! During special events or promotions, drop intervals may change or include bonus packs. To be the first to know when that happens, join our official Discord community . Card Collection & Binder Card Binder: Dive into your binder to browse your collection, examine your cards, and enjoy the unique designs and visual styles of each pull. There are 144 unique base cards , but with multiple styles, borders, and foils, there’s a total of 1,728 cards to collect, and more to come ! Drop Rates & Customization Each pack contains 5 randomly generated cards with a random rarity, border, foil and art type. Here’s what you can expect: Card Rarities: Common – 70% Uncommon – 20.71% Rare – 8.28% Epic – 1% Legendary – 0.01% Border Styles: Basic – 80% Gold – 17% Radiant – 3% Art Versions: Standard – 90% Full Art – 10% Foil Variants: Non-Foiled – 95% Foiled – 5% Marketplace Freedom All cards in your collection can be listed on the Steam Community Market! You can freely buy and sell cards with other players to build your binder, hunt for rare variants, or simply manage your growing collection however you like. Key Highlights • Free card packs every 4 hours – Always something new to look forward to. • Fully interactive card binder – Organize, admire, and display your collection. • Deep customization possibilities – Rarities, borders, art styles, and foils. • Steam Market integration – Buy and sell with players worldwide. • 1,728 collectible card variations – Will you collect them all? Join the Collection Craze Whether you're a casual collector, a hardcore completionist, or just love the thrill of opening card packs, TCG Master Trader is the perfect place to build your ultimate card collection.

rows.name: Conscience
rows.short_description: Jack Beckham is found dead, hanging in his apartment alone. Police rule it a suicide. His father, refusing to accept the conclusion, hires you to investigate. Delve into the clues left behind in his apartment to discover what really happened.
rows.description_html: Conscience is a noir detective mystery where you play as a private investigator hired to uncover the truth behind Jack Beckham's death. Initially ruled as a suicide, Jack’s father believes otherwise and hires you to search Jack’s apartment for clues to reveal what really happened. Investigate and explore Jack’s apartment, searching every room, shelf, and drawer for evidence and clues. Inspect the evidence , uncovering hidden details and piecing together crucial clues. Deduce  what truly happened using the clues you’ve gathered to solve the mystery. Solve the Mystery...

rows.name: MojiCraft
rows.short_description: MojiCraft is a minimal turn-based real-time strategy game where you build an army of Mojis and lead them into tactical battles. Choose from multiple unique factions, manage your resources, and claim victory by outsmarting your opponents and adapting your strategy to destroy their territory.
rows.description_html: Welcome to MojiCraft! Build up your army of Mojis and lead them into tactical battles! MojiCraft is a turn-based real-time strategy game with a minimalistic playstyle. Perfect for players who enjoy tactical games without a steep learning curve. Play casually with friends or show off your mastery by crafting unstoppable strategies.  Choose Your Faction There are a variety of factions, each with its own unique playstyle. Whether you're playing as the adaptable Humans, the fierce Beasts, or the sneaky Critters, there's a faction for everyone. Each one brings something different to the table, and figuring out how to make the most of your chosen faction is part of the fun! Lead Your Army To Victory Adaptability and tactical precision are key to victory. Start off by commanding one Moji from your faction and build up your structures and resources to produce even more Mojis. Fend off enemy attacks and send Mojis into battles of attrition or go all-in! Adjust your tactics to destroy all the structures of your enemies and claim victory.

Interact with objects, uncover secrets, and outsmart your the boss in this immersive, mind-bending experience.
rows.description_html: Today is the day you finally break free from that toxic work environment!.....or is it? In Escape the Office VR , you'll navigate through a series of challenging puzzles, cleverly hidden throughout the office, as you attempt to break out of the never-ending work nightmare. Interact with objects, uncover secrets, and outsmart your overbearing boss in this immersive, mind-bending experience where every detail matters. Will you escape to freedom, or remain trapped in the dream forever? The choice is yours!

rows.name: Slice, Suffer, Serve!
rows.short_description: Slice, Suffer, Serve! is a 2D slice-and-click game where you play as a chef, preparing dishes for ghost customers. Sell as many dishes as possible and try not to let the customers get angry! What are you waiting for, new employee? Serve spooky dishes to ghostly guests—quickly!!!
rows.description_html: Welcome to the Most Haunted Restaurant in Town! In Slice, Suffer, Serve! , you’ve just landed the most unique job of your afterlife, serving ghostly customers at a restaurant. But they’re not known for their patience!— Slice up human ingredients and serve ghostly customers before they get too angry. Get ready for a fast-paced, fun, and strange cooking game where you have to stay calm under pressure and keep your ghost customers happy. Make too many mistakes, and the ghosts might just haunt you! Key Features Midnight Madness : You’ll be serving from 6:00 PM to 6:00 AM, because, of course, ghosts like to eat at night! Fast-Paced Fun : Quickly slice and serve while keeping your kitchen running smoothly under pressure. Can you manage the chaos before time runs out? Four Chances : Ghosts are forgiving... to a point. You can afford a few slip-ups, but anger them too much and you’ll face the consequences. Make four mistakes, and it’s game over. High Scores : Think you can make the perfect dish under pressure? Challenge yourself to earn the highest score, beating the clock and out-serving your ghostly competition. Only the best chefs can survive the night! What You Can Expect Unique Gameplay: Slice, Suffer, Serve! is a fast-paced slice-and-click game where you play as a chef preparing dishes from human body parts to serve ghostly customers. As orders pile up, the pressure builds, and you’ll need to stay sharp to avoid losing points. Replayability: Every playthrough is a fresh challenge. With a focus on speed, accuracy, and quick thinking, you’ll have the chance to beat your personal high score each time you play. No two rounds are exactly the same! Tension and Strategy: You get four chances to make mistakes, but once you reach your limit, the night ends. You’ll need to plan carefully, react quickly, and keep your cool under growing pressure to succeed. Stylized Horror Setting with Folklore: The game’s spooky, haunted restaurant is brought to life with quirky, cartoonish visuals and eerie sound effects. Ghost customers from different countries and folklore add variety and keep the experience fresh and exciting. Mature Content Description This game includes cartoonish depictions of violence, such as slicing human body parts to serve as food to ghostly customers. While the art style is light-hearted and exaggerated, the game features themes of death and gore, which may not be suitable for all audiences.

rows.reviews_html: “Great game! A very complete package! Great concept, great execution, great sense of humor, great fun! Im really impressed with how it all came together. I think that's one of the hardest and most impressive things you can do in games (or any medium) is when everything fits together so well. The combination of Fruit Ninja + serving was really clever. And the way you get different items from slashing different parts of the body was great. And it was so intuitive which customers would want which item (Vampire = blood from the neck, zombies = brain from the head, and my favorite was the Krasue who wants poop lol). And the final twist of different levels of decay added more challenge without making the game more complex to understand. Everything was very intuitive. I think if you spend some more time polishing the game you could have a small hit on your hands! Really impressive work! I hope you all keep making games together!” Art-eater

rows.name: Ika's Odyssey
rows.short_description: Before his flock's migration, Ika the Woodpecker lost his ability to fly. He is forced to do the impossible - walk the migration path. Hope emerges when he discovers a magical child of a long extinct species. Craft, climb, and solve puzzles to overcome obstacles as a duo in this puzzle-platformer.
rows.description_html: Join Ika and the Creature on their season-spanning trek through the Migration Path! This colorful puzzle-platformer features 60 levels of puzzle-box challenges that are sure to test your wit -- and your platforming abilities! Set in the serene nature of a post-post-apocalyptic American countryside, this world has long forgotten humanity -- until Ika the Woodpecker discovers a lone child on his trek south for the Winter. CONTROLLER RECOMMENDED! - All common controllers are supported. OUR HEROES Ika was the Captain of his flock - an ace flyer, skilled archer, and role model for the fledglings under his tutelage. Days before his flock's annual migration, he was severely injured on a scouting mission, resulting in the loss of his left wing. Flightless, he was abandoned by his people as they fled Winter's bitter grasp. On his unprecedented perilous trek, Ika discovers a child of an unfamiliar breed. He quickly finds the Creature is capable of magical feats, allowing him to progress far further than he ever could alone. Alone, they are powerless. But together, the duo can surmount any obstacle in their way. ABILITIES Ika serves as the duo's muscle -- he is responsible for the platforming and item use in the game. While his loss of a wing resulted in his inability to fly, he can still jump and use his good wing to clear obstacles. The Creature is nimble and dexterous -- he is able to climb vines to reach greater heights and can fit in small spaces. But his small stature means he's unable to jump, and his weak arms prevent him from using the items that the duo craft. When the duo is united, they unlock the ability to craft items by combining the items they possess. Ika and the Creature can each hold one item, and combining them allows them to craft a new item to overcome obstacles in their path. There are dozens of combinations to discover and experiment with! The Creature has magical abilities that allow him to channel the things he eats into elemental power - use this ability wisely! Wielding the elements results in many new possible items to craft. Try to find all the combinations! SPEED IS KEY Every level will give you a Star Ranking depending on how fast you beat it. This puts your puzzling abilities and your reflexes to the test to truly show your mastery! Enable the Timer in Options to keep track of your Star Progress in real time. Play your fastest to unlock every Star! P.S. My best speedrun of the game is 56:26, try to beat that! FEATURES 60 Unique Puzzle-box Levels 12 Worlds, each concluding with a narrative diary entry Single Player Campaign lasting ~4-5 hours Support for all common controllers (Xbox, Playstation, Switch Pro Controller, Steam Deck, and many more) 7 Achievements 8 Original Songs Dozens of Item Combinations Sound and Display Settings Level Select for honing speedrun times Quick Retry to perfect individual levels This is the debut title from solo-developer Dongle Duck. No generative AI was used in the creation of this game.

rows.name: OUTSIDE
rows.short_description: OUTSIDE is a retro adventure game into a little town filled with Easter eggs and game references! Discover new places and meet familiar faces. Helping those along the way and collecting costumes to end the day.
rows.description_html: Ready to play Outside ? Out there, you'll find all sorts of people that need help! Collect items and costumes while exploring the caves and forests of this little town. Familiar characters from other worlds are sure to help you! Relax and giggle at the silly predicaments this place has to offer and enjoy these outdoors! Objective Outside is an open world game where your goal is to help the curious assortment of characters; collecting costumes and items to complete various quests scattered around the town.  Features 24 Collectible Costumes Two Possible Endings Authentic Original Soundtrack Achievements Easter Eggs

rows.name: One Day At A Time
rows.short_description: A first-person, single player horror game featuring multiple immersive and terrifying levels.
rows.description_html: ONE DAY AT A TIME This game is about one day in your life. One really bad day. When monsters are released into the world, you have to defeat the 7 deadly sins (the rulers of a place named No Rules Land). Every hour means a new level. This game includes: BASIC CONTROLS: This is a first person game. The controls are wasd to move, space to jump, 'F' for flashlight, and E' to interact. It has a minimal UI, only showing stuff like stamina when running, and the objective progress for some levels. HORROR: If it wasnt obvious and you dont use your eyes, this game is a horror game. But because I'm so cool, there are no jumpscares. I prefer a sense of dread over loud screaming. If you get scared easily then this game might be for you. If you, however, play horror so much its dull, well then feel free to play my game anyway.  I guarantee satisfaction or twice your disapointment back. FUN GAMEPLAY MECHANICS: Did you know, if you play this game, press all the movement keys and space - you explode. Try, it is funny. This game is still receiving updates and so I have some fun stuff planned in the future.  3 SCARY ATMOSPHERES: As of the intial release of this game, it has 3 levels. Try to stock up on soup cans in the convenience store. Or explore the dangerous ruins of under the city. Or perhaps just take a walk around the neighboorhood. Who knows what lies in these places? Any bugs or issues please notify me. Be warned as i am very lazy and will probaly take a while to see or fix it.

rows.name: Sword Tale : Lost Excalibur
rows.short_description: Sword Tale: Lost Excalibur is an Action-Adventure game. It can be played using both a mouse and keyboard. Players embark on a journey to help a mysterious girl escape from a group of knights intent on harming her.
rows.description_html: Sword Tale: Lost Excalibur is a third-person action-adventure game that blends sword-based combat with an emotional journey through a war-torn fantasy world. As a lone warrior, you cross paths with a mysterious girl who holds the key to an ancient secret—and you must protect her at all costs from the relentless knights who hunt her down. Explore ruined castles, dense forests, and forgotten battlegrounds as you uncover the truth behind the legend of the lost Excalibur. Use intuitive mouse and keyboard controls to engage in dynamic melee combat and make choices that affect the story’s outcome. This game was designed as a tribute to classic fantasy storytelling and the spirit of indie game development. Features: 🗡️ Legendary Swords with Unique Conditions Discover multiple swords throughout the game, each with its own distinct abilities and requirements. Choose wisely based on your strategy and playstyle. ⚔️ Charge Attacks for Greater Power Hold your attack to charge up your sword, unleashing a more powerful strike. Perfect for breaking through enemy defenses or turning the tide in a tough battle. ☠️ Zeberos Sword – Power at a Price A cursed sword of darkness that will never break—but continuously drains your health while equipped. High risk, high reward for those brave enough to wield it. While compact in scope, Sword Tale: Lost Excalibur aims to deliver a focused and immersive experience with a cinematic narrative and stylized visuals. It’s a student-developed final project, crafted by a team of passionate game developers from the Bachelor of Science in Digital Game Simulation program, Faculty of Science and Technology, University of the Thai Chamber of Commerce.

rows.name: Echoes of Madness - The Hawthorne Case
rows.short_description: Detective Norman faces one of the longest nights of his career. Alone, he searches for the missing girl, Felicia, only to discover that this case runs far deeper than he ever imagined.
rows.description_html: Echoes of Madness is a short visual novel set in a Lovecraftian world. You follow the story of a detective trying to find the daughter of a wealthy client. This is a small project, as I’m still learning game development, and I wanted to share one of my first creations with you. Pixel art style graphics Atmospheric music and sound effects A short but intense noir-style narrative Thank you for playing, and I hope you enjoy the experience!

rows.name: Fruit Stand Fortune
rows.short_description: Start with nothing and spin your way to the top! Gather fruit from slot machines and sell them to buy upgrades, new fruit types, and more! Unlock cute customers! Meet a Bear Wizard! Build your fruit empire with Fruit Stand Fortune!
rows.description_html: Fruit Stand Fortune is an idle game with slot machine and pachinko mechanics. It was designed to be captivating to watch, like a screensaver. Test your luck Slot machines can be clicked for a chance of gaining fruit. Jackpots will triple your winnings! Each slot machine can have up to 3 different fruits types. Upgrade your slot machines Slot machines can be upgraded to be more efficient! Speed upgrades increase slot spinning speed. Auto-Click makes gathering fruit truly idle, and section upgrades allow you to assign more fruit to a machine, increasing your chances of getting a fruit. Unlock customers Customers unlock like achievements, based on your progress! Each customer has a unique unlock condition and behavior. Some customers will increase buying speed, or rain a fruit storm on you! Others will try to steal your money! There are 15+ customers to unlock. Will you help Kate the Cat grow her store from a cardboard box to a fruitful business?

rows.name: Potion Problems
rows.short_description: Potion Problems is a multiplayer party game, combining social deduction and magic. Navigate Pigeonpoint's College for Potion Making as a troublemaker or an apprentice. Collect ingredients, make potions, avoid being turned into a frog, and vote out troublemakers to complete your degree!
rows.description_html: Potion Problems A chaotic social deduction party game for 4–10 players set in a whimsical world of magic and mischief. Welcome to Pigeonpoint’s College for Potion Making, where not everything is as it seems. In Potion Problems , players are secretly divided into two teams—Apprentices and Troublemakers—and must either follow the rules or stir up magical mayhem. Who will brew, and who will betray? Apprentices craft unique potions and work toward meeting their potion quota. Troublemakers use the forbidden Frog Potion to transform apprentices into frogs and derail their progress. When a frog is found, the group votes on who they think is responsible. Accuse wisely—your closest ally might be the one causing all the trouble. Key Features: Multiplayer Mayhem: Supports 4 to 10 players online or over local connection Secret Roles: Collaborate or deceive depending on your hidden identity Strategic Deduction: Gather clues, build trust, and figure out who’s working against you Whimsical Setting: Explore a colorful, magical campus full of surprises High Replayability: New dynamics every round keep the gameplay fresh Win Conditions: Apprentices win by completing their potion quota before too many are turned into frogs, or if they vote out all the troublemakers. Troublemakers win if the majority of apprentices are transformed into frogs. Blend strategy, social deception, and magical chaos in Potion Problems —where every game is a bubbling mix of suspense and fun.

rows.short_description: Big Burger Store is a 2D top down cooking game where you push around giant food items and serve burger orders to customers. Explore the busy world outside of work and participate in activities such as going fishing, fighting monsters, gambling, and so much more!
rows.description_html: Cook big burgers! Push giant pieces of food into the correct order requested by customers. Rank up and upgrade your work station along the way to become a master chef! Interact with the people in town! Decide whether or not to interact with the unfolding story set inside the town. Completing quests or simply talking with strangers may prove to be beneficial. Survive and participate in combat! Load up with tools and a weapon by supporting one of the local shops. Defend against what lurks in the darkness and stay rich in health to uncover hidden secrets. Explore fun pastimes! Catch fish and cook it by the furnace or maybe pass time playing video games at the arcade! And if the outside sounds like more fun, then enjoy competing in sports and racing events. Don't forget to test your luck at the casino!

rows.name: Vartra Abyss
rows.short_description: Vartra Abyss is an isometric ARPG that has the player exploring a dystopian underground cavern in search of their lost friend. You must learn to fight using your new abilities that you will attain by slaying enemies. Play your way and mix up your abilities to suit your playstyle.
rows.description_html: Vartra Abyss is an action role playing game set in an underground cavern that has been corrupted by an otherworldly power. You play as a spelunker who has been captured by a faction of Vartra, a race of blood fueled creatures with fantastical powers, and recently turned. You must learn to master your new abilities quickly to be able to survive in this dangerous landscape. Navigate this world in search of your lost friend by fighting your way through countless enemies and unlocking new powerful abilities.  Join The Mutated in their fight against The Abattoir, who rule this land with an iron fist and cause all but them to suffer.  Play your way with flexibility to change your equipped abilities to suit your playstyle.

rows.name: The Backrooms: Anomaly Containment Unit
rows.short_description: A first-person horror game with bodycam gameplay and tight controls. Explore the eerie, randomly generated Backrooms, catch anomalies, solve puzzles, and face atmospheric horror. Survive endless corridors in this intense PC survival experience.
rows.description_html: Dive into the chilling depths of the Backrooms in this first-person survival horror game for PC. Featuring immersive bodycam gameplay and tight controls, players navigate an endless maze of disorienting corridors filled with atmospheric tension. Randomized environments ensure that every experience is unique, adding to the sense of unease and unpredictability. Your mission is to explore and catch anomalies, all while trying to escape the eerie and mysterious halls. Key Features: Bodycam Gameplay : Experience the Backrooms through a unique, immersive bodycam perspective, intensifying the sense of realism and tension. Randomized Levels : No two runs are the same, with endless corridors and unpredictable pathways keeping you on edge. Tight Controls : Designed for responsive gameplay, ensuring you have precise movement as you explore and survive. Atmospheric Horror : An unsettling environment with eerie lighting, endless yellow hallways, and haunting soundscapes. Will you find your way out, or will you be consumed by the unknown?

In this limited version of Store Wars: Multiplayer Shop Simulator , up to 16 friends can get a hands-on experience of the fast-paced, competitive fun. Start small, learn the ropes, and decide if you’re ready for the full game experience. Please note: Some features are exclusive to the full version. Play with up to 16 Friends Help operate one of four stores in the chaos of a town filled with up to 16 friends wildly running around. It's competitive, it's hectic, and it's an absolute blast!  PVE & PVP Choose to play solo, with friends, or against them, in one of four customizable stores. Store Wars can be as relaxing or chaotic as you make it!  Grow and Expand Your Store Upgrade your store, place new shelves, and watch as your business thrives. Expand your space and attract more customers to become the ultimate grocery tycoon.  Please note: Only a few upgrades and licenses are available in the Prologue version of the game. Check Out Customers and Stock Shelves Keep your store running smoothly by quickly checking out customers and restocking shelves. Efficiency is key to staying ahead of your competitors! Lighthearted Sabotage Unleash your creativity in disrupting rival stores. Whether it's throwing something unexpected or causing a bit of chaos, sabotage has never been this fun!

rows.name: Brawlers of the West: Prologue
rows.short_description: Brawlers of the West: Prologue is a physics-based fighting game.
rows.description_html: Brawlers of the West: Prologue is a western realistic physics-based fighting game. This is the limited version of the game. You can play the first boss of the game. Some game modes like multiplayer is not available in this prologue. Physics Based Combat You can throw different punches and kicks or you can grapple your opponent in combat. You can also grab glass bottles and swing or throw them to your enemies. Characters have active physics and ragdoll system all the time so all the characters reacts to hits realistically, you can even hit the pianist or the bartender. Damage is depend on physics as well so timing your punches and positioning your character is very important. You can also block your opponent's attacks but if you can't position your character well a punch can hit you. Use the environment to your advantage is also important since there are lots of bottles chairs and table in the saloon. Different Characters Every character has different stats and this will change your gameplay. For example you can pick a character with high stamina and punch your opponents all the time or you can play with a character that can punch hard. In this prologue some characters is not available to play.

rows.name: PlanetX
rows.short_description: PlanetX is a real-time strategy MMO set on a spherical planet. Players expand territories, construct buildings, and manage resources to develop their empire. The ultimate goal is to conquer the entire planet by claiming all land plots and outpacing rivals in strategic growth and domination.
rows.description_html: PlanetX is a real-time strategy MMO that redefines large-scale multiplayer warfare. The battle begins on Planet Alpha , where dozens of players start with seven land plots each. Unlike traditional flat maps, the entire game takes place on a fully spherical planet , adding an extra layer of strategy to territorial expansion. Players must build and expand their empire , constructing various structures and managing resources. The first challenge is achieving a perfect balance between resource extraction and production to fuel economic growth. Once a player amasses enough wealth, it's time to assemble a powerful army , featuring tanks, aircraft, and missiles . A unique aspect of PlanetX is its energy-based warfare  - tanks and aircraft are fully electric , requiring charging stations before heading into battle. Units will fight until they run out of energy or are destroyed , making strategic deployment and resource management crucial. The ultimate goal? Total planetary domination. The first player to conquer every available land plot on Planet Alpha claims victory and earns a ticket to Planet Beta , where even greater challenges await. As multiple Alpha champions arrive on Beta, the war escalates to an entirely new level. Everything in PlanetX  -  construction, battles, resource trading, and land deals - happens in real time , ensuring a fast-paced, dynamic experience. Do you have what it takes to rise as the supreme ruler of the galaxy?

rows.name: Arima Lodge
rows.short_description: One of Arima Lodge's bellhops rides the elevator for his usual shift, but, after a man rushes into the elevator and compels him to get to the rooftop instead, he starts to realize something very serious is amiss.
rows.description_html: Context Within the domed city of a nearby future, Kai the bellhop rides the elevator of Arima Lodge, the hotel he works at, up from the ground floor to get a relief. However, after a secretive man rushes into the elevator and compels him to get to the 100th floor —the rooftop— instead, he starts to realize something very serious is amiss. Gameplay Arima Lodge is a free to play short 5-minute-long story with a locked camera that occurs completely within an elevator. It has limited dialogue options from the perspective of Kai the bellhop, and QTE events on screen to open and close the elevator doors whenever a new character enters.

rows.name: Ad Astra Infinita: The New Evolution
rows.short_description: Fight some battles, gain some levels, rock out to some chunky riffs, and experiment with combining overpowered abilities in a world bent on creating a supreme killing machine.
rows.description_html: Ad Astra Infinita: The New Evolution is a goofy, sanboxy JRPG focused on mechanical exploration and light environmental storytelling. This is my first major game, and I want as many people to play it as possible; therefore, I've made it free! Please leave a review if you played the game and let me know your thoughts. I'm planning to keep updating the game in response to feedback through 2026. Included: 10-20 hours of gameplay across seven to nine regions in the game world 20+ boss battles, about half of which are optional, some of which are challenging and/or have been tested, none of which have abilities the player can't get access to, but all of which drop cool stuff 150+ Mutagenes to equip to your party, including a sizeable number of unique effects, like draining health or poisoning the enemy with certain attacks, gaining resources when reduced below half HP, or becoming an energy being whose physical attacks deal Radiant damage 150+ skills to use in battle Convenience features - you can gain the ability to turn off random encounters, fast travel, trigger desired enemy encounters, and even teleport through walls on a map A fair amount of silly dialogue and environmental interactions, such as increasing or decreasing the number of corpses in a facility, going bowling, and quiz questions 50+ pieces of original music, including some that could be called headbangable slabs of riffage A manual, accessible from within the game at the player's behest, with detailed explanations of how equipment, skills and enemies work Not included: Original art Cinematic cutscenes Meticulously balanced gameplay Base building Highly detailed maps A consistent mood/atmosphere Dating/Waifus/Husbandos State of the Game(As of Dec 2, 2025): The game is mostly done, but will likely be receiving one more update with extra content, particularly aimed at making certain interesting mutagenes available earlier in the game.

rows.name: Corporate Chaos
rows.short_description: Corporate Chaos is a 2D Action game where an office worker must battle the forces of automation to get his job back! Explore the labyrinth like office building with only furniture and broken bits of bots to defend yourself.
rows.description_html: Corporate Chaos! You are an office worker who has discovered that all of your co-workers have been replaced by robots! Climb the office tower and battle the bots with whatever you can get your hands on. Confront the ByteBoss before it’s too late! Throw your way to victory! Use office supplies and the broken bodies of the bots to bash your way up the office tower. Battle Rampaging Robots! Fight against the forces of automation! Three unique bosses stand between you and full employment! Corporate Chaos was created by a team of talented middle and high school students as part of the Hackingtons Game Dev Team.

rows.name: Pale Light
rows.short_description: Pale Light is a hidden object horror game. You play as a medical examiner searching for clues on five bodies the FBI brought you. Reason suggests self-administered poison, but as you search you begin to see things that reason alone cannot explain...
rows.description_html: During your night shift as a medical examiner, the FBI arrives with an unusual case: five bodies, cause of death unknown. In this hidden object game, you'll need to piece together a randomly-generated word of power by searching the five bodies. A blacklight found at the scene of the crime reveals tattoos and other strange markings hidden on each corpse. Keep a piece of paper handy to take notes on what you find, but don't take too long: the morgue's electrical system has become unpredictable, and the dead stir in the dark. Whenever the power fails, you'll need to rush to repair it, or else meet an early end. A free horror game from Hushberry Games that blends forensic investigation with supernatural terror. Have fun ;)

rows.name: Vessel
rows.short_description: A fast-paced 1v1 sci-fi brawler where pilots clash in fully customizable mechs. Shred armor, adapt your tactics, and outfight your opponent in visceral, high-stakes combat.
rows.description_html: 'Built for war. Modified by you.' In Vessel, you take control of a customizable combat mech and face off in brutal one-on-one battles where every choice matters—from your loadout to how you fight. Vessel is a third person fighting game with armor destruction system. Tear through enemy armor, manage system damage, and exploit weaknesses in dynamic arenas. Powered by detailed destruction and full character customization, no two fights play the same. Choose your build. Adapt on the fly. Win by any means.

rows.name: Saloon King
rows.short_description: A short, cinematic western shooter with wild, fast-paced spray 'n' pray action! Help a sharp-shootin' renegade on a mission to take over the saloon. Shoot first, ask questions never. Clear out anyone daring enough to stand in your way!
rows.description_html: A short, cinematic western shooter with wild, fast-paced spray 'n' pray action! Help a sharp-shootin' renegade on a mission to take over the saloon. Shoot first, ask questions never. Clear out anyone daring enough to stand in your way! A brutal showdown awaits. It’s you against the entire town! Battle through four ruthless gangs that control the saloon and claim your place as the ultimate gunslinger. Only one can come out on top. Get ready for the fight of your life. The Origins of the Saloon King This game was originally submitted to Jern Jam 3. I was so happy with the result, plus it won an award for Cinematography & Completeness  that I decided to expand and improve it. I'm excited to share the updated version on Steam as a freebie!
