rows.name: Popo & Rob
rows.short_description: Popo & Rob is an action-packed shooter game that combines dynamic, casual-friendly shooting with a unique twist on movement. Engage in exciting battles where gravity is no limit. Choose your side, Popo or Rob, and immerse yourself in a world that’s bright, bold, and brimming with fun.
rows.description_html: About This Game Popo & Rob is a team-based first-person shooter designed for quick, thrilling matches in a vibrant, colorful world that redefines freedom of movement. Featuring two unique factions—Popo and Rob—the game pits players against each other in battles where every match feels fresh, thanks to fully explorable environments with surfaces you can walk on from any orientation. Key Features Freedom of Movement Forget what you know about gravity! In Popo & Rob , players can walk, run, and fight on any surface they see, opening up a myriad of strategic possibilities. You’re not limited to just the ground—rooftops, walls, and every possible angle are fair game. Diverse Characters and Skills Each character in Popo & Rob comes with a unique skill set and gun type, letting you approach battles with a play style that suits you best. Some characters may be more tactical, while others are all about direct firepower, giving players plenty of choices. Casual-Friendly, Yet Challenging While Popo & Rob is easy for newcomers to pick up, it also offers layers of depth for FPS veterans. The simple controls and streamlined mechanics ensure accessibility, but mastering each character’s skills and movement across varying surfaces adds a level of challenge. Colorful, Anime-Inspired Aesthetic The game’s aesthetic draws from anime and fun, stylized visuals reminiscent of games like Splatoon. Every map is filled with vibrant colors and bold designs that keep gameplay visually engaging and inviting. Pick Your Faction, Play Your Way Will you side with the fun-loving Popo or the resourceful Rob? Each faction offers its own style and strategies, creating a distinct identity that sets up every match as a playful clash of styles. Join the world of Popo & Rob for endless FPS fun, coming this December on Steam.

rows.name: Zone-0
rows.short_description: Zone-0 is a psychological horror experience built using one of our free game frameworks, offering a chilling glimpse into what you can create with it.
rows.description_html: About This Game Zone-0 was created in just one week as a showcase of our free, publicly available Unreal Engine framework. This short horror experience was built to demonstrate how quickly and effectively developers can build immersive worlds with it — and we challenged ourselves to push its capabilities to the limit. Story It was supposed to be a quiet goodbye. You’re just a low-clearance guard posted at the front gate of a sprawling facility no one talks about. For years, you watched people come and go—never knowing what went on behind the reinforced walls. Now the project is being shut down. Decommissioned. Stripped for parts and packed away like it never existed. But on your final shift, something goes wrong. The ground shakes. Pipes burst. Sirens wail in. Whatever was buried in the dark isn’t staying quiet. You were never meant to see what’s inside. But now, there’s no turning back. Features Atmospheric Exploration Navigate flickering tunnels, broken labs, and looping corridors. The deeper you go the more you start to understand. Minimalist Horror Mechanics No combat. Just immersive, sound-driven tension, environmental interaction, and storytelling. Immersive Audio & Design

rows.name: Olympia: Festival of the Gods
rows.short_description: Olympia: Festival of the Gods is a digital board game where players collect tokens in order to perform rituals to honor the Gods of Ancient Greece!
rows.description_html: Olympia: Festival of the Gods  is a digital board game where players collect tokens in order to perform rituals to honor the Gods of Ancient Greece! Players can compete against other players in local PVP, or against AI bots. Note:  Olympia: Festival of the Gods does not  support online multiplayer at this time. This feature may be added in a future update. HOW TO PLAY The game is composed of 6 rounds. Each round honors a different Greek God or Goddess. Each round is broken up into two phases: collecting, and scoring. During the Collecting phase, players compete to collect their desired tokens. Players collect all of the tokens of the same color from either columns or the table. Tokens belonging to the God or Goddess that is being honored that round are 'wild' allowing one additional token to be collected with any other tokens. But watch out for the Hades token at the table center -- collecting Hades will cost players valuable points! During the Scoring phase, players use their tokens on ritual spaces at a God or Goddess's altar. Each ritual has a cost - the player must spend tokens of the designated color (or the wild color) to complete the ritual. Completing all of the rituals of a particular God or Goddess rewards the player with bonus points!

rows.name: Chroma
rows.short_description: Chroma is a solo third-person narrative platformer game where you play as an artist exploring her creativity by restoring color and bringing life back to the environment.
rows.description_html: Through Anxiety and Creativity, follow the story of Noa. Chroma is a third-person 3D solo adventure game in which you play as Noa, an art student who evolves within her creativity. You will evolve through fantastic and dreamlike environments devoid of colors. With the help of her companion, bring back colors and life to the world in order to progress and understand what Noa is going through. RECOLORATION: To progress in this universe, you will be accompanied by Chroma, your blue slime companion. Thanks to him, you will be able to recolor and bring life back to the environment around you. PLATFORMING: Move agilely and precisely through the environment to reach your goal. Revitalize your surroundings to help them grow and progress. NARRATION: During your journey, the story will be narrated by Noa herself through fragments of memories, phrases scattered throughout the environment, and the scenery around you. You will also have access to Noa's journal, which will be filled as your adventure progresses.

rows.short_description: Project Search is a visual novel of Chinese immortality cultivation. Scholar Qian Jiangmin investigates collapsed pagodas in Linhai's old town while searching for his missing brother. With the help of Daoist cultivators, he explores grotto-heavens and uncovers the truth behind his double vision.
rows.description_html: Project Search is an atmospheric visual novel inspired by Chinese science fiction and Daoist cultivation of immortality. Set in the spectral landscapes of Linhai, Chongqing, and Dunhuang, the game invites players to explore parallel dimensions, ancient grotto-heavens, and transcendental urban spaces. Character and Plot The protagonist, Qian Jiangmin, is a young scholar recovering from illness searching for his brother. His journey gradually reveals hidden grotto-heavens and mysteries about his double vision, propelling him toward self-discovery and transcendence. You will take on the role of Qian Jiangmin with his HMD (head-mounted display) and drone, a young researcher on a quest to find his brother. Guided by scholars and Daoist cultivators, you will explore the mysterious underground realms hidden within Linhai's old town. How to Play Navigate using WASD and arrow keys , with Shift to speed up and Enter to access a bird's-eye view of the level. Use the  Spacebar  to switch levels, and press and hold  i to inspect specific NPCs and locations. Press R to restart the level. Throughout your journey, approach and interact with dodecahedron objects and hidden features, activated by mouse hovering or clicking, to dive deeper into the lore. Non-linear Exploration Designed to be non-linear with no compulsory objectives, Project Search emphasises exploration and discovery. You can switch to 14 levels anytime. Players are encouraged to wander, uncover hidden artefacts, and piece together the city's incompleteness, imperfection, and picturesqueness. There are no fixed goals—just the thrill of curiosity and adventure. Sandstorm Dunhuang Project Search transports players to Dunhuang's ordinary yet metaphysical streets, a significant religious city with ancient cultural heritage in China's far northwest. You will experience the rhythms of everyday life while uncovering deeper spiritual and historical layers. Foggy Chongqing Another scene in the game is set in Chongqing, capturing the constant rain, mist, and post-industrial feel of the district adjacent to the Sichuan Fine Arts Institute. This environment adds a hauntingly surreal atmosphere, blending art with the urban landscape. Non-collision Linhai Most Project Search unfolds in the old town of Linhai, Taizhou, in Zhejiang province. This setting forms an urban techno-fantasy that links Chinese Daoist philosophies with modern technology, offering a spectral and uncanny vision for players to reflect Chinese cultural heritage. An Auto-ethnography Each level in Project Search combines art, myth, and contemplation, creating an immersive experience. This encourages players to distinctly personalise their reflections on spirituality, cultural heritage, and modernity. Shared Universe with HyperBody Project Search is set in the same universe as the HyperBody VR game and shares NPCs and specific environments. Fans of HyperBody will enjoy exploring connections at the Garden Portal level, which provides an extended immersive experience across both games.

rows.name: Robot Unlock
rows.short_description: Robot Unlock is an open-ended puzzle game with 75+ levels. Design your own solutions and optimize them for speed, instructions or space and compare with other players. Create your own levels, challenge other players and solve community made ones.
rows.description_html: After years of trying you finally manage to dial into other-space. You find that the dweller of other-space has challenging questions about computability and is asking for your help. 75+ levels Solve puzzles in constrained spaces using a handful of instructions Solve open-ended problems and design your own solutions Optimize your solutions for speed, instructions or space Use multithreading - carefully time and synchronize your execution threads to halve the execution time Set breakpoints - step backward, or even step forward! Compare with other players - see how your solutions rank with fun histograms Create your own levels, share them and solve community made levels Trailer music: 'Home Dimension' by Joey Freeze / CC BY 3.0

rows.name: Death By Chatter
rows.short_description: A 2D platformer rage game developed by Youtuber 'PinoPrime' that is directly affected by your Twitch chat. Try to get to the top as your own chat sabotages you along the way! (Disclaimer: Game may cause rage even for epic gamers like me)
rows.description_html: Death By Chatter is a 2D platformer rage game that is directly affected by your Twitch chat. Try to get to the top as your own chat sabotages you along the way! How it works: The game connects to your Twitch account via a Twitch application. (don't worry it can only read chat messages. as you can see below) Then you simply type in the username of the Twitch account you want the game to read messages from. Epilepsy warning: Some scenes in the game could possibly trigger epilepsy

rows.name: Honu
rows.short_description: Honu is a first-person 3D puzzle adventure where magic meets technology. Solve logic-based puzzles, reshape the world with magitech, and uncover a story set in a mysterious, beautifully stylized world.
rows.description_html: Honu is a first-person 3D puzzle adventure set in a world where magic and technology come together. As an explorer stepping through a portal, you find yourself on the untouched island of Honu , a place where nature has reclaimed the ruins of an ancient civilization. Strange magitech devices lie dormant among moss-covered stones, waiting to be understood once more. Travel through a variety of biomes, from lush forests to ancient ruins. Unravel the island’s secrets by solving  magitech puzzles that challenge your logic and creativity. Piece by piece, you’ll uncover the story of the people who once blended magic and technology to shape their world, and learn why they vanished. Honu offers a story-driven experience full of mystery, exploration, and wonder, inviting you to think, experiment, and shape the world with the power of magitech. Features: Thoughtful puzzles – Repair, activate, and understand ancient magitech left behind by a lost civilization. A living world – Explore a vibrant island filled with ruins, puzzles, and traces of old magic. Meaningful encounters – Engage in quiet, heartfelt dialogue with the island’s inhabitants. A journey of discovery – Follow your curiosity through a story about wonder, memory, and renewal.

rows.name: Makis Adventure: Level Editor
rows.short_description: Build your own Dungeons, share them with the Community and play Dungeons made by the community. This is the official Level Editor for the 2D Action-Platformer Makis Adventure!
rows.description_html: This is the official (free to use) Level Editor for the 2D Action-Platformer Makis Adventure. Build your own Dungeons / Levels and share them with the Community. About me: My name is Mateo and Im the 22 years old solo-gamedeveloper behind Makis Adventure. I made the Level Editor within 2 months since community asked me to. I hope that you will enjoy building Levels and Im looking forward to play your Levels too! Elements in the Level-Editor: 10 different ground-variants (grass, stone, snow, ice, water etc.) All the 9 enemies which can be found in the main-game Different Backgrounds (jungle, underwater, sky, dungeon, snow mountains, vulcano) Popular tools with Shortcuts: Pen, Eraser, Fill Selection, Block-Picker, Clear Selection etc. A layer system (Background, Ground, Foreground) Big selection of customization-options for your Levels Save and Load your Level locally on your computer Upload and share Levels to the Server

rows.name: Progress Knight: Multiplayer
rows.short_description: An incremental multiplayer, PvP idle game
rows.description_html: Progress Knight: Multiplayer is an exciting incremental player versus player game that builds on the success of its predecessor, Progress Knight: Mobile. Set in a rich fantasy/medieval world, players must gather gold and progress their skills to fight against their opponents. As a novice of The Order, you start at the bottom rung of the ladder. However, through your faith and dedication, you can discover new skills and abilities that allow you to overpower your rivals and climb the ranks of The Order. You must choose whether to rely on their wits and skills alone, embrace your belligerent side, or use your dedication to deter potential attackers. In Progress Knight: Multiplayer, combat is a key aspect of the game. You can engage in battles with other players to steal their gold and gain ranks. But be warned, you can only attack those of a lower rank than you. Eventually, you will hit a plateau and find it difficult to progress further. However, among the ranks of The Order, you may discover a way to start over while retaining some of your power to progress even faster than before. This adds an extra layer of strategy to the game, as you must balance short-term gains with long-term planning.

rows.name: In The Night You Had Bad Dreams
rows.short_description: In the Night You Had Bad Dreams is a first-person horror game. You're trapped inside a strange house that seems to shift and change, waiting for you to solve unconventional puzzles.
rows.description_html: In the Night You Had Bad Dreams is a first-person horror game. A strange house within your dreams seems to twist and change, waiting for you to solve unconventional puzzles. You simply need to find the key and open the door. If you find enough keys and open enough doors, maybe the nightmare will end. 'Ever since I moved into this house, I've had weird dreams. For the first few months, I thought it was the stress of adapting to a new place. Two years have passed now , and I still get this strange feeling -like someone is watching me in my sleep. Like I'm not alone in this house. I feel tired all the time. Sometimes I get lost in my own house. The doctors say I'm fine. Therapy doesn't work. I'm so tired.' This game is my first project as a solo developer , and I have decided to release it for free as a gesture of gratitude towards the game development community. They have played a crucial role in making this project a reality through tons of tutorials, support forums, and free assets available online. Although I acknowledge that it is not flawless, I simply wanted to contribute something and hope that people find enjoyment in the experience.

rows.name: Undercover
rows.short_description: In Undercover, you enter a medieval world as a noble knight among trusted comrades. But beware—one of you is an infiltrator with a deadly mission. While you carry out your knightly duties, deception and danger lurk in the shadows. Can you unmask the traitor before they strike?
rows.description_html: About This Game You are a knight honorable, brave, and bound to the kingdom. But this is no ordinary day in the realm. As dawn breaks over the medieval kingdom, you and your fellow knights prepare to uphold your duties: to patrol the forests, guard the castle gates, and protect the people. Each knight stands by your side, sworn to the same codes of loyalty and valor. Or so you thought… But whispers have spread across the realm. Under you walks an infiltrator, hiding behind a knight’s armor and waiting for the right moment to strike. This imposter, clever and ruthless, has one goal—to dismantle the Order from within and carry out a dark mission. Trust begins to crumble as you look to your comrades with suspicion. The question haunts every conversation, every glance: Who is the undercover infiltrator hiding under us? A Journey of Suspicion and Survival Your quest will take you deep into the heart of this medieval world, across winding forest trails and bustling village streets. Each day brings a series of duties: you’ll defend villagers from outlaws, protect royal secrets, and, above all, stay vigilant for any sign of betrayal. As you carry out these noble tasks, every word spoken and action taken by those around you takes on a new, ominous weight. But the infiltrator is cunning. They blend in, playing the role of a loyal knight, all while weaving distrust, watching your every move, and waiting to strike. Your choices could mean the difference between victory and defeat, honor and disgrace. Do You Dare to Trust? In Undercover , trust is the rarest currency. As you move through this medieval world, each decision, each word, and each glance could be your last. Gather your courage, ready your sword, and remember—true honor lies not just in victory, but in survival.

rows.name: 1X1
rows.short_description: Become a little soul lost in a dangerous factory, avoid obstacles and battle bosses. A challenging bullet hell game where you advance by opening and closing doors!
rows.description_html: This is someone's lab and factory, full of dangerous things. You're a lost little soul here. Survive the obstacle, finish the boss that comes out of the door and move on! 'The door opens' 1X1 is largely divided into a barrage and a boss battle, and the game is played. Normally the door is closed, but as you work through the pattern and move on, the door opens and you encounter the boss of that stage. If the door opens, prepare for a battle with the boss! 'The door is closing' Give the boss schedule damage and he closes the door and runs away. The later barrage patterns and battles come back stronger. Key Features It consists of patterns of various personalities as well as 'avoid bullets.' You can have fun switching between passive avoidance and active combat. Meet the robotic design to fit the theme of factory and robot Each boss has a simple method of targeting that can be operated with one button. It is not easy, but you can enjoy it without burden with checkpoints that occur every time you open and close the door. There is an infinite bomb stage for those who want to focus on bomb shelters without fighting.

rows.name: Lifetakers & Heartbreakers
rows.short_description: 'Lifetakers & Heartbreakers' is an intense 2D side-scrolling shooter set in the war-torn world of Pavlovia.
rows.description_html: 'Lifters & Heartbreakers' is an intense 2D side-scrolling shooter set in the war-torn world of Pavlovia. Players follow the harrowing journey of three elite soldiers from the Hunter Unit— Lynch , Hirschmann , and Bishop —who must fight for their survival after their helicopter crash-lands deep within enemy territory. Stranded behind enemy lines, they soon uncover a deadly plot: a rebel faction led by the cunning Pavlovian sniper officer Sasha is on the brink of deploying a nuclear weapon. As players navigate through hostile terrain, they must rely on quick reflexes and tactical skill to overcome waves of enemies, sabotage rebel operations, and stop the nuclear threat before it’s too late. With fast-paced combat, unique character abilities, and a gripping narrative set against the backdrop of a global conflict, 'Lifters & Heartbreakers' delivers a thrilling gameplay experience where every bullet counts. Can you outsmart Sasha and his forces, and prevent the ultimate disaster?

rows.name: Crazy Dungeon
rows.short_description: Crazy Dungeon is a third-person action roguelike. Choose your character and level, survive as long as you can, and level up your skills after each round! Try to improve your stats with every run!
rows.description_html: Crazy Dungeon is a third person action roguelike. Choose your character and level, survive as long as you can and level up your skills after each round. Try to improve your stats in each game to get as far as possible. In Crazy Dungeon you can choose between two characters, a knight or a crossbowwoman and play on three maps based on rounds where at the end of each round the difficulty will increase. How far will you get? You will also have an extra level full of dangers to complete.

rows.name: Critter Gang
rows.short_description: Squeak! Chitter! Chatter! You’ll send these mafia members to heaven on a silver platter! You play as a red squirrel trained in the martial arts of crankin’ out kunais and shwingin’ shurikens! You’ll teach three very important lessons to three unlearned delinquents!
rows.description_html: CRITTER GANG   Squeak! Chitter! Chatter! You’ll send these mafia members to heaven on a silver platter! You play as a red squirrel trained in the martial arts of crankin’ out kunais and shwingin’ shurikens! You’ll teach three very important lessons to three unlearned delinquents! Lesson 1: Integrity is important; I hope you find yours quick, Coyote. Lesson 2: You only get one life, Peacock– change yours before you no longer have it. And most importantly, Lesson 3: Gambling others' lives is a nasty business, Kingpin. Let’s see how you feel when yours is on the line. Help teach these mafiosos a lesson in Critter Gang while dodging attacks and retaliating with some of your own! A STUDENT & GAME JAM PROJECT This year our team participated in the Ludum Dare 56 Game jam! We received so many positive comments about our project that we decided to take our project, patch the remaining bugs, and ship it on steam for everyone to enjoy! Additionally, we are a team of student developers taking the first few steps on our development journey. Playing our game means the world to us and we would love to hear feedback about the project! Although Critter Gang was developed in just 3 short days, we feel like we have some awesome content for everyone to enjoy! GAME CONTENTS 3 Unique and Challenging Bosses 2D Platforming and Precise Dodging 5 Achievements for your hard work Approximately 15 - 30 mins of content Epic Soundtrack to Jam to while facing off with the Mafiosos Controller Support CREDITS Chad Compton  -  Programmer, Technical Director Gabriel Delle  -  Programmer, Implementation Lead Cameron Larson  -  Programmer, Boss Designer Justin Davey  -  Art Director, Lead Character Designer Riley Moran  -  Background/Environmental Designer Jesse Ray  -  Programmer, Boss Designer Tyvarion Hill  -  Concept Artist Nick Lenssen  -  Programmer, Boss Designer Serenity Spielman  -  Artist Keaton Hagen  -  SFX Designer Auggie Phillips  -  Artists, Splash Screen Designer

Help teach these mafiosos a lesson in Critter Gang while dodging attacks and retaliating with some of your own! We received so many positive comments about our project that we decided to take our project, patch the remaining bugs, and ship it on steam for everyone to enjoy! Additionally, we are a team of student developers taking the first few steps on our development journey. Playing our game means the world to us and we would love to hear feedback about the project! Although Critter Gang was developed in just 3 short days, we feel like we have some awesome content for everyone to enjoy! rows.name: Valsa das Macaúbas
rows.short_description: A third-person narrative adventure game that blends exploration, puzzle-solving, and impactful choices. Players investigate mysteries, interact with characters, and make decisions that shape the course of the story, immersing them in a journey between the real and the supernatural.
rows.description_html: Step Into the Dance of Time - Relive Porto Nacional in 1917 In a Brazil of another era, where faith, traditions, and mysteries intertwine, you are invited to embark on a unique journey. Valsa das Macaúbas is not just a game – it’s an immersion into history, through cobblestone streets and secrets that echo within the walls of Porto Nacional. Get ready to uncover the unexpected and dance between the real and the fantastical Conversations that connect you to the mystery Explore Three Mystery-Filled Locations Between light and shadow, explore Caetanato , Catacombs , and Church . 🕯️ Features A Story Set in the Heart of Old Brazil Explore a dark narrative inspired by legends, mysteries, and memories from the countryside of northern Goiás (now Tocantins), with environments that evoke a forgotten time — from ancient churches and stifling catacombs to the enigmatic Caetanato. Puzzles and Secrets Lurking in the Shadows Solve environmental puzzles that block your path, interact with objects, and uncover hidden clues. Each puzzle reveals a new piece of the past and helps you understand the story more deeply. A World Between the Real and the Supernatural Face environments filled with symbolism and psychological tension. Light and darkness dance in every scene, and there is always more than meets the eye. Dangerous Encounters Not everything along your journey is meant to be understood — some encounters require silence, escape, or bravery. Stay alert and prepare to face what lurks in the shadows. Original Soundtrack and Immersive Atmosphere From religious chants to mysterious arrangements, the soundtrack of Valsa das Macaúbas accompanies every step with sounds that echo from the earth, the spirit, and memory itself.

rows.name: Teddy Knight
rows.short_description: Step into the paws of an unlikely hero and journey through the toy chest! In Teddy Knight, a physics-based action roguelite, you play as Teddy, a brave stuffed knight on a mission to save the toy world from evil. Engage in fast-paced combat with unique “bounce” mechanics in a dark toy universe.
rows.description_html: Long forgotten in the depths of the toy chest, Teddy—a loyal and courageous knight—is called to action. As chaos spreads across the toy world, driven by the vengeful Baba Yaga plushie and her sinister army, it’s up to Teddy to rise, face the darkness, and fight through haunted toys to restore peace to the realm of playthings! Physics-Powered Combat Engage in fast-paced, physics-based battles that require strategy and reflexes, pushing enemies off platforms and knocking them back to the bottom of the toy chest. Each room offers unique opportunities for creative takedowns! Dash, Bounce, and Chain Combos Inspired by Smash Bros, Teddy Knight introduces bouncy physics to combat, letting you launch enemies in every direction and chain them into thrilling combo attacks. Customize your playstyle Collect powerful upgrades, items, and abilities that allow you to build a unique approach to combat. Experiment with different strategies to match your playstyle and take on increasingly challenging foes. Progress through the sinister depths of the toy chest, where forgotten toys create a world full of mystery. Each area offers unique challenges, hidden secrets, and an atmosphere that grows darker and more threatening as you progress. Rediscover each level in Nightmare Mode, where the difficulty ramps up and the atmosphere takes on an even darker, more ominous tone. Conquer this mode to unlock new abilities, challenges, and rewards. Are you ready to brave the toy chest and face the darkness within? Grab your hammer, take a deep breath, and prepare to dash and bounce in Teddy Knight!

rows.name: AlibAi
rows.short_description: An AI-driven murder mystery where you play as the killer. Deceive NPCs, shift suspicion, and outsmart the AIs to survive. Strategize late-night kills and morning conversations in a tense game of trickery and deception.
rows.description_html: AlibAi is a thrilling, AI-driven murder mystery game where you, the player, take on the role of a clever imposter hidden among a group of NPCs. As suspicions rise and alibis are tested, your goal is simple but intense: deceive, mislead, and outwit the AI characters to survive. As each day unfolds, you navigate tense conversations, select night-time targets, and attempt to frame others—all while concealing your role as the true killer. Blending a murder-mystery setup with the cunning mechanics of a social deduction game, AlibAi challenges you to manipulate the story and dodge accusations. Think you're clever enough to convince AI-driven NPCs that someone else is to blame? Key Features: Unique Murder Mystery Gameplay Make strategic choices in night-time actions and morning conversations to shift suspicion onto others and avoid getting caught. Immersive AI-Driven Conversations Interact with advanced AI NPCs, each with unique personalities, alibis, and motivations, who adapt and respond based on your actions. Dynamic Social Deduction Each round, try to deduce what the other characters are thinking, manipulate their trust, and use misdirection to guide the blame away from you. Strategic Room Selection and Night-time Actions Move between rooms with intent; each night offers a new opportunity to corner a target or shift suspicion elsewhere. Narrative Twists and Unexpected AI Reactions The AI characters may have unique suspicions or even provide information that’s partially true yet damaging to your plan, keeping gameplay unpredictable. Prepare for a challenging journey as you bluff, mislead, and survive in this single-player game of deception and deduction. AlibAi combines clean, pixel art-inspired environments with a sleek UI and sound design meant to pull players into an intense atmosphere of secrecy and suspicion. Make the wrong move, and the NPCs may start to doubt you. Plan your actions wisely, and you might just walk away with the ultimate alibi.

rows.name: Lost & Found Collection
rows.short_description: Lost & Found Collection is a game where players explore diverse stories on VHS tapes, each unfolding around the same time.
rows.description_html: Lost & Found Collection is an immersive, PSX-style horror game where each VHS tape you discover unveils a unique story within the same eerie universe. Set in different but interconnected locations and timelines, each tape offers a fresh narrative and new mysteries to explore, drawing you deeper into the dark secrets of the world. Features: Multiple Stories: Every VHS tape contains a self-contained story, all within the same universe. Expanding Content: New tapes with fresh stories will be added over time, expanding the narrative. Retro PSX-Style Visuals: Experience a nostalgic, pixelated horror aesthetic. Atmospheric Gameplay: Engage in tense, story-driven gameplay, rich in mystery and suspense. Explore, uncover the truth, and dive into a chilling journey where every tape brings you closer to the heart of the mystery.

rows.name: Constantine Scores
rows.short_description: Constantine Scores is a single-player heisting Sci-fi First Person Shooter. Upgrade your arsenal to gain more abilities, weapons, and perks to keep the playing field equal. Fight against three separate factions, spanning multiple contracts, and randomized multi-day campaigns.
rows.description_html: Constantine Scores is a single-player heisting first-person shooter. Set in the Year 2375, you work as a freelance agent, handling contracts for the United Earth Federation. As a mercenary, you fight against three factions in short contracts or randomized campaigns. Sent alone you must complete the objectives given to you by the director. With a contractor to help guide you in your missions. Upgrade your arsenal to gain more abilities, weapons, and perks to keep the playing field equal. Player Customization Players can customize their agent using the credits they earn from missions. Weapons such as your primary, secondary, and melee.  Augmentations that give special perks. Armors that give different stat boots. Alternative attacks utilizing a shoulder cannon. Abilities that give passive boosts when activated. Drones that assist in combat. Operator Ranks  are a prestige system that gives rewards. Contracts Contracts are short, replayable single-day missions. Fourteen missions will be available on launch. Each contract has randomization, including layout and objective location changes. Each mission pits you against one of the three factions and can only be completed by going loud. Campaigns Campaigns are randomized multi-day contracts, utilizing solo contract missions and shuffling them to form a mini-campaign. This allows players to experience missions back-to-back in a random order that escalates from smaller missions to larger ones. On launch, you can expect to play three to five-day campaigns. Factions Constantines Empire.  Constantine was a rogue military general turned emperor. Uniting many disgruntled colonies to join the Empire, with an ambition to consolidate his power in the galaxy. Considered a main priority threat to the United Earth Federation. Orion Cartel.  An underground syndicate ruled by five families. They operate in the Constantine System. They are rapidly militarizing, and controlling the black market in the galaxy. Considered a secondary priority threat to the United Earth Federation.  Syn Corporation.  A security and research company. They provide valuable technology to Constantines Empire, in return for autonomy to work in their systems. Considered a tertiary priority threat to the United Earth Federation.

rows.name: Arctic Wolves
rows.short_description: Arctic Wolves is an open-world action game that blends the charm of wolves with high-energy combat scenarios. Customize characters and homes for a fully personalized experience, giving you ultimate freedom to shape your adventure.
rows.description_html: Arctic Wolves is an open-world action game that blends the charm of wolves with dynamic combat set in a snowy, fantasy-inspired world. As a player, you’ll explore this winter landscape, meet various characters, and uncover their unique traits. Completing quests for these characters earns you currency, which you can use to buy weapons, houses, and vehicles. With a wide variety of locations to explore, you can roam the terrain on foot, soar in a helicopter, drive an ATV, or even command a tank. Customization is central to Arctic Wolves, giving you the ability to control your character’s appearance entirely, down to specific details. You can also design custom NPCs who can join you on your journeys. For those interested, the game includes optional NSFW content, featuring explicit character customization and interactive sex scenes. Building out your personal spaces is also part of the experience; you can purchase furniture and decor to create your ideal apartment and upgrade your properties. Arctic Wolves invites players to create, explore, and battle in a unique world, where the freedom to customize and discover makes each adventure your own.

rows.short_description: DOTS Survivors is a casual action game where you play as an astronaut exploring the cosmos fending off hostile aliens along the way! As you progress through each run you can choose from a selection of futuristic weapons that can be leveled up to increase power!
rows.description_html: DOTS Survivors is a casual action game where you play as an astronaut exploring the cosmos fending off hostile aliens along the way! Create your ideal character build from two dozen unique weapons and powerups. Weapons to choose: Oxygen Hose Whip Rogue Jetpack Radioactive Waste Drops Drone Swarm Mega Laser Strike Screwdriver Shot Sawblade Scatter Satellite Dish Toss CO2 Vent Plasma Blaster Black Hole O.M.G. Wrench Upgrade your capabilities to defeat more aliens! Fight off waves of alien foes! Discover more hostile aliens! This project serves as an example of the performance and game architecture made possible by Unity's Data-Oriented Technology Stack (DOTS).

rows.name: Apricity
rows.short_description: Apricity is a top-down shooter party game for 1-4 players. 11 character classes. Arcade-style gameplay with a text-adventure driven roguelike mode and a score attack endless mode.
rows.description_html: Apricity is a top-down shooter designed to be played with friends.  Heat System When you deal damage, you build Heat, and at 100% Heat you become HOT, increasing your attack speed. After a few seconds of not dealing damage, your Heat drops to 0 almost instantly. Reloading (reloading is just the term for a special action, you can fire your primary weapon infinitely) conserves Heat and recharges your abilities, unless you are injured, in which case your Heat is expended to rapidly heal you. Importantly, enemies drop orbs on death that heal you and recharge your abilities, often forcing players into a choice: do I back off and reload, or just keep shooting and hope I can heal from the orb? Classes Apricity has 11 character classes. Each class has a different weapon, passive, and two activated abilities. Classes interact with each enemy type and item differently, and each class has a special relationship with the Heat system. Gamemodes Apricity has two gamemodes. The first is Adventure, in which players make choices in a text adventure in between combats. Winning combats equals success in the text adventure. The ultimate goal is to destroy Catrapos. The second is Endless, a simple but fun score attack mode that appeals more to singleplayer users.

rows.name: Lyra Convolution
rows.short_description: Lyra Convolution : The Future of Gaming is Here
rows.description_html: Lyra Convolution is a free UE5 game that showcases the latest and greatest features of Unreal Engine 5. It's a must-play for any gamer who wants to experience the next generation of gaming. Lyra features two exciting game modes: Elimination Mode: A team deathmatch mode where you'll battle it out against other players in a sprawling open world. Control point mode: A mode where you'll need to work together with your team to capture and hold key points on the map. No matter which game mode you choose, you'll be able to enjoy Lyra's stunning visuals, fluid gameplay, and immersive audio. Features: Unique and styled maps: Dive into the captivating world of Lyra, where a diverse array of meticulously crafted maps awaits your exploration. Each map is thoughtfully designed to cater to every player's unique style and preference, offering a rich and immersive gaming experience tailored just for you. Game currency - Lunars: Earn Lunars in Lyra by eliminating enemies, winning games, and more. Use these tokens to unlock characters and customize your gaming journey. Lyra characters: Define your in-game identity with Lyra's cosmetic characters. From sleek outfits to expressive styles, personalize your presence on the battlefield and showcase your unique gaming flair. Cross-play support: Lyra Mobile supports cross-play between mobile and PC devices. This means that you can play with your friends no matter what platform they're on. Performance scalability: Lyra, powered by Unreal Engine 5, offers seamless performance scalability on desktop and mobile devices. Experience stunning graphics with Nanite system optimization on desktop, and enjoy optimized performance on the go. Free to play: Lyra is completely free to play. Download Lyra Convolution today and experience the future of gaming!

rows.name: Slumbering Feline
rows.short_description: Slumbering Feline is a single-player, one-shot game featuring a feline-themed story. Step into the shoes of Momo, who finds herself lost in a strange dream and trying to escape from her slumber. Can Momo find her way out of this dreamscape?
rows.description_html: Slumbering Feline is a single-player, one-shot game featuring a feline-themed story. Step into the shoes of Momo, who finds herself lost in a strange dream and trying to escape from her slumber. Waking up in an unfamiliar world, Momo is equipped with the mystical gear she’s always desired. Momo will explore, battle enemies, discover weak points, find the key, and make a daring escape. Can Momo find her way out of this dreamscape? - 2D side-scrolling platformer with pixel-art and an atmospheric environment. - Unique combat system featuring Shutter Attacks and Parry Actions. - 10-25 minutes playtime. - A single objective within a large, interconnected level. - 7 enemy types, 2 weapons, plus a parry mechanic. - 4 checkpoints for respawn and progression. - Xbox controller partial support (Windows Only without Steam Input). From the Developers: Hi! This is Raditz, one of the creators behind Slumbering Feline. My team and I are thrilled to announce this new game, blending a short story collection with unique gameplay elements. In Slumbering Feline, we've introduced a scan or shutter-style combat system, where you attack enemies in a distinctive, non-traditional way. Although this is a one-shot story, we hope to continue building on its world in future installments. We’re excited to share this experience with you and bring together everything we've learned over the years. We hope you enjoy playing Slumbering Feline as much as we enjoyed creating it!

My team and I are thrilled to announce this new game, blending a short story collection with unique gameplay elements. In Slumbering Feline, we've introduced a scan or shutter-style combat system, where you attack enemies in a distinctive, non-traditional way. Although this is a one-shot story, we hope to continue building on its world in future installments. We’re excited to share this experience with you and bring together everything we've learned over the years. We hope you enjoy playing Slumbering Feline as much as we enjoyed creating it!

rows.name: Throw Home
rows.short_description: (This game was created as both a proof of concept and game design showcase) A 2D action showcase for players new to video games.
rows.description_html: (This game was created as both a proof of concept and game design showcase) Throw Home is a 2D action game designed for players new to video games. Use items in a plethora of ways and get new levels based on how you play! Throwing, spinning, jumping, almost anything ending in 'ing' (excludes fracking) can be done with items in Throw Home! With the all-new  Demand system, how you play will choose what's next. Focus on enemies and your next level is a clash in their base! But take it easy, and now you're on a date with one! If you're new to games, this is a great way to experience a variety of gameplay and figure out what fits best for you. If you're not new to games, please take 5 dollars out of the tip jar. Experience life as a toy no one wants (not even telemarketers). Defeated by his lack of market, he's been hanging in a shop display for some time, many would theorize forever. If only, only, someone out there wanted him. Alas we'll never know. Even if we could see into the future, we would be more focused on lotto numbers and loopholes in day trading. Honestly, we lost our interest in him about 8 words in. But who knows, it might take you 11!

rows.name: Magic Puzzle King 2: Rolling Cat
rows.short_description: In this free 2D puzzle game, piece together the items your feline friends have knocked off and shattered.
rows.description_html: This is a fun oddly-shaped puzzle game! And we have cute cats too! A Mischievous Cat Led Me to Develop a Relaxing Puzzle Game! 🐱✨ Speaking of inspiration for this game, I must tell you about my adorable Pipi! A white cat who's both beautiful and naughty! 🤍 Look at this cutie! Usually so peaceful and heart-melting... BUT!!! My heart skips a beat every time I see them crouching at the table edge, pawing at things! 😱 And that innocent face!! That's the expression they make after causing chaos! So annoying yet adorable!! Inspired by my daily 'torment' (just kidding) from Pipi, I developed 'Magic Puzzle King 2: Rolling Cat' 🎮 Super fun game concept: ✨ The protagonist is a mischievous cat (based on Pipi, of course!) ✨ Levels designed around cats and their furry friends ✨ Each level features items broken by our feline overlords ✨ Players solve puzzles to restore the broken items Game features: 🎯 Progressive difficulty, 15 levels from easy to challenging 🎵 Soothing music for stress relief 🌈 Fresh artistic style with adorable cats 🎮 Simple controls, fun for all ages Special highlights: 💝 Cute cats randomly appear to 'help' you solve puzzles 💝 Base game with 15 levels completely free 💝 Multiple DLCs featuring cats and their adorable friends, plus extra levels From a cat servant tortured by my feline master to a game developer - I guess this is what cat ownership leads to! 🥰

rows.name: Five Minutes Till Christmas
rows.short_description: Race against the clock in Five Minutes Till Christmas, a fast-paced holiday arcade game! Sprint through a bustling mall to gather last-minute gifts, evade vigilant security guards, and complete as many whishes before the time runs out. Perfect your strategy to top the global leaderboards!
rows.description_html: The clock is ticking, and there’s only Five Minutes Till Christmas! Step into the holiday frenzy as you race through the bustling halls of the local shopping mall, dashing to fulfill every last gift request. The stakes are high—everyone’s Christmas joy rests in your hands, and there’s no time to waste! But it won’t be easy. Security guards are on high alert, keeping an eye out for anyone moving a little too fast or getting a little too creative with their shortcuts. Every gift you grab boosts your score, but getting caught could mean missing out on the perfect Christmas for everyone on your list. You’ll need speed, wits, and a keen sense of strategy to avoid detection and make it out in time. When the five minutes are up, your performance will be scored, showing just how well you spread the holiday cheer. And with global leaderboards, you can compare your skills against others, proving who really has what it takes to make it a merry Christmas. Are you ready to beat the clock and save the holiday season?

rows.name: Cock Fight Simulator
rows.short_description: Fight as a rooster in a 3D third-person game, equipped with unique weapons in dynamic arenas.
rows.description_html: Cock Fight Simulator is an innovative multiplayer fighting game that blends action and humor, set in a 3D third-person perspective where you control chickens and cocks battling it out in dynamic arenas. Currently developed by 4 university students, our game offers an engaging 1vs1 mode across three beautifully designed maps, with six unique weapons that offer a variety of ranged and melee combat styles. Each weapon has its own distinct characteristics, providing players with multiple tactical options during matches. We'd really love to recieve feedback about bugs to solve and new ideas to implement in the game (also, a nice and active player base is a requirement to include a matchmaking system). Right now, we plan on expanding the multiplayer mode to allow more diverse lobbies, add new weapons, maps and more customization for the roosters.

rows.name: Smutstone
rows.short_description: Experience the best of both worlds: an immersive card game packed with thrilling fantasy erotica. Uncover hidden desires and secrets as you enjoy juicy maidens and advance through the story.
rows.description_html: 👑 WISHLIST NOW 👑 About the Game Be the Hero in Smutstone! Step into the seductive world of Smutstone , the thrilling card game where you’ll collect powerful cards, battle ruthless foes, and work through a fierce campaign to overthrow a wicked Sorceress and rescue enchanting characters from danger. Each victory brings tantalizing rewards, as players unlock seductive, comic-style scenes while progressing through the game. Throughout your journey, you'll strengthen and upgrade your cards to increase their power, earning saucy bonuses along the way. Fans of risqué card games will find plenty to enjoy as they gather and upgrade cards to take on powerful opponents—because only the strongest cards can prevail. After collecting the required number of specific character cards, players can even enhance those characters for added strength and unlock steamy new artwork. Battling opponents and facing off against other players in duels make for exhilarating gameplay, but the seductive cut-scenes and collection of captivating characters truly set Smutstone apart. The unique blend of strategic card battles and an endless selection of jaw-dropping characters will leave players wishing every card game could be this enticing. As long as players continue leveling up, there’s always another scene too spicy to mention here, waiting to be unlocked.

Using the power of holy light, you can convert shadow-infected enemies into allies. Try to survive until dawn! Disclaimer 'Blade of Dawn' is a demo we developed in 14 days as part of a game development event. We hope to showcase it on Steam to gather more feedback, which will be very useful for our future game development. We welcome everyone to try it out! Hack and Survive Enemies keep coming in the darkness. Slash them freely with multiple skills that let you dominate among crowds. Choose Your Upgrade Path After defeating a certain number of enemies, you'll get a chance to upgrade. You can enhance your attributes or gain new traits. Convert Your Enemies Use your ultimate skill (T) to potentially convert enemies into allies. Use this to survive in the sea of enemies! Controls Instructions Use WSAD to move, Left-click to attack, QERT to use skills.

rows.name: Tank Frenzy Survivor
rows.short_description: Jump into the cockpit of a powerful tank in this rogue-like survival game! Blast through waves of alien invaders and enemy troops, upgrade your firepower, and survive as long as you can in a relentless 2D showdown. Will your tank crush the opposition or fall to the alien onslaught?
rows.description_html: Welcome to an all-out, explosive rogue-like survival game where you pilot a tank like no other! Aliens have invaded, and enemy soldiers are gunning for you—your mission? Outlast them all! Dive into a 2D battlefield teeming with relentless waves of aliens and rival armies. As you crush your foes, earn powerful upgrades to turn your tank into an unstoppable war machine, adapting your arsenal with every run. With endless enemies, chaotic battles, and a challenge that grows as fast as you do, the question is: how long can you survive the alien onslaught? Get ready for a test of skill, strategy, and sheer firepower!

rows.name: BrahmaRakshas: Abandon Village Intro
rows.short_description: This is just the beginning. In the intro chapter, you find yourself waking up in a cursed forest, you start following strange markings, and encounter a man with glowing eyes. If you survive the night. If you do not, you will be lost to darkness. Also this is kind of demo of the game.
rows.description_html: Also this is kind of demo of the game. Game is a dark, atmospheric adventure that immerses you in a world of shadows, secrets, and choices. Blending elements of psychological horror, narrative exploration, and survival horror, Game offers immersive experiences designed to keep players on their toes from the first encounter. You'll embark on an unnerving journey of isolation, mystery, and danger. The environments are meticulously designed to tell their own story ruins, woods, forgotten landscapes marked by evidence of a strange memory or neglected whispers. Everything is atmospheric and designed to impress with curiosity and fear as you unveil pieces of the underlying hidden truth. Game is not about stupid jump scares or cheap scares. Rather, 'BrahmaRakshas Abandon Village' is about building tension through exploration, filmic experiences, and encounters that challenge your temerity. You will get to experience whether it is solving environmental puzzles, illuminating uncomfortable lore, or just existing with what lurks in darkness. Most importantly, the game values patience, observation, and gut. By EerieEchoGames

rows.name: PY-ONEERS
rows.short_description: Journey through a digital world where Python powers your progress. Solve coding puzzles, dodge obstacles, and reveal secrets in this educational platformer. Each level unlocks new skills and challenges—can you conquer the code and reach mastery?
rows.description_html: Become an Adventurer on an epic journey through a vibrant digital world, where learning Python is the key to unlocking new realms. Dodge obstacles, solve logic puzzles, and harness coding powers to outsmart enemies in this adventure-packed platformer. With every step, you will grow closer to mastering the code and unveiling the mysteries of the world. An epic journey of discovery where coding meets creativity in a single-player adventure full of humor and heart. Dive into handcrafted levels packed with Python-themed challenges, pushing your problem-solving and platforming skills to the limit. Master tricky puzzles and uncover secrets , all while learning the magic of coding in an interactive and memorable way. Meet a delightful cast of characters , each bringing their unique personality to guide and entertain you on your quest. Engaging mechanics that blend gameplay with coding , from unlocking gates to lighting torches, ensuring every challenge feels rewarding.

rows.name: MADE FOR
rows.short_description: MADE FOR is an episodic video game series where indie studio Raikori makes games for and about your favorite creators!
rows.description_html: MADE FOR is an episodic video game series where indie studio Raikori makes games for and about your favorite creators! Free to download and try - each episode is made with love and released as often as we can manage to build them! In episode one, you follow in the footsteps of legendary creator JackSucksAtLife - someone who made a career out of chasing YouTube's wildest milestone awards. Don't stop until you reach the top: thousands of dollars, dozens of awards, and millions of doting fans! Episode one takes the form of a cozy idle tycoon game: spend time in your studio, perfecting each video, and watch the numbers climb! Spend your earnings on upgrades to make your entire operation even more efficient. Rise through the ranks of fictional social media platform VideoGuy as you unlock an increasingly ridiculous number of creator awards. From the humble silver play button to the elusive ruby variant, there's a ton to strive for. Collect more than just awards: as you upload more, you'll start to achieve unprecedented stardom! Get millions of views on each video - maybe even becoming the number one VideoGuy. VideoGuy isn't ready for someone with your power. Exploit the trending tab and break the algorithm. Become so popular that even the CEO takes notice, and then break him too.

rows.name: PIO
rows.short_description: The game 'PIO' is a game created by Korean university students! Prove your strength in a world of stars and become the brightest star! In PIO, you will take on trials to prove your light and challenge yourself to become the most radiant star.
rows.description_html: * This project was created as part of the graduation work at ChungKang College of Cultural Industries Prove your abilities to the stars and become the brightest constellation! In a world of countless tiers, stars are divided into zones based on the strength of their light. The protagonist, Pio, born with a faint light, begins their journey in the lowest tier, the Graveyard of Stars, yet carries a deep longing for the upper tiers. To realize this dream, Pio takes on the Trials of the Stars , aiming to ascend to the higher realms. Game Overview Pio is a unique action platformer where players use the terrain they stand on to attack enemies. The game's standout feature is that the player's bullets also serve as terrain. The more bullets you fire, the smaller the terrain becomes, demanding precise control. On the other hand, conserving bullets means enduring the onslaught of powerful monsters. Experience this innovative action gameplay as you strategically manage your terrain and bullets to overcome challenges! Dreamlike Constellation Worldview As you continue to face challenges, a more dreamlike world of stars unfolds. Embark on a shining journey and explore a unique world! 'The Examination Hall of Stars' 'The Tomb of Stars' 'The City of Scattered Stars' 'Gort's Altar'

rows.name: Hidden Cats of Egypt
rows.short_description: Discover 100+ hidden cats in ancient Egypt's beautiful scenes. A relaxing hidden object game blending feline charm with Egyptian mystery.
rows.description_html: Hidden Cats of Egypt Embark on a mystical journey through ancient Egypt, where over 100 clever cats have concealed themselves among the pyramids, temples, and bustling bazaars. Can you spot them all? Key Features: • More than 100 uniquely hidden cats waiting to be discovered • Beautiful hand-drawn Egyptian sceneries spanning from the Nile River to ancient monuments • Relaxing soundtrack inspired by traditional Egyptian music • Perfect for short gaming sessions - find a few cats at a time, save your progress, and return later Take a break from your daily routine and immerse yourself in this charming hidden object adventure. Each cat has its own personality and hiding style, making every discovery a delightful surprise. Note: The base game includes one complete level. Additional levels are available through DLC purchase.

rows.name: The Campsite
rows.short_description: The Campsite is a short, modern point-and-click adventure that retains the spirit of classic graphic adventures. With around 60 minutes of gameplay, it’s perfect for casual players and newcomers alike, offering an accessible and enjoyable experience that’s easy to pick up and play anytime.
rows.description_html: Somewhere in the Mediterranean... An enthusiastic adventurer is about to embark on a special mission: leading a chaotic team of unruly members in the hunt for a mysterious treasure. A vibrant night in the woods awaits, unveiling a memorable adventure, but beware—the shadows conceal a watchful presence. They are not alone... A Short But Intense Graphic Adventure The Campsite is a short point-and-click adventure game, inspired by and crafted in the style of early genre classics, and adapted for a modern-day experience. If you have a passion for graphic adventures but never find the time to play, this might be exactly what you’re looking for. With about 60 minutes of gameplay, a simplified UI, and no dialogue trees, it is an excellent choice for casual players. It can be played anytime, alone or with others, and is suitable for all ages. For those new to classic point-and-click adventures, The Campsite is a great starting point. Featuring a balanced difficulty level and lighter gameplay, it offers an accessible and enjoyable experience for beginners, and hopefully, you’ll be captivated by the magic that makes this genre so special! Features Rich storytelling: Explore richly crafted characters and an intricately woven storyline, featuring a three-act structure with captivating twists. Immersive soundtrack and SFX: A wide variety of original ambience sounds and music specially composed and recorded to match every mood and scene of the game. Meticulously crafted graphics: No AI-generated or processed images. Just labor-intensive hand-drawn pixel art. Enhanced accessibility: Enjoy a more inclusive gaming experience with hotspot highlighting, adjustable subtitle speed, dialogue clues, and more. Just point and click: Experience a monkey-friendly, simplified interface—every action is only a single click away! Car interior simulator included! Likely the first and only point-and-click adventure game to feature a realistic car interior simulator of the timeless Mediterranean classic, the '600,' fully equipped with cutting-edge technology. Credits The Campsite Created by G. Espias Localization: Spanish – Guillem Espias Catalan – David Castejon Traditional Chinese – Kinugawa © 2024-2025 Guillem Espias. All rights reserved.

rows.name: The Cursed Soul
rows.short_description: A single-player horror game where you explore a haunted house, collecting items, solving puzzles, and face scares at every turn. Use your inventory to manage your items as you uncover clues to escape. Confront and defeat the monster before it traps your soul forever.
rows.description_html: You wake up on the floor of an old house, confused and not remembering how you got there. As you look for answers, you find diaries written by someone named Jack, who was once trapped in the same situation as you. They contain clues and reveal that the house belonged to Micheal, a kidnapper and murderer, whose cursed soul lures others in to keep doing his terrible acts. The diary explains that the souls of the people he killed are also cursed and trapped in the house. To free the cursed trapped souls and escape, you need to defeat Micheal's cursed soul. rows.name: Chimken
rows.short_description: Gameplay is about going thru complex levels that can include parkour, cooperation and even sometimes some puzzles you will have to go thru. The level editor has a combination of different block for aestethics, building and even logic.
rows.description_html: Chimkens is a creative and entertaining game that allows you to build your own levels using an intuitive editor and then share them with the community via Steam Workshop . With its simple building mechanics , players can easily create custom levels and share them with friends or other players online . The game features a local cooperative mode (COOP) where two players can play together on the same computer , solving challenges collaboratively. The player collision system enables fun interactions, such as climbing on each other to reach higher objects , adding a unique layer of teamwork. Additionally, the game incorporates competitive elements , ensuring both fun and challenging gameplay . Players can save, edit, and test their levels directly in the game through a user-friendly level management menu . They can also browse community-created levels , download maps , apply filters to find specific content , and play levels instantly. With Steam Workshop integration , players can effortlessly upload and share their creations , with an automated system that categorizes levels and generates preview images for each uploaded map. Whether you want to build, compete, or cooperate with friends , Chimkens offers simple yet engaging gameplay that continuously encourages players to create, explore, and enjoy user-generated content .

rows.name: Oh My Wrench
rows.short_description: Oh My Wrench is an endless driving game where you dodge obstacles and collect bonuses like extra lives, time-slowing hourglasses, and score-boosting coins. With increasing speed, dynamic weather, and a weekly global leaderboard, every run is a fresh challenge. Can you reach the top?
rows.description_html: How long can you survive the road? In Oh My Wrench , you’ll take the wheel in an endless car-driving adventure where the main goal is to survive as long as possible while dodging unpredictable obstacles. As you progress, the speed increases, pushing your reflexes to the limit. Compete for the highest score on a global leaderboard that now features both all-time and weekly rankings, giving you fresh opportunities to shine every week! To spice up the challenge, pick up bonuses along the way: grab an extra life to keep going, a time-slowing hourglass to catch your breath, or special coins to boost your score. Combined with a fast-paced day-night cycle and dynamic weather shifts, every moment feels fresh, thrilling, and filled with new surprises. Can you navigate the chaos, collect the bonuses, and claim the top spot? Find out in Oh My Wrench !

rows.name: Millivolt
rows.short_description: Millivolt is a third-person adventure puzzle game where you play as Robert Wattson, the tiny robot, navigating the mysterious inner world of a household microwave. Solve intricate puzzles and overcome mechanical obstacles to bring the appliance back to life.
rows.description_html: In Millivolt, you play as an electrical appliance repair robot named 'Robert Wattson'. You fix a microwave by entering them and solving various puzzles to put the wiring back together, replace components and avoiding obstacles. These puzzles often involve moving screws to join circuits together and activating buttons within the appliance to both traverse through the appliance and eventually fix it. Robert also faces gravity shifting in this microwave that you must traverse around whilst solving certain puzzles.

The game combines a first-person shooter with easy puzzles, as well as a scrolling shooter mode, where the player will have to fly a space plane. - Dynamic First-person Shooter with fiery Heavy Metal! - Control the cyborg Dorian, who can ram enemies with a running start and shoot ball lightning! - Various locations: Village, Snow Valley, Laboratory. - Several very strong bosses, for which you need to choose tactics, otherwise they will crush you! - Scroll shooter mode with different enemies and different types of weapons. - Interesting puzzles, however, which can be skipped if they seem too difficult for you.

rows.name: SpeedRacer
rows.short_description: Control a continuously accelerating spaceship, dodging and blasting obstacles to the beat of an adrenaline-pumping soundtrack.
rows.description_html: You have to survive 3 minutes and 40 seconds to beat the game. Pilot a continuously accelerating spaceship through a neon obstacle course to the beat of an electrifying synthwave soundtrack. Your only controls are left and right. Crashing in an obstacle is an instant game over, so collect ammo on your way to clear your path, but remember, unused ammo boosts your final score. Save your score online and compete for the top spot on the global leaderboard with your best runs. Controls (qwerty): Move left and right : [arrows keys] or [A and D]. Firing lasers to shoot obstacles : [up arrow] or [W] or [space]. Good luck.

rows.name: Aliya's Awakening: DOGE 2042
rows.short_description: Aliya's Awakening: DOGE 2042 is a narrative-driven interactive cyberpunk adventure game with secrets, survival, and justice. Experience a deep, and personal story of Aliya, and with her point of view, explore the dystopian cyberpunk world through fun and immersive gameplay.
rows.description_html: Aliya’s Awakening: DOGE 2042 Welcome to the world of  Aliya’s Awakening: DOGE 2042 , a narrative-driven interactive cyberpunk adventure game. In a world where government has become the most influential megacorporation, information and privacy are the most valuable currency. Advanced surveillance, AI security, and ruthless corporations dominate every aspect of society, controlling what people see, hear, and believe. Meet the Protagonist: Aliya Aliya is a cybersecurity analyst working for Cascadia , a multi-trillion dollar megacorporation, striving to secure a better future for her family. After meeting Lua, her Shiba Inu best friend, he became her world, driving her to work harder, take on more responsibilities, and ensure he had the best care possible. One day while alone working, her office was raided. Everything she has and has worked for was taken away in an instant. Imprisoned and accused of a crime she didn't commit, Aliya must find the truth before it’s too late. A Deeply Personal and Dynamic Story Dystopian Future - Enter a world controlled by megacorporations and surveillance, where trust is a luxury. Interactive Cyberpunk World - Explore sprawling cityscapes, high-security prisons, and corporate offices, uncovering corruption hidden beneath the neon lights. Inspired by a True Story -  Dive into a story of friendship, loss, resilience, and the struggle for truth where the lines between truth and lies are blurred. Unique Gameplay Mechanics Zoom & Enhance - commandeer cutting-edge surveillance drones to perform unique in-game mechanics to zoom into buildings and utilize advanced AI to enhance and reconstruct crime scenes. Remote Hack  - Take up your own investigation. Uncover clues and mysteries as you become your own detective to prove your innocence. Full-Featured Computers Check emails, read messages, browse files, and uncover secrets. Investigate encrypted data, crack hidden codes, and make difficult decisions that will shape Aliya’s fate. Alternate-Reality Search for hidden websites, encrypted messages, and secret files that connect the game’s mystery to the real world. Solve ARG challenges to unlock additional in-game content, lore, and hidden paths in the story. A world that hides the truth is a world waiting to be hacked. Will you take control, or become just another victim of the system?
rows.about_html: Aliya’s Awakening: DOGE 2042 Welcome to the world of  Aliya’s Awakening: DOGE 2042 , a narrative-driven interactive cyberpunk adventure game. In a world where government has become the most influential megacorporation, information and privacy are the most valuable currency. Advanced surveillance, AI security, and ruthless corporations dominate every aspect of society, controlling what people see, hear, and believe. Meet the Protagonist: Aliya Aliya is a cybersecurity analyst working for Cascadia , a multi-trillion dollar megacorporation, striving to secure a better future for her family. After meeting Lua, her Shiba Inu best friend, he became her world, driving her to work harder, take on more responsibilities, and ensure he had the best care possible. One day while alone working, her office was raided. Everything she has and has worked for was taken away in an instant. Imprisoned and accused of a crime she didn't commit, Aliya must find the truth before it’s too late. A Deeply Personal and Dynamic Story Dystopian Future - Enter a world controlled by megacorporations and surveillance, where trust is a luxury. Interactive Cyberpunk World - Explore sprawling cityscapes, high-security prisons, and corporate offices, uncovering corruption hidden beneath the neon lights. Inspired by a True Story -  Dive into a story of friendship, loss, resilience, and the struggle for truth where the lines between truth and lies are blurred. Unique Gameplay Mechanics Zoom & Enhance - commandeer cutting-edge surveillance drones to perform unique in-game mechanics to zoom into buildings and utilize advanced AI to enhance and reconstruct crime scenes. Remote Hack  - Take up your own investigation. Uncover clues and mysteries as you become your own detective to prove your innocence. Full-Featured Computers Check emails, read messages, browse files, and uncover secrets. Investigate encrypted data, crack hidden codes, and make difficult decisions that will shape Aliya’s fate. Alternate-Reality Search for hidden websites, encrypted messages, and secret files that connect the game’s mystery to the real world. Solve ARG challenges to unlock additional in-game content, lore, and hidden paths in the story. A world that hides the truth is a world waiting to be hacked. Will you take control, or become just another victim of the system?

rows.name: Green Thing From The Planet Jupiter
rows.short_description: Take on the roles of Cannoli, a crafty housecat, and Green Thing, a stranded alien engineer. As Green Thing, scavenge the house for parts to repair your UFO, or stop Green Thing from doing so as Cannoli!
rows.description_html: Green Thing from the Planet Jupiter is a fast-paced two-player competitive chase game where players take on the roles of Cannoli, a crafty housecat, and Green Thing, a stranded alien engineer. Cartoonish chaos meets strategic gameplay as Green Thing scavenges parts from around the house to repair his UFO while avoiding Cannoli and his traps. Collect all the parts as Green Thing, or stop him as Cannoli before his owner Zia Nina gets back home! Green Thing must rummage through Zia Nina's house to find parts to repair his UFO. He wields his Jupiterian gun, which can stun, smoke out, and distract Cannoli as he explores the house. Cannoli must stop Green Thing at all costs, before Zia Nina grounds him. He has access to a 'CAT-ALOGUE', where he can select and place ACME traps throughout the level, like a glue trap, anvil, and box of TNT.

You need at least 1 minute of ingame playtime to earn the drop. For that to happen you need to restart the game since it's being checked every game start.) rows.name: BA: The City Within
rows.short_description: Experience a devastated Seoul, locked down after war and biochemical attacks. Craft cocktails from discarded food and alcohol to serve guests, earning their trust to uncover hidden stories. Explore abandoned subway lines modeled on the real Seoul system in this story-driven puzzle adventure.
rows.description_html: Development of this game has been aborted. No updates will be provided except for significant bug fixes. In May 2032, the Government of the Republic of Korea declared a lockdown on the City of Seoul. Seoul was devastated and sealed off in the aftermath of war and biochemical attacks. Many survivors still live in this abandoned former capital city, unable to escape, exhausting their lives for the rest of their lives. Among these miserable Seoulites are ‘Leech’, the lonely survivor, who strives day-to-day by scavenging abandoned city facilities and ripping off other bandits, and ‘Master’, the cocktail geek who modified an abandoned subway train to run a cocktail bar. Witness the butterfly effect of the influence of two people throughout Seoul, starting from the unexpected moment when the two characters' paths intersect. Combine discarded groceries and alcohol to make cocktails and serve them to guests. Combine ingredients' six flavor elements and personalities to create a cocktail with harmonious and appealing tastes. Guess customers’ taste in drinks and win their trust to uncover the hidden stories of this city and its people. Explore Seoul's abandoned subway facilities and witness new stories. Explore abandoned subway facilities, find new materials, and encounter special characters. Get rid of obstacles on subway rail and move on, defeating road robbers and hostile forces. All the stages, including tunnels and history, are designed based on real Seoul subway lines. Find out the answer that a human must present against the great absurdness built by war and lockdown. Survivors of Seoul, in an instant, went from the capital residents of the world's 10th most developed country to tramping daily life under threat of death. But what motive or desire still drives them to live on? Will ‘Leech' be able to find the answer to this question after following each customer's story?

Play online with your friends.

rows.name: Starboard
rows.short_description: Become Cillian Cade, a pirate thief who’s in over his head after a heist gone wrong. After stealing a magical gauntlet possessed by the spirit of a pirate lord, the duo set out to find an ancient vault. Outwit and outplay the crew of a malicious pirate captain who wants the treasure all for himself.
rows.description_html: Starboard is a first-person, action/adventure game filled with nail-biting fights, daring escapes, and stylish parkour. Use a magic tether to swing and launch yourself through space like an acrobat or throw enemies and objects to turn the tide in battle. Wall-run, slide, and leap to elude foes, and bust out your trusty sword to attack head-on.

rows.name: TOY BOX
rows.short_description: A pull-apart puzzle visual novel whose fragments stitch the story together.
rows.description_html: Greetings to our newest toy inspector!     Today is your first day of work here at Toy Maker’s TOY BOX. At the end of their shelf life, it’s up to clever inspectors like you to decide which of the Maker’s creations are worth salvaging.       Pull apart stitches or rip off an arm or two; we support whatever you must do to ensure that you only save toys of the highest quality. Should you ever feel unsure, there’s no need to panic! Simply toss the trash where it belongs: the incinerator. After all, it’s of the utmost importance that inspectors upkeep the Maker’s image.      We look forward to your hard work here at the TOY BOX and congratulations – only the most special candidates have the honor of inspecting on behalf of the Maker! 🧸 GAME FEATURES 🧸 Inspect up to 5 loveable toys!  Unlock 3 totally not terrifying endings!  Haunting visuals AND 5+ CGs (there are toes...not CG related.)  Eerily beautiful soundtrack!  What we hope is a good time!  Estimated playtime: 1.5 - 2 hours

rows.description_html: Set in a universe where gemstones are abundant... but fauna and flora are scarce. A robot is sent to a newly found underwater cave to discover the fish and plants that inhabit the area. Sunken driftwood logs containing a fungus, rest on the beds of the cave. This special fungus with unique properties will be key to complete the mission. SOLO DEVELOPED FREE-TO-PLAY Key Features Discover and collect fish and plants A colourful environment to explore Simple and easy to play Relax... enjoy the underwater vibe NOTES: This game is short and does not have a save progression feature. Depending on playstyle, it may take up to one hour to complete. The full screen water motion effect can be toggled on/off in game for those who are sensitive to such effects.
