rows.name: Second Works
rows.short_description: 『Second Works』 is a 2D platform action-adventure game set in a sci-fi fantasy world based on biotechnology. Enjoy the unique atmosphere created by colorful anime-style graphics and the thrilling experience of high-difficulty action.
rows.description_html: 『Second Works』 is a 2D platform action-adventure game set in a sci-fi fantasy world based on biotechnology. Players explore a vast world filled with diverse environments such as giant laboratories, toxic forests, and ancient cities, uncovering the secrets of a chaotic world. Enjoy the unique atmosphere created by colorful anime-style graphics and the thrilling experience of high-difficulty action. Story The new research project 'Second Works', which was supposed to bring hope, has created the energies of 'Order' and 'Chaos' that now envelop the world, and a new life form called the 'Fusion' through the fusion experiments. Humanity, having acquired great power, seemed to be on the brink of realizing a peaceful and higher-order world balanced between Order and Chaos. However, the energy of Chaos went out of control, and the world descended into madness due to mutated humans, remaining unchanged for many years. Now, with the awakening of a newly created Fusion girl named 'Zero', something is about to change......... Game Features Players explore a vast map, engage in conversations with various characters, and collect items while challenging numerous stages scattered across the world. Throughout their journey, they will face impenetrable barriers and powerful bosses. As they explore, they will unlock 'Souls' that grant additional effects, 'Elixirs' usable within stages, and unique playable characters, broadening their strategic options. Experience the satisfaction of overcoming trials and breaking through with your own hands.

rows.name: AGoodField
rows.short_description: First of all, the game has level play, players need to start from level 1, by doing tasks, after completing the task to move up to the next level, directly to the full level. Then there's construction, agriculture, industry, military.
rows.description_html: A Good Field 'is a strategy simulation and construction game with rich gameplay, which combines various gameplay such as strategy battles, city construction, and leisure competitions. Multiple national camps are waiting for you to join, freely develop and build your city, and fight in all directions at any time. As the decision maker of the empire, you lead your subjects in the footsteps of faith to achieve immortal dominance. Firstly, the game has a level based gameplay, where players need to start from level 1 and complete tasks before advancing to the next level, until reaching full level. Secondly, there is Construction, players can choose to build buildings that have already been developed and constructed, and the construction conditions may require the consumption of some resources to build. In agriculture, players can cultivate rice, wheat, flax, mulberry leaves, tree paint, and other crops to obtain food and raw materials. Industry, players can build industrial buildings, which can produce daily necessities such as porcelain, lacquerware, copperware, textiles, paper, jade, etc. Military, players can train soldiers of various branches of the army, plunder player resources, and attack other cities on the world map through gameplay.

rows.name: Terram Reduc Protocol
rows.short_description: This 2.5d platformer blends the nostalgia of 90s shooters with modern gameplay mechanics and graphic design. Move using the keyboard, aim and fire with the mouse, kill everything that crawls of flies, get through mazes full of deadly traps, survive battles with robotic bosses and save the Earth.
rows.description_html: Set off on a mission beneath the occupied Earth. Battle through alien-infested tunnels, ancient vaults, and vast underground caverns — each step bringing humanity one step closer to freedom. Terram Reduc Protocol challenges you to fight, run, and survive across 17 levels and 5 bonus stages, combining tight platforming with fast-paced combat. Developed as a solo project under the name Horizont Games, this game is an homage to the classic platformers I grew up playing. Global Leaderboard See how you rank among other players worldwide in the TRP Global Leaderboard Scores update live as players complete levels. Your objective: Collect symbol-coded keys, unlock barriers, and uncover the heart of the alien network. Every second counts — every kill matters — and every run pushes you higher on the global leaderboard . Key Features: Simple Controls : Run and jump with the keyboard, aim and shoot with the mouse—intuitive controls that keep you focused on the action. System of Keys: Find the right keys to let you proceed in the levels. Power-Ups & Energy Infusions : Discover boosts and new weapons to enhance your abilities and overpower enemies. Epic Boss Battle : Confront massive alien commander that demand skill, timing, and sharp thinking to defeat. Prepare to reclaim Earth, one battle at a time.

Your objective: Collect symbol-coded keys, unlock barriers, and uncover the heart of the alien network. Every second counts — every kill matters — and every run pushes you higher on the global leaderboard . Key Features: Simple Controls : Run and jump with the keyboard, aim and shoot with the mouse—intuitive controls that keep you focused on the action. System of Keys: Find the right keys to let you proceed in the levels. Power-Ups & Energy Infusions : Discover boosts and new weapons to enhance your abilities and overpower enemies. Epic Boss Battle : Confront massive alien commander that demand skill, timing, and sharp thinking to defeat. Prepare to reclaim Earth, one battle at a time.

rows.short_description: Mall Manager Simulator: Prologue is a limited version of the full game to start running your local Mall now. Wishlist the full version to play the complete Mall Manager Simulator game. Design, build, and manage your own shopping center, where every decision you make impacts your success!
rows.description_html: Mall Manager Simulator: Prologue is a limited version of the full game to start running your local Mall now. Wishlist the full version to play the complete Mall Manager Simulator game. Step into the world of shopping and experience what it’s like to manage a real shopping mall! Mall Manager Simulator: Prologue gives you a chance to dive into the excitement of becoming a master of management. Design, build, and manage your own shopping center, where every decision you make impacts your success! Key Features: Complete control in one place : Manage all aspects of the mall through a convenient tablet interface, allowing you to track revenues, expenses, and handle essential tasks in real-time. Start with a single store and grow : At the beginning, you'll manage a simple store, but every well-placed product and carefully set price will help you reach the next level. Respond to customer demands : Watch how customers react to your prices – if they’re too high, they’ll let you know! Find the right balance between profit and customer satisfaction. Do you have what it takes to manage a shopping mall empire? Download the prologue now and begin your journey to becoming the best mall manager!

rows.name: Letters from the War
rows.short_description: Modern reimagining of text adventure games with a new gameplay and multiple endings. Censor letters coming from soldiers at the front and make the history of your nation.
rows.description_html: OVERVIEW Letters from the War is a modern reimagining of text adventure games with a new gameplay based on postal censorship during Second World War. You will take the role of a newly hired employ of the Censorship Authority, where your actions will impact on the future of your nation. GAMEPLAY Censor letters coming from soldiers at the front trying to understand what you need to do not to be fired. Censoring critical information you will get commendations from your boss, but the citizens who youl receive the letters will not understand their content. Leaving the information readable you will risk to be fired in order to let the people know what is really happening. What will you do? Will you find the correct balance? STORY The game takes place in Vitulia, a fictional country involved in Second World War. An authoritarian regime rules in Vitualia, which controls the masses thanks to its supervision on public information. Will you change that? ART Experience a well-finished pixel art and an original soundtrack that will immerse you in the atmosphere of those years. Newspaper, letters and country spots were created, along with the music pieces, taking inspiration from first half of last century sources, but redesigned to enhance player experience.

rows.name: Hock
rows.short_description: Hock is a class-based top down hockey game. Select your car from a roster of over 20 classes and use its unique abilities to gain the upper hand against your opponent. Each specific matchup brings a whole new set of challenges to the table making Hock easy to learn but hard to master.
rows.description_html: Choose from over 20 classes to push, pull, grab, shoot, shove, slice, and explode your way to victory. Use the classes' unique abilities and nuances to control the puck and dominate your opponent. The Gunner Although the Gunner has below average speed and power, it uses its bullet to supplement its mobility and force. With the lowest ability cool-down in the game it is able to use its bullet for a wide range of applications, like using the recoil for speed, shooting the other car to disrupt its movement, or just shooting the puck for a shot on goal. The Pillbug The Pillbug is the mascot of Hock. It makes up for its lack of an ability with its excellent power and shape. The Pillbug is able to power through just about every class and can use its rounded shape to hit extremely precise shots with the right player behind the controls. The Blimp The Blimp is an extremely light and floaty class that can drop a massive wall into the arena. Since the blimp struggles to push or block classes on its own, it deploys its wall to help out. The usage of the wall greatly depends on the type of Blimp player. Many Blimp players opt for a more defensive strategy, using the wall to block any openings, while many others use it offensively, hurling it at their opponent and the puck like a projectile. Overall, the gameplay and strategy of Hock greatly is decided by the player! With the wide range of classes and play styles, there is something for every type of person in Hock. What will you play?

rows.name: FIND ALL: Christmas
rows.short_description: What's that ringing filled the air? A wonder is coming! Santa has once again received many letters of wishes. The production conveyor have started! The Christmas season is upon us! Find 150 different items to give presents to everyone!
rows.description_html: Santa hastened to get to work, and his faithful assistants, the cat-elves, are already launching production lines to give everyone Christmas gifts as soon as possible! You have a unique opportunity to visit the production of Santa Claus himself and check how things are going with the preparations for Christmas. The area is vast, so you need to take a good look around! Your trip starts at the Polar Express station, and from there you can: - Walk through the dorm of the Cat Elves and explore their everyday life - Watch every stage of gift making at the magic factory. - Play with reindeer. - And of course, visit the pearl of the North Pole - Santa's residence! So, what are you waiting for? Hurry on a search for 150 cleverly hidden items throughout the area so that the black and white picture comes to life and no one is left without a gift! Game Features: 150 hidden items There is a hint The map is colorable 2.5D effect Customize brightness Saving progress Scaling Relaxing music Christmas mood

rows.name: Scauage
rows.short_description: Scauage is a short horror experience where you play as a scavenger looting an abandoned house, uncovering its dark secrets and collecting hidden treasures while facing what lurks within.
rows.description_html: You take on the role of a scavenger, searching for valuables in the ruins of an abandoned town. Entering a house to loot, you quickly realize you've stepped into a nightmare about to unfold. FEATURES A unique short horror journey driven by an unnerving sense of paranoia and claustrophobia. Multiple endings based on the decisions made throughout the game. Realistic movement/flashlight mechanics that offer complete immersion. Unconventional puzzles that require thinking outside the box. Atmospheric 3D sounds, enhancing the experience and instilling dread.  PS1/PSX retro era pixelated aesthetics, supporting the feeling of 1960s America. STORY The town of Prefield was once a bustling hub, built to support the nearby mines and the promise of rich mineral resources. Over time, though, the mines ran dry, and the town began to fade. Families left in search of better opportunities, leading to a slow socioeconomic decline. What was once a lively community turned into a ghost town, notorious for marauders and scavengers who now roamed the area in search of a fortune. Prefield became a place where few dared to stay, except for those who had nowhere else to go — squatters and the homeless found shelter in the abandoned houses. You take on the role of a scavenger, looking for valuable items hidden away in the remnants of Prefield. One building stands out to you: an old two-story country house that seems to hold something worthwhile. You decide to explore and see whether there is anything of value that you can take for yourself.

rows.name: RenewEd3D
rows.short_description: 3D Digital Game-Based Learning.
rows.description_html: RenewEd3D is an interactive software designed to enhance Renewable Energy Education (REE) through Non-Immersive Virtual Reality. It integrates images, text explanations, voice narration, animations, and quizzes to facilitate learning. The software is bilingual, offering narration in both English and Malay to assist students, especially in pronunciation of scientific terms. Students explore the content, engaging with different modules and answering quizzes at the end of each session. Its goal is to raise awareness of renewable energy in an engaging and immersive way. The gameplay in RenewEd3D  revolves around an exploration of renewable energy concepts through a series of themed levels. Here's a breakdown of how the gameplay is structured: 1. Level Exploration: Students navigate through different levels, each designed to present a new aspect of renewable energy education. The levels are structured to encourage active learning and exploration: Level 1: The Beginning Level 2: Energy Crisis Level 3: Inspiration Level 4: Exploration Level 5: New Hope 2. Interaction and Learning: Virtual Interactions : Students explore various renewable energy systems (such as wind, solar, hydro, etc.) in virtual environments. These environments are designed to mimic real-world scenarios, allowing players to interact with energy systems, solve energy-related challenges, and make decisions that affect the outcome of their virtual energy projects. Quizzes and Challenges : At the end of each level, students face a quiz or challenge that tests their understanding of the concepts covered. The quizzes are integrated into the gameplay, ensuring that students apply what they’ve learned and reinforce key concepts through interactive feedback. Rewards and Progression : As players complete quizzes and challenges, they earn points or rewards, unlocking new levels and gaining access to more complex content. 3. Mode Selection (Individual vs. Group Mode): Individual Mode : In this mode, each player works independently to explore the content, complete challenges, and track their own progress. Scores and certificates are generated based on individual performance. Group Mode : In Group Mode, players can collaborate with others, working as a team to solve challenges, explore energy systems, and discuss concepts together. The group mode tracks the collective performance of the group, fostering teamwork and cooperation. 4. Feedback and Certificates: Instant Feedback : Players receive instant feedback on their quiz answers and performance during challenges, helping them to understand where they may need improvement. Certificates : After completing the levels and achieving certain milestones, students are awarded certificates to recognize their learning achievements. Overall, RenewEd3D  combines interactive, educational gameplay with immersive virtual environments to engage students in renewable energy education, encouraging both individual and collaborative learning experiences.

rows.name: Magic Inn: Prologue
rows.short_description: Reclaim glory in Magic Inn, a charming tavern life simulator. Take on the role of an exiled wizard-turned-innkeeper, overseeing everything from menus, rooms, guests, and staff in a fully magical customizable inn. Engage in card battles to spark conversations and foster relationships with guests.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Magic Inn Imagine Fae Farm's magic combined with Travellers Rest's cozy simulation. Build and customize your dream tavern, managing menus, staff, and rooms. Use Potionomics -inspired card battles to connect with guests and build meaningful relationships on your journey. The prologue is free and includes a part of the main character’s story, which takes place in one of the three kingdoms, Kingdom Crop. Uncover the truth behind the tragedy that befell your family, reclaim the reputation of the wizarding community and rescue the princess in order to return to the Magic Castle. Key Features: Embark on a journey about tragedy and redemption, all starting with a magical humble inn. Manage the menus, staff, and rooms of your completely customizable inn. Learn and harness magic spells in order to help with inn management. Engage in conversation-driving card battles which simulate actions such as negotiation, persuasion, and attraction. Build relationships with guests and members of the inn’s staff. Collect magical creatures and items as you journey through this enchanted universe.

rows.name: After Mankind: TD
rows.short_description: A sci-fi Tower Defense game where you build your own towers by combining different modules to create unique structures. The damage system and unique enemies will force you to choose weapons for each threat separately. Study the glossary to learn more about each enemy.
rows.description_html: After Mankind: TD brings a new level of strategy to the Tower Defense genre. Usually, you build solid towers along the way to impede enemy movement, but what if you assembled towers from individual parts? Research technologies, unlock modules, and assemble unique towers! Control the battlefield Use gates to block the path and force enemies to take a different route. Reroute bridges so that enemies cannot use a shorter route. Manage the battlefield to control the movement of enemy vehicles according to your tactics! Unique opponents Study your enemies in a separate “Glossary” section - each of them has its own characteristics and vulnerabilities. Select modules for your towers according to the weaknesses of your opponents and avoid ineffective weapons.

rows.name: Dreamship Sugarcube
rows.short_description: Still confused and checking the fuel gauge mid-flight? Struggling to find the target when flying under a planet? Sorry, its all on the author! Due to low player numbers and the my internships, theres been no game update. If you enjoy it and have ideas for improvement, leave a comment or email us.
rows.description_html: It turned out to be just a dream. This is a gamejam work developed by a team of four people within ten days. It is a third-person 3D space adventure game. The theme of the game development is 'dreams', so the game's background is set in a space adventure within a dream. Its core gameplay involves simulating jumping and flying under the gravitational force of planets. However, please note that all of this is just a child's dream, so the gravitational simulation is not rigorous. It is simply achieved by interpolating the direction of gravity towards the center of the planet closest to the player and updating the gravitational scalar. As a result, there may be situations where a small planet has a stronger attracting ability than a larger planet with a greater radius. The game includes seven playable levels. Although the difficulty has been adjusted and there are players who can operate smoothly on their first playthrough, for players who are proficient in operating the game, the difficulty may already be quite low. However, some players still find it difficult to get started and may get stuck in the first three levels. This is a problem caused by the author's lack of experience in game design, and we apologize for that. Please pay attention to the tutorial text in the first level and the golden landmark hints within the levels.

rows.name: Maximum Chaser : 1001 Squad
rows.short_description: It is a universe similar to ours, where humans are technologically advanced but also full of evil. You will play as 2 member of the street organization 'Maximum Chaser' and confront an evil security company A.A.S.S., making them scream under your gunfire.
rows.description_html: This game is based on a Flash game: Hostility Ultimate Force(UF)2 : 2112 Cooperation - Original Producer of the series: 3DBBQ ———————————————————————————————————————— The story takes place in a universe similar to ours, where the human beings on Earth have made great technological leaps and are about to reach 'stellar civilization', and interstellar travel with neighboring planets is no longer a difficult task. But the Earth is in a serious energy catastrophe, with uneven energy distribution and growing disparity between the rich and the poor. In the past, there was a powerful heroic organization that maintained peace on Earth, but after a fierce battle with a huge evil biological research institute, both disappeared. But new evil forces are emerging in an endless stream, and small street organizations are beginning to emerge around the world at this time, contributing their own meager strength to continue the hero's duty. 'Maximum Chaser' is one of them. You will play two members of the 'Maximum Chaser': Kai (Member Num: 10) and Lily (Member Num: 01), and fight against an evil security company A.A.S.S. . The game is designed for single-player play, which means you need to control the characters on both screens at the same time. As the game progresses, the shooting method will also change. At this time, you will need to judge which side of the screen you should focus more on. Don't worry, it won't be difficult. Of course, you can also take on two-player challenges with your friends. This game does not support remote network connection, so you can only work together locally with your friends sitting in front of the same computer.

rows.name: Whisperstring
rows.short_description: Whisperstring is an 80s inspired text adventure game that takes place inside a “chat room”. You’re connected to Adam, a 'jock' with a severe fear of strings, who seems to have been the victim of a supernatural kidnapping. Will you be able to help him escape?
rows.description_html: Whisperstring is an 80s inspired text adventure game that takes place inside a “chat room”. You’re connected to Adam, a 'jock' with a severe fear of strings, who seems to have been the victim of a supernatural kidnapping. Will you be able to help him escape? Whisperstring was a chat program developed by &&&$$$SSS66 (pronounced “And-Es-Six”) and released in the late 1980s. While it never gained the popularity of its IRC-based counterparts, it did have a small community of enthusiasts. Instead of focusing on chat rooms, it connected two random strangers who could chat one-on-one. While the mentioned enthusiasts are by now mostly non-existent, our team has decided to preserve the software and make it compatible with modern computers. Feel free to give it a try, and maybe you’ll soon join us as part of the (hopefully) growing team of Whisperstring enthusiasts! To quote the wise words of &&&$$$SSS66: “Don't forget that you'll be talking to a real person. Don't be a dick. [...] Have fun!” You can listen to and download the soundtrack for free on bandcamp. Features: Command line processing : Interact with the game world by typing text commands. Puzzles : Explore Adam's 'prison', use items, and decipher clues to progress through the story. Player agency : Different text prompts allow you to infuse the main character with your own personality.

rows.name: Mega Pirate Pandemonium
rows.short_description: Test your skills and master new strategies to defend your pirate ship while building your crew. Customize your character with 38,416 unique combinations. Compete for the fastest time on the global leaderboard to become the Pirate King. Be prepared as the screen fills with mayhem and intensity!
rows.description_html: Mega Pirate Pandemonium is a fast-paced strategy defense game where you must recruit a pirate crew and defend your ship from relentless enemy attacks. Strategize and adapt to gather resources, build your crew, and fend off enemies—all as you aim to achieve the fastest completion time. Compete against players worldwide on the global leaderboard  and prove you’re the most notorious pirate of all!

rows.name: GIRLS' FRONTLINE 2: EXILIUM
rows.short_description: Continuing the legacy of the Girls' Frontline world, this all-new adventure casts you as the Commander, challenging you to lead your squad of Tactical Dolls deep into perilous contamination zones and overcome enemies with tactical prowess.
rows.description_html: The end of an era, the dawn of another; the fall of a faction, the rise of another... The torchbearers shall shine upon the brave new world. After severing ties with G&K, the Commander bid farewell to the past and chose to venture into the contamination zones. During their journey, the Commander encountered more and more individuals and Tactical Dolls. Each with their own unique stories, they became indispensable members of the Commander's team. The Commander, who only sought to complete bounty missions smoothly and earn a stable income, was unexpectedly ambushed during what appeared to be a routine transport mission. Far from the bustling vortex, it became clear that the Commander had been drawn into an even larger maelstrom... Girls' Frontline 2: Exilium is a 3D strategy RPG for both PC and Mobile. In this game, you will fully experience: [Covenant Ring: Forge Unbreakable Bonds with Your Dolls] Inscribe your Covenant and unlock exclusive archives, memories, and voice lines for your Dolls. Affinity can be deepened through gift-giving. A Covenant with your Dolls can be formed at a certain Affinity level, which unlocks an exclusive Covenant Projection. [Realistic Weapon System, Free-Form Weapon Customization] Handguns, machine guns, shotguns—every type of weapon is available with a 360° preview. Freely attach weapon accessories to create a unique appearance for your weapons. Equip your team with the finest weapons to face the toughest enemies. [Immersive Animations, 360° Character Interaction] Featuring high-quality character models with rich interactive features. In the Refitting Room, you can freely interact with the Dolls. In the Dormitory, you can use the dynamic camera to capture their day-to-day moments, and enjoy a unique, cozy experience. [3D Immersive Combat, Multidimensional Strategy] Stages are enriched with dynamic elements, including various cover options, mechanisms, and terrains. Analyze the combat situation and strategically lead your Dolls to victory.

rows.name: Bullet Hell Game Anthology
rows.short_description: Great news for Bullet Hell fans! We’ve prepared an anthology of games in your favourite genre from various indie developers! Try out free demo versions of projects that have just recently been released or will be out in the near future!
rows.description_html: Great news for Bullet Hell fans! We’ve prepared an anthology of games in your favourite genre from various indie developers! Try out free demo versions of projects that have just recently been released or will be out in the near future! Kickback is a top-down shooter with roguelike elements, where shooting is the only way to move. Repel waves of mutants, create combinations of weapons and upgrades to survive at all costs on your own or with a friend in a local co-op mode. Hotloop - Use the force of gravity in a fast-paced space shooter with realistic physics and orbital mechanics. Westild's Law - Journey to the heart of the Wild West in this thrilling pixelated 2D shooter and challenge the gang of Wild Joe to free your hometown from their iron grip! Castle Break - Breakout game + physics + shooting + building. Use your mouse like in air hockey to kick enemy bombs back into the evil Black Castle! Destroy enemy towers rockets and lasers. Build your base to protect your little dudes - you need them to win BOUNCE GUN is a challenging arcade roguelike shooter with a huge number of item combinations, unconventional controls and an unusual approach to difficulty progression.

rows.name: Strange New Tides
rows.short_description: Explore: Wander around Saltbay Cove and develop relationships with kooky and tasty-looking villagers. Earn Money: Fish, Gamble and collect geodes daily in order to earn your keep. Upgrade: Build your sandcastle kingdom from a humble trash-can-sized home.
rows.description_html: Strange New Tides is a quirky social sim game in which you’ll explore multiple areas of a town, collect geodes, gamble at a slot machine and play a fishing mini-game to earn sea glass to pay off your debt and upgrade your humble sandlot home into a true sandcastle. For lovers of games like Animal Crossing, Strange New Tides offers a heartwarming story with two endings, memorable characters to fall in love with, addictive mini-games and personal expression through home building!

rows.name: Bone To Gather
rows.short_description: 'Bone To Gather' is a synergy-building action roguelike. Embark on an epic journey with a team of puny skeletons determined to revenge the Demon King. Recruit skeletons with unique synergies to create a powerful team and battle through monsters on your way to the final showdown.
rows.description_html: The skeletons were bullied by the Demon King and other monsters for their weakness and were ultimately cast out from the Demon King's castle. Show that even seemingly insignificant, puny skeletons can rise to become the strongest and prove everyone wrong! Variety of Unique Skeletons The skeletons come from various backgrounds and have different roles. Meet a popstar from the slums, a clown from a pirate crew, and a cleaner from a magic academy who have gathered from all over the land to reclaim the pride of skeletons. Building Synergies Placing skeletons from the same background or with the same role on the battlefield will grant special effects to your team. There are hundreds of possible combinations and matchups. Find the best synergies to build the strongest team! Bone-gathering Action Put your team’s power to the test on the battlefield! But watch out - skeletons will immediately shatter if they take even a SINGLE hit. Don’t worry, skeletons never die. You can bring them back to life by collecting their scattered bones. Hurry to gather those bones before your entire team breaks apart! Various Events Encounter a variety of events between boss battles. Enhance your deck with the rewards you earn from these events! Who awaits at the end of this journey? Can the skeletons avenge their enemies and prove their true might?

rows.name: Big Blind
rows.short_description: Where Sound Becomes Sight, Style Meets Violence. Step into the world of darkness as a blind protagonist who sees through sound in this stylish 2D top-down shooter where every kill matters and style is everything.

Are you ready to see through sound?

rows.name: InKing
rows.short_description: is a fast-paced 2D top-down action game. Players take on the role of an ink bottle warrior on a journey to become the king of tools. Use your fast attacks, moves, and powerful skills to defeat the tools that stand in your way, prove that ink and pen are the best tools, and become the King of Tools.
rows.description_html: InKing is an fast-paced ink action rogue-lite . Scatter and absorb the ink to win the crown. The Journey of the Ink Warrior As an Ink Warrior , embark on a journey to become the king of tools. Use your fast attacks, moves, and powerful skills to defeat the tools that stand in your way and prove that ink and pen are the best tools! Absorb Ink! Utilize the ink splashes to unleash powerful skills. Ink splatters in different ways, so make sure to time your ink splatters correctly for a smooth battle. Don't let your guard down! Don't stop until the waves of enemies stop coming. Because there will be a break. Power Up Yourself! Improve yourself as you take down your enemies. From simple stats to a variety of attributes, customize your skills the way you want them to work for you and take on stronger enemies. Face Diverse Bosses! To claim the crown, the Ink Warrior must overcome monumental challenges. Defeat bosses by overcoming their unique attack patterns!

rows.name: Balantica
rows.short_description: Safely guide the twins to the altar. The path to the altar branches into multiple routes, each filled with trials and unexpected events awaiting the twins. As their companion, you will choose their path, build a deck of cards to give hope and overcome increasingly challenging trials.
rows.description_html: Balancing Hope Managing the Hope of Two Souls Assigning cards to the twins adds hope to each side of the scale. If the difference in their hope grows too large, the scale will tip, and its balance will begin to falter. When the scale tips completely and balance cannot be restored, its health decreases. Additionally, failing to accumulate enough hope to surpass the set despair value for each trial also reduces the scale’s health. If the scale’s health is fully depleted, the journey can no longer continue. Evolving Relationships After each trial, the tilt of the scale affects the twins’ relationship. With strong Rapport, building hope becomes easier. In states of Conflict, it becomes much harder. Strategically Build and Use Your Cards A Variety of Card Effects Cards assigned to the twins do more than give hope-they offer a variety of effects. Plan your deck carefully, considering the synergies between card effects. Exclusive Cards Some cards can only be assigned to one twin. Strategize your deck composition while keeping the number of exclusive cards in mind. Choices on the Journey Crossroads of Dilemmas The path to the alter, the final destination, splits into many routes. At these crossroads, the twins will encounter various individuals and face unexpected situations.

rows.name: Dr. COG
rows.short_description: Dr. Cog is a deck-building roguelike game using gears. Operate the memory restoration machine, turn gears, discover and enhance them, and build synergies. Complete the memory restoration within the time limit, recover the client's lost memories, and reach the final chapter.
rows.description_html: Become a memory restoration expert and restore your patient's memories. Your client has come to you to restore his father's memories. Use Reminiscence Mk.1 to enter his memories and carry out the restoration process, recovering the forgotten memories. Strategically arrange the gears to maximize memory production. Memory restoration surgery requires extreme precision. Gears rotating clockwise and counterclockwise directly affect memory production. If you fail to restore the required memory within the time limit, the surgery will end in failure. Build your own gear deck and create powerful synergy. utilize gears with unique synergies. Try to create your own synergy strategy by adding, upgrading, or sometimes removing gears to your deck as a reward for each stage clear.

rows.name: The Permanent Residence : Souls Kept
rows.short_description: Permanent Residence invites players into an episodic journey of psychological horror, where each chapter reveals a sinister short story woven into the eerie legacy of a cursed place.
rows.description_html: The Permanent Residence pulls you into the unsettling world of an isolated bungalow shrouded in mystery and dread. You step into the shoes of a traveling musician, stranded after your shows are suddenly canceled. Desperate and tempted by a 50% discount, you take up an offer to stay in this strange house, blissfully unaware of the horrors that await. The once-quiet halls now hum with whispers, and the walls seem to hide secrets aching to be uncovered. As you piece together strange clues, the bungalow’s chilling history unfolds—a past filled with rituals, vanishings, and a dark presence that refuses to let go. Soon, you realize that walking out the door might not be as simple as walking in. The Permanent Residence : Souls Kept In Souls Kept , the first chapter of ' The Permanent Residence' series, you take on the role of a musician drawn into the chilling mystery of an isolated bungalow. With only cryptic diary entries and unsettling photographs left behind by a vanished wedding photographer to guide you, you’ll piece together the terrifying events that have cursed this house. Can you uncover its secrets before it’s too late? Will you find a way out, or will you become yet another soul ensnared in its dark, unrelenting grip? More episodes are planned for the future—each one delving deeper into the cursed legacy of The   Permanent Residence . Key Features Atmospheric Exploration: Roam through an intricately detailed house filled with clues and eerie ambiance. Narrative-Driven Clues: Discover diary entries from previous residents, like a vanished wedding photographer, to piece together the house’s dark history. Paranormal Encounters: Experience haunting events that escalate as you uncover the bungalow’s secrets. Immersive Sound Design: Feel the terror through subtle whispers, unsettling noises, and a soundscape that heightens dread. Psychological Horror: Navigate a looping nightmare of fear, guilt, and despair that blurs the lines between reality and the infernal. Descent into Hell: Witness a twisted depiction of hell as the house reveals its true, horrifying nature.

Will you rise to the top and become the richest and most feared warrior on the battlefield? 🎮 Key Features ⚔️ Fast-paced multiplayer battles 🧬 DNA-based character system 💰 Earn and collect coins 🛍️ Unlock and buy new characters

rows.name: qualia
rows.short_description: Intellica thanks you for volunteering in this short text-based Research Study. Pay attention to the participants answers, and classify them as either Human or Artificial. Join us in shaping the future of technology. Remember, think happy!
rows.description_html: Intellica believes that positivity and happiness are the keys to self-sustaining thinking programs. By taking part in the A.M.T. Study, you can help make it happen!   QUALIA is a retro-inspired Interactive Fiction text game where you analyze and categorize two participants based on their responses to a series of questions. Are they really human? Are you? Remember, the A.M.T. Study is not a measurement of intelligence, but a questionnaire designed to determine the ability of an AI to be able to convincingly appear as a human. It is up to you to decide whether or not the participants are Human or Artificial.   featuring... 6 endings! over 20,000 words! over 300 possible unique playthroughs! audio visual media to satisfy your senses! the weight of extreme existential dread! clinically insane levels of world-building for a short text-based game! retro aesthetic for anyone born before 1984 to feel nostalgic for! educational lore! one jumpscare! ambition far beyond the dev's reasonable means! (:

It is up to you to decide whether or not the participants are Human or Artificial.   featuring... 6 endings! over 20,000 words! over 300 possible unique playthroughs! audio visual media to satisfy your senses! the weight of extreme existential dread! clinically insane levels of world-building for a short text-based game! retro aesthetic for anyone born before 1984 to feel nostalgic for! educational lore! one jumpscare! ambition far beyond the dev's reasonable means! rows.name: Ooga Booga Battle
rows.short_description: Raise your Ooga Booga Baby for greatness in Ooga Booga Battle, a half virtual pet, half horde defense arcade experience! Train to evolve into a fierce cryptid and take down as many Ooga Booga Baddies as you can! Can you battle with the Ooga Booga Best of 'em?!
rows.description_html: FEED 'EM, RAISE 'EM, BATTLE 'EM!  ABOUT: One stormy night, while exploring the woods near your hometown, you stumble upon a strange egg nestled in the underbrush, glowing faintly in the dark. Curiosity gets the better of you, and you bring it home, not knowing what lies inside. The next morning, the egg hatches, and out pops a tiny, mysterious creature—an “Ooga Booga Baby.” Unsure of where it came from but feeling a bond with the little cryptid, you decide to raise it as your own. You quickly learn that this baby has untapped potential—potential that will only grow with proper care and training. Feed it, train it, and guide it as it evolves into a powerful cryptid, capable of facing the strange and dangerous “Ooga Booga Baddies”. It's up to you to ensure your cryptid grows strong for the battles ahead! FEATURES:  Train your Ooga Booga Baby in the Raising phase… Then Defeat “Ooga Booga Baddies” in the battle phase! Can you get a high score and scare with the 'Ooga Booga Best of 'Em'? Three playable cryptids with unique playstyles to evolve into! Can you see them all?  Online leaderboards! Complete bestiary!  Nostalgic one-bit graphics and chiptune sound!  ...AND MORE!

rows.description_html: Play as a curious bat on his mission to take a full fledged photo of the moon. Progress to the end in time to take a photo of the full moon! NEW STEAM FEATURES The new Steam version of Batography includes more mooncakes to find, and steam achievements to complete. Can you 100% Batography?

rows.name: ENSCROLL
rows.short_description: Fresh out of Magic Academy with a hefty student loan, you must craft and sell magic scrolls to pay off your debt. Create spells for demanding customers and manage your growing loan payments. Will your magical skills be enough to free you from student debt?
rows.description_html: The Power of Elemental Combinations: Create New Magic Combine elements and attribute magic freely on scrolls to create entirely new spells! With over 30 unique and vibrant combinations to discover, the possibilities are endless. Whether you craft a blazing fire spell or conjure a magical garden of blooming flowers, unleash your creativity to shape magic beyond imagination. Experience the power of creation as you weave spells onto the scrolls! Blank Scrolls, Ready for Your Magic Start with an empty scroll and create magic your way. Fill the blank scrolls with your unique style—whether elegantly intricate or brilliantly efficient. The choice is yours to make every spell truly one of a kind! Stories of Diverse Customers From scrolls for magical education to those destined for ancient ruins, a wide variety of customers will visit your shop with unique requests! Understand their needs and craft the perfect magic scrolls to fulfill their demands. Complete orders successfully to earn tokens and repay your debt. And who knows? You might even encounter customers with far more secretive and mysterious needs. Special Customers Not all customers are ordinary! Meet a cast of colorful characters: a young adventurer embarking on her first journey, a bard seeking to immortalize forgotten legends through song, an explorer delving into ancient ruins, and a jovial yet fearless dwarf with a heart of gold. Their requests may be challenging, but the rewards—and the hidden stories they reveal—are worth the effort. Support their adventures with your magical creations and uncover the secrets they carry!

Step into a whole new world with new classes, innovative gameplay, and thrilling adventures in the classic MMORPG.Return to the Forest Kingdom, defend your homeland, and join the Shield of Glory as a new-generation hero.

Step into a whole new world with new classes, innovative gameplay, and thrilling adventures in the classic MMORPG. Return to the Forest Kingdom, defend your homeland, and join the Shield of Glory as a new-generation hero. Fight alongside legendary champions to reclaim peace in a vibrant, magical realm. [Exclusive New Class for the Global Version] A mysterious new class debuts in the global edition: the Celestial Priest, a master of starry divination. Harness the power of constellations and blend advanced technologies to command multi-elemental magic in combat. This hybrid style excels in both melee and ranged combat, delivering visually stunning battles and a unique gameplay experience. Innovative pet matching gameplay allows player to raise unique, adorable species while enjoying the benefits of enhanced combat power. Dive into nurturing fantastical creatures for a richer social and progression experience.. [Enhanced Quality-of-Life Features] Fast Travel: Saves time and focus on the adventure. Equipment Set Quick Switching: Adapt instantly to battle scenarios for peak performance. Batch Crafting: Streamline crafting with efficient mass production. Instant Channel Switching: Switch without delays for seamless gameplay. [Visual and UI Interface Upgrades] Immerse yourself in fairy tale-like environments. The global edition features enhanced character creation scenes and interface designs, blending refined aesthetics with intuitive gameplay for an immersive experience. [Multilingual Support and Chat Translation] Play without borders! The global version supports multiple languages, including Chinese, English, Japanese, and Thai. Real-time chat translation bridges communication gaps for a global community. Robust anti-cheat mechanisms ensure a fair and clean gaming environment for all adventurers.

rows.name: Latent Experience
rows.short_description: Latent Technology's first tech demo. A journey through different worlds built with Generative Physics Animation technology, featuring, for the very first time, fully physical and interactive characters.
rows.description_html: Latent Technology's first tech demo: a glimpse into the future of games. Step into a series of fully physical worlds powered by Generative Physics Animation technology, where characters' muscles are controlled by neural networks in real-time. Explore interactive environments where characters and objects respond dynamically to your presence. Key features: Fully physical interactions: interact with characters that move and respond realistically in real-time with their environment, adding depth to the world. Real-time neural networks:  dive into a future where neural networks drive the muscles of the characters in a fully responsive manner. Relaxing exploration:  no complex mechanics—just you, the world, and the joy of discovery :) This isn’t about racing to the finish—it's about taking in the details and savoring the journey.

rows.name: Kings of Emperor Bonaparte
rows.short_description: A persistent online wargame set in Napoleonic Europe. Command infantry, cavalry, and artillery to achieve victory.
rows.description_html: A big thank you to Epic History TV for providing the audio for our video trailer. Epic History TV is a world-renowned leader in historical storytelling. Be sure to check them out on YouTube for more amazing content. About Kings of Emperor Bonaparte: Kings of Emperor Bonaparte extends the classic vanilla wargame skirmish by providing a dynamic, persistent 24/7 war that anyone can join at any time. This online PvP experience recreates the intensity of the Napoleonic Wars, offering players the chance to take part in a massive, ongoing conflict that evolves with every skirmish and battle. Set in the historical region of Alessandria in Northern Italy, players will fight for control of key locations, pushing the frontlines and changing the tides of war with every victory and defeat. Future plans include expanding the map to cover the full breadth of the Napoleonic campaigns, from Paris to Moscow. Players can choose to side with either the French Empire or the Coalition forces, engaging in fierce battles to capture towns and strategic positions. Each faction brings its own unique playstyle and tactical options, from powerful infantry formations to decisive cavalry charges. You'll need to adapt to changing battlefield conditions, plan your assaults, and coordinate with your allies to achieve victory. The game offers an immersive historical experience, with authentic units, weapons, and tactics inspired by the Napoleonic Wars. Whether leading a cavalry charge or commanding artillery to bombard enemies, you'll be immersed in the chaos and strategy of 19th-century warfare. The persistent nature of the game ensures that every skirmish affects the greater war effort, making each player's contribution meaningful in the grand campaign. Do you have what it takes to change history? Join the fight in Kings of Emperor Bonaparte and lead your faction to victory!

rows.name: 2024: Aliens Are Coming
rows.short_description: An Indie Sci-Fi Adventure game that thrusts you into the heart of the secrecy surrounding UFOs and Aliens. Visit exotic places, meet Aliens, make alliances and enemies alike as you make critical decisions and fight for what you think is right. Time is short, because it's 2024, and Aliens Are Coming!
rows.description_html: EARLY ACCESS Game is currently an early access demo that only contains the first 3 levels. See Early Access details to know the expected development timeline. A storm is brewing behind the scenes. You start out as a normal, unsuspecting person on Earth, but your story is about to turn upside down as you encounter UFOs, Aliens, and the military. Aliens Are Coming to Earth, and some hard choices are coming your way. What will you do? Who will you trust? What will you fight for? How will it all turn out? This Indie Single Player Sci-Fi Adventure/RPG game will send you beyond Earth and back again as you get swept up into all of the secrecy surrounding Aliens and UFOs. Visit exotic places, meet Aliens, make alliances and enemies alike as you make critical decisions and fight for what you think is right. Time is short, because it's 2024, and Aliens Are Coming ! This story rich 2D side-scroller adventure game is in early release. The initial early release experience is mostly a cinematic experience with 2 mini-games (motorcycle racing and stealth/sneaking). As more scenes are added to the game, you will eventually: Choose your character's specialties, stats, and skills over time through your dialogue and action choices Learn to use psionic powers such as telekinesis, telepathy, shielding, remote viewing, psionic blasts, and healing Acquire your own top-secret military black-triangle spaceship and travel to several unique adventures on Earth, the Moon, Mars, Ceres, Ganymede, Space Stations, and eventually even planets in other star systems once your ship unlocks the wormhole jump upgrade. Encounter unique characters throughout the story who can become your companions as you travel through space As a roleplaying adventure game, gameplay will vary widely as more areas are added to the game, which will include: 2D space shooter fighting and travel 2D beat-em-up style fighting with secret high-tech weaponry when on the ground or in a spaceship Psionic training minigames to build your focus Diplomatic encounters with high-stakes dialogue choices Companion/party management as you manage your subordinates' skills and equipment Keep an open mind and prepare yourself for the secrets and changes to your reality, because Aliens Are Coming !

rows.name: Subvirtual
rows.short_description: Clear the subgrid of cubes without touching the bombs by sorting out how many connections are safe! Happy puzzling!
rows.description_html: Story Follow along with Zivraye on an adventure through the subvirtual! The story of Subvirtual is analogous to the creation process, such that closing the Infinity Chest at the end is akin to completing the MagiRouter -a device used to communicate from the Zivraye universe to many many others. Zivraye's sojourn will take you across all 7 background arenas! Gameplay Subvirtual consists of cubes that form a subgrid. Cubes can be dug up (uncovered) using the VR shovel hand and flagged using the VR flag hand. Cubes uncovered, which are not bombs, will show either a number or will be blank. Blanks mean no bombs directly surround that cube; while numbers indicate how many bombs border that cube. Use this information to uncover all non-bomb locations and you win the match! GL HF! If you enjoy logic & numbers, this is the game for you! Game Modes Campaign: Experience the story of Subvirtual while playing through 21 hand picked matches spread over 7 unique arenas ('All Arenas Bundle' item purchase NOT required for Campaign). Custom Game: this match type is the 'classic' experience. It is the playstyle used in the campaign mode. Allows player selections of both subgrid size (smol/medium/large) as well as difficulty (easy/medium/hard) Memory Test: this match type is, as the name suggest, a memory game. Cubes will flash in order, adding 1 cube per round, and the player mush recover (fill) cubes in the same order that was flashed. Bomb Sniffer: Need a break from the other game modes? This match type is impossible to lose! The subgrid contains only 1 bomb! You win when you blow up! Additional Features Unlockables: level up to unlock configurable options for each part of the flag & shovel VR hands with different colors & shaders. We're excited to see the custom combinations you come up with! Distinct Arenas: all 7 of the arenas that are featured in the campaign present themselves with a distinct atmospheric vibe that gives each arena a unique sense of identity while you play. Which will be your favorite background aesthetic? Atmospheric Music: Subvirtual's sound track was hand picked by Zivraye. A few tracks play on all arenas, but most arenas have 2-4 songs unique to that arena. Statistics: see how many cubes you have uncovered, games won, and more!

rows.name: skate.
rows.short_description: Experience improved Flick-It controls, the rich physics based skateboarding gameplay that provides those “only in skate.™“ moments and off-board exploration for full freedom in the online multiplayer world of San Vansterdam.
rows.description_html: SKATE.™ - WELCOME DELUXE PACK SKATE.™ - WELCOME PACK About the Game The next evolution of the award-winning skate.™ franchise is here in Early Access. Your new favorite hangout awaits. PLAY TOGETHER IN A DYNAMIC SOCIAL WORLD Drop into the dynamic, ever-evolving city of San Vansterdam - a city with a new lease on life building its growing skate scene alongside its new residents. In San Van, no two days are alike and fun waits around every corner in this online multiplayer world fueled by skateboarding, self expression and community. EXPERIENCE TOTAL CONTROL Skate through San Vansterdam’s streets, parks and plazas with improved Flick-It controls, play with physics to experience “only in skate.™“ moments or hop off your board to explore on foot and climb to discover new spots at all heights across San Van. From the rails and ledges to the rooftops and ramps, San Van is your canvas to find endless spots and fun as you immerse yourself in the city’s budding skate culture. PAVE YOUR OWN PATH Earn rewards, show-off and progress no matter how you want to play as you take on activities, challenges and events while exploring the city to develop your own style, favorite tricks and favorite spots. There are countless possibilities to personalize and express yourself in San Vansterdam with a rich and growing suite of character customization options to create your own skater and an extensive inventory of hats, clothes, footwear and accessories, featuring some of the biggest brands in skateboarding and street fashion. Make your board an extension of you and show off your style by building out your collection of decks, grip tape, wheels, trucks and stickers. CREATE YOUR OWN FUN Build new spots by placing skateable objects in the world in-real time with your Quick Drop items, create your own challenges against other skaters with Throwdowns across the city or roll into one of San Vansterdam’s many Community Parks to get the session going with your friends and fellow San Van residents. Capture your biggest tricks, slams and moments on film with the Replay Editor to create your collection of photos and clips and then share them to highlight what you’ve been getting up to across the city. CROSS-PLAY, CO-OP AND CROSS-PROGRESSION* Skate with friends and the wider community across supported platforms with cross-play and 150 player servers. Want to party up? Take on cooperative challenges together for greater rewards. Cross-progression allows you to keep earning rewards and finding the fun no matter what platform you want to drop in on. EARLY ACCESS IS JUST THE START Early Access is only the beginning and the experience will continue to evolve and grow with your feedback helping shape the future of San Vansterdam. The San Van City Council will bring ongoing and seasonal updates featuring new gameplay experiences and ways to play together, fresh rewards and gear, new locations and skate spots across the city, in-game events, soundtrack refreshes and more. This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items.
rows.about_html: SKATE.™ - WELCOME DELUXE PACK SKATE.™ - WELCOME PACK About the Game The next evolution of the award-winning skate.™ franchise is here in Early Access. Your new favorite hangout awaits. PLAY TOGETHER IN A DYNAMIC SOCIAL WORLD Drop into the dynamic, ever-evolving city of San Vansterdam - a city with a new lease on life building its growing skate scene alongside its new residents. In San Van, no two days are alike and fun waits around every corner in this online multiplayer world fueled by skateboarding, self expression and community. EXPERIENCE TOTAL CONTROL Skate through San Vansterdam’s streets, parks and plazas with improved Flick-It controls, play with physics to experience “only in skate.™“ moments or hop off your board to explore on foot and climb to discover new spots at all heights across San Van. From the rails and ledges to the rooftops and ramps, San Van is your canvas to find endless spots and fun as you immerse yourself in the city’s budding skate culture. PAVE YOUR OWN PATH Earn rewards, show-off and progress no matter how you want to play as you take on activities, challenges and events while exploring the city to develop your own style, favorite tricks and favorite spots. There are countless possibilities to personalize and express yourself in San Vansterdam with a rich and growing suite of character customization options to create your own skater and an extensive inventory of hats, clothes, footwear and accessories, featuring some of the biggest brands in skateboarding and street fashion. Make your board an extension of you and show off your style by building out your collection of decks, grip tape, wheels, trucks and stickers. CREATE YOUR OWN FUN Build new spots by placing skateable objects in the world in-real time with your Quick Drop items, create your own challenges against other skaters with Throwdowns across the city or roll into one of San Vansterdam’s many Community Parks to get the session going with your friends and fellow San Van residents. Capture your biggest tricks, slams and moments on film with the Replay Editor to create your collection of photos and clips and then share them to highlight what you’ve been getting up to across the city. CROSS-PLAY, CO-OP AND CROSS-PROGRESSION* Skate with friends and the wider community across supported platforms with cross-play and 150 player servers. Want to party up? Take on cooperative challenges together for greater rewards. Cross-progression allows you to keep earning rewards and finding the fun no matter what platform you want to drop in on. rows.name: Stellarion
rows.short_description: Upgrade your spaceship and conquer the stars in this thrilling space-mining adventure! Mine asteroids, battle enemies, and trade resources for powerful upgrades to customize your ship. Master the galaxy and embark on the ultimate journey!
rows.description_html: Embark on a galactic adventure in this thrilling space-mining simulator! Returning home from your interstellar travels, you stumble upon a mining station that presents the perfect opportunity to upgrade your outdated spaceship. Take on the role of a miner, harvest precious resources, and trade them for powerful upgrades. Navigate asteroid fields, face increasingly challenging enemies, and master your spaceship’s controls in a vast, procedurally generated space environment. Customize your ship with four types of upgrades—cargo capacity, firepower, durability, and speed—each with multiple tiers to suit your playstyle. With dynamic gameplay that combines resource management, strategic upgrades, and combat, the game offers a compelling progression system. Once fully upgraded, set off on your ultimate journey with your enhanced spacecraft, or start a new game to refine your mining skills. Are you ready to conquer the stars and build the ship of your dreams? Adventure awaits!

rows.name: Pal-Mon
rows.short_description: A thought-provoking indie game developed in Godot that uses casual mechanics to spark a conversation about creativity and fairness in gaming. You perform pointless tasks while The Developer talks at you. Satirical humor, goofy artwork, and an unsurprising end make this game worth playing--maybe.
rows.description_html: This game is not really a game. It is an interactive podcast, aimed at bringing awareness to specific issues within the gaming industry. Mainly, it dives into the impact of copyright and patent disputes on creativity. Through its simple mechanics, Pal-Mon  sparks a conversation about fairness, innovation, and the future of gaming. Each level is designed as a parody of another game that had mechanics that were patented. You can choose to play through these game parodies while listening to the podcast. Gameplay is very simple, usually moving a 2D character around on the screen using WASD. But for the most part you really don't have to do anything except listen unless you want to. The podcast features narration from the developer themself. This adds a personal touch to the experience, and allows for a deeper dive into how patents affects small scale, solo developers. The perspective is from the indie scene. However, the point is made that unfair legal action hurts every game studio, no matter its size. Whether you're here for the casual gameplay or the deeper commentary, Pal-Mon  invites you to play, enjoy, and reflect on what truly matters in the gaming community.

rows.name: Battle for Rakir
rows.short_description: Fly, fight, and level up!
rows.description_html: Battle for Rakir is an open-world, isometric (top-down) space combat game. This RPG is set in orbit around the war-torn desert colony of Rakir. Rakir, once a slave world, has risen in rebellion against its master, the tyrannical Federation; a galactic power that exploits its colonies for profit. As a new recruit in Rakir’s amateur spy division, you’ll pilot advanced spacecraft, command small strike fleets, and carry out daring missions to sabotage the Federation. The planned gameplay loop is to level up your pilot, customize your build with hundreds of abilities, and make key decisions in a branching campaign that shapes the fate of the rebellion.  This is a solo indie project. Please help me to make it better, with your suggestions and by reporting any game breaking bugs.

rows.short_description: You wish to bring 'She' back to life to reclaim something precious you’ve lost. Solve the various puzzles set before you and gather what 'She' needs. Even you don’t know what 'She' truly is. 'sheeeroom' is a mysterious adventure game.
rows.description_html: 'sheeeroom' is a mysterious adventure game. ◆ Story You have come to this place to retrieve something precious that was lost. To do so, you wish to bring 'She' back to life. Solve the various puzzles prepared for you and gather what 'She' needs. Even you don’t know what 'She' truly is. But you have no choice—you must do it. ◆ Game Features A walking simulator where various events unfold as you move. Progress the story by investigating objects. No quest markers or time limits—play at your own pace. 'She' is always glowing. Playtime: 15–60 minutes ◆ Video Streaming Guidelines Streaming is allowed without prior permission, whether by individuals or organizations.

rows.name: YAMIKKO TROUBLEMAKER
rows.short_description: A long-form, choice-driven depression game in which the protagonist’s ending changes based on the choices made by “you,” the voice he hears in his head.
rows.description_html: ▷ Synopsis The protagonist, known as “Doctor,” decides their actions based on the choices made by “you,” the player. Doctor , a psychiatrist, wakes up in a hospital. For the next five days—until the patients are discharged—Doctor must take care of them. However, the three patients are exceptionally sweet, exceptionally cute, and exceptionally troublesome troublemakers…? This is a choice-driven depression game in which the protagonist’s ending changes depending on the choices made by you , the player. Features Long playtime: approximately 7–12 hours Endings: 3 NORMAL ENDINGS 4 GAME OVERS 13 BAD ENDINGS 1 TRUE ENDING 0 HAPPY ENDING Over 100 illustrations Memorable background music In-game Achievements

rows.name: Etherburn
rows.short_description: Etherburn is a Souls-like action-adventure. Play as a hero resurrected in a mysterious and interconnected dungeon. Explore and face intense duels as you fight your way to freedom.
rows.description_html: Etherburn is a student game and offers Souls-like gameplay in a medieval dark fantasy setting. Play as a revived Hero, a legendary knight who's name is lost to time. Your goal is to explore and escape the dungeon on one of many Routes. On your perilious Journey you will encounter Foes and might even die in Combat against them. But Death is not the End: The Dungeon is filled with the life-giving Powers of Ether - bringing you and your Enemies back to life in due time. Explore an interconnected Dungeon - filled with different Biomes and Areas to explore. Discover different parts of the Dungeon in a medieval dark fantasy setting in the attempt to find the right path to escape. Master various weapons and unleash deadly attacks to defeat your enemies. Weaken your foes and finish them off with brutal executions. Unlock new weapons as you journey through the Dungeon - looking for a way out.

rows.name: StormCore
rows.short_description: A TPS with roguelike elements. Choose your loadout, gather powerful upgrades, and fight your way through hordes of alien insects. You only have 3 days, so make them count.
rows.description_html: StormCore is a dynamic third-person shooter with roguelite elements. Play as a forgotten cyborg, reactivated to save a dying alien planet from its creators’ catastrophic mistakes. With modular limbs and great firepower, blast through hordes of alien insects, optimize your build, obtain powerful upgrades, and reach the StormCore terraformer tower before the world collapses in just three days. KEY FEATURES Cybernetic limbs Mix and match 4 limb types/abilities (Primary Weapon, Secondary Weapon, Kicks, Movement) to tailor your experience to your own playstyle and build. Powerful upgrades Defeat enemies and grow stronger. Each fight won means one more stack of one of 12 distinct upgrades that grow stronger with each stack. Try out various builds based on your choice of limbs and upgrades, and become an unstoppable force of destruction. Roguelite progression For each 3-day cycle, use the first 2 days to build up your strength. Dying isn’t the end, keep your upgrades and try harder the next day. But when the final day comes, it’s do or die: reach the StormCore or lose everything

rows.name: OAsys - Speedbots Tournament
rows.short_description: A fast-paced competitive racing game set in a solarpunk universe. You play as a speedbot, an athlete competing in a spectacular and perilous new tournament filled with robots, lasers, and a healthy dose of style !
rows.description_html: Welcome to OAsys! A new extreme sport is taking the valley by storm, and what better way to promote it than with a tournament? You play as The Pilot and their army of speedbots—built to run, crash, and start all over again in a frenetic time-trial race! All thanks to our sponsors, of course. Competition Above All! Take the top spot on the leaderboard! Other contenders want the #1 rank, but you’re more relentless. Replay the level as many times as needed to secure the highest score—so don’t hold back. Show your robot fury to the competition and dominate the leaderboard! Master Speedbot! This exceptionally dangerous sport is practiced only by robots designed for this purpose. Very few make it to the finish line, as countless obstacles stand in their way. Will you be the first champion of this Speedbot Tournament? A Breathtaking Valley! The races take place in a sprawling landscape, blending natural and industrial settings with a solarpunk-inspired art direction. You’ll die often—but what a stunning valley to behold as you do! Game Features - Race through 10 levels with increasing difficulty. - Improve your mastery of the character and the environment! - Use gameplay elements to optimize your path and get the best time!  - Survive obstacles during your run! - Climb the Leaderboard and compare your scores with friends! - Earn as many Medals as possible ! aim higher and higher ! Game Modes - A main campaign mode ! - A 'level chaining' mode : If you die, you go back to the first level! - Each level comes with challenges to complete ! can you finish it 100%?

rows.description_html: Hey there, Intern - Welcome to Coolmath Games! We're excited to have you join our team. Are you prepared for your first day? Don't worry, it'll be an easy one! Just introduce yourself to the team, help out on some quick tasks, and prepare for our daily game launch. Just don't break anything along the way, okay? Take part in choice-based conversations that show your true personality to the team! Play fun puzzles that will take you out of the office and beyond! Pick game parts that will affect the type of game that will be used for the game launch! Spot as many easter eggs as you can!

rows.name: Model Casting
rows.short_description: You are in the role of the owner of an exclusive adult modeling agency. Your mission is to discover and mentor aspiring models, each with distinct personalities and backgrounds. Engage in immersive dialogues where your choices influence relationships and unlock intimate moments.
rows.description_html: Gameplay and Features: Three Distinct Chapters for Each Model: The Interview: Get to Know Her: Discover the model's background, personality, and reasons for joining the agency. Light Intimacy: Encourage her to show some skin or participate in a sensual photoshoot, setting the stage for future encounters. First Meeting: Deepen the Connection: The model returns seeking a favor or negotiating her contract. First Full Encounter: Use your charm to navigate the conversation into a passionate and explicit scene where boundaries are pushed. Lewd Visit (Sandbox Mode): Total Control: Revisit previous H-scenes or unlock new, more explicit content based on your relationship level. Explore New Fantasies: Choose from various scenarios, outfits, and settings to create unique experiences. Meet the Models: Chloe – The College Girl: Shy and innocent, yet secretly intrigued by the adult world. She opens up as she feels more comfortable, revealing a playful side. Lana – The Unsuccessful Actress: Bold and self-assured, using her charm and body to negotiate. Despite her confidence, she seeks recognition and success. Maya – The Go-Getter: Direct and focused on financial gain. She's here for the money but isn't opposed to fun once she lets her guard down. Sasha – The Yoga Instructor: Calm and in tune with her body. Prefers a slow, sensual buildup and values genuine connections. Emma – The Gamer Girl: Casual and straightforward, lacking traditional social skills but open to new experiences. She's here to fund her gaming passion. Dive into the World of Model Casting: Become the Decision-Maker: As the agency owner, your choices directly impact the models' careers and your relationships with them. Explore Intimate Narratives: Each model offers a unique storyline filled with personal challenges, desires, and opportunities for connection. Are You Ready to Lead the Ultimate Modeling Agency? Step into a world where every decision matters, and every interaction can lead to new heights of intimacy and success. Whether you choose to be a supportive mentor or a confident negotiator, the path you take will shape your agency's future and the destinies of the models who rely on you.

rows.name: Fateful Destiny
rows.short_description: Can you uncover the truth, or will the mystery remain buried? Explore a village, make final choices, and shape a story you can never undo.
rows.description_html: Fateful Destiny is a short narrative-driven adventure set in a small village where mystery lurks beneath the surface. Playing as a young farmer, you’ll uncover the story by exploring the town, speaking to its inhabitants, and piecing together clues. Designed to be completed in about twenty minutes, it offers a unique experience: decisions are final, and once finished, it’s not meant to be played again. Every choice shapes your understanding of the truth in this fleeting yet impactful journey.

rows.name: 1-Bit Explorer
rows.short_description: An adventure game focused on exploration where you do NOT save the world and the world does NOT need saving.
rows.description_html: 1-Bit Explorer is an adventure game focused on exploration where you do NOT save the world and the world does NOT need saving. The point is to explore to your heart's content and uncover mysteries and secrets (or don't, it's up to you, really). You are the son of Frank, regular citizen of Moneta Village, which is trying to complete his collection of Ancient Coins. Due to a disease, your father needs your help with this apparently mundane task of gathering 3 Ancient Coins. Each one requires you to explore a bit of the village and its habitants. What you might discover is that there are secrets, ghosts, other dimensions, demons and ancient Kings hiding in the corners. It is up to you to discover this mysteries. The gameplay consists mostly of various puzzles, either being: Conversational Puzzles: Talk your way into making some people do as you want. Saying the right things might turn them into useful people for your quests. Push & Pull Puzzles: Rocks can be moved around the environment to either unblock a path or to press buttons and special locations, revealing secrets and opening new pathways. Lever Puzzles: Levers can be used to unblock paths, either by activating them in a certain order, activating them in a time limit or simply finding your way into them to uncover new shorcuts. Timing Puzzles: Some puzzles require you to do tasks in a certain time limit. Be careful with the timer, because it might be the difference between just failing or straight up dying! Positional Puzzles: Puzzles might require you to stand on different places in different orders. Be aware of sounds that can indicate a success or failure! Environmental Sound Puzzles: Some times you just need to follow your ears. Be aware of your surroundings and seek out the sounds! Active Combat: If you are willing to explore, you might fight your way into a battle or two. Make sure to learn the ropes with a helpful weaponsmith! Explore, explore and explore: The game is focused on exploration, so make sure to check every corner and talk to everyone! The world is there for you to experience and discover!

rows.short_description: Dookie Clicker is an idle game where your #1 goal is #2.
rows.description_html: An idle game about... anyway, this is Dookie Clicker. Collect Dookie to buy more Pooducers to collect more Dookie. Once you've filled your pockets you may prestige, resetting your progress. Each prestige rewards you with Stars to spend on Powers that'll give your runs the runs. Equip your 'ducers with bowl-shattering Perks and watch as they blow more mud than you thought possible. Your 'ducers don't stop while the game is closed, so feel free to leave and come back when your body tells you to. Just make sure you clean up when you're done...
