rows.name: Epiko World
rows.short_description: Epiko World is a fast-paced multiplayer battle game where players engage in PvP duels, team-based combat, and free-for-all chaos. Customize legendary heroes, summon tactical companions, and fight in dynamic maps inspired by global mythology and cultural epics.
rows.description_html: About This Game Epiko World is an action-packed multiplayer battle game that seamlessly blends mythological storytelling with futuristic combat. Step into a vibrant universe where legendary heroes and gods clash in dynamic battlegrounds inspired by cultures from around the globe. Whether you’re engaging in fast-paced PvP matches, teaming up in 3v3 battles, or hunting down epic Ravagers, Epiko World delivers an adrenaline-filled experience for gamers of all skill levels. Key Features Dynamic Gameplay Modes PvP Duels : Face off against opponents in intense 1v1 battles. 3v3 Team Matches : Work together to dominate the battlefield in fast-paced strategic combat. Free-for-All Chaos : Compete against up to seven players in a thrilling fight for supremacy. Ravager Encounters : Hunt down powerful creatures within the arena for rare rewards and an edge in battle. Mythology Meets Futurism Play as gods, warriors, and futuristic heroes, each with unique abilities and weapons, blending ancient myths with cutting-edge technology. Explore battlegrounds inspired by legendary locations such as Dwarka, Babylon, and Mayan temples, complete with dynamic weather and interactive terrain. Customizable Heroes and Companions Personalize your heroes with unlockable skins, weapons, and abilities to match your playstyle. Summon powerful companions to assist in battle, offering tactical and magical advantages. Progression and Rewards Climb leaderboards and complete daily challenges to earn exclusive rewards. Participate in global tournaments for a chance to win rare in-game items and claim your spot as a top competitor. Cross-Ecosystem Integration Bring your NFTs from Epiko Market to life, unlocking unique in-game benefits and customizations. Connect your account through the Epiko Hub (coming soon), where gameplay activities and achievements will earn KARMA points for real-world and in-game rewards. Why Choose Epiko World? Immersive Storytelling : Dive into a world where every battle unfolds a story rooted in rich cultural myths. Cutting-Edge Visuals : Experience stunning graphics, smooth animations, and vibrant environments. Accessible and Competitive : Designed for casual players and hardcore gamers alike, with balanced gameplay and competitive features. Prepare to unleash legendary heroes, conquer mythological realms, and forge your destiny in Epiko World ! Will you rise to the challenge and claim victory? The battle awaits!!!

rows.name: BROK - Natal Tail, A New Christmas
rows.short_description: A Christmas tale set in the world of BROK the InvestiGator, presented as a visual novel.
rows.description_html: A Christmas Tale in a Dystopia When students Graff and Ott are called upon to celebrate 'Natal Untail,' a corrupted version of Atlasia's ancient tradition, they'll discover that even in this decaying world, the values of sharing and friendship endure as life's greatest treasures. Do I need to play BROK the InvestiGator first? Nope! This story serves as a prequel to the main game, introducing the characters and explain the game’s terminology. While playing BROK the InvestiGator first provides additional context, this visual novel is a valid entry point into the BROK universe. What is the length? I have written and made this visual novel in approximately 3 weeks of work, this re-uses a large majority of assets from the main game, and spans about an hour to get through. Accessibility This visual novel has full accessibility for blind players in English. Special Edition The original version is free, but the upgraded 'Special Edition' of Natal Tail, revisited for consoles, with choices, achievements and new scenes is now also available on PC as a DLC to support the developer!

rows.name: Bouncing Buds
rows.short_description: A party minigame like no other. Battle friends and foes while bouncing around the world in fun minigames anyone can learn.
rows.description_html: Bounce into action with this chaotic multiplayer party fighter! Play as bouncy balls in a physics-driven battle where speed and weight determine your impact. Choose from diverse game modes like free-for-all Fighter, high-speed Race, or strategic King of the Hill. Master power-ups like the heavy slam, rocket boost, speed burst, and time bomb to outplay your opponents. With multiple maps and dynamic gameplay, every match is a fresh test of skill, strategy, and sheer mayhem! Party Up Create your own server Join friends in private servers Find new friends in public servers Bounce Bounce off wall, friends, anything Power Up loads of powerups to enjoy Rockets Time Bombs Getting heavy or becoming air Explore Experience different game modes such as: Racing King of the Hill Fighters And Worlds to explore

rows.name: Metabrawl
rows.short_description: Metabrawl is a new way of action battles combined in platform fights, beat-em-up, open-world adventure to choose your favourite style. Explore the huge and dynamic world of meta-ryft without bounds.
rows.description_html: After 1000 years, the mysterious portal to the metabrawl tournament opens once again. the masters of inu gather to crown the next champion of the metabrawl . The best fighters across the space come together to compete to reign victorious for the illustrious title of champion. The meta-ryft, a world that connects all dimensions, and houses many powerful items, welcomes the fight. Witness an epic test of strength and skill where only the most powerful will be triumphant. many battles will be fought with one goal in mind: crowned king of the metabrawl . Metabrawl delivers adrenaline-packed action and intense battles in a vibrant and dynamic world. Choose your fighter and step into the arena, where skill and strategy determine victory. Whether you’re taking on up to 3 opponents in chaotic brawls or going head-to-head in a classic 1v1 showdown, Metabrawl offers non-stop excitement. Key Features: Epic Brawls : Engage in high-energy battles, whether 1v3 or 1v1, in action-packed arenas designed for fast-paced combat. Story Mode Exploration : Dive into the open-world story mode and uncover the secrets of the Metabrawl universe while honing your skills. Powerful Fighters : Play as unique characters like Wolverinu , the ferocious brawler, or face off against fierce opponents such as Volt , Shiba , or Shibnobi . Dynamic Arenas : Fight in beautifully crafted arenas that evolve during battles, pushing your tactics to the limit. Are you ready to unleash your power and dominate the battlefield? The world of Metabrawl awaits! Do you have what it takes to be the next metabrawl champion?

rows.name: Escape from Castle Claymount
rows.short_description: A 3D point-and-click puzzle adventure featuring beautifully rendered claymation scenery and a colorful cast of characters. Search for clues and solve the hidden puzzles to Escape from Castle Claymount!
rows.description_html: The popular web game is now on Steam! An evil wizard has locked you in Castle Claymount and the king is nowhere to be found... But you won't be alone! Work together with a collection of unlikely friends to solve the hidden puzzles and make your escape! Escape From Castle Claymount is a 3D point-and-click adventure game filled with beautifully rendered Claymation scenery and unique puzzles. Explore every nook and cranny to find every item and puzzle solution. Can you escape without being caught? FEATURES: Solve unique puzzles Talk with others held captive and learn about who they are Find and collect strange items to use and give to others Take notes and collect memories to keep puzzle solutions in mind Explore detailed Claymation film sets NOTE: The tree puzzle has been changed slightly for balancing.

rows.name: JR's Christmas Adventure
rows.short_description: Join Jessica in this humorous holiday FMV adventure. With 9 unique endings to discover, will you find joy or chaos?
rows.description_html: 'JR’s Christmas Adventure: A Holiday Conspiracy Unfolds!' Join Jessica on her unpredictable journey as she volunteers at her favorite holiday charity, only to be entangled in a web of intrigue and deception. Your choices will shape the outcome of her story, leading you down paths filled with laughter, drama, and unexpected twists. Will Jessica make it home safely? Will she trust the wrong people or uncover hidden truths? Will she finally get that warm drink she's been craving? As you navigate this interactive fiction adventure, you will discover secrets, meet quirky characters, and unravel a conspiracy that will keep you guessing until the end. But be warned: not everyone is as they seem, including Saint Nick himself... Features: 9 unique endings to uncover Multiple paths to choose from, shaping Jessica's story Quirky characters and secrets Join the holiday hijinks in 'JR’s Christmas Adventure' for free! Thank you for visiting my page! This product is unpolished and has rough edges, but if you can look past that, there is fun to be found. It was completed in five rushed weeks by a single passionate gamer who pretends to be a dev. They were learning new AI tools and made a lot of mistakes. They promise to learn from their mistakes, and they appreciate your forgiveness for any foolishness that transpires.

rows.name: Stan
rows.short_description: Obsessive fans are common for artists, but this one is different. He's found his way to the home of J.W. Eel slug, a piano player who just got a deadline from a record label, and is determined to get inside.
rows.description_html: In Stan, your main objective is to record enough music before the deadline while dealing with the demands of a psycho-fan. Throughout the night, your fan will be trying to get your attention, asking for things through notes left around the house. If you ignore the notes, the fan will break in, but If you acknowledge the notes, they will ask for more. Your goal is to correctly record 10 pages of music before your label drops you, or before your Stan gets inside. Controls: The Q through P row controls the black piano keys, while the A through Semicolon row controls the white piano keys. E or Left click to interact with objects.

rows.short_description: A very short, 2D side-scroller collect-a-thon game that lets you play as the cute HOLORO mascots!
rows.description_html: A very short, 2D side-scroller collect-a-thon game that lets you play as the cute HOLORO mascots! It's the HOLORO's anniversary day! It's HOLORO's anniversary day! Ollie, Reine, and Anya want to party, but they don't have any money, so they ask Udin, Mr. Akyat, and Toaster-kun for help. And so, the mascot trio goes on a short walk~ GAMEPLAY - Play through 3 stages! UDIN stage — Play as UDIN, Kureiji Ollie's mascot. This blue and purple stitched small bear will navigate around the forest with her versatile jumps! MERAKyats stage — MR Akyat is a devoted follower of Pavolia Reine, and this gentle peafowl will follow her wherever the wind sweeps. He can fly, and he will reach the top to help his lady. TOASTER-KUN stage — Toaster-kun is Anya Melfissa's prized toaster machine that somewhat alive. He has a unique way of traversing the stage, powered by electricity and making use of the environment around him. rows.name: Idle Legion
rows.short_description: Observe, analyze, plan, and change the battle! Focus on your legion's combat, analyze key moments and positions. Adjust formations to ensure victory for Dark Lords! A single legion move can change the outcome—this game tests sharp insight and strategic thinking.
rows.description_html: Kind-hearted person, please save the broken Dark Lord! Our beloved leader, the unholy and terrifying Dark Lord, has been betrayed by the treacherous Death Knights in his campaign against the filthy humans! It is up to us, his loyal servants, to piece back his shattered soul in this abandoned Dungeon. We must rebuild, collect resources, and re-muster our Legions for the glory of our evil master! Observe, analyze, plan, and change the battle!   Focus on your legion's combat, analyze key moments and positions. Adjust formations to ensure victory for Dark Lords! A single legion move can change the outcome—this game tests sharp insight and strategic thinking. A game that combines dungeon management with card-based army battles. The developers of this game are fans of simulation and management games. In the past, while playing other simulation management games, We felt a significant regret: after spending a lot of time carefully designing and managing my city or base, the only reward was an increase in in-game economic income, allowing me to build larger and more powerful structures. However, as you can imagine, once my economy is strong, what I need is an army and warfare! By establishing my economic foundation through simulation management, I aim to support the formation of an army to conquer enemies! Therefore, we merged dungeon management with card-based army battles to create this game, and we hope it brings you enjoyable moments.

rows.name: Midnight Snack
rows.short_description: A short first-person horror game where you wander through an eerie forest using the dials of a microwave.
rows.description_html: Midnight Snack is a short and surreal first-person horror game where you wander through an eerie forest using the dials of a microwave. FEATURES Alternative and experimental control scheme. Retro/Pixelart 3D visuals. Short and sweet, the game takes about 30 minutes to complete. THE GAMEPLAY The controls are integrated into the interface itself, modeled after the dials of a conventional microwave. The bottom dial controls the camera direction, while the top dial determines how long the player moves. Once the time has been set, the controls are locked until the top dial stops turning, so be careful. To interact with the dials, only the mouse is required. The player must use these unconventional controls to navigate a strange environment in search of a snack, avoiding various obstacles. THE STORY The game takes place in the protagonist's recurring nightmare. In this nightmare, the protagonist wakes up hungry in the middle of the night, viewing the world from the perspective of a microwave. Before reaching the kitchen, he must navigate through a dark and eerie setting, even being attacked within the dream manifestations of his guilt. Finally, upon reaching the kitchen and opening the microwave on the table, he will find an unpleasant surprise.

rows.name: Lift/Shift
rows.short_description: In Lift/Shift, you're a research agent documenting a strange apartment where objects constantly change. Use your specialized camera to stabilize reality across multiple floors.
rows.description_html: Description: Lift/Shift is a horror puzzle game where you play as a research operative of a secret institution investigating a mysterious, ever-changing apartment. Armed with a specialized camera, you must document the transformations of objects across multiple floors of an anomalous building. Be careful: any object can shift between realities, and making correct photos is the only way to stabilize the environment. Make mistakes, and you risk destabilizing not just the apartment, but potentially the entire fabric of reality. Features: Reality-shifting gameplay Atmospheric, minimalist design Increasing complexity with each floor

Choose between three different difficulties and try to solve as many puzzles as you can!

Help Balloon Boy continue on his path by typing in the right words without losing all of your balloons. If you lose all of your balloons, Beast will eat you! Choose between three different difficulties and try to solve as many puzzles as you can!

rows.name: Moral Dilemma: The Interview
rows.short_description: A fourth-wall-breaking narrative adventure. It’s interview day, and you really need this job—enough to ignore the talking printer, the anomaly corridor, and the ridiculous life-or-death trials your interviewer keeps putting you in. But deep down, you know... something here is very, very wrong.
rows.description_html: It’s the day of your big interview! The position? ‘Moral Dilemma Judge’—whatever that means. But something about this office feels... off . Maybe it’s the talking printer. Or the anomaly corridor that changes every time you enter. Or the narrator who keeps throwing you into ridiculous life-or-death situations. No, no—it’s probably just your imagination. Must be pre-interview nerves. Good luck out there! Features A story-rich experience with a narrative that is impossible to predict! The Narrator is your friend. Don't question him; you should listen to everything he says. Atmosphere -  Countless whiteboards, sticky notes, posters, and signs. Some seem like the ramblings of a sleep-deprived intern, while others whisper secrets you'd rather not know. Minigames - A very strange interview process involving an IQ quiz, a memory test, counting sheep, and more... Make friends - A talking printer, a chair with a doctorate, a toilet playing the guitar... Choices! Trolley problems, dilemmas in war, hospitals, the city, nature... Puzzles - Walk through The Hallway and don't fall for its tricks, or solve a riddle. Multiple endings with many secrets to discover! Explore Nothing in this office is as it seems. Meet a talking chair with existential dread, count passing sheep to 'test' your IQ, and enter the world's first time machine. There are countless secrets and hidden endings to uncover, some so well-concealed they might remain undiscovered for decades. Moral Dilemmas Should you save one baby or five cans of soup? Throw the world into nuclear armageddon, or... not? Sometimes, doing nothing feels like the hardest choice of all.

rows.name: Gameday Mayhem!!
rows.short_description: A goofy, competitive two-player showdown perfect for killing time (and your buddy’s pride) while waiting for the pizza to arrive.
rows.description_html: Grab a friend, hit the field, and brace yourself for Gameday Mayhem!! – the local multiplayer brawl that asks: 'What if football had no strategy, no rules, and possibly… a rifle?' It's a 3-minute duel where two players run, dodge, tackle, and fumble their way to victory. Want to pass the ball? Sure, but don’t expect your AI teammates to help—they’re barely functional. Think Nidhogg meets American football. So, lace up, lock in, and prepare for zero strategy, all chaos. (and Gameday Mayhem may actually be the worst game!) GameDay Mayhem!!  is 2-Player-only and local-only . It supports gamepads but it can also be played with two players on one keyboard. Try the demo to find out if your keyboard supports shared keyboard. To play online with a friend you can use Remote Play Together.

rows.name: BrainRot
rows.short_description: A party pvp game based on brainrot trends.
rows.description_html: Compete against your friends to in a series of brainrot related minigames to become the brainrot champ. This is a casual party game based on popular brainrot trends and memes.  A lobby can host up to 16 players There are currently 4 game modes Each minigame has it's own unique challenge related to the meme the minigame is based off. Players earn brainrot in various ways each minigame. The player with the most brainrot at the end of all the minigames WIN! WARNING: Play at own risk, may cause serious brainrot.

rows.name: Palette Cleanser
rows.short_description: Jump, dash and slide through a futuristic garden in Palette Cleanser, cute 3D platformer focused on smooth movement and an optimistic vibe! Control a tiny robot trying to restore the color palette of its garden. Capture the alien invaders to activate paint sprinklers and make the garden alive again.
rows.description_html: A whimsical and lively garden somewhere in the distant future gets invaded by color-slurping aliens and ends up completely desaturated. The garden robot is on a mission to cleanse the aliens of their gluttony and restore the color palette.    Palette Cleanser is a sweet, compact 3D platformer lovingly crafted by students from Breda University of Applied Sciences over the course of eight months.  Swiftly dash and jump around the level controlling an adorable robot, cleansing critters along the way to keep your speed up and your spirits high!                          These cheeky little aliens think they've taken over, but not for long! Collect them and bring them to safety of their own silliness.  But watch out, some might fight back...                          Experience a playful twist on size as a tiny robot exploring a HUGE garden! Wander in an open-ended environment and watch the world around you spring back to color as you progress!                          Anything else? Well, the development team couldn't figure out if the player is: slurp & sliding, dash & riding, zip & zapping, jump & pumping, boot & scooting, hop & bopping, surf & turfing, smooch & smacking, blink & skipping, boom & zooming, Plink & Plonk™-ing, but in any case you go very fast, so how about you just go and figure out and tell us later in the reviews.

rows.name: The Final Print
rows.short_description: You're a journalist investigating a suspicious case during the Harlem riots. Take pictures of evidence, gather information by interrogating people, and put it all together in an article to show people the truth.
rows.description_html: In Development Take the role of an investigative journalist in Harlem, in the early 1940s. Someone has been murdered, and the explanations that the police have come up with just don't add up. Furthermore, the person that the police are accusing of the murder is a good friend of yours, so you'll do anything you can to find out the truth. Take Pictures Use your camera to collect evidence; take pictures of anything that seems important to the case. Organize Evidence See the evidence you collected in your journal, where you can organize and look at the pictures. Gather Clues Talk to people to try and find out what they know. But be careful, some might try to lie to you, and hide the truth. Get their testimonies and piece together the real story Solve the Case Build your case in the article and publish it to expose the true killer.

rows.name: Katharsi
rows.short_description: Katharsi is a puzzle adventure set in a corrupted Byzantine cathedral. With the help of your companion, cleanse and illuminate the path in front of you by harnessing the power of the light. Solve the puzzles that block your path and reveal the truth behind this story.
rows.description_html: Explore the depths of the cathedral on your mission to eradicate the plague in this puzzle adventure game. Make your way towards the final chamber as you uncover the mysteries behind your companion and the cathedral around you.  Key Features  Explore a Byzantine era cathedral which has been corrupted by the plague   Solve light-based puzzles and use the light to cleanse the cathedral   Work together with your companion to overcome obstacles  Reveal the truth behind the plague and your companion  About the Development Team  This game is being developed by a team of 15 third-year students at Breda University of Applied Sciences. The game will fully release in June. After the game's final update, this game will no longer be supported by the developers.

rows.name: Break-a-Bot
rows.short_description: Defend your spaceship in Break-a-Bot, a vibrant roguelike where you battle cyborg raiders and customize your playstyle by scavenging enemy parts. Swap body parts in fast-paced combat to adapt and survive. Protect your home and become the galaxy’s most fearsome little robot!
rows.description_html: Fast-Paced Roguelike Action Engage in electrifying high-speed combat that combines dynamic attacks and over the top, slapstick violence. With each run, adapt and evolve your playstyle as you discover new part combinations and upgrades to dominate increasingly tougher foes. Key Features Unique Part-Swapping System: Customize Zippy with scavenged body parts, unlocking endless possibilities for strategy and playstyle. Fast-Paced Combat: Dive into frantic, skill-based battles where every decision and every part counts. Dynamic Progression: Each run offers new challenges, upgrades, and surprises ensuring no two fights are ever the same.

rows.name: Umbra Mortis
rows.short_description: Rise children of the almighty and be guided to your salvation. You must trek a path of mud and blood, but if you walk it together, you will surely have enough strength to tear through these beasts. Grab two friends and shoot zombies in this Venice carnival inspired shooter.
rows.description_html: Rise up to your duty raven, foul magic has overtaken the beautiful city of Venice. We cannot let this stand. Venice must be purged. You will be tasked with going through the streets of the accursed city and erasing all that reeks of undeath. Serve well. The streets are full of them, for the carnival was taking place. Pay no heed to the enemy's numbers, for you will prevail. An odious miasma hangs in the air and has transformed all the celebrators into mindless husks of what they once were, free them from this hell so that the city can live on and grow old. Your task will take you all the way to the church, where you must call the horde upon yourself and deliver our god's fury to them. The subjects of your divine violence will be tenacious and maddened with starvation, you must never let your guard down. Through the possession, their bodies have deformed beyond recognition. Beware of the large ones and the partially disolved especially. This foul magic has made them resilient and formidable. It will be a battle hard-fought. But be not afraid for you are well equipped. You have at your disposal our finest weapons. The rifles we give you have been infused with prayer and the good will of our Lord, their bullets sear wicked flesh and purge evil souls. Our explosives carry in them the ashes of great saints, they tear skin and bone alike. But most of all, we give you a blessed artifact, one passed down through our organization. It heals the wounds of the righteous and brutalizes any heretic in its way. We wish you good luck warriors, may the light guide thee well. This game is a 3 player coop PvE shooter where you play as members of a secret organization, Umbra Mortis. You will go through the city of Venice which is overrun by undead carnival-goers.

rows.name: Oh, Bugger!
rows.short_description: ‘Oh, Bugger!’ is a first-person shooter set in a luxury space hotel overrun by alien hordes. As a professional alien exterminator, pilot your mech to blast aliens and destroy their eggs, ending the infestation for good!
rows.description_html: Oh, Bugger! is a single-player first-person shooter where you take on the role of a mech pilot on a mission to reclaim a luxury hotel overrun by an alien infestation. Set in a retro-futuristic hotel, the game combines intense combat, mech upgrades, and a visually striking environment to deliver a thrilling experience. Key Features Mech Combat: You are controlling a big mech suit with a massive mini-gun that can transform into a shotgun! With it, you mow down hordes of relentless aliens. Experience adrenaline-fueled action with satisfying gunplay and explosive effects. Customization: Upgrade the abilities that your mech has. Tailor your playstyle to dominate the battlefield. Retro-Futuristic Aesthetic: Immerse yourself in a visually stunning environment inspired by retro-futuristic sci-fi designs. From the posh lobby of the hotel to the eerie glow of alien nests – every detail enhances the atmosphere. Challenging Enemy Types: Face different alien threats, each one with unique behaviors. Strategize your approach to overcome every threat you face! Endless Mode: Explore the ship room by room in a new survival mode - face unending waves of aliens and see how long you can last! Unlock it after completing the campaign. About the Development Team Developed by third-year students at Breda University of Applied Sciences, Oh, Bugger! delivers intense action, strategic mech customization, and a uniquely stylized space environment for an unforgettable gaming experience.

rows.name: DREADTOME
rows.short_description: Enter a corrupt and hostile library with the task of extracting forbidden knowledge from its tomes. Triumph over the entities that linger within, in this short Action-Adventure FPS made by a team of third-year university students.
rows.description_html: Enter a corrupt and hostile library with the task of extracting forbidden knowledge from its tomes. Triumph over the entities that linger within, in this Action-Adventure FPS. DREADTOME is a short game made by a team of third-year university students. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Use your repulser, firearm, and environmental hazards in strategic ways to dispatch the corrupted creatures that roam the library. Overcome trials of the mind in order to upgrade your tools. Explore the labyrinthian library to replenish resources and uncover the story that unfolded before your arrival. Battle varying enemy types, each with their own unique dangers.

rows.name: Blightspire
rows.short_description: Blightspire is a fast-paced, wave-based survival shooter. Battle through a cursed graveyard as undead abominations rise in endless waves. With only your reflexes and firepower, survive the darkness in a world where death is never the end.
rows.description_html: Blightspire is a fast-paced, wave-based survival shooter. Battle through a cursed graveyard as undead abominations rise in endless waves. With only your reflexes and firepower, survive the darkness in a world where death is never the end. In a plague-stricken 17th-century, you’re a thief drawn to rumors of treasure buried in a cursed cemetery. As you rob the graves, the dead rise to defend what’s theirs. Fighting to survive, you uncover a demonic presence seeping from an ancient church altar, its influence twisting the dead and spreading corruption. Now, it’s not just about gold... it’s about stopping hell from breaking loose. Survive relentless waves of the undead as the Black Death twists the once-living into monstrous horrors. Dodge, dash, and leap through plague-ridden graveyards to avoid the infected swarms Use your trusty revolver to blast through the twisted remains of humanity Stay alive, and uncover the dark forces fueling the nightmare The deeper you go, the stranger it gets. Loot the fallen dead to fund powerful relics from a demonic source Absorb their lingering souls to restore your health and keep fighting Take advantage of the demonic presence in the graveyard and use the unholy relics to your advantage.

rows.name: Kitchen Wars: Appetiser
rows.short_description: Kitchen Wars: Appetiser is the limited first taste of a fast-paced party game with 2-8 players that plunge players into the chaos of a restaurant, where they must engage in strategic fights and theft while catering to their clients.
rows.description_html: Kitchen Wars: Appetiser is the prologue version of the full game Kitchen Wars . The Appetiser version is just a 60-minute gameplay of the full game. Serve your clients: Quickly prepare and deliver meals to keep customers happy. Purchase upgrades and items: Improve your kitchen, unlock boosters, and get the edge on your opponent. Attack the opposing restaurant: Use melee weapons to disrupt your rival's operations and steal their resources. Steal chairs: Sabotage the other restaurant by swiping their chairs, reducing their seating capacity. Upgrade your restaurant: Earn money from satisfied clients to invest in your kitchen and improve your chances of winning. Local Multiplayer Online Multiplayer Steam Remote Play

rows.name: Dice Making Ending
rows.short_description: Does rolling the dice determine a person's ending?At every crossroad, we've all wondered about this at least once.Enjoy a casual game where you roll the dice and watch endings unfold.You can play various endings in just a short amount of time.
rows.description_html: 🎲 Does Rolling the Dice Decide a Person's Ending? Dice Making Ending is a casual game designed to answer three questions you might have: Can life be determined by rolling a die? What if a game had no gameplay—only endings, like watching internet shorts? Would it still be fun? What kind of ending do I truly want? Features: Quick Play: While rolling the dice, you can experience the game at a fast pace. Anyone can enjoy it casually without pressure. Multiple Endings: Just like the many faces of a die, explore a variety of episodes and endings. A single person’s life can lead to countless possibilities—discover them all. Your Choice: What will your choice be? Ask yourself and find out. About the Developer bluestruggle is a one-person indie game development team creating games as a hobby. Making games is fun, but it also comes with its fair share of struggles. To all indie game developers out there—stay healthy and keep going! You got this! 💙✨

rows.name: Crestfall
rows.short_description: Jebait your way to victory in this turn-based game of capture the flag. All board pieces are hidden at the start and you must capture territory, deploy pieces and use special abilities to outmaneuver your opponent. Bluff, bait and blunder your way to glory.
rows.description_html: You have 60 seconds to set up your side of the board, then, the game begins Advance your way up the board, capturing territory Deploy your forces across a compact battlefield Attack and discover your opponent's pieces Unleash powerful supports to turn the tide of battle mid-game From air-striking your opponent's General to airlifting your Flag out of danger. Each piece has unique ranks and abilities letting you craft devious strategies to outmaneuver your opponent. Unlike traditional strategy games, you can continue deploying reinforcements throughout the match, adapting your tactics as your opponent's army is gradually revealed. Will you play it safe and defend, or risk it all on an aggressive push to capture the enemy's flag?

rows.name: CHASERS

Play your favorite characters and build your ultimate team. Master elemental affinities, real-time swaps, dodges, and skill combos to win!
rows.description_html: CHASERS is an Urban Fantasy Collectible RPG set against the conflict between the sky city of Aluna, which monopolizes the power of the sun, and the resistance forces of the surface, Line. Mediator, assemble your own team and join the battle! · Diverse Characters and Growth System Collect unique characters, develop their abilities, and strengthen your team. Experience the thrill of precise dodging and timing to turn the tide of battle. · Immersive Worldbuilding Explore the captivating story of Aluna and the resistance forces, uncovering secrets across diverse cities and mysterious locations. The journey to uncover the truth behind the sun's power awaits. · Variety of Game Content Enjoy main story missions, challenge modes, PvP battles, and mini-games! With monthly updates adding new events and characters, there’s always something to look forward to.

rows.name: Lost Age
rows.short_description: In the mystical world of Lost Age, darkness looms, and heroes rise to reclaim the light. Embark on a captivating adventure where card-based strategy meets the excitement of RPG. Collect and customize powerful heroes, explore magical realms, and tackle thrilling challenges—all at your own pace.
rows.description_html: In the mystical world of Lost Age, darkness looms, and heroes rise to reclaim the light. Embark on a captivating adventure where card-based strategy meets the excitement of RPG. Collect and customize powerful heroes, explore magical realms, and tackle thrilling challenges—all at your own pace. With idle mechanics, your journey continues even when you're offline, making Lost Age the perfect mix of relaxation and epic discovery. Key Features: Progress Anytime – Even When Offline! Your heroes continue their journey while you're away, gathering resources and battling enemies. Log in to collect rewards and watch your team grow stronger without constant effort. Use the fast-paced double-speed feature to push through stages quickly. Exciting Gameplay Variety – More Than Just Idle Battles! Explore a mix of gameplay modes, including tower defense, roguelike dungeons, cross-server battles, and pet-raising adventures. Whether you have a few minutes or an hour, Lost Age offers something fun and engaging to suit your schedule. Strategic Team Building – Synergize for Maximum Power Carefully select and customize heroes with complementary skills to create powerful synergies. The right hero combinations can make your team stronger and more effective in battles. Legendary Companions – Raise Mythical Pets Recruit legendary companions that provide powerful buffs and abilities, enhancing your heroes’ strength and helping you conquer tougher challenges. Social Features – Make Friends and Share the Adventure Join forces with other players to exchange tips, share rewards, and collaborate in battles. Build lasting friendships as you explore Lost Age together.

rows.name: What The Hack!
rows.short_description: What The Hack! Is a humoristic, story puzzle game, where you, a computer program, tries to avoid getting destroyed by escaping a facility. Doing so by hacking and hijacking devices in your surroundings.
rows.description_html: What The Hack! Is a humoristic, story puzzle game, where you, a computer program, tries to avoid getting destroyed by escaping a facility. Doing so by hacking and hijacking devices in your surroundings. You play as Boolian, a facility worker whose consciousness is unexpectedly zapped into a computer. Before you can even process what’s happened, a security drone begins checking for malware. With no time to waste, you tap into your newfound hacking abilities, taking control of various machines to escape, like a drone, a robot vacuum, or even a towering logistics crane as you maneuver through the facility. Embark on a thrilling adventure, outsmart the facility's defenses, and uncover creative ways to break free. But be careful—some of the robots you encounter might not be as friendly as they seem! Make use of the unique hacking mechanic, allowing you to traverse the level in creative ways. This game was made by 6 students as a group project assignment for their third year in the bachelor Digital Arts & Entertainment at Hogeschool West-Vlaanderen in Belgium. The music was composed by Joshua Mas, student at the Royal Conservatoire of Ghent

rows.name: Voice of the Ocean
rows.short_description: Voice of the Ocean is a single-player adventure about a lost world, and the echoes of a forgotten past. Use your voice to sing ancient melodies and explore a world lost beneath the waves. Dive into the depths to uncover the power within your song and learn why you may be the last of your kind.
rows.description_html: You've just come into a world already in ruins. You don't know who you are, and there's no one to tell you. Perhaps you are the last of your kind. It’s up to you, and the strength of your voice and fins, to piece together the past. Sing the forgotten songs, and uncover the echoes of a sunken, broken civilization.   Voice of the Ocean is the beginning of a single-player adventure where you will have to sing and swim. You will be a newborn mermaid, diving through ruins and looking for pieces of a long lost mural.  In the game you will: Sing to a living, handcrafted soundtrack. Use your voice to navigate the depths. Sing the melodies of your lost civilization, brought to life through an original score composed exclusively for the game by Jaime Fenoy Aguilera. You will have to hit the correct pitch using your voice, to charm fishes, move objects and sing the songs of the mermaids. Explore an unique artistic atmosphere. Dive into a forgotten world beneath the waves, with a traditional oil painting style brought to 3D. Swim through a vivid, impressionistic seascapes, poisoned by an uncertain past. You will be able to swim through ruins, buildings and areas reclaimed by nature. Recover the fragments of a hidden legacy. Part of the story of your people lies scattered across the deep. Unstructured and half-buried in a world that has forgotten it. Find the audio logs and the lost mural to reconstruct the past.    This game was created over the course of 11 weeks by third-year bachelor students from Howest - Digital Arts & Entertainment, with the invaluable contribution of our original soundtrack composer, Jaime Fenoy Aguilera as well as our animator Maxine Desmet. We would also like to extend our heartfelt thanks to our coordinators, Alex Vanden Abeele and Tristan Clarysse, for their support and trust in our vision.

rows.name: Mr. Photographer - Into The Light
rows.short_description: Stylized Platformer Game.
rows.description_html: Dive into the captivating world of 'Mr. Photographer - Into the Light' , an action-packed platformer where every moment challenges your wit, strategy, and skill. With no paywalls or in-game purchases, this is a pure test of talent, patience, and wisdom. Every game is a fresh start, and every adventure demands a unique approach. Are you ready to rise from an intern to a master photographer? A Strategic Platforming Adventure Embark on a journey across intricately designed levels, collecting essential photography gear and uncovering special items to aid your progression. From bounce cards to drones and event triggers, every piece you collect enhances your abilities and opens up new strategies. But be warned—there’s no save feature. Every game is a new adventure, with dynamic checkpoints you must activate using live-collected items. Fail to strategize, and you’ll start over. But plan wisely, and you’ll keep pushing forward. Your Drone: Friend or Foe? Meet your drone companion—a tool that can be as much a challenge as it is a helper. Colliding with it depletes your health and may even cost you a life. Yet, with the right collectable item, the remote , you can take control of your drone, turning it into a valuable ally. Jump on it to access hidden areas or solve complex platforming puzzles. However, just like real drones, it might get stuck behind obstacles, testing your patience and timing. Dynamic Gameplay Features Strategic Collectables : Gather unique items that enhance your gameplay and allow you to discover new paths and solutions. Checkpoints on Your Terms : Progress by activating checkpoints with collectables, but choose wisely to optimize your run. Variety and Challenge : Each playthrough is unique, requiring you to adapt your strategies and explore the full depth of the game’s mechanics. Skill-Based Design : Success depends on your creativity, skill, and the ability to think quickly under pressure. The Final Test: Into the Studio The ultimate goal? Reach the photography studio and prove your worth. Adjust your lighting, fine-tune your camera settings, and capture the perfect shots of a model. Submit your best photo to the game’s server, where players worldwide will vote on the top submissions. This is your moment to shine, to showcase not just your platforming prowess but also your artistic eye. Will your photo stand out above the rest? Why You’ll Love This Game Pure, Skill-Based Gameplay : No shortcuts, no pay-to-win mechanics—just your ingenuity and determination. Fast-Paced Action Meets Creative Challenge : Combine quick reflexes with strategic thinking and artistic expression. Endless Replayability : With no saves and unique runs every time, each game offers a fresh experience. Community Engagement : Compete with players worldwide in the photography challenge and see how your skills stack up. Rise to the challenge. Unleash your creativity. And become the master photographer you were destined to be.

rows.description_html: JBomb is an action-strategy game that combines elements of adventure, puzzles, and online cooperation. It offers players a diverse and engaging experience, featuring two main modes and a PvP option for direct competition. Campaign Mode: Explore unique worlds, each composed of five challenging levels and an epic boss battle. Strategically place bombs to navigate intricate mazes, eliminate enemies, and overcome obstacles along the way. Arena Mode: Team up with friends in a dynamic cooperative mode. Face endless waves of adversaries in an action-packed online arena, collect power-ups to enhance your abilities, and survive increasingly challenging foes. PvP Mode: Engage in thrilling player-versus-player battles with the PvP mode. Whether playing solo, collaborating with friends, or competing against other players, JBomb guarantees strategic and exciting gameplay! Credits Software engineers: Simone Di Berardino Cristian Di Berardino Contributors: Art work: Zarkeys

rows.name: Cat Rescue
rows.short_description: A desperate woman fights to rescue her cat from a paranoid streamer’s lair of twisted experiments, puzzles, and lurking horrors in this psychological thriller.
rows.description_html: Your beloved cat has been taken. In your desperate search, you uncover something far worse than you imagined, a paranoid streamer obsessed with esoteric experiments that disrupt electricity and WiFi. His lair is a maze of eerie tech, cryptic notes, and hidden horrors. And in the shadows, something watches. Play as a determined woman who will stop at nothing to rescue her cat from the clutches of this unstable streamer. Navigate his chaotic world, decipher his twisted mind through discarded notes and dropped keys, and unlock the secrets of the garage where he hides his captives. But every step closer to the truth draws you nearer to 'it,' a terrifying presence tied to his madness. Will you rescue your cat and uncover the truth, or will the darkness of his experiments consume you?

rows.description_html: Are you ready for the grand opening of Happy Furry Restaurant? Meet the adorable residents of the forest and run the restaurant until the day you become the legendary Chef King! Cook and Serve Food Take orders from customers and serve them delicious meals. Your fluffy employees and feathered, sleek, or even chitinous cooking tools are ready for your command. Don’t forget to offer warm encouragement—with the help of your brand-new whipping machine! Gather Ingredients A meat-loving customer placed an order, but you’re running low on ingredients? Open your hand wide and embrace the abundance of the forest. Keep Your Restaurant Clean Leaving your restaurant untidy can lead to serious issues: poor hygiene, tripping employees, or awkward stares from litter. Clean up in time! Deal with Complaints Is a customer upset because their food arrived late? A complimentary bottle of premium champagne might just calm them down—for good. Defend Your Restaurant With popularity comes jealousy and unwanted attention. Whether you choose to appease or fend off these threats is up to you… although not for long.

Defend Your Restaurant With popularity comes jealousy and unwanted attention. Whether you choose to appease or fend off these threats is up to you… although not for long.

rows.name: jumpo world
rows.short_description: run, jump & hide! get as far as possible in the bizarre world of jumpo world. you only have one life, make it count.
rows.description_html: warning: this game is hard. anything can and will kill you in this reaction-based platformer with randomly generated biomes & great variations of enemies and obstacles. only 10 players make it to the global leaderboard — a mark of ultimate skill and achievement. will you claim your spot at the top? in jumpo world the biomes ahead are randomly sequenced, meaning you never know which challenged you will be faced with next. discover the land by foot, on a horse, on a minecart, maybe even as a frog? No biome is like another, and there is never a guarantee on what you will travel with or what you will travel as.

rows.name: Grasshopper Collection
rows.short_description: Grasshopper Collection Collect more than 30+ grasshoppers and decorate your profile! Will be updated soon
rows.description_html: Catch grasshoppers and collect them all! Grasshopper Collection is a full-fledged grasshopper-catching simulation game where you can enjoy the thrill of not knowing which grasshopper will appear next in this collection-style game. Grasshoppers appear in the field, and with just your mouse and keyboard, you can catch them and store them in your Steam inventory. Each grasshopper has its own rarity. Every time you catch one, you’ll receive an item based on the following probabilities: Common: 90% Rare: 4.5% Epic: 0.49% Legendary: 0.01% Collect them all and show off your collection on our official Discord! 👉

rows.name: Christmas Infinity
rows.short_description: Christmas is getting closer and Santa needs more gifts, always more gifts. Time to get the elves to do his bidding. But one Christmas after another, it'll never be enough.
rows.description_html: The Ultimate Holiday Clicker Adventure! In Christmas Infinity , you step into the magical role of Santa's right-hand helper, tasked with crafting an endless supply of gifts. Gather resources like wood , metal , and paint , and transform them into delightful presents for kids and adults worldwide. But there's a twist—this isn't just about making toys. As you progress, you unlock upgrades, hire industrious elves, and build a seamless production line, automating the holiday magic. And when the big day arrives? Prestige by gifting all your creations to spread Christmas cheer, earning powerful bonuses to make next year's operation even more efficient. The magic of Christmas truly never ends! Story It's Christmas Eve, and Santa has been thrown into chaos. A cosmic snowstorm scattered the North Pole's workshop and scattered its magic! To save Christmas, you must rebuild the toy-making empire from scratch. Using your creativity, resourcefulness, and a little holiday spirit, you’ll rally elves, improve your workshop, and unlock the secrets of an infinite Christmas season. Every Christmas Eve, the world awaits your gifts—don’t let them down! Features 🎅 Gather Resources Chop wood, mine metal, and mix paint to create the building blocks of every toy. 🎄 Craft Endless Gifts Combine materials to create an ever-growing list of toys, from simple wooden trains to high-tech gadgets. 🛠️ Upgrade Your Workshop Enhance your tools and unlock cutting-edge machinery to boost efficiency. 🎁 Hire Elves Employ hardworking elves to automate your operations. 🔄 Prestige System Deliver your gifts to the world every Christmas and gain magical bonuses for the next season. ✨ Holiday Spirit Upgrades Earn perks like faster crafting, more efficient elves, and festive new decorations. 🎶 Festive Soundtrack Immerse yourself in the holiday spirit with cheerful, heartwarming tunes. Will You Save Christmas Forever? Start small, dream big, and craft an endless holiday season in Christmas Infinity ! Are you ready to become Santa’s ultimate helper and ensure that Christmas joy never fades? Download now and experience the infinite charm of holiday cheer! 🎅✨

rows.name: Recoil Control: The Adventures of Rico Ché
rows.short_description: A low-poly first-person shooter with challenging combat, realistic bullet-drop physics, and cartoony characters. Navigate a foggy urban lot, solve puzzles to uncover secrets, and face quirky foes with bold personalities. Can you crack the mystery of Hobbe’s Gun Shop?
rows.description_html: This free base game includes the first playable chapter. Future chapters will be released as paid DLC Step into the shoes of Rico Ché, a rising sharpshooter on a mission! In the atmospheric depths of a shadowy city, danger lurks at every turn. Outsmart your adversaries as you unravel the secrets hidden around Hobbe’s Gun Shop. Arm yourself with a variety of weapons to gain the upper hand—but beware, your enemies are more dangerous than they appear! Outside Hobbe’s Gun Shop The most renowned gun store in the city, Hobbe’s Gun Shop serves everyone—from first-time buyers to veteran marksmen perfecting their craft. But beneath its unassuming storefront lies a deeper mystery. Rumored to be a covert training ground, its secrets are yours to uncover—if you can find a way inside. From behind the gates of the parking lot, behold the bustling city streets, where random passersby roam and cars cruise through the fog-drenched night, bringing the world to life. Parking Lot Dwellers The characters strolling in Hobbe’s Parking Lot may seem friendly —until you give them a reason not to be. From the casual citizens to the sharp-eyed security guard and the deadly Gunslinger, there’s plenty to deal with. Enjoy their quirky lines and bold personalities, but don’t get too close—the Sharpshooter isn’t one to miss. The Derelict Gate A shadowy fence stands tall beside Hobbe’s Gun Shop, locked tight and long forgotten by the bustling city around it. Its origins are unclear, but those with ambition and resourcefulness seem to have claimed the area for their own pursuits. What secrets lie behind the gate? Perhaps the answer isn’t what you expect—but those willing to explore might just uncover the tools they need to make progress. Gear up and dive in—will you uncover the secret behind Hobbe’s Gun Shop?

rows.name: Xalos Conquest
rows.short_description: Awaken my Xalos, the Venishien Empire calls for you! Conquer Earth against the Egyptians and Romans with our robotic might. As Sci-Fi meets Medieval in a epic top-down side-scroller war!
rows.description_html: Imagine a reality where strange metallic beings suddenly fall from the sky with strange deadly weapons, and all you can defend yourself with are swords and bows. This unknown and powerful threat is something Egypt and the Roman Empire must soon face. Our adventure begins as Xalos, a Venishien war machine! Where sci-fi meets medieval, experience a epic clash between Xalos, Cleopatra, and Caesar in a top-down side-scroller. Play as Xalos as you charge into combat and summoning your robot army as you duke it out against the mighty soldiers of Egypt and Rome!  Featuring: 3 main gameplay levels 2 classes and upgrades to choose from high quality voice acting cutscenes with voice acting dialogue The goal of this is to bring a short but memorable experience as you play in a spare hour or lunch break.

rows.name: CSC
rows.short_description: Challenge yourself in this tiny and incredible game!
rows.description_html: CSC is a simple platformer game where your small, square friend must dodge enemies and obstacles to reach the green substance. This game is so tiny that it’s almost hard to see, which is part of its charm. By default, the game’s resolution is extremely low. If you start the game and are greeted by a screen as tiny as a speck of dust, don’t worry—that’s completely normal. Test your skills in this amazing game! Controls Move : A, D Jump : Spacebar Tips If you want to make this game a bit easier and more playful, try lowering your computer’s resolution for a better experience.

rows.name: FleshBound
rows.short_description: FleshBound is a fast paced and blood pumping demon-slaying speed running first person action platformer with a unique “splatterpunk” aesthetic. Fight, jump and sprint your way through the levels using your hookshot and wall-running skills.
rows.description_html: FleshBound is a fast paced and blood pumping demon-slaying speed running action platformer with a unique “splatterpunk” aesthetic. Traverse unique and dangerous environments by utilizing abilities like dash, wall-run and grapple.  Explore the environment vertically through launchpads and see the world from a different perspective through the gravity inverters. Slay vile demons all along the way.  You play as Endo, a human incarcerated inside the fleshy walls of a living prison in hell, the Manifold. The sentence is harsh: be cocooned in place and slowly morph into a demon. One day a parasite attaches itself to Endo and begins communicating with him, offering a chance to escape his prison. Run! Key Features 15-20 minutes of playtime with high replayability A first person action runner in an organic-looking hellscape environment Dynamic traversal through grappling hook, wall run, jump pad, and gravity inversion mechanics A minimalistic gameplay UI A unique intense aesthetic inspired by punk, horror, comics, and older first person shooters A high intensity industrial metal and techno soundtrack Where did the game come from? FleshBound was developed during a 7 week project at FutureGames. Taking inspiration from games like Mirror's Edge , Ghostrunner , and Doom , we sought a fast, simple game loop where the challenge lies in mastering the balance between maintaining speed and control. Leaning heavily on the design pillars of 'Velocity, Visuals and Viscera', we quickly formulated the concept and with a visual style we can only describe as 'Splatterpunk', the vision of the game was easily communicated both within the team and with external stakeholders. The Team See game website link for contact information. rows.name: Moldbreaker: Rise of the Loaf
rows.short_description: Embark on a moldy adventure in a land of bread. Play as Bradley the Breadapus, a waffle-tailed bread platypus, in this quirky action platformer and battle to cleanse a world infected by mold. Break the mold, save the world!
rows.description_html: The Bread Kingdom is crumbling ! A sinister Mold is spreading, threatening to consume every loaf and crumb. Step into the crust of Bradley, a brave breadapus, as he rises to save his world. Explore vibrant breadscapes and venture deep into the luscious bread forests, the rumored source of the moldy infestation. Join Bradley, a brave bread hero with a waffle tail, as he embarks on a daring quest to save the Bread Kingdom! Traverse three, short but loafy , platforming levels, battling creeping mold and cleansing the kingdom’s infected inhabitants before they’re lost forever. Can you stop the rise of the Mold Kingdom and restore the realm of doughy delights? The fate of the Bread Kingdom lies in your flour-covered paws! Battle enemies, upgrade your kit, and uncover secrets in your quest to knead the kingdom back together. Upgrade Bradley with Yeasts of Power to gain that extra edge against the mold. These powers might help you find various collectables in this unique bready world. Get Yeasts of Power to upgrade your breadapus.  Collect various collectables hidden in the levels.  Can you help Bradley rise to the occasion, or will the Mold reign supreme? This game was made by a team of 19 passionate students in the span of 12 weeks. As part of our Bachelor program at the Rotterdam University of Applied Sciences in The Netherlands. We are a collection of students from different majors, making our very first game together under the studio name 'Silly Business'!

rows.name: Kimochii Classroom
rows.short_description: Welcome to Kimochii Classroom! A slice-of-life visual novel with stunning visuals, a beautiful soundtrack, and an immersive story. Who will you meet first?
rows.description_html: Hi hi~! This is Akemi signing on! Welcome to my new game, Kimochii Classroom! A free, slice-of-life visual novel with stunning visuals, a beautiful soundtrack, and an immersive story. Filled to the brim with personality, Kimochii Classroom offers a loveable cast of characters and a meticulously crafted soundscape to bring the world to life! You will follow Simon, a second-year high school student, and his day-to-day life with his friends, coworkers, and little sister. Every day Simon goes to school, works at his secret part-time job, and studies at home with his best friend Anna. Everything seems normal until Simon comes across a strange object that belongs to his classmate, Felicia. He doesn't know it yet, but he's stumbled into something much more complicated than he realizes. Get to know the characters! Annabelle - Annabelle, or 'Anna,' is Simon's best friend, and a classmate of his in class 201. Her outgoing and cheeky personality keeps Simon on his toes, and makes every day enjoyable! Anna is also super close with Chiko, so much so that many people think they're sisters! Chiko - Chiko is Simon's little sister! She may be small, but she packs enough energy for everyone around her! On top of her already immaculate cooking skills, Chiko is practicing hard every day to become an amazing singer and guitar player at her school's light music club! Felicia - Felicia is another member of class 201 with Simon. She's known for her stunning looks and perfect grades, but Felicia is also known for being the heiress to the Arison corporation, a massive company with lots of influence! Mayuka - 'Mayu' is a bartender and Simon's coworker at the 'Tumultuous Tap,' a local bar establishment Simon works at part-time. Mayu is excellent at being professional, but often likes to show off her more playful and teasing side, like when Simon is around! I can't wait for you to meet and get to know all of my new characters, I hope you have fun~! This has been Akemi, signing out!

rows.name: I`m not spider
rows.short_description: A 2D platform game, by dragging the character's corner to climb upward, the character's feet can be glued to some platforms, intended to test the player's ability to control the mouse
rows.description_html: This is my first game after teaching myself how to make a game 'I'm not spider' is a 2D platform class small game, players need to observe the rules of the platform, by dragging the limbs of the character to climb on a platform, to challenge their own control of the mouse!

rows.name: A Realm of Eternity
rows.short_description: A Realm of Eternity is a clicker Game, in which you click captivating Waifus & Husbandos! Every 30 minutes you get dropped a new Char. Each Char is inspired by the community on our discord. Come hang out with us and let's grow into something more awesome!
rows.description_html: 🦄 A Realm of Eternity In a distant universe lies the enchanting Realm of Eternity , where legendary beings—known as 'Eternals'—exist in various forms, personalities, and realms of power. These Eternals, who manifest as captivating waifus and husbandos, have been bound to this magical world by their unique gifts and talents, waiting for the right person to appreciate and cherish them. Players are known as “Seekers,” individuals blessed with the ability to journey into Eternia and connect with these Eternals. Eternals exist across five mystical rarity levels, each with unique traits: Rare : Compassionate companions who bring loyalty and warmth, enhancing the Seeker's experience. Ultra Rare : Mysterious beings who hold secrets and stories that unfold with each interaction. Legendary : Powerful allies from ancient lineages, possessing abilities that inspire awe and respect. Ragnarök : Guardians of Eternia with intense powers and rare wisdom, sought after by every Seeker. Otherworldly : Mythical figures believed to be pure legends, gracing only the most dedicated Seekers with their presence. 🥷 As Seekers, players will Call Eternals to Join : With every click, Seekers reach deeper into Eternia, drawing in Eternals who hear their call. Each character has a unique personality, backstory, and interactive elements that make them a cherished addition to the collection. Strengthen Bonds : Every Eternal added to the collection brings “Glory Points” and personal lore, allowing Seekers to learn about their history, likes, and quirks. These bonds grow stronger over time, unlocking rare items, special moments, and new insights into Eternia’s history. Engage in the Eternal Marketplace : Through the Steam marketplace, Seekers can trade and connect, exchanging waifus and husbandos to diversify their collections and share with other Seekers. 🚀 Join us on the journey Each Char is inspired by the community on our discord. Come hang out with us and let's grow into something more awesome!

rows.name: Delivery & Beyond
rows.short_description: No packages? No problem! Break in, scrap, deliver... A chaotic online co-op game for up to 5 players!
rows.description_html: Discord About the Game Congratulations, employeen! You just joined &Beyond, the only delivery company bold enough to leave the job description blank. You wanted benefits? You got 'em. You wanted details? Too bad. Now grab your next delivery contract and get to work! PROP SURF (It's not a bug, it's a feature) Bridges? Too slow. Ladders? For cowards. With PhysTech's Prop Surfing System , every random piece of junk becomes a high-speed launch vehicle. File cabinets, barrels, office chairs... If you can stand on it, you can surf it straight across the abyss. SCRAP Scrap first, ask questions later. Anything that isn't nailed down is raw material: Tables, chairs, electronics, junk... DELIVER Throw scrap in, pull out a delivery. Delivery Maker 3000 doesn't ask questions... and neither do we. Get it done, pay off your debt... or don't, and find out how much we love failure.

rows.name: Rabolut: Escape From Hell
rows.short_description: A 2D pixel art game where you escape crises born in a toxic workplace. With semi-randomized maps and an increasing variety of traps as you progress, players must master movement techniques and carefully plan the use of limited resources to survive. Perfect for fans of Celeste and Getting Over It.
rows.description_html: RABOLUT: Escape From Hell  is a 2D pixel art game where you escape crises born in a toxic workplace. With semi-randomized maps and an increasing variety of traps as you progress, players must master movement techniques and carefully plan the use of limited resources to survive. Upgrading equipment can significantly lower the difficulty, making it easier for story-focused players to enjoy the narrative. For fans of platforming challenges, the endless mode provides an opportunity to test your limits. Perfect for fans of Celeste and Getting Over It with Bennett Foddy, this game combines a compelling story with skill-based gameplay. However, as the story touches on themes of workplace manipulation and PUA (Pick-Up Artist) tactics, players with related sensitivities should approach with caution.

rows.name: Action Game Course
rows.short_description: This action-packed game is the result of the Action Game Course by UNF Games—a complete beginner-to-pro game development training using Unreal Engine 5. This project showcases exactly what you'll build step by step in the course.
rows.description_html: This action-packed game is the result of the Action Game Course by UNF Games—a complete beginner-to-pro game development training using Unreal Engine 5. This project showcases exactly what you'll build step by step in the course. The Game: Fight your way through waves of enemies, master combat mechanics, and push your skills to the limit as you take down the final boss. The gameplay focuses on fast-paced melee combat, simple AI, skill-based attacks, and survival tactics. Learn by Doing Master game development Up to 10x faster than the average learner! Build an action game from scratch with real industry workflows, guided by developers with over 10 years of experience. Our step-by-step system takes you from total beginner to publishing-ready, covering everything from AI and combat systems to bug fixing and Steam release. Join hundreds of learners who’ve transformed their skills through our hands-on projects and lifetime access to expert updates. By the end of the course, you'll not only understand Unreal Engine—you’ll be able to create a full game and publish it on Steam. With live training, continuous updates, and an active support community, you're never learning alone.

rows.name: Nigudin really fought against Furong Wangyuan
rows.short_description: brief introductionNicotine vs. Furong Wangyuan 'is a brain pumping game that takes place in a fantasy world called' Litang County '. Players will play as' Ding Zhen ', defeat Furong Wangyuan, and gradually uncover the truth about their ability to manipulate the level of Sharp Cut 5
rows.description_html: Go through the plot like reading a novel, and then choose an option to achieve a good ending Nicotine vs. Lotus Source The light of domestic production in the new era! Let's manipulate Ruike Wu together and enter the world of Ding Zhen, defeat Furong Wangyuan to dominate this world! Anyway, it's a free game that makes you laugh for half an hour. Why not? Background of the story Litang County is a place where humans and animal mothers coexist. Litang's technology has been ahead of human civilization for fifty years, and as Ding Zhen, you are the god prophesied by Litang's prophets. A god who can swallow clouds and smoke will lead Litang to the world, training troops and suppressing bandits in your hometown to support your younger brother's college education. However, your younger brother is being bullied in the city by others. Angry, you come to the city to seek revenge on Wang Yuan Gameplay Defeat the Furong King Source according to the options to achieve victory, explore the ability to manipulate the Sharp Cut Level 5, and defeat the enemy with the correct method Game Features The game has 20 endings, 183 CG images, an amazing Litang Divine Comedy, and my own abstract voice acting (which can be turned off in the settings) The characters, locations, items, and all elements appearing in the game are purely fictional, and any similarities are purely coincidental Afterwards, I will continue to develop new works to perfect this vast worldview

rows.name: 困兽TrappedBeast
rows.short_description: Detective Iver investigates the case of a missing girl. As the investigation deepens, Iver is unable to escape and the secrets behind it are slowly being revealed. Can they escape from that crazy world
rows.description_html: Background of the story: Detective Iver investigates the case of a missing girl, and as the investigation deepens, he gets closer and closer to the truth. Unexpectedly, Iver is also in the hands of a mysterious organization, waiting for him to overcome the perilous situation. Can he get rid of all of this. Gameplay elements: The game is a third person action genre that includes shooting, melee, and puzzle solving. There are different types of enemies in the game, and using different weapons can achieve twice the result with half the effort Find weapons and ammunition to strengthen your arsenal Search for different types of medication packs to restore blood volume or physical fitness Maps can facilitate finding a way out Collect task notes to understand the background of the story Be careful of some traps Use keys, passwords, etc. to unlock the corresponding levels Author's supplement: This is a game that I personally created during my leisure time At present, the first chapter has been completed, and the plan is to complete it into three chapters, which will be gradually updated in the future The game is completely free, please do not use it for commercial purposes I am very grateful that everyone is willing to take the time to play, and I will listen carefully to everyone's opinions. Although time is limited, I will fix bugs as soon as I have time Game Play Recording： You can search for my name on YouTube  @linzhilong-cn

rows.name: Confluence: An Of Sense and Soul Soliloquy
rows.short_description: A poet ponders queer life and love after his happily ever after.
rows.description_html: Story Confluence (noun): a coming or flowing together, meeting, or gathering at one point; the joining of two rivers. In the epilogue of his happy ending, Hugo waxes poetic on the scale of his life and love and how, wondrously, the littlest of things can also be the most precious. About A short kinetic novel spin-off from Forsythia Productions' Of Sense and Soul , a Queer Victorian Romance Visual Novel.  Confluence  was created during the O2A2 (Only One of Any Asset) VN Game Jam: Queer Edition 2023 . Features An emotional reflection on personal growth through love and change. 8-15 minutes of playtime Full voice acting One sprite, one soundtrack, and one background Dynamic cinematography and effects Gay thoughts 🌈 💭✨ English with Japanese Localisation Content & Spoiler Warnings Confluence  takes place after the events of  Of Sense and Soul , and contains vague references to the best ending in which Hugo and Seamus are in a relationship.  No OSAS plot events are detailed in Confluence, and you can still enjoy this without knowing the main story. Rated G.  Motion: Animations for a rotating background and cinematography are used. References The Ugly Duckling by Hans Christian Andersen.  Major themes include queer belonging, change, personal growth, and hope.

rows.name: Couple Maker
rows.short_description: This is a puzzle game where you create couples. Place panels with various effects on a 3x3 grid and help two people in love meet. You can freely choose the combination of couples, such as male-female, male-male, or female-female.
rows.description_html: Overview This is a puzzle game where you create couples. Place panels with various effects on a 3x3 grid and help two people in love meet. You can freely choose the combination of couples, such as male-female, male-male, or female-female. Strong Puzzle Elements We have prepared a total of 76 levels, ranging from easy to difficult. Each level has a specific number of characters, their arrangement, and the number and types of panels. The level is cleared when all the characters on the field are paired up. Each level has been designed with a focus on making the puzzle-solving experience enjoyable. Instead of simply increasing the number of similar levels to inflate the game's volume, we have adjusted the levels to ensure that each one offers a unique and engaging challenge. While the time it takes to clear all the levels may vary depending on the player, it is estimated that it will take around 10 hours to complete all levels. Support for Various Genders By default, the game pairs boys and girls together, but you can change this setting from the options menu to allow for same-gender pairings, such as boys with boys or girls with girls. Additionally, there are more detailed settings available for further customization. Story The protagonist is a woman in pajamas, as seen in the main visual. Her profession is a romance novel writer. When brainstorming ideas for her stories, she never skips a mental simulation. In her mind, she creates couples, has them converse, go on dates, and be affectionate with each other, using these imagined scenarios to expand her story ideas. This game, a puzzle about creating couples, is a representation of her daydreams (or rather, her job to earn a living). Let's try playing on a smartphone or tablet With the Remote Play feature, you can play this game on your smartphone or tablet. Instead of using arrow keys or ABXY buttons, you can control the game with just taps and drags. Every once in a while, why not take a break from your computer and relax in bed, playing on your smartphone? Streaming Policy Play videos and screenshots of 'Couple Maker' can be used on SNS, blogs, and video posting sites as long as they do not violate public order and morals or laws. Feel free to monetize it. Please keep promoting it!

rows.name: Symphone
rows.short_description: Symphone is a narrative platformer where you play as Euphony, a voiceless bunny, who must collect lost souls, overcome obstacles, and bring light and harmony back to her world.
rows.description_html: Symphone is a platformer set in a once-vibrant world now consumed by a mysterious force known as 'The Silence.' This dark power steals the voices of the creatures of Symphone, turning them into lost souls wandering aimlessly. Play as Euphony, a unique bunny without a voice, on a quest to collect these souls and restore the music and light that once filled the forest. Journey through a desolate, bioluminescent world, overcoming obstacles, and dodging threats to free the souls trapped by 'The Silence.' Each soul you collect brings Euphony closer to completing the final symphony, a powerful melody capable of banishing the darkness once and for all. Key Features: Platforming Action – Jump, dodge, and explore a beautiful yet haunting forest. Emotional Story – Experience a touching narrative about loss, restoration, and hope. Atmospheric Music – Enjoy a captivating soundtrack that follows you throughout the world. Bioluminescent World – Stunning visual style with glowing environments that come to life as you restore balance. Challenging Obstacles – Face environmental challenges and enemies in your journey to save the world from The Silence. Help Euphony restore harmony to Symphone and bring light back to her world. Will you be the one to end The Silence?

rows.name: Espresso Economics
rows.short_description: Coffee shop management game that teaches economics. Manage your own coffee shop and make money. During the day you serve orders at your coffee shop, during the night you manage it using economics principles like demand and supply curves, labour market, externalities etc.
rows.description_html: Coffee shop management game that teaches economics Manage your own coffee shop and make money. During the day you serve orders at your coffee shop, during the night you manage it using economics principles like demand and supply curves, labour market, externalities etc. Game has 3 levels of cafes, variety of coffee types and a lot of mechanics to manage your shop.

rows.name: 2024: Mosaic Retrospective
rows.short_description: 2024: Mosaic Retrospective is a charity-fundraising picross/minesweeper hybrid featuring a single ENORMOUS puzzle inspired by global news stories from throughout the year.
rows.description_html: 🧩 2024: Mosaic Retrospective is digital cross-stitch . A meditative game about completing a single enormous  60,000 piece grid puzzle. 🖼️ In this entry   in the Mega Mosaic series, you'll slowly reveal a pixel art collage of major news events from the last year, ranging from politics to sport, climate change to pop culture. 💣 If you’re familiar with minesweeper, you’re ready to dive in! Use the numbered clues (0-9) to uncover light tiles that gradually reveal an intricate, detailed mosaic. 🎶 Whether you're engrossed in your favourite podcasts or listening to your favourite tunes, 2024: Mosaic Retrospective serves as the perfect backdrop to enhance your experience. Or choose from the soothing built-in soundtrack. ⏳ Dozens of Hours of Addictive Gameplay!  2024: Mosaic Retrospective offers hours of meditative, yet challenging gameplay as you piece together the events that shaped the year. If you like this free game, please consider supporting the UNICEF fundraiser that the game is supporting! You can find the link to the fundraiser in the settings menu within the game.
