rows.name: ReSpaced
rows.short_description: A fast-paced first-person shooter where you master gun recoil to leap across platforms, battle various enemies, and upgrade your weapon to escape an overrun space station.
rows.description_html: Step into the role of Proband 027, a test subject fighting for survival aboard a space station overrun by hostile entities. Your goal? Escape the station by clearing each room, while mastering unique mechanics that turn your gun into more than just a weapon. Battle Through Enemy-Infested Rooms! Face a relentless horde of threats determined to stop you at every turn. Your goal is simple: eliminate every enemy to unlock the safety doors and advance. But be ready... Each room introduces new challenges and enemy types that demand strategy, speed, and quick reflexes. Turn Recoil Into Power! Your gun isn’t just for shooting, it’s your key to mobility. The gun’s powerful recoil can launch you to hard-to-reach platforms or propel you away from danger. Master this unique mechanic to gain the upper hand and navigate the station in ways no normal jump could ever achieve. Upgrade and Adapt! Clearing the room unlocks the upgrade machine, where you can modify your weapon. Want faster reloads? Do more damage? Customize your gun to suit your playstyle, but beware, some upgrades comes with trade-offs. Choose wisely to prepare for the increasingly difficult challenges ahead. Survive. Adapt. Escape. Re:Spaced is an intense experience where every shot counts, every upgrade matters, and every room brings you closer to freedom. Do you have what it takes to make it out alive?

Customize your gun to suit your playstyle, but beware, some upgrades comes with trade-offs. Choose wisely to prepare for the increasingly difficult challenges ahead. Survive. Adapt. Escape. Re:Spaced is an intense experience where every shot counts, every upgrade matters, and every room brings you closer to freedom. Do you have what it takes to make it out alive?

rows.name: The Nutcracker of Riepass (Nymph's Tale ep 2)
rows.short_description: A fantasy comedy hybrid visual novel with jrpg battles
rows.description_html: A YA fantasy comedy hybrid visual novel with turn-based jrpg battles. Part 2 of the Nymph's Tale series, but can also be played as a standalone. Story rich with (skippable) battles between the scenes and optional minigames. FEATURES: -epic adventure, comedy and romance -custom anime art -beautiful pixel art maps -battles where you can affect how difficult you want them to be with optional items -4 characters with unique skills and strategy -optional minigames -total playtime 2-3 hours The gameplay consist of cutscenes that advance the story and a number of fights between them. The battles feature an ATB-wait turned based system and offer challenging adversaries. The difficulty can be adjusted by choosing to use optional items. All the battles can be skipped if you just want to follow the story. A young man embarks on a quest to find the woman of his dreams, but instead runs into the woman's angry little sister. Together they must travel the hostile frozen wastes to reach the home city of the mysterious race living in the mountains. The route is filled with terrible monsters, but are the monsters really what the young man should be fearing? Adventure awaits in the frozen mountain lands!

rows.name: Nephilim
rows.short_description: Battle Angels and Demons alike as Strider Lazarus -  a fighter born again to master Darkness and Light - in this student-made isometric combat game.
rows.description_html: Nephilim is a student-made isometric combat and exploration game set in a dying fantasy land. As Strider Lazarus, you'll learn to master both Light and Shadow to vanquish the foes standing in your path. Switch between the Light and the Dark worlds to empower your abilities, get over obstacles and solve puzzles.  Fight Angels and Demons alike using all the tools in your arsenal! You'll need to master everything to defeat the game's many bosses. Fast and Charged attacks Special unlockable combos Powerful Light and Dark Ultimate Abilities Holy Sword Summon Speed is of the essence. Move quickly to evade attacks, Health Potions can run out quick! Keep your eyes peeled for Upgrade Gems. Each one takes you one step closer to being to ultimate warrior. Invest them at Bonfires to increase Strider Lazarus' stats and to unlock new combos, attacks and special abilities! Nephilim was made over 4 months by a team of six developers and features an original soundtrack by Nerveight .

rows.name: Caveman hits Giraffe in a Car
rows.short_description: Slash, survive and get tougher - a wacky action roguelike with hand-drawn graphics and a caveman on the hunt for monsters! Just when you think you've seen it all, here it comes: a giraffe in a car.
rows.description_html: Slash, survive and get tougher - a wacky action roguelike with hand-drawn graphics and a caveman on the hunt for monsters! Just when you think you've seen it all, here it comes: a giraffe in a car. Features: Fight against 5 unique, hand-drawn opponents with different abilities. The waves are randomly generated and follow a sophisticated difficulty system that pits you against increasingly more and tougher opponents. Improve your skills after each completed round and adapt them to your play style. Use powerful abilities to gain an advantage - whether you're escaping from tricky situations or planning the perfect attack. Too easy? In hard mode , you have to make strategic decisions: Do you heal yourself or improve your skills? Compare your high scores with other players on our leaderboard . Why does the caveman hit the giraffe in the car? The caveman doesn't like technology :(

rows.name: Revival and Exploration
rows.short_description: Revival and Exploration is an oriental simulation game. Decorate your town with diverse landscapes and buildings, recruit residents to live in, and build a thriving city! You can also lead armed residents on traveling to different landscapes such as grassland, desert, snow, and volcanoes.
rows.description_html: Build Your Town From a Ruin As your city rivals, the appearance of the buildings will change—from thatched huts to grand mansions, from deserted place to thriving town. Try to use the unique ancient Oriental-style landscape to build up a staggering, prosperous, and lively paradise! Peace Life with Diverse Residents Recruit a variety of classes and different-looking residents! The characters you recruit will live in your city and take up different activities. As your city grows, you can recruit more people to join this city. Every day you'll see them strolling the streets, chatting with each other, or working hard. There are time and weather systems in the game, forming a dynamic cityscape! Craft Equipment, Develop Trade Trade with merchants for resources to upgrade your city! Residents with crafting abilities can create a wide variety of equipment. These armaments can be equipped for your residents to make it easier to defeat enemies when they explore, but also can be traded as commodities. Use earnings to upgrade your building and create a prosperous business center! Vast Map, Free Exploration Seamless maps are available for free exploration! Command your residents to explore the wild, gather resources, or fight for treasure. Train your residents, and lead them deeper into the mists to fight stronger enemies, spreading your name across the entire continent!

rows.short_description: Here, you can fill colors on fun patterns and doodle freely. Come and relax!
rows.description_html: Here is a simple and relaxing coloring and doodling game, featuring many fun and cute patterns. You can freely fill them with colors and doodle however you like. Come and relax! ——Game Features—— Relaxing and casual gameplay A variety of fun patterns to choose from Hand-drawn art style Soothing background music ——Game Controls—— Click on the toolbar on the left to choose your tool The toolbar includes paint bucket, paintbrush, spray can, eraser, and zoom. You can adjust the size of the paintbrush and spray can. Use the mouse wheel to zoom in and out of the canvas Hold the right mouse button to drag the canvas Click the left and right arrow buttons to undo and redo steps Click the reset button at the bottom left to reset the canvas

rows.name: Infinity R
rows.short_description: Welcome to Infinity R, an IDLE where the road is endless, the drops are regular, and the only thing standing between you and victory is... well, a bunch of pesky tolls and a never-ending fuel gauge!
rows.description_html: Race through voxel tracks that go on forever, collecting regular item drops as you go—unless a toll or lack of fuel decides to slow you down. But don’t worry, you’re in control! Simply click to clear those annoying tolls or refuel your car when the gas light’s on. The faster you click, the sooner you get back on track, with those sweet drops just around the corner. No upgrades, no fancy power-ups—just you, your car, and the satisfaction of clicking your way through each obstacle. The car may slow down now and then, but who said you can’t have fun while waiting? Perfect for the IDLE player who loves a little challenge, a lot of clicks, and zero pressure. So, ready to fuel up and drive toward your next drop? Infinity R is waiting! Drop statistics: Start at 2KM, then increase by 1.6 times each successful drop Drop chances are 1 out of 12 from the game Every 10 successful drops, ratio start from the base again Common: 70%, Uncommon 19.9%, Rare 6.8%, Epic 2.8%,  Legendary 0.5% Maximum 20 drops per day, Minimum 2 Minutes of playtime required to receive drops

rows.name: Lightmatter Anniversary
rows.short_description: Join us for a walk down memory lane with never-before-released Lightmatter prototypes. Get a peak behind the game design curtains and learn how we made a first-person puzzle game about lights and shadows.
rows.description_html: Celebrate the 5-year anniversary of Lightmatter with us! Join us for a walk down memory lane with 9 playable Lightmatter prototypes — spanning from 2013 to 2018! From its early inception as a university project called 'See You On The Other Side', to the full Steam release in 2020, we want to give something back to the community by providing an exclusive peak into the many iterations that Lightmatter went through to see the light of day! Use lights and shadows to solve mind-bending puzzles Lightmatter is a 3D puzzle game where touching shadows is dangerous. Drawing inspiration from the classic first-person puzzlers, the gameplay revolves around utilizing lights to your advantage in order to solve mind-bending puzzles. As the prototypes demonstrate, we experimented with a lot of different gameplay mechanics about how to manipulate light in interesting ways. But the core goal was always the same: make the player experience the satisfying 'aha moment' by using lateral thinking. Play through a gallery of 9 prototypes and learn about the game's development Each of the prototypes tell the story of the many trials and tribulations we went through as an indie game studio in order to release our very first game on Steam. As a completely new team, we had to learn everything from scratch — including how to design puzzles, writing a story, running a business, and pitching to investors and publishers. See you on the other side! By scrolling through the game's menu and looking at the prototypes in chronological order, you will learn tidbits about how the gameplay evolved over time, how we managed to tell a sci-fi story, and how the game slowly found its identity. We hope you enjoy this little package of game development nostalgia as much as we did putting it together! <3

rows.name: Eternal Night Glory
rows.short_description: From the beginning, you've got all the cards. Now, command the garrisons of the Gate of Radiance to stop them from approaching.
rows.description_html: In the dark corners, there are all kinds of them, which seem to appear suddenly. Chasing the brilliance and delusionally wanting to be a creature that shines brightly. The Gate of Radiance is their goal. And you will command the garrisons of the Gate of Radiance to stop them from approaching. For you, it doesn't matter if you fail, you have countless chances to fail, and they don't have a chance to succeed. The gates of radiance have never been opened to them. In this game, from the very beginning, you have all the cards And you lose the sense of accomplishment of unlocking cards in the game The balance of the game is approximately equal to nothing Who loves to play this game !? Game content The game has more than 20 building cards (Light Cards) and more than 100 functional cards (Radiance Cards) Start At the beginning of the game, you need to choose the difficulty and the building card that will be used in the game. Light door In the part of the game, the colored rings, you need to stop any monsters from approaching the light door. Otherwise, if the light door is not durable enough, the game fails. Building Cards can only be placed inside the light door. Layout Building: Tower When placing building cards inside a light gate during a match, most buildings will automatically attack the enemy closest to the light door When you put a building, you need to consume one resource: the light. The light grows automatically over time. It can also be obtained by laying out some specific buildings or using some Radiance Cards Gacha phase During the defense, enter the Radiance card gacha round every once in a while, This draws cards from decks you've built yourself. At this point, you'll need to choose the Radiance card you want to play to directly enhance your building, or synthesize/buy new cards to build your deck, etc. Victory Defended until the end of time.

rows.name: Physics World: Evolution
rows.short_description: Push the limits of what’s possible with physics in Physics World: Evolution!
rows.description_html: Enter the New World of Physics Welcome, Testers! Step into Physics World: Evolution,  the next-generation sandbox simulation where physics is your playground and curiosity is your guide. As the spiritual successor to 2023’s Physics Lab , this evolution delivers more tools, more locations, and a world layered with secrets waiting to be uncovered. New Tools. New Chaos. Push the limits of what’s possible using an expanded arsenal of physics tools and environmental objects. Launch explosives  or  detonate nukes . Shatter jars , rocks , and more with real-time physics interactions. Experiment freely across 5+ diverse testing labs , each with unique environments and potential outcomes. Whether you're stacking, smashing, or sending objects into orbit, your creativity is the only limit. Uncover a Hidden Past Behind the tests lies a deeper mystery… What happened to the world before you arrived? Scattered across the locations are hidden articles  and clues that hint at a story far bigger than any single experiment. Piece together the past and uncover the truth buried beneath the surface.

rows.short_description: 'Atropos' is a visual novel in which you will learn about the story of Atropos, the prince of Capernaum.
rows.description_html: For a long time, the kingdom of Capernaum has been ruled by the Khrushch dynasty - powerful beetles that rule over other insects. Atropos, the crown prince, decides not to wait for his father's death, but to take power by force. On the way to the throne, intrigues, difficulties and obstacles await him. Will Atropos be able to defeat his enemies, overthrow his father and become the head of the kingdom?

rows.name: Only The Lost Shall See
rows.short_description: Wander though nature. Overcome dangers. Get to the end of your pilgrimage... But don't dig any deeper.
rows.description_html: This humble 3D platformer is about peace of mind. Wander though nature. Overcome dangers. Get to the end of your pilgrimage. You may find distractions that will lead you down a bad path. You may want to stay clear of those. Unless you want to get lost. If you are looking for elaborate game mechanics, options to unlock skins and huge boss battles - well then you have come to the wrong place. This game is simply a singleplayer platformer. You should play this game if you want a break from tactical gameplay - or if you want unravel the purpose of this game. The goal of this game is simple; get to the end. Only you can decide where exactly the end is.

rows.name: Frak
rows.short_description: Frak is a fast-paced, movent shooter that is simply put a short rogue-like with charm.
rows.description_html: Frak is a fast-paced, movement-shooter, rogue-like that aims to immerse audiences with a simple gameplay loop. You play as an escaped employee trapped beneath the mines of a foreign planet attempting to escape against overwhelming odds the infected former coworkers of your facility. Will you survive, or you will you be trapped in the loop destined to cycle forever against unwavering forces? As a former worker, you will have access to maneuverability tech for traversing the mines. You will be able to wallrun and use your thrusters to dash through the air or boost around on the ground. The mines sought after a powerful material that gave those that wield it unique abilities. You can find these in each room designated by the doorways leading to different refinery sections. Collect the ancient material, grow stronger, and find a way to escape!

rows.name: Ryo And Gears
rows.short_description: A 2D pixel-graphics bullet-hell with a last-chance shield mechanic
rows.description_html: The game takes place in a world where machines roam the planet, where humans are rare to come by. Ryo is small humanoid robot tasked by its owner to retrieve six mythical circuits scattered across lands and seas. As Ryo's journey goes on, perhaps a truth unbeknownst will reveal itself, questioning the very purpose of Ryo's journey. Gameplay Fight a variety of foes divided into 5 chapters, each in a unique environment, most starting with easier enemies and ending with a boss. Ryo has but one hit point and a gearwheel , so be careful not to take two consecutive hits! Ryo fires highly pressurized four-way  steam cutters  to attack its enemies.

rows.name: VR Secretary: Ailey Edition
rows.short_description: VR Secretary puts you in a real office situation. You think you can handle anything, but the relationship with your secretary, Ailey? Cross the line, and your workplace journey might become unexpectedly “eventful”. Being a CEO may not be quite what you imagined.
rows.description_html: [Background] Congratulations on starting your CEO career! We’re here to teach you how to manage the relationship between you and your secretary. If you happen to experience anything else, well... that’s just your imagination running wild. [Game Feature] In VR Secretary , you will become a rookie CEO, managing not just the office, but also the subtle dynamics with your new secretary, Ailey. Here’s what awaits you: Immersive Roleplay: Take charge as a fresh CEO navigating a fully interactive VR office. From delegating tasks to sharing quiet moments after work, every scene brings you closer to the fine line between professionalism and personal connection. Dynamic Scenarios: From managing tasks in the office to sharing drinks after hours—every choice matters. High Interaction: Explore a variety of poses and enjoy the freedom to interact closely with your secretary, creating a highly immersive experience. [Tips] Before you begin the first day as a CEO, here are some practical tips to keep in mind: Tip 1 : Be polite and keep a professional distance! Tip 2 : Maintain proper social etiquette, even when drinking! Tip 3 : Once everything is organized, your career will reach the next level!  Prove you can stay cool, make the right calls, and survive the ultimate workplace challenge - if you can! Thank you for playing VR Secretary. We hope you enjoy every moment of your office journey!

rows.name: Deep Siege
rows.short_description: Deep Siege is a fast-paced, first-person endless wave shooter. Play as Akula, an Atlantean sharkfolk warrior, and defend your underwater realm against waves of mutated sea creatures. Rack up kills to gain buffs using Bloodthirst or heal during tough moments.
rows.description_html: Deep Siege is a fast-paced, first-person endless wave shooter set in the depths of an underwater world. Step into the role of Akula, a fearless Atlantean warrior of sharkfolk descent, as you battle relentless hordes of mutated sea creatures threatening your home. Harness your Bloodthirst ability, which builds with kill streaks and features three tiers, granting different buffs or allowing you to heal yourself in the heat of battle.

rows.name: Psi Academy: Orientation
rows.short_description: Finding love in a psychic high school.
rows.description_html: PSI ACADEMY: ORIENTATION +85,000 Words! 16 Sprited Characters! 50+ Expressive Choices! Extremely Generic Backgrounds! It is the year 94AP, ninety-four years after the alien comet struck the earth and reset the calendar, causing psions (‘psionically-gifted children') to be born around the world. Only 2% of the population is found to have such superpowers at adolescence, so when the ages passed you by wherein such powers typically manifest themselves, you resigned yourself to a lifetime *without* the powers of a demigod. Until today. Psi Academy is a slow-burn slice-of-life dating sim exploring the mundane in the fantastic. Set in a magical/superhero academy, you’ll find yourself making lots of fun, expressive choices as you make new friends (and enemies) and choose to pursue one of three female leads: You’ll also meet plenty of other curious characters, such as faculty, family, and other psychic students. Psi Academy is an attempt to capture what we first imagined when we heard the word ‘dating sim’, and we hope it is as much fun to play as it was to write. 🙂 Psi Academy: Orientation is the first project of Playdate Studios, hopefully it attracts attention so more games like it can be developed!

rows.name: Call of Clans
rows.short_description: Call of Clans is an online turn-based strategy card game set in a magical world. Build a versatile deck with minion and skill cards to challenge equally matched opponents in a world of swords and magic. Team up with others to conquer challenging co-op dungeons
rows.description_html: Call of Clans is an online turn-based strategy card game set in a Western fantasy world. You can build a dynamic and strategic deck using minion cards and skill cards to challenge equally matched opponents in a world of swords and magic. You can also team up with other players to tackle highly challenging co-op dungeons. Game Features Deck Building : Players can construct their decks using minion cards and skill cards. Minion cards are categorized into Normal, Elite, and Hero. Normal cards can be deployed up to 2 copies, while others can only be deployed once. Each deck can contain up to 30 cards, including both minion and skill cards. Gameplay : Players battle on a 3x10 grid, taking turns to move until the opponent’s or their own commander is defeated. Classes : Players can freely choose between four classes: Knight, Mage, Priest, and Hunter. Each deck can only use cards from a single class. Ladder Competition : Once the Tiani Arena is unlocked, you can compete against other players in thrilling matches. The ladder is reset each season, and based on the players’ ranking points, top players will earn not only prestige but also generous seasonal rewards. Team Mode : After unlocking team dungeons, you can team up with other players to challenge high-difficulty dungeons. Dungeons come in three difficulty levels: Easy, Normal, and Hard. The higher the difficulty, the greater the rewards.

rows.name: Ascent DX
rows.short_description: Crashed on a desolate but mysterious planet you find yourself eye to eye with an ancient civilisation. Explore the planet, find powerful upgrades, and fulfill your destiny.
rows.description_html: Ascent DX is a tiny metroidvania brought to life in glorious 64 x 64 pixel art and soothing chiptune music. Crashed on an unknown planet you have to explore lush jungles, lifeless deserts, and luminescent caves in search of anything that can help you understand what has happened to the planet and how to get off it. While the game is a bigger version of the original Ascent, with almost twice as many locations to explore, it is still quite a short game. With the same celebrated gameplay and atmosphere, the DX versions also brings more items to find, more platforming puzzles, and more lore to uncover.  FEATURES A world brought to life by tiny but expressive pixel art Explore the planet's many biomes in your own pace and direction Find new powers and abilities that help you on your way Uncover the fate of the planet as well as your own  Different endings based on how much was discovered CREDITS Design, code, & pixel art: Johan Peitz Music & sfx: Brent Houston Capsule art: Jon Nielsen

rows.name: Our Winding Road
rows.short_description: retired heroes-domestic-fantasy-breakup(?)-adventure
rows.description_html: Disillusioned with civilian life, former heroes Rowan and Jori retrace the steps of the journey on which they fell in love, with the hopes of rekindling their strained relationship. Assume the role of the-great-“Ogre Slayer”-turned-desk-jockey Rowan, brave the various dangers lurking on your way, yourself being chief among them. Will you and your love find your way back together again, or will this journey mark the end for you two? Mature Warning: Contains explicit descriptions of sex. (Can be avoided via an in-game choice) -32k words -Multiple endings  -Animated sprites and backgrounds  -Immersive soundscape  -Enough puns to bring you to tears, or drown your sorrows, your choice A collaborative effort by Square Weasel Studio and friends, made for Amare Jam 2023. Game, Art & Story Direction:  Nim & Ze Environment Art:  Sarianne, Nim Sprites and Character Design: Rinnuah (with a little help from Nim & Ze) UI Design and Coding Support:  Ayael Writing and Editing: Nim & Ze, Brombeer Programming:  RodFireProductions Scripting: Nim & Ze Animation: Ze Sound Design: Nim & Ze Proofreading:  Rinnuah,  Brombeer,  Aetheries Music and Sound: Samuel Francis Johnson, Musictown, William King, MaxKoMusic, Scott Buckley, Alexander Nakarada, Check Out Square Weasel's Other Games: Chronicles of Taldun: The Remainder Chronicles of Taldun: The Longing

rows.name: Sewers Adventures
rows.short_description: Dive into Sewers where you will find a secret lab filled with terrifying creatures. Face the horrors of a fallen scientist and try to escape his dark legacy. This project was conceived in the context of a Level Design programming course.
rows.description_html: Dive into the twisted depths of Sewers Adventure , where science meets horror in an unforgettable mini-game experience. Step into the boots of a daring investigator unraveling the tragic story of a brilliant but reckless scientist who transformed the sewers into his sprawling secret laboratory. Driven by ambition, he created terrifying creatures—but his hubris led to his ultimate demise at the hands of his own experiments. Navigate claustrophobic tunnels, and survive encounters with grotesque monstrosities as you piece together the scientist's dark legacy. Will you escape the depths, or will you become another victim of his ill-fated ambition? Prepare to descend. The sewers await.

rows.name: Cobble: The Stone Forager
rows.short_description: Gather resources and explore to help lost settlers build a new home in this relaxing, foraging RPG.
rows.description_html: When a group of shipwreck survivors wash up on the shores of a strange quiet island, the last thing they expected was a miracle. With no supplies and no idea where to get food, the settlers begin searching for help before stumbling across a sleeping stone automaton. When one brave settler takes a closer look, the stone giant awakens and offers to help the villagers build a home. Cobble: The Stone Forager is an adventure resource-gathering game where you play as the friendly stone giant, Cobble. Help the shipwrecked settlers build up their town by gathering and foraging for supplies. Unlock new areas and trade with the settlers to get stronger materials. Rediscover the story of Cobble's creator and rebuild what has been lost. This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: Jumping Henry
rows.short_description: Jump, collect coins, and enjoy a fun, easy adventure for players
rows.description_html: Jumping Henry is a fun and simple adventure game where you collect coins and jump your way through exciting challenges. Whether you're a casual gamer or someone looking for a relaxing experience, Jumping Henry provides a delightful and engaging journey for everyone. Jump, collect, and enjoy the ride!
